chapters.title: Chapter 4651: Buddhist Land
paragraphs: Chapter 4651: Buddhist Land
Pond of Life!

A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. The power of will of all living beings was naturally also a type of power. Furthermore, after being processed, it could be considered the purest kind of power.
In the whole universe, what force had gathered the most power of belief?
If the Buddhist Race claimed to be second, no one would dare claim to be first.

Moreover, even if the power of will gathered by all the forces ranked from second to 100th were added together, they probably wouldn’t be able to compare to the Buddhist Race. In fact, they might not even be able to compare to a fraction of the power of will gathered by the Buddhist Race.
Just look at the universe in its heyday. How many people were believers of the Buddhist Race?
Thus, the power of belief in this Pond of Life would definitely be extremely terrifying.
Ling Han believed that as long as he could enter the Pond of Life once, he would definitely be able to satisfy the appetite of the Seed of the Holy Flame.
“If I want to become a Saint as soon as possible, there is only one way, and that is to sneak into the Buddhist Land!”
In the past, this would have been impossible.
Why?
That was because they had absolutely no idea where the Buddhist Land was.
Without even knowing where it was, how could he sneak in?

It could be said that though the Buddhist Race was the most renowned force in the universe, with no equal, in terms of the mystery of their ancestral grounds, the Buddhist Race was completely comparable to the Battle God Palace.
But now, the Buddhist Race had revealed their identities. They were one of the Twelve Lands of Death, and a large number of elites had come out of the Buddhist Race to participate in this great war.
Thus, the location of Buddhist Land was naturally exposed.
Ling Han was skilled and courageous. He was already a fifteen-star Venerate, and his battle prowess had already reached thirteen or fourteen stars of Saint Tier. What did he have to fear?
Even if he was discovered, he could still leave calmly.
More importantly, it was not that all of the Buddhist Race were of the same bloodline as their Great Emperor, which gave him the chance to sneak in.
Ling Han informed everyone, and then set out on his journey alone.
This was the ancestral grounds of the Buddhist Race. In fact, it was possible that even Ah Han, the Ancestral Buddha, was hidden there.

Though these ancient Great Emperors had all sorts of reservations, and would definitely not make a move unless absolutely necessary, they only had to revive the Imperial Weapon, then even a Pseudo-Emperor would have to turn around and run.
Thus, it was more appropriate for Ling Han to go alone. Once the Seed of the Holy Flame absorbed enough energy, he would immediately run.
“As a thief, I have to keep a low profile.”

Ling Han entered into the Void and activated the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. His speed was astonishingly fast, and after a long while, he reappeared in the Void. This place was already filled with a sinister air, and he could barely sense the Regulations of the Living Realm.
He hadn’t become a Saint yet, so he was unable to absorb Regulations. Thus, his battle prowess would fall drastically in this place.
Thankfully, his spiritual power was strong enough, and he could completely use this as a weapon to unleash astonishing destructive power.
Moreover, he could also use Destructive Energy, which was still a deadly weapon.
“However, now that I’m here, I really have to keep a low profile.”
It was very fast for him to come out of here. In just a few days, the Buddhist Land appeared in front of him.
This was really a piece of land, floating directly in space.
However, this piece of land was extraordinarily huge, several times larger than the surface area of many planets.
There was a layer of light enshrouding this piece of land, forming a shield of light. In the darkness of space, it appeared very striking.
Ling Han walked over, carefully created an opening, and then entered.

The defenses of this shield of light were very strong, but Ling Han was already at the strength of a top-notch Saint by now. Thus, no one naturally noticed that he had created a small opening to sneak in. He then repaired it.
Then, with a leap, Ling Han landed on the ground.
Yi?
He shockingly discovered that the Regulations here had once again become richer.
It could be said that though this mainland was presently in the environment of the Netherworld, it was still detached from the outside world.
“The Lords of the Twelve Lands of Death, commanding the Netherworld to create chaos, what exactly are they planning?”
“Will letting the Netherworld invade allow them to attain immortality?”
Ling Han found this inconceivable. He couldn’t figure it out no matter what.
No matter how he looked at it, this would lead to only one conclusion, and that was the destruction of the Living Realm.
But the problem was, weren’t those ancient Imperial Sons all living beings? Oh, burying countless eras to come to this era, all for the sake of becoming Yin souls?
That was impossible.
“This is something that only those Lords of Death know.”
Ling Han hid himself, because a village had appeared ahead of him.

There was a large area of farmland around the village, and it could be seen that there were farmers working in the fields. Upon a closer look, these rice grains were not ordinary rice grains, but rather as tall as a man, and the stalks they bore were also astonishingly large.
Yi, this was Celestial Rice.

Ling Han nodded. If one ingested the Celestial Rice for a long period of time, it would be much more beneficial for cultivators. It could allow their meridians to be unobstructed, and their physical body to develop spiritual power. Cultivating would naturally be half the work, but double the effect.
Looking at these farmers again, they were all mortals, but there was no shortage of Meridian Opening and Blood Transformation Tiers.

By the looks of it, though these farmers weren’t the main people enjoying the benefits of the Celestial Rice, they would definitely be able to eat a little. That was why they could reach Meridian Opening and Blood Transformation Tier without even cultivating.
He observed this village for three days, and had already gained a considerable understanding of it.
In this place, the villagers did indeed farm for a living, but there was also a chance that they could stand out among others.
That was to practice martial arts.

A good seedling would be taken in as a disciple by the Martial Hall of the city. Once he took this step, it would mean a change in his fate. From now onwards, he would be able to cast off his identity as a farmer, become a landlord, or even become a noble.
All right, he had an idea.
Ling Han set his sights on a person called Zhang Hanjun.

This person was an orphan. Both his parents had died when he was young, and he did not have any other relatives. Thus, Ling Han moved, and knocked this person out. Then, he sealed off his vital signs, and buried him deep underground.
Although Zhang Hanjun was a Buddhist, he was clearly an innocent person. Ling Han naturally couldn’t kill him directly.
No matter how strong his abilities were, Ling Han still had a bottom line that he wouldn’t cross.
Otherwise, what difference would there be between him and the Lords of Death, those fallen Great Emperors?
Then, Ling Han became Zhang Hanjun.
After a few more days, the Martial Hall would send someone over to recruit disciples. Ling Han had his sights set on this opportunity.
First Martial Hall, then advance all the way, then enter the Pond of Life, satisfy the Seed of the Holy Flame, and leave.
En, it was that simple.
Ling Han took his place. Every day, he would practice martial arts in his room, and did not go to farm, which attracted the pointing fingers of the villagers.

There was no other reason for this. This was because Zhang Hanjun was already 17 years old this year. He had already participated in the recruitment test for the Martial Hall two years ago, but he had never been chosen.
Thus, in the eyes of the villagers, he should have given up long ago. He should have been working hard on farming, and should not have fantasized about something that was completely impossible.
Four days later, someone came from the Martial Hall.
On this day, a great many villagers deliberately stopped their farm work, and brought their sons and daughters to the open space at the village entrance.
This was the key to changing the fate of their children. They were also filled with anticipation.
Only Ling Han was alone. The majority of people looked at him not with sympathy, but with mockery and disdain.
As expected, this person was really biting off more than he could chew. He was completely unrealistic.
You are already seventeen years old, and that is your last chance to enroll in the Martial Hall, but having failed twice, is that not enough to make you give up?
Do you have to crash into a wall before you could turn around?

chapters.title: Chapter 4652: Test
paragraphs: Chapter 4652: Test
“Zhang Hanjun, you are really thick-skinned!” A young man declared coldly. He directly pointed at Ling Han’s nose, “I have already told you, Yuanyuan is not someone that you are worthy of at all!”
Yi, this involved romantic relations as well?
Ling Han was surprised. Because he had not searched Zhang Hanjun’s memories, he did not know much about this either.
Thus, he only smiled faintly, expressing his disdain in a soundless reply.
“Looks like you won’t turn back until you’ve crashed into a wall!” the youth continued to mock.
“Who are you?” Ling Han asked.
Pu, that young man almost died from fury. He actually dared to pretend that he did not know him?
He naturally didn’t know that Ling Han was telling the truth. He genuinely didn’t know him.
“I’m Zhao Jian!” the youth roared. “This time, I’ll enter the Martial Hall, and from now on, I’ll rise above everyone else. My future isn’t something you can imagine!”
“Oh,” Ling Han replied with a nod.
With his status, would he care about the provocation of a young man? Moreover, the one whom he was provoking was Zhang Hanjun, not him.
Faced with Ling Han’s attitude, it was as if Zhao Jian had encountered a porcupine. He had absolutely no idea where to attack, and could only glare angrily.
Forget it. As long as he entered the Martial Hall, Zhang Hanjun would only be able to look up to him, so what need was there for him to be concerned?
He was destined to become a mighty figure in the future. It was completely meaningless to lower himself to the level of this kind of trash.
On the other side, the people from the Martial Hall also began their test.
This was a middle-aged man with an arrogant expression. He took out a rock and had the young men and women here place their hands on it.
If one’s natural talent in martial arts was high, the stone would light up. The higher one’s natural talent, the more intense the light would be.
However, up until now, there had not been a single person that could make the stone glow.

This village wasn’t large, and there were only a total of 17 young men and women who had come to undergo the test. By now, there were already 14 people who had completed the test, and all of them looked gloomy.

Their parents, meanwhile, comforted them. Natural talent in martial arts did not always show at fifteen years old. Some people would be later, reaching sixteen or even seventeen years old. That was why the Martial Hall had given them a time limit of three years.
If they couldn’t do it today, then they would do it next year. If they couldn’t do it next year, then there was still the year after next!
“I’ll go!” Zhao Jian walked up.
He had been clever and quick-witted since childhood. Though he was only fifteen now, he had already cultivated to the Blood Transformation Tier, far surpassing his peers.
Hence, he was incredibly confident.
He walked in front of the middle-aged man from the Martial Hall and stretched out his hand, placing it on the stone that the latter was holding.
The stone instantly lit up, and it was extremely bright at that.
“A-grade prodigy!” The eyes of the middle-aged man from the Martial Hall immediately lit up, revealing an excited expression.
For someone like him who had come out to enroll students, though there was no necessary quota he had to fulfill, if he enrolled prodigies B grade and above, he would also be able to receive rewards.
And an A-grade prodigy… it would be difficult to pick even one out of 10,000 qualified prodigies.
He was rich!
He was extremely excited. Now that he had discovered an A-grade prodigy, the rewards he would receive would also be incredibly generous.
“Cough, what’s your name?” the middle-aged man from the Martial Hall asked, trying his best to suppress the excitement in his heart.

An A-grade prodigy! In the future, he would at least be able to become an elite of the True Self Tier. If they could form a good relationship now, he would naturally become a powerful backer in the future.
Though Zhao Jian was young, he was a smart man. He could tell from the slight changes in the other’s expression.
He couldn’t help but break into a smile, and said somewhat proudly, “My name is Zhao Jian.”

“My name is Li Yun, and you can call me Big Brother Li,” the middle-aged man from the Martial Hall said. “In the future, when you enter the Martial Hall, you can look for me if you encounter any problems.”
“Thank you, Big Brother Li.” Zhao Jian nodded. At present, he was still very weak, so he had to give Li Yun some face. As for the future? Hehe.
“Big Brother Li!” With a thought, he pointed at Ling Han and whispered, “Can you help me deal with this brat?”
“No problem,” Li Yun promised.
It wasn’t like he didn’t know Ling Han. He had already participated in two consecutive tests, and had not passed either time.
Although some people awakened their natural talent in martial arts later, if most of them didn’t succeed once or twice, it was impossible for them to awaken it in the future.
Thus, Li Yun naturally assigned Ling Han to the majority.
For the sake of an A-grade prodigy, he was naturally willing to mess around with someone who did not have natural talent in cultivation.
This was a favor.
Another person stepped forward to take the test. This was the second last person, and in the end, they still couldn’t light up the stone.
Only Ling Han was left.
“Hehe, I remember you. You’re Zhang Hanjun, right?” Li Yun asked with a smile.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, “I am.”
“You’ve already failed twice, yet you’re still unwilling to give up?” Li Yun said, mercilessly attacking Ling Han. “If courage can be used to cultivate, you have a good chance of becoming a prodigy.”
Yi, this mouth of his was not too bad.𝐟𝚛𝕖𝚎𝕨𝗲𝐛𝚗𝐨𝐯𝐞𝕝.𝐜𝗼𝗺
Ling Han didn’t immediately speak. Instead, he stared at Li Yun for a while, and said, “You didn’t wash your face when you woke up this morning, so it’s a little dirty.”
Li Yun’s mouth almost twisted in anger. ‘What kind of thought process is going on in your head? Why is the focus of your attention so different from the norm?’

At first, he had wanted to strike a blow on Ling Han, but now, he was no longer in the mood. He pointed at the rock in his palm, and urged, “Begin quickly! Humph, in any case, it is only a waste of time.”
Ling Han smiled, and placed his hand on it.
Just as everyone thought, there was no movement from the rock at all.
But just as Zhao Jian was about to begin mocking him, a majestic light burst forth.
It was incredibly dazzling.
This!
Everyone was stunned. In fact, this light was even more dazzling than what Zhao Jian had unleashed previously.
The brighter it was, the higher one’s natural talent in cultivation would be. This was something that everyone knew.
Hiss, Zhao Jian was already an A-grade prodigy, then what about Ling Han?
There were even higher grade prodigies above A-grade?
Zhao Jian was also dumbfounded. From Li Yun’s reaction, he knew just how awesome an A-grade prodigy was, but now, the aptitude of “Zhang Hanjun” was actually superior to his?
This was something that he could not accept!
The most awkward person was definitely Li Yun.
He saw that Zhao Jian’s natural talent was astonishing, and immediately wanted to form good relations with him. For this reason, he deliberately targeted Ling Han.
He had never thought that his face would be slapped so quickly.
“Earth Grade aptitude!” he exclaimed as if he had seen a ghost. Heavens, in his lifetime, he would actually encounter such a super seed!
Above A-grade was Earth Grade aptitude aptitude. As long as there weren’t too many problems, that kind of prodigy could definitely charge up to Spirit Transformation Tier.
…He didn’t know that if Ling Han didn’t control it, he would see Heaven Grade aptitude, or perhaps even higher.
Ling Han nodded, “Notify me when we set out.”
After saying this, he turned around and left.
He was calm and composed.
Though his natural talent in cultivation was even more awesome than Zhao Jian, but look, he was really too calm.
Show off!
A considerable number of villagers were cursing internally, but Ling Han’s future prospects were boundless now. Who would dare say such words to his face?
Only Zhao Jian clenched his fists, his expression twisted.
Ling Han actually ignored him!
Previously, he had mocked Ling Han so much, but after Ling Han had gained the upper hand, he actually ignored him completely.
He was being completely ignored!
This was even more humiliating than being reprimanded to his face.

Instead, he stared at Li Yun for a while, and said, “You didn’t wash your face when you woke up this morning, so it’s a little dirty.”
Li Yun’s mouth almost twisted in anger. ‘What kind of thought process is going on in your head?
Why is the focus of your attention so different from the norm?’
At first, he had wanted to strike a blow on Ling Han, but now, he was no longer in the mood.
He pointed at the rock in his palm, and urged, “Begin quickly!
Humph, in any case, it is only a waste of time.”
Ling Han smiled, and placed his hand on it.
Just as everyone thought, there was no movement from the rock at all.
But just as Zhao Jian was about to begin mocking him, a majestic light burst forth.
It was incredibly dazzling.
This!
Everyone was stunned.
In fact, this light was even more dazzling than what Zhao Jian had unleashed previously.
The brighter it was, the higher one’s natural talent in cultivation would be.
This was something that everyone knew.
Hiss, Zhao Jian was already an A-grade prodigy, then what about Ling Han?
There were even higher grade prodigies above A-grade?
Zhao Jian was also dumbfounded.
From Li Yun’s reaction, he knew just how awesome an A-grade prodigy was, but now, the aptitude of “Zhang Hanjun” was actually superior to his?
This was something that he could not accept!
The most awkward person was definitely Li Yun.
He saw that Zhao Jian’s natural talent was astonishing, and immediately wanted to form good relations with him.
For this reason, he deliberately targeted Ling Han.
He had never thought that his face would be slapped so quickly.
“Earth Grade aptitude!” he exclaimed as if he had seen a ghost.
Heavens, in his lifetime, he would actually encounter such a super seed!
Above A-grade was Earth Grade aptitude aptitude.
As long as there weren’t too many problems, that kind of prodigy could definitely charge up to Spirit Transformation Tier.
…He didn’t know that if Ling Han didn’t control it, he would see Heaven Grade aptitude, or perhaps even higher.
Ling Han nodded, “Notify me when we set out.”
After saying this, he turned around and left.
He was calm and composed.
Though his natural talent in cultivation was even more awesome than Zhao Jian, but look, he was really too calm.
Show off!
A considerable number of villagers were cursing internally, but Ling Han’s future prospects were boundless now.
Who would dare say such words to his face?
Only Zhao Jian clenched his fists, his expression twisted.
Ling Han actually ignored him!
Previously, he had mocked Ling Han so much, but after Ling Han had gained the upper hand, he actually ignored him completely.
He was being completely ignored!
This was even more humiliating than being reprimanded to his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 4653: Currying favor
paragraphs: Chapter 4653: Currying favor
Zhang Hanjun was actually a prodigy!
This explosive piece of news instantly spread throughout the small village, and became a topic of idle gossip, and before this, Zhao Jian, who was also a prodigy, was only occasionally mentioned.
This naturally made Zhao Jian want to commit murder. However, if he wanted to deal with Ling Han now, Li Yun would be the first to stop him.

He could only swallow his anger for the moment, and told himself that his aptitude was not too bad either. As long as he worked hard on cultivation after entering into the Martial Hall, he could still trample “Zhang Hanjun” beneath his feet.
He and Ling Han each had a night’s time to prepare. Early the next morning, they were going to follow Li Yun into the city to enter the Martial Hall.
And that night, in Ling Han’s extremely dilapidated straw hut, there were many visitors.

None of them were idiots. Ling Han was definitely going to make a name for himself in the future. If they didn’t take advantage of this opportunity to curry his favor, would they still have a chance in the future?
“Hanjun, I can tell that you’re no ordinary person. One day, you’ll detach from the mortal world and become a dragon!”
“This is what it means to be silent for three years, and amaze the world with a single feat.”
“Come, this is Aunty Liu’s knitted clothing. Take it with you. After a while, the weather will turn cold.”
These neighbors were all asking about his well-being, wanting nothing more than to take him as their godson.
Ling Han merely smiled faintly. If these people found out in future that he was not Zhang Hanjun at all, what kind of expressions would they have?

“Out of the way! Out of the way!” At this moment, a middle-aged man in his forties came through the crowd. He was also dragging a young girl with him. By the looks of it, she should be his daughter. Otherwise, it would be inappropriate for a man and a woman to have bodily contact.
“It’s Ma Yunlai.”
“Tsk, tsk, tsk, he has a good daughter!”

The people around them immediately began discussing in low voices. This Ma Yunlai was a well-known layabout in the village, but good bamboo shoots sprouted from bad seeds1. Though the daughter he had was only fourteen years old, she had already revealed her beauty. What young man in the village would not think of her?
Zhang Hanjun was one of them, and Zhao Jian was also completely captivated by her. This was the “Yuanyuan” that he had spoken of.

Arriving in front of Ling Han, Ma Yunlai rubbed his hands together, and said, “Hanjun, you’re not young anymore. Furthermore, both your parents have passed away. Today, Uncle will make a decision for you, and betroth you and Yuanyuan.”

If he could turn “Zhang Hanjun” into his son-in-law, then no matter how successful the latter would become in future, he could also stick to him. No matter what, he would not be missing out on this kind of benefit.
Thus, though he was lazy, he was not the slightest bit stupid.
Ling Han swept an eye over the father and daughter duo. They were both extremely thin, and it was clear that they didn’t eat much.
This young girl did indeed have a bit of beauty. Of course, this was because there were too few people in the village. Among the masses that were not outstanding in appearance, she stood out.
In the eyes of the people in the city, they would probably despise her for being too much of a village girl.

Ling Han smiled. Since the main character liked this girl so much, and he was borrowing his identity, then he would treat this little girl better. He brought over the roast chicken and rice cakes that his neighbors had given him, and handed them over to the young girl.
“Eat,” he said softly.

The young girl was shy, and did not reach out to take it, but how could her father be polite? He took the food in one go, and wolfed it down himself first. Then, he reprimanded his daughter, “Whatever Hanjun has given you, just take it. We are a family, so what are you afraid of!”
Hearing these words, the young girl couldn’t help but blush, but she also seemed to feel uncomfortable from hunger. She reached out to pick up a rice cake, and began to eat it in small bites.
Ling Han didn’t mind this. As long as it didn’t affect his plans, he didn’t mind helping these people. It could be considered as doing a good deed for Zhang Hanjun.

Though Ling Han was not very cordial, his words also implied that when he became a mighty figure in future, he would give back to his fellow villagers. Thus, everyone was very pleased. When night fell, they all took their leave.
“Yuanyuan, you can sleep here today.” When Ma Yunlai walked out of the thatched cottage, he turned around and blocked his daughter inside.
The young girl’s face instantly flushed bright red again. She was incredibly embarrassed, but did not dare to oppose her father, and only looked at him pleadingly.
But since Ma Yunlai had already said so, how could he possibly change his mind?
He roughly pushed his daughter into the house, then closed the door behind him, looking like a pimp.
Hehe, as long as “Zhang Hanjun” slept with his daughter, then everything would be over. There was no way he could renege on this.
The young girl was at a loss for what to do, and lowered her head to play with the hem of her clothes.
A young girl in her prime, pure and ignorant, was extremely alluring.
However, in Ling Han’s eyes, there was already no difference among all the living beings in the world. Men and women were merely different manifestations of lige.
There was not much difference between this young girl and a lamb outside the house.
“Do you want to practice martial arts?” Ling Han asked.
The young girl had not thought that Ling Han would suddenly ask such a question. After being stunned for a moment, she nodded, “Yes.”
“I’ll teach you,” Ling Han said with a smile. He had nothing to do anyway.
Rather than relying on others to help them after they achieved meteoric success, it would be better to rely on one’s own efforts to achieve meteoric success.
The young girl couldn’t help but look curious, “Can I also practice martial arts?”

Cultivating martial arts consumed a lot of energy, and needed to be accompanied by medicinal baths. It was very hard for poor families to afford it. Usually, the boys in the family would be the ones to cultivate martial arts, because girls would have to get married in future, after all.
Since they were considered water that would be poured out of the family in future, why waste money?
Ling Han smiled, “Sure.”
He taught a cultivation technique to the young girl. This was directly harvesting the energy of heaven and earth, and not completing Meridian Opening Tier through the method of Body Arts.
The young girl was stunned. This was a legendary cultivation technique!
It was said that this was a supreme bible that only the noble masters of the city could grasp. She had not thought that “Zhang Hanjun” would actually have it as well.
No wonder his natural talent was so high.
Ling Han wasn’t afraid of revealing the secret. In any case, he could say that he had obtained it by chance in the mountains.

He would “bloom” his talent as soon as possible, and only then would he be able to charge into the core area of the Buddhist Land in a short amount of time, and sneak into the Pond of Life. Thus, his cultivation level had to soar like he had a cheat code.
Thus, passing on a cultivation technique to the young girl was no big deal.
He slept with his clothes on, and after the young girl mulled over the cultivation technique for a while, she too fell asleep in a daze.
If there was anyone who could not sleep at this time, it would definitely be Zhao Jian.
He had lost to “Zhang Hanjun” in the day, and at night, even the woman he liked stayed in “Zhang Hanjun’s” thatched cottage. Just thinking about it, he knew what this beast, “Zhang Hanjun”, would do.
“We are irreconcilable!” He lay on the ground, swearing to the moon outside the window, clenching his fists tightly.
The night passed, and Ling Han and Zhao Jian set out with Li Yun.

Li Yun wasn’t some Saint or Venerate. He couldn’t bring the two of them to tear a rip into space, and he also didn’t have any means of transportation. The three of them had to cross the muddy land one step at a time before crossing mountains and ridges.

They wouldn’t be able to reach the city in a day’s time. At night, they would still have to spend the night in the mountains. Hearing the roars of tigers and the howls of wolves, Zhao Jian and Li Yun were both on tenterhooks.

chapters.title: Chapter 4654: Fortune Dragon City
paragraphs: Chapter 4654: Fortune Dragon City

There were fierce beasts in the mountains, and this was something that everyone knew. Moreover, Li Yun was only an Enlightenment Tier. What if they encountered a Mystery Realm Tier-level or even Celestial Path-level fierce beast?
The only fate would be death.

Thus, Li Yun didn’t dare to lead the two of them in a straight path at all. Instead, they circled around the mountains, fearing that they would encounter powerful ferocious beasts deep in the mountains, and never return.
This naturally depressed Ling Han. As long as this Li Yun was braver, he was completely capable of releasing the slightest bit of his aura, and have the wild beasts avoid them.
Sigh, then he’ll just take things slowly.
At night, the three of them took turns keeping watch.

Ling Han discovered that when it was Zhao Jian’s turn to keep watch, he had repeatedly revealed killing intent, but the latter was still a fourteen to fifteen year old young man, after all, and could not make up his mind. Thus, he had not made a move all this while.
Ling Han didn’t take it to heart, and pretended not to see it.
After a whole nine days, they finally walked out of the great mountain, and a vast great city appeared ahead of them.

“So this is the Fortune Dragon City?” Zhao Jian murmured. This city stretched over 50 km, and the majestic structures were even more than three hundred meters tall. To a village youth, this was naturally an incredibly shocking scene.
Li Yun couldn’t help but reveal a hint of pride and disdain. What a country bumpkin!
And this was only outside the city. If you entered into the city, and saw that endless golden wall of glory, wouldn’t your eyes pop out in shock?
However, why was only one person shocked?
He looked at Ling Han, and felt that this young man was really incredibly calm, as if he was already used to seeing such things.
Good willpower! Good temperament!

Li Yun’s opinion of Ling Han instantly rose a few notches higher. They had both just arrived, yet Ling Han’s expression was as calm as could be. In comparison, the difference between them was obvious.
He was even more certain of his own judgement. Ling Han’s future was brighter than Zhao Jian’s.
He definitely had to cling to this powerful backer. In future, he would definitely be able to obtain benefits.
The three of them set out, heading towards the city.

There was a city restriction in the Fortune Dragon City. If one was not registered as a resident of the city, they would only be able to obtain a temporary residence permit, and could stay for three days, five days, ten days, and so on, depending on the purpose of entering into the city that was expressed when they had registered their residence permit.
If he didn’t leave the city before the time limit expired, that would be a serious crime. If he was caught, he would be severely punished.

For Ling Han and Zhao Jian, they would first get a temporary residence permit for three days, and after they passed the examination of the Martial Hall, they would change to a long-term residence permit. In fact, it was even possible that they could obtain a citizenship permit.
If he obtained a citizenship permit, he would be a citizen of the city. If this was a village, this would be considered bringing glory to his ancestors. He would be outstanding.
Li Yun registered permits for them, then the three of them entered into the city. On the way, Zhao Jian couldn’t help but exclaim in shock.

Everything in the city widened his horizons, especially when he walked past the brothels. Those scantily clad girls were all making a show of themselves there, which made Zhao Jian, a young man who had just experienced the first awakening of love, extremely excited. He almost spluttered out a nosebleed.
At this moment, the girl that the youth had once adored immediately vanished without a trace.
That had only been the ignorant first love of a young man, and was not unforgettable. Now that he had suffered such a huge impact, it immediately crumbled and crumbled.
As it turned out, there were actually so many beautiful young ladies in this world. As it turned out, women could also be so enchanting and captivating.
He was reluctant to leave, and even his steps slowed.
Li Yun smiled, and pulled the youth along with him.
He knew that as long as this young man worked hard on cultivation, in future, to say nothing of women in this kind of brothel, even the daughters of prestigious clans would throw themselves at him.
Very soon, the three of them arrived at the Martial Hall.

“So big!” Zhao Jian couldn’t help but blurt out. Merely the area encircled by the Martial Hall’s walls was larger than their entire village, and the whitewashed walls were spotless, making him exclaim that there was actually such a clean place in this world.

Led by Li Yun, the three of them entered into the Martial Hall. First, he settled Ling Han and Zhao Jian down. Then, Li Yun went to make his report. Within three days, there would be a second test for Ling Han and Zhao Jian, to ensure that Li Yun had not accepted bribery from the two of them and helped them cheat.

Only two days later, the two of them were brought for another test, and in these two days, Zhao Jian did not even dare to step out of his rooms, fearing that he would break the rules, and be kicked back into the village.
Having just witnessed true prosperity, how could he be willing to return to that backward, poor place?

Ling Han and Zhao Jian weren’t the only ones who were undergoing the test today. There were seven other youths. Naturally, they had just been brought over from a village as well. All of them were extremely careful, not even daring to breathe loudly.
“Don’t be nervous. As long as you can pass the test, you’re a disciple of our Martial Hall,” a middle-aged man walked out and said to the youths with a smile.
This caused the youths to regain their composure. Then, the test began.

Because they knew that there would be a second test like this, the people who went to the villages to conduct the recruitment test naturally did not dare to do anything untoward. Thus, the results of everyone’s test were the same as the first time — except for Ling Han.
As Li Yun watched, he kept having a feeling that this light, tsk, was slightly different in brightness.
It was an illusion, it must be an illusion. How could it possibly be different? Hehe, he was really an idiot.
Among the nine candidates, Ling Han’s aptitude was the highest, followed by Zhao Jian’s. The others were far inferior, and there was not even a single B grade among them.

Thus, Ling Han and Zhao Jian both received extremely good treatment, and were allocated a private room. Furthermore, they would be able to obtain a packet of medicinal bath ingredients every three days.
Another few days later, the recruitment work for the Martial Hall this year ended.
This time, a total of 27 new disciples had been recruited, and only three of them were female, which showed how much this world favored men over women.
At this time, the 27 people were all brought to the basement. There was an underground spring there, which turned into a large pool, and steam was bubbling from within.

“This is Earth Flame Spring Water, which is greatly beneficial for unblocking meridians and improving one’s physique,” a trainer of the Martial Hall said. “You guys only have this one chance to enter the pool to absorb the benefits.”
“There’s no time limit. However, once you come out, you won’t be able to enter again.”
“That’s because you won’t be able to obtain any benefits even if you enter again.”
“Those who maintained the longest record in the pool stayed for a total of one and a half days.”
“Hehe, I wonder if any of you can break records.”𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
“Go into the water.”
He waved a hand dismissively.

There was another trainer beside him, and he said in a low voice with a smile, “Have you given these brats a motivation talk again? You have to know that the record holder is presently one of the four great War Gods and Guardian Deities of our Buddhist Race!”
“Hehe, giving these brats a goal is what motivates them,” the first trainer said with a smile.
The youths were all young and impetuous, and none of them would submit easily. Immediately, a competitive spirit rose up in them, and they all walked into the hot spring.
Wasn’t it just taking a bath? To say nothing of a day and a half, what was so difficult about taking a bath for ten days or even half a month?
However, when they stepped in, they almost immediately jumped out again.
Gods, it was too hot. Were they going to be cooked alive?
Hiss!
Only now did they know why the longest record was only one and a half days. This was really not a place for humans.

Li Yun registered permits for them, then the three of them entered into the city.
On the way, Zhao Jian couldn’t help but exclaim in shock.
Everything in the city widened his horizons, especially when he walked past the brothels.
Those scantily clad girls were all making a show of themselves there, which made Zhao Jian, a young man who had just experienced the first awakening of love, extremely excited.
He almost spluttered out a nosebleed.
At this moment, the girl that the youth had once adored immediately vanished without a trace.
That had only been the ignorant first love of a young man, and was not unforgettable.
Now that he had suffered such a huge impact, it immediately crumbled and crumbled.
As it turned out, there were actually so many beautiful young ladies in this world.
As it turned out, women could also be so enchanting and captivating.
He was reluctant to leave, and even his steps slowed.
Li Yun smiled, and pulled the youth along with him.
He knew that as long as this young man worked hard on cultivation, in future, to say nothing of women in this kind of brothel, even the daughters of prestigious clans would throw themselves at him.
Very soon, the three of them arrived at the Martial Hall.
“So big!” Zhao Jian couldn’t help but blurt out.

Merely the area encircled by the Martial Hall’s walls was larger than their entire village, and the whitewashed walls were spotless, making him exclaim that there was actually such a clean place in this world.
Led by Li Yun, the three of them entered into the Martial Hall.
First, he settled Ling Han and Zhao Jian down.
Then, Li Yun went to make his report.
Within three days, there would be a second test for Ling Han and Zhao Jian, to ensure that Li Yun had not accepted bribery from the two of them and helped them cheat.

Only two days later, the two of them were brought for another test, and in these two days, Zhao Jian did not even dare to step out of his rooms, fearing that he would break the rules, and be kicked back into the village.
Having just witnessed true prosperity, how could he be willing to return to that backward, poor place?
Ling Han and Zhao Jian weren’t the only ones who were undergoing the test today.
There were seven other youths.
Naturally, they had just been brought over from a village as well.
All of them were extremely careful, not even daring to breathe loudly.
“Don’t be nervous.
As long as you can pass the test, you’re a disciple of our Martial Hall,” a middle-aged man walked out and said to the youths with a smile.
This caused the youths to regain their composure.
Then, the test began.
Because they knew that there would be a second test like this, the people who went to the villages to conduct the recruitment test naturally did not dare to do anything untoward.
Thus, the results of everyone’s test were the same as the first time — except for Ling Han.
As Li Yun watched, he kept having a feeling that this light, tsk, was slightly different in brightness.
It was an illusion, it must be an illusion.
How could it possibly be different?
Hehe, he was really an idiot.
Among the nine candidates, Ling Han’s aptitude was the highest, followed by Zhao Jian’s.
The others were far inferior, and there was not even a single B grade among them.
Thus, Ling Han and Zhao Jian both received extremely good treatment, and were allocated a private room.
Furthermore, they would be able to obtain a packet of medicinal bath ingredients every three days.
Another few days later, the recruitment work for the Martial Hall this year ended.
This time, a total of 27 new disciples had been recruited, and only three of them were female, which showed how much this world favored men over women.
At this time, the 27 people were all brought to the basement.
There was an underground spring there, which turned into a large pool, and steam was bubbling from within.
“This is Earth Flame Spring Water, which is greatly beneficial for unblocking meridians and improving one’s physique,” a trainer of the Martial Hall said.
“You guys only have this one chance to enter the pool to absorb the benefits.”
“There’s no time limit.
However, once you come out, you won’t be able to enter again.”
“That’s because you won’t be able to obtain any benefits even if you enter again.”
“Those who maintained the longest record in the pool stayed for a total of one and a half days.”
“Hehe, I wonder if any of you can break records.”𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
“Go into the water.”
He waved a hand dismissively.
There was another trainer beside him, and he said in a low voice with a smile, “Have you given these brats a motivation talk again?
You have to know that the record holder is presently one of the four great War Gods and Guardian Deities of our Buddhist Race!”
“Hehe, giving these brats a goal is what motivates them,” the first trainer said with a smile.
The youths were all young and impetuous, and none of them would submit easily.
Immediately, a competitive spirit rose up in them, and they all walked into the hot spring.
Wasn’t it just taking a bath?
To say nothing of a day and a half, what was so difficult about taking a bath for ten days or even half a month?
However, when they stepped in, they almost immediately jumped out again.
Gods, it was too hot.
Were they going to be cooked alive?
Hiss!
Only now did they know why the longest record was only one and a half days.
This was really not a place for humans.

chapters.title: Chapter 4655: Spirit Devouring Physique
paragraphs: Chapter 4655: Spirit Devouring Physique
However, everyone had heard very clearly that the longer they stayed here, the more benefits they would obtain. Thus, everyone was gritting their teeth and holding on.
Of course, Ling Han was completely unperturbed. As someone who possessed the battle prowess of a high-level Saint, would he take such a small token to heart?
He merely sat quietly.
This was a very good opportunity for him to shine and gain the notice of the Martial Hall, becoming a stepping stone for him to enter into the inner ranks of the Buddhist Race.
Otherwise, how long would it take for him to rise up step by step and gain the notice of the Buddhist Race?
He didn’t have much time. Thus, though rising too quickly would definitely be risky, Ling Han couldn’t care less.
Merely half an hour later, therewas one that could no longer bear it, and crawled out, screaming in pain.
There were already people from the Martial Hall standing guard at the side, and they immediately carried this person out for treatment.
—They would gain benefits here, but they would also be burned by the hot water.
In truth, this was the method to force out the potential of life to improve one’s physique, paving a wide path for one’s future cultivation.
Hence, the length of time one stayed here was not determined by the height of aptitude, but rather the toughness of one’s willpower.
After two hours, there were only nine youths left in the pool.
Three hours later, there were only seven left.
Five hours later, there were only six left.
Six hours later, only Ling Han and Zhao Jian were left.

Aside from his head, Zhao Jian’s whole person was buried in the water. The more area that came into contact with the pool waters, the greater the benefits he would receive. If it was not for the fact that he still had to breathe, and the organs on his face were more important, he would definitely bury his face in as well.
However, after enduring for six hours, his entire body was trembling, and the muscles on his face were also trembling.
He couldn’t hold on any longer.
However, a powerful willpower was supporting him, and that was Ling Han, who was not far away.
He couldn’t lose. He could lose to anyone, but he definitely couldn’t lose to Ling Han!
With this willpower, he actually managed to endure it.
Eight hours, ten hours, fourteen hours… When the two of them had endured until twenty hours, a great many people in the Martial Hall were alerted, and came over to take a look.
“Goodness, twenty hours!”
“Aside from that Lord, there hasn’t been anyone else that could last for more than a day. Could it be that two miracles are going to appear at the same time?”
“Yes, it can’t compare to that Lord. However, being able to last for a day is already extremely shocking.”
Everyone whispered among themselves, discussing in low voices.
Only now did Zhao Jian know what kind of results he had achieved.
This was already incredibly shocking, but how could he lose to “Zhang Hanjun”?
Hold on, he definitely had to hold on.
One hour, another hour, and finally, a day and night had passed.

Zhao Jian was still holding on, which surprised even Ling Han. This should have long since surpassed the other’s limits, but under the belief that he would not admit defeat, this young man actually managed to hold on. It was really not easy.
However, no matter how much he persevered, there was ultimately a limit. Willpower could not last forever.
After a whole day, Zhao Jian soon passed out.
Before passing out, he had even glanced at Ling Han, his eyes filled with resentment.
—Why haven’t you collapsed yet?
Everyone was flustered, and hurriedly carried Zhao Jian out.
And now, Ling Han was the only person left.
One day, another three hours, another five hours, another eight hours.
This time, even the Master of the Martial Hall had arrived. Could it be that this would catch up to the record of that Lord?
One day passed, and eleven hours later.
“Heavens!”
“There is only an hour left, and he would have caught up to that Lord.”
“Hiss, that Lord has cultivated to become a Sect Master!”
Everyone was numb with shock. Even if Ling Han couldn’t hold on any longer and retreated, he was still infinitesimally close to that Lord. His future prospects were boundless.
Another hour passed.
He had caught up!
Everyone was dumbfounded, and felt their minds go completely blank.
Most importantly, Ling Han was still in the pool waters. He didn’t look like he was about to come out at all.
Heavens, was this guy going to surpass the gods?
With a thought from Ling Han, his aura instantly soared explosively.
For him, this was a negligible improvement, but for the Meridian Opening Tier that he seemed to be, it was a super great leap.
Blood Transformation Tier!
“Heavens!”
“He has broken through!”
Everyone was grabbing their heads and exclaiming in shock, all of them looking like they had seen a ghost.
Others could only persevere in the pool waters, but what about Ling Han? He had directly increased his cultivation by a whole cultivation level!
Was there such a freak?
“Hiss, I’ve heard that there’s a kind of physique. It can absorb all kinds of energy and transform it into one’s mystical power.”
“I’ve also heard of it. This is called Spirit Devouring Physique!”

“Before the Spirit Transformation Tier, as long as there is enough energy to support it, this kind of physique would not have any bottleneck in cultivating at all, and would be able to realize the leap in cultivation level in a short period of time.”

“That’s right. If it was not for the fact that one has to start from the Spirit Transformation Tier and comprehend Regulations, this kind of physique would be able to soar all the way to the level of Great Emperor.”
Someone was making wild guesses, causing the others to agree one after another. Their words were very logical.
Ling Han listened carefully. Since they had all helped him come up with a reason, there was no need for him to hide anything.
Come on then!
He absorbed the energy in the pool waters. This couldn’t be converted into cultivation, but it didn’t matter. He only had to make it meet the criteria of “Spirit Devouring Physique”.
“Yi, I can clearly feel that the energy is continuously gathering with him as the core.”
“Why didn’t I sense it before?”
“Idiot, previously, he was a Meridian Opening Tier, and now he’s a Blood Transformation Tier. The intensity of the energy surge has increased!”
“Oh, that’s right.”
These people had found their own “reason”, and there was absolutely no need for Ling Han to give them an explanation.
Very good, then continue.
Ling Han controlled himself, causing his cultivation level to rise steadily.
“Blood and Qi boiling!”
“Condensed Blood Pillar!”
“Condensed Blood Beast!”𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚
“Blood Qi Condensation Emperor!”
Hong, a powerful fluctuation flashed over Ling Han’s body. He took another step forwards, and stepped into Extreme Bone Tier.
This!

Everyone was extremely envious. This kind of physique was really too awesome. As long as one had enough cultivation resources, he could completely ignore the barrier of cultivation level, and soar all the way to the peak stage of the True Self Tier.

“Humph, if cultivation level advances too quickly, and there is not enough stabilization of cultivation level, even if he reaches the peak stage of the True Self Tier in a short period of time, it would be as difficult as ascending the heavens to take another step forward.” There would always be people who would be jealous, and make cynical remarks.
“Hehe, if I can reach the True Self Tier, even if I can’t advance a single step further for the rest of my life, I’m willing!”
“En!”
Many people nodded in agreement. One had to realize that the strongest elite in the Fortune Dragon City was only True Self Tier.
For them, easily becoming the elites of the highest level, what was there to be dissatisfied about?

Ling Han continued to perform the “miracle”. On the ninth day after entering the pool, he successfully broke through to the Inscription Tier, and then directly reached the Enlightenment Tier. Finally, he stopped.
It couldn’t be helped. The energy in this hot spring had already been exhausted, so Ling Han couldn’t break through for no reason, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 4656 I want to sleep
paragraphs: Ling Han reluctantly walked out of the pool.
He very much wanted to rush up to the Celestial Path in one go. In that way, he would be able to enter into the eyes of the higher-ups of the Buddhist Race sooner, and enter into the Pond of Life.
As for now? Seems like he would still have to wait a while longer.
However, the gazes that the members of the Martial Hall directed at him were filled with shock, and at the same time, a great many people were filled with jealousy.

—They had worked hard, and even risked their lives to explore ancient sites, and only then did he manage they manage to cultivate to Enlightenment Tier and Mystery Realm. In the end, this boy only had to swallow a little energy, and he would be able to advance rapidly and catch up to them, or even surpass them.
Who would be willing to accept this?

"Good, good, good!" The Master of the Martial Hall was all smiles. "Hurry up and stabilize your cultivation level. Although your physique is astonishing, you can't neglect the foundations of martial arts."
"Yes." Ling Han nodded.
Because he had broken through to the Enlightenment Tier, his treatment was greatly improved all of a sudden. Not only had he been moved to a large courtyard, he was also allowed to have servants.
When Zhao Jian found out, he directly smashed three cups in his fury.
He fought so hard, and suffered so much, just because he was unwilling to lose to Ling Han.
Unexpectedly, it was not that Ling Han's willpower was tougher than his at all. Instead, it was purely due to his unique physique, which allowed him to swallow energy.
How could he accept this?
However, he was only in Blood Transformation Tier now, while Ling Han was an elite of Enlightenment Tier. If he sought Ling Han out to cause trouble, hoho, he would only be asking for a beating.
Furthermore, it was also because of Ling Han that he had managed to hold on for a whole day.

This couldn't compare to that Lord who had become a Sect Master, but he was still the third in the history of the Martial Hall. Add to that his A grade aptitude, and as long as he was given enough time, he would definitely be able to advance into the Spirit Transformation Tier in future.
"I'm inferior to you now, but I'll definitely surpass you in the future!" Zhao Jian thought to himself.

There was no way he could compare his cultivation level with Ling Han now. The latter had a Spirit Devouring Physique, and there was no bottleneck before Spirit Transformation Tier in terms of cultivation level. How could he compare?
However, he was sure that Ling Han would definitely be stuck at the peak stage of the True Self Tier if he advanced so quickly, becauseheaven and earth was only fair.
Just how fast had your cultivation speed been previously? You would be stuck at the peak stage of the True Self Tier for an inverse ratio of that amount of time.

Ling Han had become a well-known figure in the Martial Hall. When the news spread out, even the Lord City Master was alerted. Though he did not summon Ling Han to meet him, he sent out an old butler to have a chat with Ling Han.
In short, everyone knew that the Martial Hall had recruited a prodigy who possessed the Spirit Devouring Physique and had boundless future prospects.
Ling Han naturally wouldn't take it to heart. He wasn't here to show off.
With Spirit Devouring Physique as his cover, when his cultivation level increased too quickly, there was a reasonable explanation—I've gotten cultivation resources again.
Peng, peng, peng! A knock suddenly sounded on the courtyard doors.
The servant immediately went over to take a look. Not long after, he led a young man in.

This man was only eighteen or nineteen years old, but his cultivation level was "higher" than Ling Han's. He had already stepped onto Celestial Path, though he had only just built his Human Dao Foundation.
"My name is Zhu Yangzhou, and the Master of the Martial Hall is my father," this young man said, a hint of pride in his expression.

Before Ling Han, he was the number one prodigy in the Martial Hall, yet now he had lost to Ling Han's physique, which made him extremely displeased. However, in order to maintain the appearance of tolerance as a "senior brother", he still came personally.
"Oh." Ling Han nodded.
Yi, just like that, you have no other expression?
Zhu Yangzhou was taken aback, then revealed an expression of displeasure.
He was already displeased to begin with, and now that Ling Han was acting condescending, he was naturally even more displeased.
"I stepped into Celestial Path four months ago," he said calmly, but his tone was filled with the air of showing off.
Impressive, wasn't it? This was the Celestial Path!
No matter how fast you were to reach the Mystery Realm Tier, the barrier of leaping over the Celestial Gate would still be able to stop 99% of cultivators from advancing further.
Those that could become Celestials were as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.
Ling Han gave another 'oh', "Congratulations?"
'F*ck! You're just expressing your congratulations, and you're even asking in a questioning tone? What do you mean?'

Zhu Yangzhou suddenly felt an urge to beat someone up. Though Ling Han did not say a single word to provoke him, nor did he say anything out of line, and in fact, his expression was not very arrogant either, so why did it make him feel extremely uncomfortable?

If the large black dog were here, he would pat his shoulder to express his understanding. After all, Ling Han had learnt the skill of speech from him. Unknowingly, he would incite fury in others. This was the highest level of skill.
"Junior Brother Zhang, though your physique is astonishingly strong, you should know that the path of martial arts is long, and when it is time to be humble, you should learn humility," he warned.
"All right," Ling Han readily accepted. He had not come to cause trouble. As long as he could enter into the Pond of Life, he would immediately return.
Moreover, what sense of accomplishment could he have by stepping on a mere Human Dao Foundation?
Zhu Yangzhou was taken aback. Ling Han's reaction caused him to be unable to flare up no matter how furious he was.
But the other party was clearly very obedient, so why did he keep making him feel displeased?
"Behave yourself, and you also have to be careful of propriety. Don't get greedy when something doesn't belong to you." He left behind these words, and then left.
Was this considered a warning?
Ling Han simply smiled, not taking it to heart at all.
Just as Zhu Yangzhou left, another person came over.
Knock, knock, knock. A knock sounded on the courtyard door. The servant went out to investigate, then led another person back.
This was no longer a man, but rather a woman. She was very young, and also very beautiful. Furthermore, she had an aura that had been formed from being in a high position for a long time.
"I am Yan Yan," the woman introduced herself.
"Oh?" Ling Han's expression was still calm. How could he know who Yan Yan was?
"Young Master Jun, Miss Yan is the beloved daughter of the Lord City Master!" At the side, the servant hurriedly made an additional introduction to Ling Han.

The City Lord doted on his daughter. Her status was too noble, and if Ling Han offended Yan Yan, as Ling Han's servant, he would definitely be implicated as well. Thus, he immediately gave Ling Han a reminder.
Ling Han remained silent. At this moment, only Ah Han and the Buddhist Race could suppress him.
If the Great Emperor did not appear, and the Buddhist Race Race did not have a Pseudo-Emperor either, so who did he need to take to heart?

This kind of calmness caused Yan Yan to have a slightly higher opinion of him. As the beloved daughter of the City Lord, she was usually courted and pursued by who knew how many men. As time passed, she would naturally feel bored.
Ling Han's cold and indifferent demeanor gave her a sense of novelty, and she felt an urge to make him fall at her feet.
After all, putting aside the identity of the City Lord's beloved daughter, she herself was also an outstanding beauty.
"Junior Brother Zhang, I'm going into the mountains to hunt tomorrow. Are you willing to go with me?" she invited Ling Han.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
She was brimming with confidence. With her status and beauty, as long as she issued an invitation, it was guaranteed that every man would scramble madly to accept.
"No," Ling Han immediately replied.
Yan Yan almost vomited blood. He actually gave such an answer?
This guy!
She was still hopeful, and asked, "Does Junior Brother Zhang have other plans?"
"En, I want to sleep."

He fought so hard, and suffered so much, just because he was unwilling to lose to Ling Han.
Unexpectedly, it was not that Ling Han's willpower was tougher than his at all.
Instead, it was purely due to his unique physique, which allowed him to swallow energy.
How could he accept this?
However, he was only in Blood Transformation Tier now, while Ling Han was an elite of Enlightenment Tier.
If he sought Ling Han out to cause trouble, hoho, he would only be asking for a beating.
Furthermore, it was also because of Ling Han that he had managed to hold on for a whole day.
This couldn't compare to that Lord who had become a Sect Master, but he was still the third in the history of the Martial Hall.
Add to that his A grade aptitude, and as long as he was given enough time, he would definitely be able to advance into the Spirit Transformation Tier in future.
"I'm inferior to you now, but I'll definitely surpass you in the future!" Zhao Jian thought to himself.
There was no way he could compare his cultivation level with Ling Han now.
The latter had a Spirit Devouring Physique, and there was no bottleneck before Spirit Transformation Tier in terms of cultivation level.
How could he compare?
However, he was sure that Ling Han would definitely be stuck at the peak stage of the True Self Tier if he advanced so quickly, becauseheaven and earth was only fair.
Just how fast had your cultivation speed been previously?
You would be stuck at the peak stage of the True Self Tier for an inverse ratio of that amount of time.
Ling Han had become a well-known figure in the Martial Hall.
When the news spread out, even the Lord City Master was alerted.
Though he did not summon Ling Han to meet him, he sent out an old butler to have a chat with Ling Han.
In short, everyone knew that the Martial Hall had recruited a prodigy who possessed the Spirit Devouring Physique and had boundless future prospects.
Ling Han naturally wouldn't take it to heart.
He wasn't here to show off.
With Spirit Devouring Physique as his cover, when his cultivation level increased too quickly, there was a reasonable explanation—I've gotten cultivation resources again.
Peng, peng, peng!
A knock suddenly sounded on the courtyard doors.
The servant immediately went over to take a look.
Not long after, he led a young man in.
This man was only eighteen or nineteen years old, but his cultivation level was "higher" than Ling Han's.
He had already stepped onto Celestial Path, though he had only just built his Human Dao Foundation.
"My name is Zhu Yangzhou, and the Master of the Martial Hall is my father," this young man said, a hint of pride in his expression.
Before Ling Han, he was the number one prodigy in the Martial Hall, yet now he had lost to Ling Han's physique, which made him extremely displeased.
However, in order to maintain the appearance of tolerance as a "senior brother", he still came personally.
"Oh." Ling Han nodded.
Yi, just like that, you have no other expression?
Zhu Yangzhou was taken aback, then revealed an expression of displeasure.
He was already displeased to begin with, and now that Ling Han was acting condescending, he was naturally even more displeased.
"I stepped into Celestial Path four months ago," he said calmly, but his tone was filled with the air of showing off.
Impressive, wasn't it?
This was the Celestial Path!
No matter how fast you were to reach the Mystery Realm Tier, the barrier of leaping over the Celestial Gate would still be able to stop 99% of cultivators from advancing further.
Those that could become Celestials were as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.
Ling Han gave another 'oh', "Congratulations?"
'F*ck!
You're just expressing your congratulations, and you're even asking in a questioning tone?
What do you mean?'
Zhu Yangzhou suddenly felt an urge to beat someone up.

Though Ling Han did not say a single word to provoke him, nor did he say anything out of line, and in fact, his expression was not very arrogant either, so why did it make him feel extremely uncomfortable?
If the large black dog were here, he would pat his shoulder to express his understanding.
After all, Ling Han had learnt the skill of speech from him.
Unknowingly, he would incite fury in others.
This was the highest level of skill.
"Junior Brother Zhang, though your physique is astonishingly strong, you should know that the path of martial arts is long, and when it is time to be humble, you should learn humility," he warned.
"All right," Ling Han readily accepted.
He had not come to cause trouble.
As long as he could enter into the Pond of Life, he would immediately return.
Moreover, what sense of accomplishment could he have by stepping on a mere Human Dao Foundation?
Zhu Yangzhou was taken aback.
Ling Han's reaction caused him to be unable to flare up no matter how furious he was.
But the other party was clearly very obedient, so why did he keep making him feel displeased?
"Behave yourself, and you also have to be careful of propriety.
Don't get greedy when something doesn't belong to you." He left behind these words, and then left.
Was this considered a warning?
Ling Han simply smiled, not taking it to heart at all.
Just as Zhu Yangzhou left, another person came over.
Knock, knock, knock.
A knock sounded on the courtyard door.
The servant went out to investigate, then led another person back.
This was no longer a man, but rather a woman.
She was very young, and also very beautiful.
Furthermore, she had an aura that had been formed from being in a high position for a long time.
"I am Yan Yan," the woman introduced herself.
"Oh?" Ling Han's expression was still calm.
How could he know who Yan Yan was?
"Young Master Jun, Miss Yan is the beloved daughter of the Lord City Master!" At the side, the servant hurriedly made an additional introduction to Ling Han.
The City Lord doted on his daughter.
Her status was too noble, and if Ling Han offended Yan Yan, as Ling Han's servant, he would definitely be implicated as well.
Thus, he immediately gave Ling Han a reminder.
Ling Han remained silent.
At this moment, only Ah Han and the Buddhist Race could suppress him.
If the Great Emperor did not appear, and the Buddhist Race Race did not have a Pseudo-Emperor either, so who did he need to take to heart?
This kind of calmness caused Yan Yan to have a slightly higher opinion of him.
As the beloved daughter of the City Lord, she was usually courted and pursued by who knew how many men.
As time passed, she would naturally feel bored.
Ling Han's cold and indifferent demeanor gave her a sense of novelty, and she felt an urge to make him fall at her feet.
After all, putting aside the identity of the City Lord's beloved daughter, she herself was also an outstanding beauty.
"Junior Brother Zhang, I'm going into the mountains to hunt tomorrow.
Are you willing to go with me?" she invited Ling Han.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖
She was brimming with confidence.
With her status and beauty, as long as she issued an invitation, it was guaranteed that every man would scramble madly to accept.
"No," Ling Han immediately replied.
Yan Yan almost vomited blood.
He actually gave such an answer?
This guy!
She was still hopeful, and asked, "Does Junior Brother Zhang have other plans?"
"En, I want to sleep."

chapters.title: Chapter 4657 Change of mind
paragraphs: I want to sleep!
Yan Yan was dumbfounded.
Firstly, she was completely unprepared to be rejected by Ling Han. Secondly, the reason for her being rejected was actually so casual.
'You want to sleep?'
'You've already slept well, haven't you? Who did not allow you to sleep? But isn't one night enough for you? You still want to sleep in broad daylight?'
Was it because of the Spirit Devouring Physique that this guy didn't have the heart to cultivate? In any case, he only needed to absorb energy to break through.
If that was the case, then this person's future prospects would be limited. He was too narrow-minded, and had short vision.
However, Yan Yan was still a little dissatisfied. She was the number one beauty of Fortune Dragon City, and she was actually rejected like this. How could she swallow her anger?

Moreover, she was certain that Ling Han definitely wasn't putting upn a show of retreating in order to advance, purposely refusing to keep her hanging— that kind of indifference meant he really wasn't interested.
No way!
Once her temper as a young miss rose, she immediately declared, "I never accept rejection. I will come and pick you up tomorrow morning!"
After saying this, she turned around and left.
Ling Han scratched his head in confusion. What kind of person was this?
Forget it, let's go back to sleep.
At his cultivation level, cultivating =was already useless. The Seed of the Holy Flame needed a huge amount of energy to "sprout". Thus, his only thought was to enter the Pond of Life.
However, he hadn't slept for long when he was woken up by someone.
It was Zhu Yangzhou again.

En, Yan Yan was quite pretty, and was also the daughter of the City Lord. Thus, if he married her, he would definitely be able to save a few hundred years of hard work, or even spend several lifetimes.
"I remember warning you, don't have any delusions about something that doesn't belong to you." When this person appeared in front of Ling Han again, his face bore a baleful expression.
'What do you mean?'
With how smart Ling Han was, he immediately understood after some thought.
It was because of Yan Yan.

En, Yan Yan was quite pretty, and was also the daughter of the City Lord. Thus, if he married her, he would definitely be able to save a few hundred years of hard work, or even spend several lifetimes.
However, why had Zhu Yangzhou suddenly appeared again?
Someone must have gone to tell on him and report the news.

In order to completely conceal his identity, Ling Han did not release his powerful divine sense to enshroud the whole city at all. He was very much like an Enlightenment Tier. Otherwise, in this massive city, no matter what happened, as long as he willed it, he could 'see' everything in his mind.
"Listen, Yan Yan isn't someone you can hope to attain, so you have to reject her tomorrow. Otherwise, humph!" Zhu Yangzhou said in a baleful voice. In fact, there was killing intent on his face.
Yan Yan was his exclusive property, and he would definitely not allow anyone to touch her.

He was the Young Master of the Martial Hall, so the servants here were naturally all his people. They knew how much this Young Master cared about Yan Yan, so as soon as Yan Yan left, the servants here immediately went to look for Zhu Yangzhou.
Though Zhu Yangzhou did not think that Yan Yan would be moved by a country bumpkin, even if she was curious, he could not tolerate it.
That was because he was definitely going to marry Yan Yan, and could not allow even the slightest bit of accident.
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I am unmarried, and she is unmarried. Senior Brother Zhu is being too nosy, aren't you?"

"You can try!" Zhu Yangzhou said threateningly, "Don't forget, this is my territory. If you dare to disobey me, not only will it be difficult for you to take a single step, you may even encounter all kinds of accidents!"

Ling Han shook his head, "As far as I know, all the Martial Halls in the world are the property of the Buddhist Race. Your father is only in charge on their behalf. Since when has it become your family's private property? Why don't we go to the city lord's residence and ask him to pass judgement?"
Zhu Yangzhou's heart was instantly filled with anger, and he wanted nothing more than to smack Ling Han to death.

However, it was easy to smack this country bumpkin to death, but this boy was a Spirit Devouring Physique. Even the Lord City Master paid close attention to him. If this kind of prodigy suddenly disappeared, the Martial Hall probably wouldn't be able to hide it, and someone from the City Lord's Residence would definitely interfere in the investigation.
At that time, even if he was the son of the Master of the Martial Hall, so what? Murdering a prodigy of the Martial Hall was a serious crime.
Thus, he forcefully suppressed his killing intent.
"Zhang Hanjun, let me give you another warning. Don't seek your own death!" As he spoke, he turned around and left.
Ling Han shrugged. Was this person an idiot? He had already clearly rejected Yan Yan, yet he still came over to threaten him. He really didn't know what was wrong with his brain.
Oh, did he think that he was deliberately keeping Yan Yan hanging?
Was he that idle?
The night passed, and on the morning of the second day, peng, peng, peng. Ling Han heard a knock on the door, and it was a very loud knock at that.
Who was it, to actually disturb his rest?
Ling Han hadn't woken up yet, when he saw a young girl run in energetically.
"Why are you still sleeping?" This young girl chided delicately, her pretty face filled with displeasure.
Of course, it was Yan Yan, Miss Yan.
"Didn't I tell you? I want to sleep!" Ling Han said helplessly. This young girl was truly spoiled, daring to barge into a man's bedroom.
"No, get up!" Yan Yan rebuked. The temper of a young mistress was already flaring up.

"Sister Yan, Junior Brother Zhang has been cultivating these few days, and is indeed very tired. You had best let him have a good rest. I have nothing to do anyway, so I'll go hunting with you, all right?" Zhu Yangzhou's voice rang out.
Yet Yan Yan ignored him, and merely stared at Ling Han who was lying on the bed, "You won't get up?"
She drew out the whip that was wrapped around her waist, her expression cold.
If Zhu Yangzhou hadn't said this, Ling Han would have definitely slept to the end. However, with Zhu Yangzhou's interruption, Ling Han couldn't take it anymore.
If he continued to sleep, wouldn't that be equivalent to admitting that he was afraid of Zhu Yangzhou?
"Cough!" He suddenly sat up, "I suddenly changed my mind. Let's go and hunt."
"Ah!" Yan Yan covered her eyes with both hands, and after a sharp scream, she hurriedly turned around and ran, "Pervert, you are not wearing any clothes!"
It wasn't like he wasn't wearing pants.
Ling Han thought to himself, then slowly began to put on his clothes.
On the sidelines, Zhu Yangzhou looked coldly at him.
As expected, this guy used the strategy of playing hard to get, and successfully caused Yan Yan to become interested in him.
This scheming guy deserved to die!
"Senior Brother, could I trouble you to pass me that coat?" Ling Han pointed at the coat hanging on the chair on Zhu Yangzhou's left.
Zhu Yangzhou did not speak, and merely coldly grabbed the coat, then tossed it onto the bed.
"I hope you can come back alive!" After saying this, he turned around and left.
Humph, since Ling Han was so determined to seek death, then he would oblige him.
Did he really think that just because he was a prodigy, he didn't dare to make a move?
Wrong, for the sake of Yan Yan, he was willing to do anything!
This woman was his!
Ling Han merely smiled, and did not take it to heart at all. He had only concealed his cultivation level, and had not lost his cultivation level.
When it was time to make a move, he would still make a move.
He got off the bed, and after washing up, he came to the courtyard. He saw Yan Yan standing there and waiting, looking very angry, filled with the innocence of a young girl, alluringly beautiful.
When she saw Ling Han, her pretty face involuntarily flushed red, and she cursed softly, "Shameless!"
Tsk, she actually dared to barge into a man's bedroom. Why was she still so embarrassed?
"Let's go," Ling Han said calmly, and led the way out.
"Hey, wait for me, wait for me!" All of a sudden, Yan Yan had no time to be angry, and hurriedly broke out into a run in pursuit.
