chapters.title: Chapter 4658 Chance Encounter with Celestial medicine
paragraphs: As they left the city and entered the mountains, Ling Han took the chance to ask Yan Yan about Buddhist Land.
Yan Yan only thought that he was a country bumpkin who was ignorant, but she told him everything she knew, filling him in on common knowledge.

Within Buddhist Land, there were countless cities like Fortune Dragon City, and they numbered in the tens of thousands. This was the smallest administrative unit of Buddhist Land, and belonged to the category of ordinary city.

And the smallest number would be a dozen over, and the largest number would be a few dozen ordinary cities, which would form a relatively large administrative area, which would be managed by a single B-level city.
For example, the superior city of Fortune Dragon City was called White River City, and it belonged to one of several thousand B-level cities.
Compared to ordinary cities, a B-level city was only slightly larger, and the overall level of cultivation was slightly higher, and the population was slightly larger.
Above B-level cities, there were also A-level cities, which similarly managed a dozen to a few dozen B-level cities.
This number was much lesser, only a few hundred.
Above A-grade cities were the ten great capitals, which were respectively in charge of these A-grade cities, and above the ten great capitals was the supreme Sacred Buddhist Land.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He had to fight his way from an ordinary city all the way to a B-grade city, then to an A-grade, a capital, and only then would he be able to enter into the Sacred Land.
The Pond of Life must be in the Sacred Land.
Though he would have to go through multiple layers of selection, there was nothing that could be done. Who asked this to be the Buddhist Land?
The two of them chatted idly all the way, and soon entered into the depths of the great mountain.
Though Yan Yan was only a Mystery Realm Tier-level martial artist, she was very brave, and kept running into the depths of the mountains.
However, Ling Han knew that there was still an "elite" following behind them.
An elder in Cauldron Forging Tier.

This was obviously a Dao Protector that the City Lord had assigned to Yan Yan. He would definitely not allow anything to happen to Yan Yan, and that was why this little girl dared to be so unrestrained.
With an "elite" of this level following behind them, even if Ling Han didn't deliberately release his divine sense to investigate, he couldn't possibly deceive him.
"Three-Eyed Snow Leopard!" Yan Yan exclaimed excitedly, pointing ahead.
She ignored Ling Han, and immediately broke into a run and charged out.
Meanwhile, Ling Han followed behind at a leisurely pace. He suddenly realized that this was a good opportunity to "raise" his cultivation level.

He could completely discover a divine pond, a Celestial medicine, and then ingest it. When he returned, he could boldly announce that he had once again set foot into the Mystery Realm Tier, or even Celestial Path.
"Yes, not bad."
He released his divine sense, and began to search the mountains.
Ahead of them, the Three-Eyed Snow Leopard did not flee, but rather approached Yan Yan. Clearly, it thought that this was not a hunter, but rather a prey.
Peng!

The two immediately began a fierce battle. This human and panther were both Mystery Realm Tier-level. However, the snow leopard was a fierce beast, and was battling almost every day. Whether it was in terms of ferocity or battle experience, it was all superior to Yan Yan.
Hence, Yan Yan soon fell into a disadvantage, and was in a perilous situation.
Ling Han immediately joined the battle.
In just a few moves, Yan Yan was pushed out of the battle zone. She was not even qualified to interfere.
Yi?

Yan Yan was very surprised. That was because Ling Han's power was clearly not as strong as hers, but every move and every strike was just right, achieving the effect of defeating a stronger opponent as a weaker opponent.
This was because his use of power had reached perfection. He had not wasted a single bit, and had used it to its fullest.
Heavens, it could be done like this?
He was forcefully using his natural talent in battle to oppose an opponent at a higher cultivation level.
Yan Yan's beautiful eyes shone. This had practically overturned her understanding of martial arts.
As it turned out, his cultivation level was inferior, and his power was far inferior. It could actually be compensated through battle techniques.
No, no, no, this was not battle technique, but rather basic skills, basic skills that could not be any more solid.
Only when he had grasped the basics, would he be able to use such technique.
After a few dozen more moves, the Three-Eyed Snow Leopard didn't dare to fight anymore. It hurriedly turned around and fled.
Though fierce beasts were fierce, they were not idiots either. They knew that they were no match, so what was the point of fighting?
Ling Han leaped out in pursuit, and Yan Yan hurriedly followed behind him.

If Yan Yan had been paying close attention, she would have discovered that the snow leopard's escape routes were extremely irregular. Sometimes it would flee east, and sometimes it would flee south. Unfortunately, she was only focused on chasing, and had not considered this at all.
That was because the snow leopard was under Ling Han's control, but even the Cauldron Forging Tier behind couldn't tell.
"Celestial medicine!" Ling Han suddenly called out. His feet paused, and he pointed at the side of the mountain.
Yan Yan faltered for a moment before raising her head to look as well. True enough, there was a dark purple plant growing on the mountain wall. It was like a ganoderma, exuding a faint fragrance.
What kind of luck was this? They had actually discovered the Celestial medicine in pursuit of a fierce beast?
She knew that she had a Dao Protector, but what if her Dao Protector was no match either?
After all, they were already too deep into the mountains. If they were here, it wasn't impossible for vicious beasts of Cauldron Forging Tier or even Core Formation Tier to appear.
This was definitely not a Spiritual Herb. From so far away, she only had to take a single sniff, and it was as if all the pores on her body had opened up, making her feel extremely comfortable.
"Be careful!" she hurriedly said. "Wherever Celestial medicines grow, there will definitely be fierce beasts standing guard!"
She knew that she had a Dao Protector, but what if her Dao Protector was no match either?
After all, they were already too deep into the mountains. If they were here, it wasn't impossible for vicious beasts of Cauldron Forging Tier or even Core Formation Tier to appear.
"I'm going to pick the herb!" Ling Han didn't say another word as he ran out and climbed the mountain side.
"Zhang Hanjun, come back quickly!" Yan Yan hurriedly shouted. Who knew if a ferocious beast would suddenly appear?

What they feared really came true. A large snake actually poked out of a cave in the mountain wall. Its body was as wide as a bowl, and with a flick of its tongue, there was actually a black Qi surging.
"Not good, this is the Black Murderous Snake!" The Dao Protector immediately dashed out, grabbed Yan Yan, and turned to flee.

This Black Murderous Snake was a Cauldron Forging Tier-level fierce beast, and was one of the strongest of this level at that. The black Qi it spat out was incredibly poisonous. If one did not take the anti-venom in advance, then absorbing even the slightest bit, even a fellow Cauldron Forging Tier would very quickly fall to their knees.
Thus, his only option was to flee with Yan Yan. He didn't dare to battle at all.
In any case, his mission was to ensure Yan Yan's safety. As for others?
No matter how prodigious he was, what did it have to do with him?
Yan Yan faltered for a moment before screaming, "Hurry up and save Zhang Hanjun!"

"I'm sorry, Young Miss. Please forgive me for not being able to obey you." The Dao Protector shook his heads, obviously unwilling to turn around. "If that brat is lucky enough, he might have a chance of survival, but I definitely won't allow Young Miss to take risks."
No matter how much Yan Yan screamed, he only acted as if he had not heard anything. He grabbed onto Yan Yan and ran madly.

"Sigh!" Ling Han sighed.
His public image wouldn't be destroyed so quickly, right?

"En, not bad, not bad."

At this time, the Black Murderous Snake could no longer hold back and began to attack.
'This human is far too arrogant! He's already at death's door, yet he's still mumbling to himself. Fine, I'll eat you!'

What a terrifying aura!

Yan Yan only thought that he was a country bumpkin who was ignorant, but she told him everything she knew, filling him in on common knowledge.
Within Buddhist Land, there were countless cities like Fortune Dragon City, and they numbered in the tens of thousands.
This was the smallest administrative unit of Buddhist Land, and belonged to the category of ordinary city.

And the smallest number would be a dozen over, and the largest number would be a few dozen ordinary cities, which would form a relatively large administrative area, which would be managed by a single B-level city.
For example, the superior city of Fortune Dragon City was called White River City, and it belonged to one of several thousand B-level cities.
Compared to ordinary cities, a B-level city was only slightly larger, and the overall level of cultivation was slightly higher, and the population was slightly larger.
Above B-level cities, there were also A-level cities, which similarly managed a dozen to a few dozen B-level cities.
This number was much lesser, only a few hundred.
Above A-grade cities were the ten great capitals, which were respectively in charge of these A-grade cities, and above the ten great capitals was the supreme Sacred Buddhist Land.
Ling Han gritted his teeth.
He had to fight his way from an ordinary city all the way to a B-grade city, then to an A-grade, a capital, and only then would he be able to enter into the Sacred Land.
The Pond of Life must be in the Sacred Land.

Who asked this to be the Buddhist Land?

This was obviously a Dao Protector that the City Lord had assigned to Yan Yan.

chapters.title: Chapter 4659  Advancing another level
paragraphs: If snakes could also break out in a cold sweat, then this Black Murderous Snake would definitely be covered in sweat by now.
This was too terrifying. How could there be such a terrifying aura?
It felt that to say nothing of devouring this person, even if it made the slightest move, it would still be crushed into pieces.
Its only bit of intelligence made it want to cry. You're not some freaking Enlightenment Tier at all!
Showing off would cause you to be struck by lightning!
"Where can I find a golden condor?" Ling Han released his divine sense. Boom! The entire mountain was enshrouded by his divine sense, and it seemed as if it were boundless.
All of a sudden, the wild beasts all over the mountain trembled, as if they had encountered their natural enemy.

The Black Murderous Snake almost fainted. Being able to set foot on the Celestial Path, it actually already possessed a little intelligence, which made it realize that the man in front of it was so strong that he could practically destroy the heavens and earth.
There were many birds in the mountains, but if they just happened to meet Ling Han's requirements, both a golden condor and in the level of Cauldron Forging Tier, it would be difficult to find them.
"There actually isn't any!"
Ling Han gritted his teeth, and sighed, "I can only settle for the next best thing."

He made a grabbing motion behind him, and saw that a small black dot had appeared in the distant skies. Then, it rapidly enlarged, and turned into a giant green vulture that was as long as thirty meters when it spread its wings.
The Black Murderous Snake was about to faint, all right?

Vicious beasts could be considered as wild beasts that had slightly developed intelligence, but were incredibly powerful. They naturally knew of the existence of natural enemies. Eagles devoured snakes, and when they were wild beasts, they were naturally weak. After becoming vicious beasts, those of the same level would still be naturally weaker than their natural enemy.

This was a Green Arrow Vulture, its natural enemy — of course, it was not weak either, and also posed a great threat to the Green Arrow Vulture. Thus, unless it was absolutely necessary, the Green Arrow Vulture would not consider it part of its diet.
However, the two of them had now been forcefully brought together.
It should be said that the Green Arrow Vulture was even more dumbfounded, all right?
Even now, it was still dizzy.
Who am I?
Why am I here?
What the f*ck was going on here?

If this was another time, when natural enemies met, they would definitely have already gotten into a fight. However, because of Ling Han, the snake and vulture were both trembling, not daring to move at all.
"Yi, you guys aren't going to fight?" Ling Han asked in surprise, "If you guys aren't going to fight, how am I supposed to explain my story?"
The snake and vulture were on the verge of tears. 'You're freaking strong, so why are we fighting?'
Sigh!

Ling Han could only operate it manually. He forcibly pried open the snake's mouth, to take a bite out of the Green Arrow Vulture. Then, he used the claws of the Green Arrow Vulture to scratch a part of the snake's body.𝗳𝚛𝚎𝚎𝘄𝕖𝕓𝕟𝕠𝚟𝚎𝕝.𝗰𝕠𝐦
This snake and vulture could be considered overlords in the mountains. When had they ever suffered such injustice?
They were wild beasts, and no matter how wary they were of Ling Han, their vicious nature was still present.
The two enemies actually joined forces, launching an offensive at Ling Han.
What was the point? In front of Saint-level power, this was practically as weak as if it was made of paper.
It wasn't long before the two beasts were both killed.
Ling Han cut off a piece of snake meat, tore off a bird's wing, and placed some Celestial medicine on it. He then began to cook.
Not long after, a fragrant aroma wafted through the air, and he began to eat heartily.
Yi, someone was here?
This little girl had a good conscience, and even went to get reinforcements. However, if Ling Han really had to wait for her to save him, he would have long since entered the snake's stomach by now.
He smiled, and continued eating, pretending not to know.
Ling Han's divine sense told him that there was presently a group of three people rushing over.
It was the little girl, Yan Yan. En, there was also her Dao Protector, and lastly… the Master of the Martial Hall.
This little girl had a good conscience, and even went to get reinforcements. However, if Ling Han really had to wait for her to save him, he would have long since entered the snake's stomach by now.
He smiled, and continued eating, pretending not to know.
Thus, when Yan Yan, the Master of the Martial Hall, and the Dao Protector came over, they saw Ling Han sitting leisurely, eating and drinking to his heart's content.
Yi, wasn't it said that he was in imminent danger?
Are you playing with me?
The Master of the Martial Hall glanced at Yan Yan, and did not speak. However, his heart was probably filled with curse words.
"Zhang Hanjun, you didn't die?" Yan Yan was overjoyed.
Meanwhile, Ling Han said in irritation, "If I were dead, would a ghost be eating here now?"
"Why didn't you die?" After Yan Yan breathed a sigh of relief, she became curious.
Ling Han pointed at the corpse of the snake and vulture on the ground, "I was lucky. The two of them got into a fight, and ended up perishing together, which I took advantage of."

The Master of the Martial Hall and that Dao Protector stepped forwards to investigate. As expected, this Green Arrow Vulture and the Black Murderous Snake had experienced a great battle before their deaths, and the wounds on their bodies were left by their sharp fangs and claws.
"Your luck is really good!" The Master of the Martial Hall nodded. At this time, he naturally knew that Yan Yan had not been joking joking, but that Ling Han was really too lucky.
Weng! At this moment, a fluctuation flashed across Ling Han's body.
"Mystery Realm Tier!"
"He has broken through!"

The Master of the Martial Hall and the Dao Protector both exclaimed in shock. Though they knew that Ling Han was a "Spirit Devouring Physique", they were still shocked to see him break through so easily with their own eyes.
In comparison, how difficult had it been for them to break through at that time?
Sigh, comparisons were really infuriating.

Ling Han smiled. This was just right. He would have these two as witnesses. He had eaten Celestial Path-level vicious beast meat, and obtained enough energy, so breaking through was naturally a matter of course.
Since there was no longer any danger, the Master of the Martial Hall naturally returned, while Yan Yan stayed behind. She was too curious about Ling Han.
After eating, the two of them returned to the city. That Dao Protector was still protecting them in secret.
Halfway there, that Dao Protector suddenly appeared. He said that he had suddenly received a notice from the City Lord, and had to bring Yan Yan back immediately.
Thus, Ling Han was left to travel the rest of the way alone.
As he walked, a smile suddenly appeared at the corners of Ling Han's lips.
That was because he discovered that there were currently three people approaching him.
In a short while, xiu, xiu, xiu, three Mystery Realm Tiers appeared, two in front and one blocking his path of retreat.
"Die obediently, and you can suffer less," one of them said.
These three people were all dressed in black, and their faces were also covered with a black cloth.
"Zhu Yangzhou sent you?" Ling Han asked calmly.
"Humph, you're about to die, so what's the point of knowing so much?" The two people in front of him immediately moved, drawing their sabers and swords to slash at Ling Han.

Ling Han's feet didn't move, and he simply used his hands to casually block the attacks. He had clearly only used the power of Mystery Realm Tier, yet he was always able to neutralize the attacks just right.
"Zhu Yangzhou doesn't know that I've broken through again, right?" Ling Han said with a smile. The power he displayed now was at the level of Mystery Realm Tier.
The three of them were taken aback. How could there be such a coincidence?

Originally, for Mystery Realm Tiers to kill an Enlightenment Tier, who furthermore had an advantage in numbers, it was naturally almost certain that they would succeed, so Ling Han wouldn't even have the chance to escape.
But now?
Though they still had an advantage in numbers, if their cultivation levels were equal, then the outcome was hard to say.
"It can't be helped. I'm a Spirit Devouring Physique. I just happened to eat a meal of Cauldron Forging Tier-level beast meat, and broke through," Ling Han kindly explained.
They knew that Ling Han had been attacked, because even the Master of the Martial Hall had been mobilized.

It was also because of this that they had been sent out by Zhu Yangzhou. At first, they had thought that Ling Han had already met with misfortune, but who would have thought that when the Master of the Martial Hall arrived, he discovered that Ling Han was still alive, and that was why they had mobilized again.
This was a monster who could break through just by eating and drinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 4660  I broke through again
paragraphs: Ling Han was fighting against three opponents all on his own, yet he was firmly on the upper hand.
Since he had nothing else to do, he was tempering his technique.

In a situation when power was completely not on the upper hand, and without even using martial arts techniques, merely relying on his basic skills and meticulous control of power, he easily gained the upper hand.

This was a little like how the Great Emperor had suppressed his cultivation level. Even if his cultivation level had dropped to the Venerate Tier, he would still be able to put up a fight against a Saint.

Ling Han actually gained a sliver of enlightenment. That was because even in a battle on the level of Saints, Regulations was the main force and real power, but it was not that power was completely useless.
Sometimes, it may be this slight difference that would allow him to defeat his opponent.
On the other hand, the three black-robed men became more and more panicked as they fought.
What was going on?
They were clearly Mystery Realm Tiers, and had entered into this cultivation level much earlier than Ling Han, so why were they still at a disadvantage in a three-on-one battle?
What kind of freak was this?
Pu!

Just as they were distracted, a black-robed man had his saber snatched away by Ling Han. He turned it around and swiped out at his neck. Immediately, blood poured out madly. Even if he tried his best to cover the wound on his neck, it was useless.
Ling Han slashed again, and after a few slashes, another person was cut down.
The remaining person was scared to death, and did not have any fighting spirit left. Immediately, he fled in a panic.
Ling Han didn't give chase. This was a good opportunity for him to return and deliver a message to Zhu Yangzhou, scaring that guy.
He slowly returned to the Martial Hall. At this time, the news that he had broken through to the Mystery Realm Tier had already spread out, which naturally caused another commotion.
How many days had it been since he entered the Martial Hall?

It had only been ten days, but what about it? His cultivation level had already soared from the Meridian Opening Tier to the Mystery Realm Tier. Every two days or so, he would advance another cultivation level. Who wouldn't go crazy with jealousy?
—Zhao Jian broke another four cups in outrage.

Yan Yan's interest in Ling Han was growing more and more. She would come to look for him every few days, which naturally caused Zhu Yangzhou to feel even more jealous. However, the fact that he had sent someone to kill Ling Han, but they had failed made him feel uneasy.
Because with Ling Han's present relationship with Yan Yan, he was completely capable of asking the City Lord's Residence to make a move, and begin an investigation.

What made him feel slightly at ease was the fact that the black-clad man who had fled back had already been silenced by him. There would be no witnesses now that he was dead. It was impossible for Ling Han's one-sided story to cement the accusation. After all, he was already a Celestial, and furthermore, the son of the Martial Hall's Master. Without complete proof, even the city lord's residence couldn't do anything to him.
He was like a poisonous snake, searching for the next chance to make a move.

Right at this moment, the Martial Hall Competition was about to begin.

Every three years, there would be a disciple competition among the Martial Halls of the various ordinary cities. The victor would be able to represent the B-level city in the high-level competition, and could even charge all the way to the capital.
If he could reach this step, that would be reaching the heavens in a single step.
Every three years, there would be such prodigies and lucky people that would rise above the rest, and soar through the ranks.
This kind of prodigy had appeared in the Fortune Dragon City before. Now, he was already esteemed as one of the four great War God Guardian Deities, and was an elite of Sect Master-level!

Wasn't this a good opportunity for him to quickly enter the Pond of Life?

In Fortune Dragon City's Martial Hall, there just happened to be three Celestial Path-level disciples. Thus, there was no need for trouble at all. It was just these three, and there was no need to pick and choose.
—Once one had stepped onto the Celestial Path, that was a completely different level of being. It was not something that the Mystery Realm Tier could aspire to at all.
However, Ling Han definitely wouldn't settle for that.
Wasn't this a good opportunity for him to quickly enter the Pond of Life?
Thus, he immediately went to find the Master of the Martial Hall. Oh, right, the Master's name was Zhu Tai, and he was a Core Formation Tier cultivator.
Because he was a prodigy of the Martial Hall, Zhu Tai also gave him face. When he found out that Ling Han wanted to see him, he very quickly allowed him to come in.
"I want to participate in the Martial Hall tournament," Ling Han said directly.

Zhu Tai immediately shook his head, "Hehe, though your physique is heaven-defying, you joined too late after all, and haven't stepped into Celestial Path yet. Don't be anxious, three years later, it will be your world."
Ling Han cracked a smile, "I ate a Celestial medicine yesterday, and have just broken through to Foundation Building Tier."
"Pu!" Zhu Tai immediately spluttered out a mouthful of tea, then coughed uncontrollably.
What kind of joke was this? You broke through again?
Hold on, could advancing in the mortal level compare to setting foot on the Celestial Path?
From mortal to Celestial, how much energy was needed to breach this step?
This was the accumulation of many, many things, and was definitely not something that could be accomplished overnight.

He revealed an expression of displeasure. Even if Ling Han's physique was so awesome, it was still impossible for him to rush up to Celestial Path in just a few days. After all, he knew that Ling Han had just broken through to Mystery Realm Tier a few days ago.
"Zhang Hanjun, do you know that deceiving an elder is a serious crime!"
Ling Han looked surprised, "I have indeed broken through."
He released a wisp of aura, which was shockingly Foundation Building Tier-level.
Zhu Tai was instantly dumbfounded, speechless.
He really was a Foundation Building Tier cultivator!
He didn't know how to react at all. Could it be that this was the terror of the Spirit Devouring Physique?
This was too shocking. From mortal to Celestial, this step was actually so simple.
"This!" Aside from being stunned, he was slightly troubled.
In the first place, there were only three Celestial Path-level disciples, so there was no need to choose at all. It was just these three disciples.
But now?
There was now Ling Han added into the equation.
What could they do?
One person had to be eliminated.
"You can leave first. I will consider for a while."
Although Zhu Tai was the Master, the Martial Hall wasn't his private property. Rather, it had been established by the Buddhist Race. Thus, he couldn't do as he liked.
Thus, he convened a meeting, and after a discussion with a few deputy masters, he came up with a solution.
Then let's have a competition.
One out of the four people would be chosen, and the weakest one would be eliminated, which would be fair and just.
When the news spread out, it shook the Martial Hall.
Who would have thought that there would be a person like Ling Han?
As long as there was need, his cultivation level could be increased. It was really too amazing.
When Zhao Jian found out, who knew how many things he had broken.

He knew that Ling Han was a "Spirit Devouring Physique", so his cultivation speed was fast, but no matter how fast, it couldn't possibly be so fast, right? He hadn't even advanced half a minor level, and you have already become a Celestial!
Celestials were extremely valuable. If it was in the village, they could definitely be worshipped on a longevity plaque.
Because time was tight, only a day later, the knockout tournament began.
Ling Han and the others stepped out respectively.
Aside from himself and Zhu Yangzhou, the other two Foundation Building Tier disciples were a man and a woman respectively. Their names were Liu Jia and Li Mingyue.
They drew lots first, then battled in pairs. There was no need for the victors to compete again. The two losers would battle again, and the one who lost would be eliminated.
This was still quite fair. As long as one's abilities weren't at the bottom, they would definitely be able to win.
Thus, the four of them drew lots first. The result was Ling Han against Liu Jia, and Zhu Yangzhou against Ling Han.
The two battles began at the same time.

"Junior Brother Zhang, aren't you a little too arrogant!" Liu Jia shook his head. "Though your physique is astonishingly strong, you have only just broken through to the Foundation Building Tier, after all. What battle prowess could you possibly have? You really don't care about the big picture!"
Meanwhile, Ling Han smiled, "How do you know that when I go to White River City to participate, I would not have already eaten my way to Cauldron Forging Tier?"
So logical!
Liu Jia was instantly rendered speechless, and could not refute him.

chapters.title: Chapter 4661  Tournament Begins
paragraphs: Since he could not convince him otherwise, they could only fight.
Liu Jia stared coldly at Ling Han, his eyes filled with disdain.
He indeed looked down on this opponent, because he felt that the latter had not put in much effort at all. He had completely relied on his physique to advance into Celestial Path.
Was this kind of person worthy of being called a cultivator?
Moreover, to charge up to the Foundation Building Tier in such a way, just how strong could one's battle prowess be?
"Humph, then we'll have to see who's stronger!" he shouted lightly, then charged towards Ling Han.

He had just advanced into Celestial Path not too long ago. Of course, it was only Human Dao Foundation, but his cultivation level had already stabilized. With each punch and kick, the aura of a Celestial Path supreme elite was fully displayed.

Ling Han also channeled power on the level of Human Dao Foundation. This was far from being as powerful as he had once been, because he had already been able to battle against the Ultimate Dao Foundation when he had been in Human Dao Foundation. He had been overwhelmingly freakish.

Right now, he didn't have an advantage in terms of power. However, his grasp of power was far too perfect. One portion of his power could be used like it was two, or even three portions. This was simply terrifying.

Very soon, Liu Jia was at a disadvantage. Furthermore, it was the kind of disadvantage that meant he would be completely dominated. No matter how amateur one was, he could still tell with a single glance who was at the upper hand, and who was at a disadvantage.
All around them, the disciples that were watching the battle exclaimed in surprise.
How could they have imagined that not only did this "Zhang Hanjun" have a special physique, but his natural talent in battle was also so powerful?
This was practically… enough to drive anyone to despair.
After fighting for around a hundred rounds, Liu Jia had no choice but to admit defeat.
He was really no match.
On the other side, Zhu Yangzhou had also won. Now, Liu Jia and Li Mingyue were going to compete for the last place in the tournament.
This battle was soon carried out, and Ling Han had no interest in watching. He directly left.
Just as he was about to leave the arena, he saw Zhu Yangzhou looking at him coldly, his gaze very complicated.
Perhaps, he was also complaining about why Ling Han's cultivation level would increase so quickly.
It hadn't even been a month, and he had already advanced from Meridian Opening Tier to Celestial Path. Who could have imagined this?
The Spirit Devouring Physique was actually so terrifying.
Ling Han ignored him, and strode off.

When Yan Yan heard about this, she deliberately ran over to see Ling Han, and even dragged him to a restaurant outside, saying that she wanted to give him a proper celebration, which almost drove Zhu Yangzhou mad with fury.
He had pursued Yan Yan for several years, and she had never given him any face at all. However, what about Ling Han?
He didn't flirt with her at all, yet Yan Yan chased after him instead.
Comparisons would drive one crazy.
His killing intent blazed even fiercer. No matter what, he could not give Ling Han any more time to grow. Otherwise, this guy would really surpass him in terms of cultivation level.

At first, he had thought that Ling Han merely had cultivation level but no genuine battle prowess. After all, Ling Han had relied on his physique to improve, but after watching the battle between Ling Han and Liu Jia, he was naturally shocked. As it turned out, Ling Han's natural talent in battle was also astonishingly terrifying.
Thus, the only way to suppress Ling Han was to kill this guy.
Another two days later, the Master of the Martial Hall, Zhu Tai, personally brought Ling Han, Zhu Yangzhou and Liu Jia to White River City to participate in the Martial Halls Tournament.
Yan Yan also approached forcefully, requesting to go with them.
She was the daughter of the City Lord, so Zhu Tai didn't dare to say anything. He could only follow the wishes of this Young Miss.
Due to Zhu Tai's presence, Yan Yan's Dao Protector also appeared boldly and publicly with them. The six of them travelled for five days, crossing mountains and rivers.

It should be known that they had to pass through a great many primitive mountains and forests, and among them, there were a great many fierce beasts that were Celestial Path and above. This was also why Zhu Tai wanted to go with them. Firstly, it was to express his high regard for the tournament of the Martial Halls, and secondly, it was also to ensure the safety of the participating disciples.
What surprised them was that they actually did not encounter any wild beasts along the way.

It should be known that they had to pass through a great many primitive mountains and forests, and among them, there were a great many fierce beasts that were Celestial Path and above. This was also why Zhu Tai wanted to go with them. Firstly, it was to express his high regard for the tournament of the Martial Halls, and secondly, it was also to ensure the safety of the participating disciples.
Strange, the wild beasts seemed to have all gone into hiding.
This was natural. Ling Han didn't want to complicate matters. He had already suppressed the ferocious beasts with his powerful aura, so how could any of them dare to run out?
Five days later, they finally arrived at White River City.
In comparison, the White River City was much larger. It was at least the size of three Fortune Dragon Cities.
And after entering into the city, they would also discover that the streets here were wider, with more people, and the streets were also livelier.
From afar, they could see a tall tower standing erect in the city.
That was the Buddhist Tower.
Visibly, seven-coloured light was entwined around the Buddhist Tower, and there was an indescribable sacredness about it, that others would feel deep veneration.
A light flashed through Ling Han's eyes. That was formed from the power of will of all living beings.
The Fortune Dragon City didn't have any Buddhist Tower, and it seemed like it wasn't high-grade enough. Thus, only B-grade cities were qualified to build Buddhist Towers.
Zhu Tai brought them to the Martial Hall here, and after showing the corresponding credentials, they were arranged to stay.

After arriving here, they could see that there were too many Celestial Path-level and above disciples here. Not only were there Foundation Building Tier disciples, there were even Cauldron Forging Tier disciples.

—If one had cultivated to the Foundation Building Tier in a normal city's Martial Hall, then he would be sent to a B-level city's Martial Hall for further cultivation in three years, at most. Similarly, if he advanced another level, he would be able to enter an A-level city for further cultivation.
Similarly, those further up could go to the Royal Capital.

Ati this level, if he wanted to improve further, it would no longer be a matter of cultivation level. Instead, he would have to possess extremely high natural talent in martial arts, and only then would he be qualified to be chosen to enter into the Sacred Land, and become a true member of the Buddhist Race.

White River City could be considered small for a B-level city, with a total of seventeen ordinary cities under its jurisdiction. Thus, every ordinary city's Martial Hall sent out three disciples to participate, and the total number was only fifty one.
Even if there were ten people from White River City itself, it was still far from 100.
In a few days, all the disciples of the Martial Halls from the ordinary cities had arrived, and the tournament was about to begin.

The rules of the tournament were very simple, and that was to "kill" the disciples of the other Martial Halls. Every person that was defeated would be counted as one point, and the loser would immediately be disqualified.

Finally, when there was only one person left, or when the three days' time for the tournament had ended, everyone's score would be counted. The five people with the highest score would be qualified to participate in the advancement tournament of the A-grade city.
The Master of White River City's Martial Hall personally arrived to announce the start of the tournament.

The venue for the competition was arranged in a large mountain. There were still wild beasts inside, and they had not been cleared out. This was also to increase the difficulty and variables of the competition.
The mountains were covered with monitors, so it was very easy to tally the results. None of them would be able to stay in the competition and cause trouble after they were defeated.

With the Martial Hall as the unit of measure, each group would enter into the depths of the mountains. Otherwise, if everyone entered together, it would immediately cause a battle royale, and the tournament would soon end.

This was not just training the battle prowess of the disciples, but also their ability to react to danger. If they only knew how to fight head-on, and did not know how to guard against ambushes or perform ambushes, they would not be of much use even if they were nurtured.
Ling Han and the others were the seventh group to enter the depths of the mountains.
The moment they set off, Zhu Yangzhou led the way, heading towards the depths of the great mountain.
"Let's find a place to hide first, and let the strongest teams cause damage to one another." That was what he said.
Indeed, there were a few teams that were extremely powerful. In fact, there were even "elites" that had formed Ultimate Dao Foundations.
That night, not only did they enter deep into the mountains, they also entered into a cave. There were definitely no surveillance devices here.
Tsk!

Even if there were ten people from White River City itself, it was still far from 100.
In a few days, all the disciples of the Martial Halls from the ordinary cities had arrived, and the tournament was about to begin.
The rules of the tournament were very simple, and that was to "kill" the disciples of the other Martial Halls.
Every person that was defeated would be counted as one point, and the loser would immediately be disqualified.
Finally, when there was only one person left, or when the three days' time for the tournament had ended, everyone's score would be counted.
The five people with the highest score would be qualified to participate in the advancement tournament of the A-grade city.
The Master of White River City's Martial Hall personally arrived to announce the start of the tournament.
The venue for the competition was arranged in a large mountain.
There were still wild beasts inside, and they had not been cleared out.
This was also to increase the difficulty and variables of the competition.
The mountains were covered with monitors, so it was very easy to tally the results.
None of them would be able to stay in the competition and cause trouble after they were defeated.
With the Martial Hall as the unit of measure, each group would enter into the depths of the mountains.
Otherwise, if everyone entered together, it would immediately cause a battle royale, and the tournament would soon end.
This was not just training the battle prowess of the disciples, but also their ability to react to danger.
If they only knew how to fight head-on, and did not know how to guard against ambushes or perform ambushes, they would not be of much use even if they were nurtured.
Ling Han and the others were the seventh group to enter the depths of the mountains.
The moment they set off, Zhu Yangzhou led the way, heading towards the depths of the great mountain.
"Let's find a place to hide first, and let the strongest teams cause damage to one another." That was what he said.
Indeed, there were a few teams that were extremely powerful.
In fact, there were even "elites" that had formed Ultimate Dao Foundations.
That night, not only did they enter deep into the mountains, they also entered into a cave.
There were definitely no surveillance devices here.
Tsk!

chapters.title: Chapter 4662  Resolved
paragraphs: After a simple dinner, Ling Han and the others began to rest, and took turns standing guard.
At midnight, Ling Han was sleeping, when he suddenly felt an ice-cold sensation on his neck.
He opened his eyes, and saw that there was already a sword held against his neck. No wonder it felt cold.
The sword was held in Zhu Yangzhou's hand, and Liu Jia, who was beside him, merely watched coldly from the sidelines. He had absolutely no intention of stopping him.
"Senior Brother, what's the meaning of this?" Ling Han asked, pretending to be confused.
Zhu Yangzhou couldn't help but laugh in spite of himself. "Zhang Hanjun, are you really stupid or are you doing this on purpose? Can't you tell?"

After saying this, he shook his head and continued, "You're truly careless. I've already threatened you several times, and in fact, you even knew that I was the one who sent people to kill you. Yet, you're still sleeping so soundly beside me!"
Even if he wanted to seek death, that was not the way to do it.
To think that he had deliberately found a cave to avoid all the surveillance devices, planning to join forces with Liu Jia to kill him as quickly as lightning.
He had never imagined that things would progress so smoothly to the point of being unbelievable.
He merely stretched out his sword, and Ling Han's life was in his grasp.
Meanwhile, Ling Han pretended to be furious, "Senior Brother, I have really misjudged you! You are too despicable. We are all cultivators, so we should have a fair and square battle to the death!"
"Who's going to fight you to the death? Are you worthy?" Zhu Yangzhou scoffed. "I warned you not to come into contact with Yan Yan, yet you ignored me!"
Meanwhile, Ling Han cried out in injustice, "Senior Brother, you only said not to touch anything that doesn't belong to you, but you didn't say that it was Yan Yan."
Yi, are you a f****** idiot? Can't you even tell the meaning behind these words?
Zhu Yangzhou instantly felt like he was about to go crazy. It couldn't be that he had become enemies with Ling Han because the latter was too straightforward and didn't understand his words, right?

However, upon further thought, this person had the Spirit Devouring Physique. His cultivation level was advancing too quickly, and if he missed this opportunity, there would be no possibility of killing him in the future.
Moreover, Yan Yan was indeed very interested in him. In fact, she had even deliberately accompanied him here!
Just the thought of it made him feel as if a knife was being twisted in his heart.
"This day next year will be the day of your death!" he declared balefully.
"Hold on." Ling Han raised his hand, and said, "What time is it now? Is it past midnight? Otherwise, if the time is remembered wrongly, then wouldn't the death day be remembered wrongly as well?"
This!
Zhu Yangzhou and Liu Jia exchanged looks, both wanting to grit their teeth.
Had this guy really become stupid?
"Don't care about his feigned madness!" Liu Jia said. "The longer the delay, the more trouble there will be. Kill him!"
Zhu Yangzhou nodded in understanding. This person in front of him was indeed terrifying. His cultivation speed was far too quick.
He held the sword forwards, but a strange thing happened. The sword bounced back up, and stabbed into Liu Jia's chest at an incredibly fast speed.
Liu Jia looked at his chest in disbelief. Blood was already gushing out, and when he looked at Zhu Yangzhou, his eyes were still filled with confusion.𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
"W-why?" he asked in a trembling voice.
If he didn't ask clearly, he would die with remaining grievances.
Zhu Yangzhou was also very flustered. He too wanted to know why.

He was clearly extending his sword forwards, so how had it bounced back up? Furthermore, it was so coincidental that it had actually pierced into Liu Jia's body, and had even pierced through the latter's heart.
Ling Han rubbed his neck, and said with emotion, "Senior Brother, you've come back to your senses. In the future, you can still be a good person."
Liu Jia stared fixedly at Zhu Yangzhou, and took his last breath, "You b@stard!"
As he spoke, his neck tilted, and he was completely dead.
The destructive power of this strike was too terrifying, causing him, a Human Dao Foundation cultivator, to practically be killed directly.
'F*ck! This has nothing to do with me!'
Zhu Yangzhou was extremely depressed. He was already dead, so this misunderstanding would naturally never be resolved.
"You, it's you!" He suddenly pointed at Ling Han. There were only three of them here.
It was impossible for Liu Jia to seek his own death, and it was not him who had done it either. Thus, the only one left was Ling Han.
This was something that had suddenly occurred to him, and that was why he had blurted it out. However, after the words left his mouth, a layer of coldness suddenly rose up on his body.
How did he do it?
"You, you, could it be that you have broken through again?" he asked in a trembling voice.
Yi, his imagination was so rich?
Ling Han couldn't help but smile. He nodded, and said, "That's right." He released his aura slightly, reaching the Heavenly Dao Foundation.
Although Zhu Yangzhou was shocked, his heart calmed down.
Thankfully, he was not inferior to his opponent.
However, when Ling Han's aura fluctuated again, it had reached the level of Ultimate Dao Foundation.
W-what!
Zhu Yangzhou was instantly dumbfounded, his eyes widened.
He had broken through again?
However, this was not the end. Every time Ling Han's aura fluctuated, it would become stronger by another level.

Zhu Yangzhou watched helplessly as Ling Han soared all the way from Human Dao Foundation to Spirit Transformation Tier. He was already completely dumbfounded, and could only gape, completely unable to speak.
"Fun, right?" Ling Han smiled as he patted Zhu Yangzhou's shoulder.

"Impossible! Absolutely impossible!" Zhu Yangzhou finally came to his senses. "Even if you're a Spirit Devouring Physique, your cultivation level can't possibly soar like that! That's right, you must have cultivated some kind of mind bewitching technique, and that's why I accidentally killed Liu Jia."
"As long as I stay true to my heart, don't even think of bewitching me!" he roared loudly, brandishing his sword in a slash towards Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled, and stretched out two fingers, casually catching the blade of the sword between them.
Zhu Yangzhou forcefully twisted the hilt of his sword. With the sharpness of this sword, it was completely capable of instantly severing Ling Han's fingers.
However, when he exerted force, he heard a 'qiang', and saw that the sword's blade had broken.
'Holy f*ck!'
The sword was broken?
Zhu Yangzhou looked at the broken sword in disbelief. With a 'ding', the tip of the sword fell onto the ground, releasing a crisp sound, but it was as if he had not heard it.
En, he must have brought a fake sword with him when he left. It must be, haha!
"Die!" He abandoned his sword and threw a punch at Ling Han.
Ling Han casually brandished the broken sword. Pu! Blood instantly sprayed through the air.
Zhu Yangzhou screamed in agony. He grabbed his severed wrist and retreated, only to see that his right hand had already been severed.
"How could this be! How could this be!" he exclaimed in shock, completely unable to believe that he had actually become a cripple.
"Sigh, I wanted to keep a low profile, so why did you come to provoke me?" Ling Han shook his head, and said, "You're seeking death!"
Keep a low profile my a*s!
In ten days to half a month, you have already advanced from Meridian Opening Tier to Celestial Path, and this is called keeping a low profile?
Did anyone act low-key like that?
"Who exactly are you!" Zhu Yangzhou roared.

"You don't have to know that." Ling Han didn't say his name. It was extremely likely that Ah Han was sleeping in this land. That was a Great Emperor, so even if he was sleeping or recuperating from his injuries, Ling Han didn't want to be careless.
He slashed out with his sword. Pu, Zhu Yangzhou was sliced into two, but with a thought from Ling Han, flames burned, burning Zhu Yangzhou into ashes.

He did not touch Liu Jia's corpse. As long as others investigated, they would be able to find out that it was Zhu Yangzhou who had done it. Furthermore, Zhu Yangzhou had disappeared from this moment onwards, so they would conclude he must have fled for fear of punishment.
As for why Zhu Yangzhou wanted to kill Liu Jia, let others think about it. He couldn't be bothered to make up an excuse.
All right, it was time to earn points.

chapters.title: Chapter 4663  Closer and Closer
paragraphs: Ling Han moved out, and searched all over the mountains and plains.
His divine sense was too powerful. As long as he wanted to know, who could escape his senses?
Not long after, he found the first person.

The other party had not foreseen that Ling Han would suddenly appear, because among the contestants this time round, he belonged to the category with higher ranking abilities. Thus, he should be the one that could strut out and look for targets.
Now that he suddenly saw someone walking towards him, he was slightly shocked.
"Very good. You have delivered yourself to my doorstep." He nodded, then said in a haughty manner, "Take the initiative to admit defeat."
Ling Han smiled, "Without fighting, how would you know that I am inferior to you?"
"Haha!" That person laughed loudly, "Do you think that I have not seen the information on the disciples of this tournament? Your name is Zhang Hanjun, and you are merely Human Dao Foundation!"
And as for him?
Ultimate Dao Foundation!
With a gap of two minor levels, this was an absolutely one-sided suppression.
Ling Han shook his head and said, "Wrong, I'm currently Heavenly Dao Foundation."
"How could that be!" That person did not believe him.
"Huh? Don't you know that I'm a Spirit Devouring Physique?" Ling Han countered.
The corner of that person's mouth twitched. He had indeed heard that one of the participating disciples this time round was an incredibly rare physique.
However, even if the Spirit Devouring Physique could rely on absorbing energy to break through to the next cultivation level, there had to be a process of absorption, right?
It was just like water overflowing when the vessel was full, but you have to fill up the entire vessel with water first, right?

"Humph, even if you are Heavenly Dao Foundation, you are still inferior to me by a minor level." That person tried his best to maintain his arrogant attitude, "It would be a piece of cake for me to defeat you."

"Come," Ling Han said with a smile. When he had been in Human Dao Foundation, he had already been able to defeat Ultimate Dao Foundation, though he didn't want to put on such an exaggerated performance now.
That person smirked coldly, and raised his palm to deliver a strike at Ling Han.
Boom, power surged, turning into a massive black palm.
Ling Han smiled faintly as he clenched his fist and punched forward.
Peng!

He had clearly only used the power of Heavenly Dao Foundation, and it was a very standard Heavenly Dao Foundation at that, but under the bombardment of a punch, it had achieved the effect of piercing through.
With this strike, the massive palm immediately crumbled.

That person couldn't help but give an 'en'. That was because this punch from Ling Han was really too amazing, and just happened to be the weak point of his power. Thus, with this strike, it had the effect of breaking through a stronger strike with a weaker counter.

There was no perfect attack in this world, so there would definitely be flaws. However, with his overwhelming advantage in cultivation level, this flaw should be very, very hard to catch. How could it be that every attack could be so accurate?
This opponent was not simple!
He launched another attack at Ling Han.
Ling Han activated his movement technique and counterattacked.
The images of the battle between the two of them passed through the monitors, and very soon, attracted the attention of a great many people.
"Yi, this person should be a Human Dao Foundation. How could he actually manage to exchange blows with an Ultimate Dao Foundation?"
"Wrong, wrong, wrong. He has already advanced into Heavenly Dao Foundation."
"Hiss, this is too shocking, isn't it?"
"Hehe, you have to know that this guy is a Spirit Devouring Physique. If you knew, you wouldn't be so surprised."
"Oh, so that's the case!"
This Spirit Devouring Physique was really a good excuse. No matter how fast Ling Han's cultivation level "improved", this explanation could easily answer any doubts without making anyone suspicious.
"However, this guy doesn't just depend on his physique."

"Indeed, his attacks are far too powerful, and he's also far too sensitive about his opponent's weak points. It's as if he didn't even need to think before instinctively throwing a punch to find his opponent's weakest point."
"Too awesome!"
The spectators all exclaimed in shock. This guy had the ability tier surpassing battle prowess.
"Will he be able to battle someone one minor level higher than him, or will he be able to defeat someone one minor level higher than him?"
"I'm really expectant."
Everyone was curious, and could not take their eyes off him.

And they were not disappointed either. The battle between Ling Han and his opponent was incredibly exciting, and in the end, it was Ling Han that had grasped the weakness of his opponent, and defeated him.𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
The battle ended, and that person left dejectedly. There were surveillance devices here, so he did not dare to break the rules.
Meanwhile, Ling Han smiled faintly. This kind of battle was actually still somewhat useful for him, allowing him to better control the use of power when his battle prowess was limited.
Continue.
He walked all over the mountains and plains, battling with others.
In this place, points could not be earned by defeating one's opponent, but rather by knocking them down.
In comparison, this was much more difficult, because they could run if they couldn't win.
Ling Han didn't mind. In any case, he had three days.

There were some opponents that were relatively strong. In a situation where Ling Han had suppressed his power to Heavenly Dao Foundation, there were three opponents that he could only defeat but not detain.
It could not be helped. He could not use a super strong movement technique to give chase.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed, and the competition had ended.
When the scores were counted, they discovered that two people had not appeared. Then, when they sent someone to look for them, they actually discovered a corpse!
When the news spread out, everyone was shocked.
It was just a competition, and someone had actually died?
Upon investigation, they discovered that this person was Liu Jia, a disciple of Fortune Dragon City. Meanwhile, the missing person was Zhu Yangzhou.
Upon further examination, the injuries on Liu Jia's body were clearly left by Zhu Yangzhou.
The matter was very obvious. Zhu Yangzhou had fled after committing murder.
Zhu Tai instantly cried out in injustice, and went everywhere to find someone to resolve the matter. His son was not that kind of person.
But the evidence was irrefutable. No matter how eloquent he was, it was useless.
Actually, this really could not be considered as wronging Zhu Yangzhou. That was because he and Liu Jia had indeed wanted to kill Ling Han, but they had not succeeded.
When the scores were counted, Ling Han was ranked first!
Even if he still had three opponents that he had yet to defeat, the number of people that had been eliminated by him was still the highest, so his score was naturally the highest.

Thus, Zhu Tai didn't know whether he should be happy or not. This was because the Fortune Dragon City's Martial Hall had always been weak. Every time it participated, it would only be a minor role. Now, Ling Han actually won first place, allowing the glory of several thousand years ago to reappear. This was naturally a joyous matter.
However, his son had been charged with murder, and the entire world was hunting him down. How could he be happy?

Next, Ling Han and the others who were ranked in the top five would be qualified to participate in the advancement battles of the A-grade city. However, Zhu Tai's trip could only end here. If he still wanted to go to the A-grade city, he could only do so as a visitor.

Yan Yan was naturally the happiest about Ling Han's performance. After the tournament ended, she dragged him around the White River City. It was rare for even her to come here, so she naturally wanted to walk around and take a look.

However, the White River City was too big, and they actually lost their way as they walked. Under Yan Yan's instigation, they climbed over a wall, because this way, they would be able to return to the main path faster.
However, because of this, they walked into a massive garden.
"Ah!" Yan Yan suddenly exclaimed in shock. This was because an extremely embarrassing scene had suddenly appeared in front of them—a man and woman were doing something shameful.
And when they discovered that someone had actually interrupted their fun, the couple also cried out in surprise, and hurriedly separated.
"Who are you two?" The man was very young, and he immediately shouted at Ling Han and Yan Yan. However, upon seeing Yan Yan's appearance, his lust was immediately aroused.

No matter how fast Ling Han's cultivation level "improved", this explanation could easily answer any doubts without making anyone suspicious.
"However, this guy doesn't just depend on his physique."
"Indeed, his attacks are far too powerful, and he's also far too sensitive about his opponent's weak points.
It's as if he didn't even need to think before instinctively throwing a punch to find his opponent's weakest point."
"Too awesome!"
The spectators all exclaimed in shock.
This guy had the ability tier surpassing battle prowess.
"Will he be able to battle someone one minor level higher than him, or will he be able to defeat someone one minor level higher than him?"
"I'm really expectant."
Everyone was curious, and could not take their eyes off him.
And they were not disappointed either.
The battle between Ling Han and his opponent was incredibly exciting, and in the end, it was Ling Han that had grasped the weakness of his opponent, and defeated him.𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
The battle ended, and that person left dejectedly.
There were surveillance devices here, so he did not dare to break the rules.
Meanwhile, Ling Han smiled faintly.
This kind of battle was actually still somewhat useful for him, allowing him to better control the use of power when his battle prowess was limited.
Continue.
He walked all over the mountains and plains, battling with others.
In this place, points could not be earned by defeating one's opponent, but rather by knocking them down.
In comparison, this was much more difficult, because they could run if they couldn't win.
Ling Han didn't mind.
In any case, he had three days.
There were some opponents that were relatively strong.
In a situation where Ling Han had suppressed his power to Heavenly Dao Foundation, there were three opponents that he could only defeat but not detain.
It could not be helped.
He could not use a super strong movement technique to give chase.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed, and the competition had ended.
When the scores were counted, they discovered that two people had not appeared.
Then, when they sent someone to look for them, they actually discovered a corpse!
When the news spread out, everyone was shocked.
It was just a competition, and someone had actually died?
Upon investigation, they discovered that this person was Liu Jia, a disciple of Fortune Dragon City.
Meanwhile, the missing person was Zhu Yangzhou.
Upon further examination, the injuries on Liu Jia's body were clearly left by Zhu Yangzhou.
The matter was very obvious.
Zhu Yangzhou had fled after committing murder.
Zhu Tai instantly cried out in injustice, and went everywhere to find someone to resolve the matter.
His son was not that kind of person.
But the evidence was irrefutable.
No matter how eloquent he was, it was useless.
Actually, this really could not be considered as wronging Zhu Yangzhou.
That was because he and Liu Jia had indeed wanted to kill Ling Han, but they had not succeeded.
When the scores were counted, Ling Han was ranked first!
Even if he still had three opponents that he had yet to defeat, the number of people that had been eliminated by him was still the highest, so his score was naturally the highest.
Thus, Zhu Tai didn't know whether he should be happy or not.
This was because the Fortune Dragon City's Martial Hall had always been weak.
Every time it participated, it would only be a minor role.
Now, Ling Han actually won first place, allowing the glory of several thousand years ago to reappear.
This was naturally a joyous matter.
However, his son had been charged with murder, and the entire world was hunting him down.
How could he be happy?
Next, Ling Han and the others who were ranked in the top five would be qualified to participate in the advancement battles of the A-grade city.
However, Zhu Tai's trip could only end here.
If he still wanted to go to the A-grade city, he could only do so as a visitor.
Yan Yan was naturally the happiest about Ling Han's performance.
After the tournament ended, she dragged him around the White River City.
It was rare for even her to come here, so she naturally wanted to walk around and take a look.
However, the White River City was too big, and they actually lost their way as they walked.
Under Yan Yan's instigation, they climbed over a wall, because this way, they would be able to return to the main path faster.
However, because of this, they walked into a massive garden.
"Ah!" Yan Yan suddenly exclaimed in shock.
This was because an extremely embarrassing scene had suddenly appeared in front of them—a man and woman were doing something shameful.
And when they discovered that someone had actually interrupted their fun, the couple also cried out in surprise, and hurriedly separated.
"Who are you two?" The man was very young, and he immediately shouted at Ling Han and Yan Yan.
However, upon seeing Yan Yan's appearance, his lust was immediately aroused.

chapters.title: Chapter 4664  Ripples
paragraphs: Actually, as long as Ling Han was willing, his divine sense could enshroud the entire city, and easily find the way out for him.
However, the closer he got to the core of the Buddhist Land, the more cautious he became. He definitely wouldn't use his strength easily.
Thus, he didn't care where he went.
However, he was still slightly embarrassed that he had actually witnessed the intimate moment between a man and a woman.

"You're not from my residence!" The woman hurriedly pulled on her clothes that were half-removed, and after sweeping a glance over Ling Han and Yan Yan, she immediately exclaimed in shock, "Shaolin, they're thieves!"
"Hehe, what a beautiful villain!" Yet the young man was not the slightest bit flustered. He merely stared at Yan Yan, desire flickering in his eyes.
He had just been interrupted, and now that he saw an even more beautiful woman, desire naturally rose up in him again.
This was someone that had delivered herself to his doorstep.
Yan Yan covered her face with her hands. This was really too painful to the eyes. She was still a virgin.
"We're not thieves, we, we just got lost!" she argued. After all, she was in the wrong.

"Haha, you barged into my Zhou Manor, and you still say you're not a thief?" The young man gritted his teeth, "Hehe, if you don't want me to send you into the government office, then listen to me obediently."
En, they had encountered a pervert.

Ling Han shook his head, and said, "The two of you are not a married couple. En, looking at her age, she's older than you. Furthermore, the two of you are having a tryst in the depths of the garden. Obviously, the relationship between the two of you is shameful."
"Going by that deduction… this woman can't be your stepmother, right?"
When these words fell, the expressions of the young man and the woman changed drastically.
F***, his guess was too accurate.

This woman was precisely the seventeenth concubine of the young man's father. Because she was lonely in her room, and this "son" was outrageously bold with lust, the two of them became good friends as they spent time together.
It should be known that this kind of thing could never be exposed. Once it was revealed, there would definitely be deaths.
"Humph, you guys are seeking death!" The young man's expression changed drastically, filled with killing intent.
Ling Han had to die. As for Yan Yan, he could imprison her, and when he was tired of her, he would decide whether to kill her or throw her into a brothel.
He directly charged over, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Ultimate Dao Foundation.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and directly increased his power to the level of Ultimate Dao Foundation.

He couldn't be bothered to dawdle slowly. In any case, he had won first place in the Martial Hall competition, and he had obtained a Celestial medicine as his reward. He only had to say that he had broken through after consuming it, and that would be fine, right?
He did as he willed, and very soon, he had suppressed that young man, and directly stepped on him.
However, this was a battle on the level of Foundation Building Tier, after all, so the commotion was still very big. Very soon, someone rushed over.
What was going on?
Everyone was slightly stunned. Firstly, who was this unfamiliar man and woman?
Secondly, why would Third Young Master and Seventeenth Concubine appear here?
Would this… cause one's imagination to run wild?
"Who are you two?" The elite guards appeared, staring at Ling Han and Yan Yan. "Let go of Third Young Master first."
Ling Han smiled, and said, "If I let go of him, will you guys immediately rush over and beat me up?"
Of course they would.
'You guys are trespassing on someone else's property, and as guards, if we don't react at all, that would not be logical, right?'
However, if he had said it so directly, would the other party still let the hostage go?
"We can talk things over peacefully." The elite guard hurriedly appeased Ling Han, "Do you know that this is the Zhou Clan! Our Old Master Zhou is the father-in-law of the Lord City Master!"
Yan Yan couldn't help but pale slightly. If the other party was just a member of a small clan, she would be able to deal with him as long as she revealed her identity.
But… the City Lord of a B-level city?
That was naturally a level higher than the City Lord of an ordinary city.

"Oh." Ling Han nodded, "At this point, we can no longer hide our identities! Actually, we are the investigator that your Old Master Zhou has hired, and that is to find out which wife and concubine is committing adultery outside."
"Sigh, who would've thought that the adulterer wasn't an outsider, but one of our own."
"To be on guard against all kinds of dangers, but those among our own are hard to guard against."
Hearing Ling Han's words, everyone gave an "oh", and some even nodded.

Previously, they had already been curious as to why Third Young Master and Seventeenth Concubine would appear here. It should be known that there were only flowers and trees here, and there was not even a single chair. This man and woman were all alone here, so what could they be doing here?
Now that they heard Ling Han say this, it naturally confirmed their conjecture.
This… damn shameless guy, he actually dared to cuckold his father.

"No, don't believe him!" That Seventeenth Concubine hurriedly explained. However, because she had been in a rush previously, she had only pulled on her clothes and not tidied them up properly. It was obvious that her clothes were disheveled.
Hence, her explanation was naturally pale and powerless.
As for that Third Young Master, he had been stepped on by Ling Han, and could not speak at all.

"Alright, I'll hand him over to you guys. We'll naturally ask your master for the compensation, so there's no need to send me off." Ling Han gave Yan Yan a signal, and the two of them turned to leave.

"Hehe, since you've already arrived, why are you in a rush to leave? Let's go to the inner courtyard and have a cup of tea." The elite guards hurriedly intercepted them. The identities of these two people were unknown, so how could they be trusted just because of mere words?
If he allowed them to escape, he would definitely be in deep trouble.
"Let's drink again next time." Ling Han stretched out a hand, and exchanged a blow with the elite guard, forcing him backwards. Then, he took advantage of the opening to flee.
This elite guard was only in the Ultimate Dao Foundation, so how could he stop Ling Han?
However, he had already memorized the appearance of Ling Han and Yam Yam. After making his report to the City Lord's Residence, the entire city would naturally issue a warrant for their arrest.
After Ling Han and Yan Yan left the Zhou Residence, they finally found the right path and returned to the Martial Hall.
Recalling what she had just experienced, Yan Yan couldn't help but cover her mouth and laugh.
Though the process was a little embarrassing, it was still very fun.
However, not long after, as expected, portraits of them were posted all over the city. The city lord's residence issued a warrant for their arrest.

At this time, that Dao Protector of Yan Yan had no choice but to step out. After he had clarified the situation, he took out the official seal of Fortune Dragon City, and entered into the city lord's residence to explain the situation.

When he came out of the city lord's residence, the warrant for their arrest had also been removed. After all, the city lord of an ordinary city was only one level lower than the city lord of a B-level city. Furthermore, this matter could actually only be considered a misunderstanding.
Ling Han and the others who were ranked in the top five in the Martial Hall tournament rested for a few days before setting off for the A-grade city.
They would form a team with the other five disciples to participate in the advancement competition of the Martial Hall tournament.
There were still five days until departure, and everyone could move freely. After they set out, they would not be able to move freely.
After Ling Han stayed in the Martial Hall for a day, Yan Yan dragged him out to play again.
"Zhang Hanjun, if you can enter the Sacred Land, will you forget about me?" This willful young mistress suddenly asked, appearing a little worried and rueful.
After so many days of contact, she realized that Ling Han was becoming more and more mysterious and difficult to understand, making her feel as if she was about to lose him.
