chapters.title: Chapter 4665  Extorting a confession
paragraphs: "Yes," Ling Han replied without hesitation.
To him, Yan Yan was only a stranger, after all, what more when he was still acting as Zhang Hanjun. What Yan Yan saw and understood was not the real him at all.
Moreover, he wasn't here to pick up girls.
Thus, instead of giving her false hope, it would be better to deal with her quickly.
Yan Yan faltered upon hearing this. She hadn't expected that Ling Han would be so direct, and her face instantly became as white as a sheet.
"Wu!" She covered her face and left.
Ling Han didn't give chase. This was a good opportunity for him to sever his connection with Yan Yan. After all, he was going to sneak into the Pond of Life.
He stood up, planning to return to the Martial Hall.

Having won first place in the Martial Hall tournament this time, he would naturally be rewarded, and that wa he could enter the Little Pond of Life of White River City and cultivate inside for three days.

White River City had a Buddhist Tower, which could gather the power of will of all living beings, and with the conversion of a certain formation or Spirit Tool, this power of will would turn into incredibly pure energy fluid. If a cultivator cultivated in it, there would be many benefits.
Unfortunately, it was the Little Pond of Life.

Ling Han couldn't help but feel a little regretful. This Little Pond of Life definitely wouldn't be connected to the real Pond of Life. Otherwise, he would be able to absorb to his heart's content in one go, and directly "accelerate" the Seed of the Holy Flame, thereby becoming a Saint.
However, this was another chance to allow his cultivation level to soar in broad daylight.

Tomorrow morning, he would enter the Little Pond of Life to cultivate. After he came out, the newly established White River City's "team" would set off for Heavenly Prosperity City, an A-grade city to participate in the advancement battles.
"It's not good to break a woman's heart like this." A man's voice was heard from behind him, filled with vigor.
Ling Han turned around, only to see a middle-aged man in embroidered robes walking out from the darkness.
Master of Fortune Dragon City's Martial Hall, Zhu Tai.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "She's not suitable for me."
"If you don't try, how do you know she's not suitable?" Zhu Tai asked.
Yi, when did you become such a gossip?
"Why don't you try then, Lord Zhu?" Ling Han said with a smile.
"How could I possibly!" Zhu Tai laughed in spite of himself.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
"If you don't try, how do you know it's not suitable?" Ling Han said.
These words were a retort.
Zhu Tai showed a hint of displeasure, and said, "Zhang Hanjun, have you forgotten yourself in your conceit? You actually dare to speak to me like this!"
Ling Han shook his head, "Lord Zhu has killing intent on him, so—"
Zhu Tai was surprised. 'You can even tell that?'
However, since he had been seen through, he no longer put on any pretences, and asked darkly, "Is the disappearance of Yangzhou related to you?"
"Why would Lord Zhu think so?" Ling Han asked.

"Hmph, at that time, the three of you entered the depths of the mountains together. Even in the final surveillance image, the three of you did not separate." Zhu Tai balefully said, "But in the end, only you walked out. How could it be that it would not be not suspicious?"
Ling Han shrugged and said, "If it's really as Lord Zhu has said, then shouldn't the investigation be conducted by the Martial Hall of White River City?"

"Humph, you're a Spirit Devouring Physique. How valuable is this!" Zhu Tai said through gritted teeth. Precisely because Ling Han was a rare talent, the investigation into Liu Jia's death was very sloppy. In any case, Zhu Tai was the biggest suspect, so they just had to put this person on the wanted list first.
"Where have you hidden Yangzhou!" he raised his voice and shouted loudly.
Ling Han smiled, "Does Lord Zhu want to use force?"
"That's right," Zhu Tai said coldly. "I will apprehend you, and under torture, you will definitely tell the truth!"
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Since it's torture, can the answers extorted be used as evidence?"
"I only need to force out the whereabouts of Yangzhou, and find Yangzhou. When we ask him directly, the truth will naturally come out!" Zhu Tai said.

Zhu Tai gritted his teeth. If this matter really had nothing to do with Ling Han, then with how he had persecuted a prodigy, he would either have to roam the world from now onwards, or kill him to keep him from leaking the secret. He would just have to gamble and see if he would be able to get through it by luck.

Ling Han clapped his hands, "Your logic is accpetable, but firstly, what if I really have nothing to do with it? Then what does Lord Zhu plan to do? Kill me to keep the secret? Secondly, Lord Zhu, you are not considering the possibility, and that is whether you can defeat me or not?"

Zhu Tai gritted his teeth. If this matter really had nothing to do with Ling Han, then with how he had persecuted a prodigy, he would either have to roam the world from now onwards, or kill him to keep him from leaking the secret. He would just have to gamble and see if he would be able to get through it by luck.
However, for the sake of his son, he was willing to take this risk.
As for whether he could defeat Ling Han or not?
Haha, wasn't this the biggest joke in the world?
"Zhang Hanjun, do you really think that just because you're a Spirit Devouring Physique, you can look down on everyone?" He sneered, and said, "I'm a Core Formation Tier cultivator!"

Compared to the Foundation Building Tier, he had the advantage of a whole two major cultivation levels, and in the cultivation world, putting aside the fact that the gap of a major cultivation level would crushing enough, even the gap of a minor cultivation level would be extremely, extremely difficult to breach.
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, "Come!"

—To have some private words with him, Yan Yan deliberately chose a very secluded small forest, and this also created an absolutely good opportunity for Zhu Tai to make a move. Otherwise, he would definitely have to wait until Ling Han walked to some secluded place to make his move.
Zhu Tai was instantly enraged. He, a dignified Core Formation Tier cultivator, was actually provoked like this by a mere Foundation Building Tier cultivator?
Even a clay figurine would get angry, what more when he was not made of clay.
He didn't waste any more words, and he immediately lashed out with his palm. He was just about to subdue Ling Han and drag him to a more secluded location for interrogation.
He was sure that his son was definitely still alive. It was just that Ling Han had locked him up somewhere.
Ling Han raised his hand, and grabbed back at Zhu Tai's wrist.
"Where did you get the courage to—"
Zhu Tai had not even finished his words, when he realized that his wrist had already fallen into Ling Han's hand.
This was very easy and natural, as if he had taken the initiative to stretch out his hand for Ling Han to grasp.
He looked down, then raised his head to look at Ling Han, his face filled with surprise.
This was completely unacceptable.
"You father and son, why do you always think of using your superior strength to bully others?" Ling Han shook his head.
"Y-y-you, what cultivation level are you at?" Zhu Tai asked in a trembling voice. At this moment, he sensed an indescribable aura from Ling Han, causing him to shiver in fear.
This was an absolutely one-sided suppression.
"Me?" Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "That's hard to say."
Whatever cultivation level he was at, that was that. What did it mean that it was not easy to say?
Zhu Tai looked humiliated and furious. He was already in such a state, yet Ling Han was still toying with him.
Ling Han couldn't help but smile, and said, "I'm a fifteen-star Venerate. Have you ever heard of something like that?"
Of course, I know about Venerate Tier, but what the hell was a fifteen-star Venerate?
Venerate Tier only had one to nine stars!
The humiliated and furious expression on Zhu Tai's face became even more pronounced. 'As expected, you're still toying with me!'
Ling Han sighed, "Could it be that I have countered too many people verbally, so no one would believe me even if I told the truth now?"
"Sigh, when I go back, I will slap Old Black; it's all his fault for leading me astray!"
With a thought from Ling Han, boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames burned fiercely, immediately burning Zhu Tai into ashes, leaving nothing behind.
Then, he retracted all of his aura. He was no different from any other Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator, and headed towards the Martial Hall.
He had to end this adventure as soon as possible, and advance into Saint Tier. Only then would he be able to truly compete with the king tiers of the younger generation.

After he came out, the newly established White River City's "team" would set off for Heavenly Prosperity City, an A-grade city to participate in the advancement battles.
"It's not good to break a woman's heart like this." A man's voice was heard from behind him, filled with vigor.
Ling Han turned around, only to see a middle-aged man in embroidered robes walking out from the darkness.
Master of Fortune Dragon City's Martial Hall, Zhu Tai.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "She's not suitable for me."
"If you don't try, how do you know she's not suitable?" Zhu Tai asked.
Yi, when did you become such a gossip?
"Why don't you try then, Lord Zhu?" Ling Han said with a smile.
"How could I possibly!" Zhu Tai laughed in spite of himself.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
"If you don't try, how do you know it's not suitable?" Ling Han said.
These words were a retort.
Zhu Tai showed a hint of displeasure, and said, "Zhang Hanjun, have you forgotten yourself in your conceit?
You actually dare to speak to me like this!"
Ling Han shook his head, "Lord Zhu has killing intent on him, so—"
Zhu Tai was surprised. 'You can even tell that?'
However, since he had been seen through, he no longer put on any pretences, and asked darkly, "Is the disappearance of Yangzhou related to you?"
"Why would Lord Zhu think so?" Ling Han asked.
"Hmph, at that time, the three of you entered the depths of the mountains together.
Even in the final surveillance image, the three of you did not separate." Zhu Tai balefully said, "But in the end, only you walked out.
How could it be that it would not be not suspicious?"
Ling Han shrugged and said, "If it's really as Lord Zhu has said, then shouldn't the investigation be conducted by the Martial Hall of White River City?"
"Humph, you're a Spirit Devouring Physique.
How valuable is this!" Zhu Tai said through gritted teeth.
Precisely because Ling Han was a rare talent, the investigation into Liu Jia's death was very sloppy.
In any case, Zhu Tai was the biggest suspect, so they just had to put this person on the wanted list first.
"Where have you hidden Yangzhou!" he raised his voice and shouted loudly.
Ling Han smiled, "Does Lord Zhu want to use force?"
"That's right," Zhu Tai said coldly.
"I will apprehend you, and under torture, you will definitely tell the truth!"
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Since it's torture, can the answers extorted be used as evidence?"
"I only need to force out the whereabouts of Yangzhou, and find Yangzhou.
When we ask him directly, the truth will naturally come out!" Zhu Tai said.
Zhu Tai gritted his teeth.

If this matter really had nothing to do with Ling Han, then with how he had persecuted a prodigy, he would either have to roam the world from now onwards, or kill him to keep him from leaking the secret.
He would just have to gamble and see if he would be able to get through it by luck.
Ling Han clapped his hands, "Your logic is accpetable, but firstly, what if I really have nothing to do with it?
Then what does Lord Zhu plan to do?
Kill me to keep the secret?
Secondly, Lord Zhu, you are not considering the possibility, and that is whether you can defeat me or not?"
Zhu Tai gritted his teeth.

If this matter really had nothing to do with Ling Han, then with how he had persecuted a prodigy, he would either have to roam the world from now onwards, or kill him to keep him from leaking the secret.
He would just have to gamble and see if he would be able to get through it by luck.
However, for the sake of his son, he was willing to take this risk.
As for whether he could defeat Ling Han or not?
Haha, wasn't this the biggest joke in the world?
"Zhang Hanjun, do you really think that just because you're a Spirit Devouring Physique, you can look down on everyone?" He sneered, and said, "I'm a Core Formation Tier cultivator!"

Compared to the Foundation Building Tier, he had the advantage of a whole two major cultivation levels, and in the cultivation world, putting aside the fact that the gap of a major cultivation level would crushing enough, even the gap of a minor cultivation level would be extremely, extremely difficult to breach.
Ling Han crooked a finger at him, "Come!"
—To have some private words with him, Yan Yan deliberately chose a very secluded small forest, and this also created an absolutely good opportunity for Zhu Tai to make a move.
Otherwise, he would definitely have to wait until Ling Han walked to some secluded place to make his move.
Zhu Tai was instantly enraged.
He, a dignified Core Formation Tier cultivator, was actually provoked like this by a mere Foundation Building Tier cultivator?
Even a clay figurine would get angry, what more when he was not made of clay.
He didn't waste any more words, and he immediately lashed out with his palm.
He was just about to subdue Ling Han and drag him to a more secluded location for interrogation.
He was sure that his son was definitely still alive.
It was just that Ling Han had locked him up somewhere.
Ling Han raised his hand, and grabbed back at Zhu Tai's wrist.
"Where did you get the courage to—"
Zhu Tai had not even finished his words, when he realized that his wrist had already fallen into Ling Han's hand.
This was very easy and natural, as if he had taken the initiative to stretch out his hand for Ling Han to grasp.
He looked down, then raised his head to look at Ling Han, his face filled with surprise.
This was completely unacceptable.
"You father and son, why do you always think of using your superior strength to bully others?" Ling Han shook his head.
"Y-y-you, what cultivation level are you at?" Zhu Tai asked in a trembling voice.
At this moment, he sensed an indescribable aura from Ling Han, causing him to shiver in fear.
This was an absolutely one-sided suppression.
"Me?" Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "That's hard to say."
Whatever cultivation level he was at, that was that.
What did it mean that it was not easy to say?
Zhu Tai looked humiliated and furious.
He was already in such a state, yet Ling Han was still toying with him.
Ling Han couldn't help but smile, and said, "I'm a fifteen-star Venerate.
Have you ever heard of something like that?"
Of course, I know about Venerate Tier, but what the hell was a fifteen-star Venerate?
Venerate Tier only had one to nine stars!
The humiliated and furious expression on Zhu Tai's face became even more pronounced. 'As expected, you're still toying with me!'
Ling Han sighed, "Could it be that I have countered too many people verbally, so no one would believe me even if I told the truth now?"
"Sigh, when I go back, I will slap Old Black; it's all his fault for leading me astray!"
With a thought from Ling Han, boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames burned fiercely, immediately burning Zhu Tai into ashes, leaving nothing behind.
Then, he retracted all of his aura.
He was no different from any other Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator, and headed towards the Martial Hall.
He had to end this adventure as soon as possible, and advance into Saint Tier.
Only then would he be able to truly compete with the king tiers of the younger generation.

chapters.title: Chapter 4666  Wait Three days for me
paragraphs: Zhu Tai's death did not cause any reaction.
Because the Martial Halls tournament had ended, he should have returned to Fortune Dragon City by now. Thus, his "disappearance" was naturally very normal.
—He had gone back.

When it was truly discovered that Zhu Tai had disappeared, Ling Han would have already gone to Heavenly Prosperity City. In fact, he may have even entered into the Royal Capital. Who would be able to trace it to him?
On the second day, Ling Han brought his token and headed to Buddhist Tower.
With this token, he could cultivate in the Little Pond of Life for three days.
White River City was very big, but his speed was also very fast. Even if he couldn't use his normal speed, he was now at least "Ultimate Dao Foundation".
Not long after, he arrived before the Buddhist Tower.

This Buddhist Tower was extremely tall, and looked like it could pierce through the clouds and tear open the sky. Because the power of faith of all living beings was too dense, it turned into a seven-coloured light, making this Buddhist Tower appear even more sacred.
Even outside of Buddhist Tower, there were still a great many believers that were sincerely kowtowing, delivering slivers of power of belief.
Ling Han couldn't figure it out at all. Since the Lords of Death had completely become the opposing side of the Living Realm, why did he still keep this piece of territory?
Shouldn't they be like the Sea Emperor, all alone and with only one Imperial Son?
Forget it, he wouldn't think about it.
Ling Han circled around, and arrived at the main entrance.
There was a flight of stairs that led upwards, and there were about a few hundred steps. At the end was the main doors of the Buddhist Tower.
Ling Han was just about to ascend the stairs, when he suddenly glimpsed a group of people.
There were people coming and going here, so it wouldn't be strange to see more people. However, there was one person in this group that Ling Han recognized.
Zhou Shaolin, that guy who had cuckolded his old man.
"It's you!" Zhou Shaolin also saw Ling Han, and couldn't help but feel angry. He immediately rushed over, looking like he was about to eat someone.
"Brother Shaolin, what is it?" The people beside him all caught up and asked.
"Zhang Hanjun, I never thought that I would see you here!" Zhou Shaolin ignored everyone else, and only gritted his teeth at Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, "Who would've thought? You stole your father's woman, yet he didn't break your third leg."
Hiss, everyone in the surroundings inhaled sharply.
They had indeed heard some rumors, but they had all heard it from hearsay. Now that they had personally heard Ling Han say this, they were instantly greatly shocked.

Some people were disdainful. This Zhou Shaolin had cuckolded his own father. He was practically a beast among beasts, but there were also some that expressed their envy. Just thinking about this kind of thing was exciting.
Zhou Shaolin was furious. This was his humiliation, yet Ling Han had publicly exposed it.
"Haidong, do me a favor and give this brat a beating," he said to a young man beside him.
This Niu Haidong was the top elite of their group, and had already advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier.
Cauldron Forging Tier against Foundation Building Tier, no matter how high your natural talent was, so what?
Niu Haidong nodded, and stepped out.

Though his cultivation level was higher, his background was inferior to the others. He came from a small clan, and with his high talent in martial arts, he managed to sneak into the ranks of these second-generation young masters. Thus, he could not possibly refuse Zhou Shaolin's request.
"Sorry!" Niu Haidong immediately threw a punch at Ling Han.
Sigh!
Ling Han sighed. This was a persona, and he couldn't allow his persona to collapse.
Thus, he could only turn around and flee.
His target was Buddhist Tower!
Everyone faltered upon hearing this. They hadn't imagined that Ling Han would dare to run toward the Buddhist Tower.
It should be known that in the hearts of these people, Buddhist Tower was sacred and could not be blasphemed against.
If you drew the flames of war to Buddhist Tower, you would be condemned by everyone, and there would definitely be no place for you in the future.𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
"You are really outrageously bold!" Zhou Shaolin declared. With a wave of his hand, he beckoned Niu Haidong to set off in pursuit as well.
Niu Haidong faltered for a moment, but still gave chase.
Ling Han ran quickly, and arrived at the entrance to the Buddhist Tower. He saw two monks immediately stand up from their cross-legged positions at the entrance, looking at him balefully.
"This is a peaceful place of the Buddhist Sect, so don't be impudent!" they both said in ice-cold voices.
Ling Han smiled, and took out his token, "I have come to soak, er, enter the Little Pond of Life to cultivate."
At this time, Zhou Shaolin and Niu Haidong had also caught up, but in front of the two monks, they did not dare make a move.

In Buddhist Land, monks were also known as ascetic monks. They were completely devoted to serving Ancestral Buddha, and would never marry for the rest of their lives. Thus, the status of monks was also very, very high. Even the City Lord would not dare to easily offend them.
A monk took the token, looked at it, and nodded: "Go in."
Ling Han walked in, then turned around and said with a smile, "I'll battle again in three days. Do you dare?"

"To say nothing of three days, even if it was thirty days, I would still wait until you appear!" Zhou Shaolin said through gritted teeth. Then, with a wave of his hand, he brought Niu Haidong to the foot of the steps to wait.
He didn't dare to block Buddhist Tower's entrance.
However, once Ling Han came out, he would definitely beat this guy to death.

So what if he was a prodigy of the Martial Hall? It wasn't like he would kill or cripple his opponent. With his status as the brother-in-law of the Lord City Master, who would dare to make things difficult for him?
'I'll wait!'
After Ling Han entered, it wasn't long before a young monk came out and guided him to the Pond of Life.
They actually walked all the way downwards. After a whole eighteen levels, a wide space suddenly opened up ahead of them, and a very large pool appeared.
The waters of the pool were boiling, but it could be clearly seen that it was not steam rising from high temperatures, but rather dense mist.
"Benefactor, please," the young monk said. "Three days later, I will come and ask you to leave."
Ling Han nodded, and without any hesitation, directly walked into the pool waters.
He was sensing, wanting to figure out how to convert the power of belief into pure energy. If he could also imitate it, it would bring great benefits to the cultivation of those around him.
As for absorbing the power in the pool waters?
It was no big deal. With his appetite, wouldn't he be able to absorb all of it in a few moves?
Ling Han released his divine sense, and carefully observed.
The beliefs of all living beings were focused on the Buddhist Tower, which was then converted into a trickle that flowed down from different pipes and converged here.
However, Ling Han still couldn't figure out exactly how it was converted.
"Perhaps, this involves the techniques of a Great Emperor, and that is not something that I can glimpse now."
After Ling Han studied it for half a day, he gave up on the idea of continuing to study it.
He began to absorb the power of all life.

Actually, he wasn't a Spirit Devouring Physique. However, firstly, his cultivation level was too high, and secondly, he still had a Seed of the Holy Flame in his mind. This was a true glutton, and it had surpassed the Spirit Devouring Physique by who knew how much.
Thus, no matter how much energy you had, he would still absorb it all.
Boom!
He relaxed slightly, and went to collect the energy in the pool waters, but the whole Buddhist Tower was releasing loud noises, trembling, as if it was about to collapse.
Hiss!
Ling Han gritted his teeth. There was too little energy in the pool waters. He hadn't gone all out yet, and had only absorbed it for a while. What was the result?
The energy in the pool waters had decreased by one third.
That was too little, wasn't it?
Sigh, so it could only be called Little Pond of Life.

chapters.title: Chapter 4667: Six Cauldrons
paragraphs: Xiu, xiu, xiu! Multiple figures flew over. They were all monks cultivating in Buddhist Tower.

They sensed the massive tremors of the Buddhist Tower, and also discovered that the root of these tremors was the Pond of Life at the lowest level. Thus, they naturally had to run over at the first instant to check on the situation.
"What’s going on?" a monk who looked like the leader of the group asked.
"T-the Pond of Life!" Someone pointed ahead, his finger trembling slightly.
It could be clearly seen that the pool waters had initially been close to the edge of the pool, but now? It had directly declined by one third.
"It was this person who absorbed it?"
"Hiss, who is he?"
"The champion of this year’s Martial Halls tournament, Spirit Devouring Physique."
"Spirit... Spirit Devouring Physique?"
"Clearly knowing that he has a Spirit Devouring Physique, yet he was still allowed in?"
"Er, according to convention, the champion of every tournament would be qualified to enter the Pond of Life to cultivate for three days. It should be an oversight."
That’s right. Who would have thought that a freak like the Spirit Devouring Physique would appear out of nowhere?
"Quick, hurry up and fish him out. Otherwise, the Pond of Life will be sucked dry by him!"
Everyone hurriedly dragged Ling Han out of the Pond of Life. In such a short while, it had lost a whole third of its energy.
Meanwhile, Ling Han sighed. The energy in this Pond of Life was really too little.

Thinking about it, it was normal. After all, this was only gathered by the believers of White River City and the 17 ordinary cities under its jurisdiction. Furthermore, it was always used by the monks, so how much could be left?
"Three days hasn’t passed, right?" he protested.
"Shoo, shoo, shoo. Are you trying to suck the Pond of Life dry?" The monks all treated him like a ferocious beast, directly shooing him away.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. His persona clearly hadn’t collapsed yet, so why was he still able to attract animosity like this?
Reflection, he really had to reflect on himself.
Ling Han walked out in a daze, but he had not taken too many steps, when his aura suddenly fluctuated, and ascended to the next level.
Cauldron Forging Tier!
These monks were the best witnesses.
In the end, these monks were even more troubled.
And what the f****** did you do? You directly advanced into the next major tier, but what was the price? The Pond of Life had lost one third of its energy!
They practically chased Ling Han out the main doors.
Was there a need to do this?
Ling Han shook his head, turned around, and descended the stairs.
"Haha, so you have actually been chased out." When Zhou Shaolin saw Ling Han, his face was filled with pleasant surprise.

He now knew that Ling Han was a Spirit Devouring Physique. Thus, he was really afraid that Ling Han would suddenly advance into the Cauldron Forging Tier three days later. That way, it would be very difficult to beat him up.
However, only half a day had passed, and Ling Han had already come out. Furthermore, he had been chased out.
What did this signify?
This guy must have done something out of line in his speech and actions, angering those monks, and that was why he had been chased out.
In other words, Ling Han was still in the Foundation Building Tier.
Hehe.
Ling Han looked at Zhou Shaolin coldly, and shook his head, "Foolish clown, you still haven’t scrammed?"
"Stubborn fool!" Zhou Shaolin said with a humph. "Haidong, hit him. The harder you hit him, the better."
"All right." Niu Haidong strode forwards, bearing down on Ling Han.
This time, even if Ling Han ran to the Buddhist Tower’s entrance again, he would still be chased off.
Ling Han smiled, "Are you sure you want to help the villain?"
"You really have a bad mouth!" Niu Haidong smirked coldly, then charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han casually delivered a palm strike. Pa! Niu Haidong collapsed to the ground, completely unable to get back up.
F***, what was going on here?
Zhou Shaolin wore a dumbfounded expression. He could not accept this at all. What was going on here?

Ling Han kindly explained, "I’ve broken through again. Now, I’m a Cauldron Forging Tier, and furthermore... Six Cauldrons." He very casually set a cultivation level for himself. In any case, the Pond of Life had lost one third of its energy, so it wasn’t impossible for it to send him up to Six Cauldrons.
After all, he was the only "Spirit Devouring Physique" in the world, and there was no way to prove it.
This!
Zhou Shaolin was dumbfounded. ’You have just gone in for a tour, and in total, it has not exceeded three hours, and you have broken through just like that?’
Furthermore, not only had he broken through to the next major tier, he had also broken through the limits of the Cauldron Forging Tier?
But if that was not the case, how could Niu Haidong sent flying with a single slap be explained?
This was an absolutely one-sided suppression.
"You, you, you—" He stuttered "you" for a long time, but did not say anything else.
Ling Han walked over and slapped him onto the ground. "If you trifle with me again, I’ll chop off your head!"
If it was not for the fact that his public image could not be destroyed, he would have long since crushed this kind of damn bug.
Zhou Shaolin didn’t even dare to say a word. He had been terrified by Ling Han.
Ling Han returned to the Martial Hall, and the news of his "breakthrough" had already spread out, directly rendering the Master of the Martial Hall here speechless.
Advancing to the next major tier in just a few days was practically like a dream.
Spirit Devouring Physique: too freakish.
Another two days later, the team of ten set out. This time, it was led by a Deputy Master.
Outside the city, Yan Yan stared at the spot where Ling Han and the others had disappeared for a long time, unwilling to leave.
"Young Mistress, let’s go back," the Dao Protector appeared and said softly.

Yan Yan nodded. Some people were like True Dragons. Once they soared, they would directly ascend to the Ninth Heaven. The distance between them was too far, and the two of them were not from the same world at all.
The journey from White River City to Heavenly Prosperity City would be a long one.
They travelled for a whole nineteen days before finally arriving at their destination.
In comparison, Heavenly Prosperity City was much wider, and the Buddhist Tower stood tall and proud, making for an even grander sight.
The group completed their registration, then entered into the city, and settled into the Martial hall here. Then, they waited for the advancement battles to begin.
The advancement battles were much more important. If one performed well, they would be directly taken in as disciple by the Heavenly Prosperity City’s Martial Hall.
It should be known that this was an A-grade city. It was similarly a Martial Hall, but the resources they could obtain here and in other Martial Halls could not be compared.
Thus, the team members all set out to gather information about the other teams.
"A prodigy has appeared in the Space Expansion City, and his cultivation level is Four Cauldrons."
"The Great Clouds City is even more kickass. There’s a Five Cauldrons."
"The Heavenly Horse City also has disciples at Five Cauldrons."
Everyone exclaimed in shock. In comparison, the Heavenly Prosperity City was much weaker. Even the strongest elite had only broken through the limit once, and was a Four Cauldrons.
Er!
They immediately turned their gazes to Ling Han. They had almost forgotten about this guy— Six Cauldrons!

It couldn’t be helped. Who asked Ling Han’s cultivation level to soar too quickly? Who would have thought they would wake up and find out that the guy who had been a Foundation Building Tier yesterday would become a Cauldron Forging Tier today, and a Six Cauldrons at that.
They were all surprised. Ling Han wouldn’t have the last laugh again, right?
This was really going to break the record!

That was because a rookie like Ling Han would only be able to stand out in the ordinary city competition, at most. To win in the B-level city competition, they would definitely have to wait another three years.
There was no other reason than the fact that his cultivation level was not high enough.
However, there were actually such freakish physiques like the Spirit Devouring Physique in this world. This directly caused Ling Han’s cultivation level to soar in a short few days.
Now, his cultivation level was clearly the highest, so it was really very likely that he would win again.
"Hiss, look, there’s an even more freakish person in the Great Horse City!"
"Mo Taiping, Seven Cauldrons!"
Everyone exclaimed in shock. On the competitor list that they had just obtained, after Mo Taiping’s name, the words ’Seven Cauldrons’ were shockingly written.

sentences.text: Xiu, xiu, xiu!
Multiple figures flew over.
They were all monks cultivating in Buddhist Tower.
They sensed the massive tremors of the Buddhist Tower, and also discovered that the root of these tremors was the Pond of Life at the lowest level.
Thus, they naturally had to run over at the first instant to check on the situation.
"What’s going on?" a monk who looked like the leader of the group asked.
"T-the Pond of Life!" Someone pointed ahead, his finger trembling slightly.
It could be clearly seen that the pool waters had initially been close to the edge of the pool, but now?
It had directly declined by one third.
"It was this person who absorbed it?"
"Hiss, who is he?"
"The champion of this year’s Martial Halls tournament, Spirit Devouring Physique."
"Spirit...
Spirit Devouring Physique?"
"Clearly knowing that he has a Spirit Devouring Physique, yet he was still allowed in?"
"Er, according to convention, the champion of every tournament would be qualified to enter the Pond of Life to cultivate for three days.
It should be an oversight."
That’s right.
Who would have thought that a freak like the Spirit Devouring Physique would appear out of nowhere?
"Quick, hurry up and fish him out.
Otherwise, the Pond of Life will be sucked dry by him!"
Everyone hurriedly dragged Ling Han out of the Pond of Life.
In such a short while, it had lost a whole third of its energy.
Meanwhile, Ling Han sighed.
The energy in this Pond of Life was really too little.
Thinking about it, it was normal.
After all, this was only gathered by the believers of White River City and the 17 ordinary cities under its jurisdiction.
Furthermore, it was always used by the monks, so how much could be left?
"Three days hasn’t passed, right?" he protested.
"Shoo, shoo, shoo.
Are you trying to suck the Pond of Life dry?" The monks all treated him like a ferocious beast, directly shooing him away.
Ling Han gritted his teeth.
His persona clearly hadn’t collapsed yet, so why was he still able to attract animosity like this?
Reflection, he really had to reflect on himself.
Ling Han walked out in a daze, but he had not taken too many steps, when his aura suddenly fluctuated, and ascended to the next level.
Cauldron Forging Tier!
These monks were the best witnesses.
In the end, these monks were even more troubled.
And what the f****** did you do?
You directly advanced into the next major tier, but what was the price?
The Pond of Life had lost one third of its energy!
They practically chased Ling Han out the main doors.
Was there a need to do this?
Ling Han shook his head, turned around, and descended the stairs.
"Haha, so you have actually been chased out." When Zhou Shaolin saw Ling Han, his face was filled with pleasant surprise.
He now knew that Ling Han was a Spirit Devouring Physique.
Thus, he was really afraid that Ling Han would suddenly advance into the Cauldron Forging Tier three days later.
That way, it would be very difficult to beat him up.
However, only half a day had passed, and Ling Han had already come out.
Furthermore, he had been chased out.
What did this signify?
This guy must have done something out of line in his speech and actions, angering those monks, and that was why he had been chased out.
In other words, Ling Han was still in the Foundation Building Tier.
Hehe.
Ling Han looked at Zhou Shaolin coldly, and shook his head, "Foolish clown, you still haven’t scrammed?"
"Stubborn fool!" Zhou Shaolin said with a humph.
"Haidong, hit him.
The harder you hit him, the better."
"All right." Niu Haidong strode forwards, bearing down on Ling Han.
This time, even if Ling Han ran to the Buddhist Tower’s entrance again, he would still be chased off.
Ling Han smiled, "Are you sure you want to help the villain?"
"You really have a bad mouth!" Niu Haidong smirked coldly, then charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han casually delivered a palm strike.
Pa!
Niu Haidong collapsed to the ground, completely unable to get back up.
F***, what was going on here?
Zhou Shaolin wore a dumbfounded expression.
He could not accept this at all.
What was going on here?
Ling Han kindly explained, "I’ve broken through again.
Now, I’m a Cauldron Forging Tier, and furthermore...
Six Cauldrons." He very casually set a cultivation level for himself.
In any case, the Pond of Life had lost one third of its energy, so it wasn’t impossible for it to send him up to Six Cauldrons.
After all, he was the only "Spirit Devouring Physique" in the world, and there was no way to prove it.
This!
Zhou Shaolin was dumbfounded. ’You have just gone in for a tour, and in total, it has not exceeded three hours, and you have broken through just like that?’
Furthermore, not only had he broken through to the next major tier, he had also broken through the limits of the Cauldron Forging Tier?
But if that was not the case, how could Niu Haidong sent flying with a single slap be explained?
This was an absolutely one-sided suppression.
"You, you, you—" He stuttered "you" for a long time, but did not say anything else.
Ling Han walked over and slapped him onto the ground.
"If you trifle with me again, I’ll chop off your head!"
If it was not for the fact that his public image could not be destroyed, he would have long since crushed this kind of damn bug.
Zhou Shaolin didn’t even dare to say a word.
He had been terrified by Ling Han.
Ling Han returned to the Martial Hall, and the news of his "breakthrough" had already spread out, directly rendering the Master of the Martial Hall here speechless.
Advancing to the next major tier in just a few days was practically like a dream.
Spirit Devouring Physique: too freakish.
Another two days later, the team of ten set out.
This time, it was led by a Deputy Master.
Outside the city, Yan Yan stared at the spot where Ling Han and the others had disappeared for a long time, unwilling to leave.
"Young Mistress, let’s go back," the Dao Protector appeared and said softly.
Yan Yan nodded.
Some people were like True Dragons.
Once they soared, they would directly ascend to the Ninth Heaven.

The advancement battles were much more important.

chapters.title: Chapter 4668: Special Physique
paragraphs: Everyone’s eyes fell on Ling Han again. This time, there was a sliver of sympathy.
Originally, Ling Han could have defied the heavens, but now, an opponent had appeared.
Seven Cauldrons!

Even if your Spirit Devouring Physique was awesome, it would only allow you to break through your cultivation level quickly. It didn’t mean that you could break through one limit after another. These were two completely different matters.
He was already at the Cauldron Forging Tier, so if he wanted to break through to the Core Formation Tier, he would need a huge amount of energy, right?
Thus, the chances of Ling Han breaking through to the Core Formation Tier were very small, and he would need a very, very long time. Thus, he was definitely no match for Mo Taiping.
They went to make some more queries, and obtained even more information about Mo Taiping.
"This person is only 29 years old!"
"He has really obtained the great fortune of heaven and earth. He is already a Seven Cauldrons elite before thirty years old."
"That’s right. There is absolutely no way he can be compared wtih that kind of person that has rushed up with his physique."

"It’s said that he has repeatedly challenged those two levels above him in the Great Horse City. Not only has he defeated those at the same cultivation level, he can even challenge those two levels above him."
"This is what a true prodigy looks like!"

For example, Ling Han was only a Spirit Devouring Physique. When he reached the peak stage of the True Self Tier, he would no longer be able to rely on his physique to increase his cultivation level. Mo Taiping, on the other hand, may be temporarily surpassed by Ling Han, but in the end, he would still be able to catch up.
That was because the path of cultivation was ultimately something that had to be taken one step at a time, and walked steadily.
Ling Han, on the other hand, was unconcerned. He was already a fifteen-star Venerate, so would he lower himself to the level of these people?
What he was pursuing now was to stimulate the Seed of the Holy Flame, to become a Saint.
Thus, it was fine as long as he could enter the Pond of Life.
More and more teams from B-level cities arrived. Another seven days later, the advancement battles would begin.
The rules were more or less the same as the first stage of the competition. It was still defeating opponents to earn points, but there was an additional option of seizing the flag.
The top four in points, or those who had found a flag and could hold it until the end of the competition would become the five victors to participate in the Royal Capital’s competition.
If one was one of the top four in points and obtained the flag as well, the fifth place in terms of points would fill in the gap.
This added a certain amount of variables, and it was not just limited to fighting and killing.
However, it was not easy to snatch the flag.

Because this flag itself would light up, soaring straight into the skies, and even if they were very far away, they could still see it clearly. Thus, once they successfully captured the flag, they would be hunted down by a great many people. It was really, really too difficult to keep it until the end of the tournament.𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
The night passed, and the tournament began.

Just like the first round, with cities as the unit of measure, the teams entered the mountains and forests separately. They could first find a suitable location, hide or ambush, as long as they didn’t kill or severely injure their opponents during the battle.

There were more participants this time round. Not only had the number of participants in a team increased to ten, there were also as many as several dozen teams participating, and the total number of participants was close to five hundred.
The moment they entered, Ling Han and his group could do as they liked.
There was really no need to be afraid. They had Ling Han, a Six Cauldrons elite, with them. Among all the participants, this cultivation level was the second highest.
Thus, as long as they didn’t encounter Mo Taiping’s team, they really didn’t have to fear anything.
The ten-man team searched. However, the mountain range where the tournament was held was huge, and five hundred people were like a drop in the ocean. It was too, too difficult to search.
After a day, they had only encountered three teams. Though they had won the battle, seven people had still managed to escape, and had not been "completely wiped out".
However, this also caused their fighting spirit to soar, and they became increasingly arrogant.
At noon on the second day, they stopped to rest.
Although they wouldn’t need to eat after ascending to the Celestial Path, many people still maintained this habit of starting a fire to cook. A fragrance instantly wafted out.
If they were a weaker team, they definitely wouldn’t dare to do this. Wouldn’t that be announcing their location to others?
However, things were different now. With Ling Han, a Six Cauldrons, standing guard, what did they have to fear?
This was just right. This could also lure others over.
As expected, someone really discovered the commotion and ran over.
This was a young man who was completely enshrouded in black robes. His expression was cold, and he carried a long sword on his back. Unlike the others, who had stored it in their Spatial Spirit Tool.
He walked over, his eyes sweeping over the surroundings. He clearly saw Ling Han, yet was completely unmoved.
"Very good, everyone is here." He nodded, revealing a cruel smile.
"Haha, you dare to come alone?" Someone laughed loudly, pointed at this black-robed young man, and said, "Where are the others in your team?"
"I thought they were in the way, so I got rid of them all," the young man in black said calmly.
Hiss!
Everyone couldn’t help but inhale sharply. This guy was really too ruthless, wasn’t he?
It should be known that there was no point awarded for defeating a teammate. Otherwise, a great many teams would have long since fallen into internal strife.
But what did this guy do? Just because he thought they were in the way, he actually defeated all his teammates.

Moreover, when he said the word "got rid", it was filled with a baleful killing intent. It could be imagined that if this wasn’t a Martial Halls competition, but a contest inside a Mystery Realm, he would probably really deliver a fatal strike.
Moreover, he was able to get rid of nine of his teammates, so what did that mean?
Even if he had launched a surprise attack, he could "kill" one or two people at first, but how could the others be unprepared?
Thus, if he wanted to "kill" all his teammates, his personal abilities would also have to be incredibly powerful.
One faltered for a moment before asking, "Do you know which team we belong to?"
"It doesn’t matter. In any case, I will defeat all of you," the black-robed young man said calmly.
"We’re from the White River City!" the person from before shouted.
"Oh." The black-robed young man nodded. "So it’s the team that has the Spirit Devouring Physique."
Judging by his expression, he wasn’t afraid at all.
Hiss, he clearly knew that there was Ling Han among them, yet was still so careless. This guy was either a maniac, or his abilities were really strong, and that was why he had such confidence.
"You guys, are you ready to die?" the black-robed young man asked calmly, his voice chilling to the bone.

Everyone clearly knew that this was only a competition, and no deaths were allowed. In fact, even severe injuries were not allowed, but the words of the black-robed young man were too infectious, causing them to involuntarily feel cold all over.
"Trash, die!" The black-robed young man charged out. With a qiang, the long sword on his back was unsheathed, exuding an endless cold light.
No one dared to face this attack head-on, and they all stepped back.
"Haha!" The black-robed young man laughed loudly. As his sword slashed out, a coldness intertwined, making everyone feel as if all the blood in their bodies had frozen.
This effect was extremely great, causing everyone’s movements to slow down. They could only unleash 10% of their battle prowess.
"This is a special physique!"
Everyone was exclaiming in shock. No wonder this person could "eliminate" all his teammates. Under such coldness, everyone’s speed was greatly reduced. Even if they wanted to flee, they couldn’t.

In comparison, this kind of physique was even more terrifying, because it was especially made for battle. It was not like the Spirit Devouring Physique, which only allowed one to improve quickly in cultivation level.
Without the advantage of cultivation level, how could Ling Han rival such a terrifying physique?

chapters.title: Chapter 4669: Truth and falsehood
paragraphs: The black-robed young man was incredibly domineering.
Not only did he have a special physique, but his cultivation level wasn’t low either, reaching the level of Five Cauldrons. It could be said that aside from Ling Han, no one could compare to him.

His cultivation level was higher, and he also had a special physique, allowing him to have the upper hand completely even if he was fighting against nine people alone. Furthermore, it was an absolute upper hand.
It wasn’t long before one of them was wounded by his sword. A deep gash was left on his chest, and blood gushed out violently.
And this was still because the black-robed young man had held back. Otherwise, with the might of this strike, it was enough to slice him into two.
The black-robed young man bared his teeth in a grin, "A bunch of trash!"
The remaining people were all shocked. Even with nine against one, they were still unable to stop this guy?
"Zhang Hanjun, are you not going to make your move?" someone called out to Ling Han.
Though this Lord’s physique was not of much use in battle, he was still a Six Cauldrons. In terms of cultivation level, he was superior to the black-robed young man.
Ling Han wore an expression of righteousness as he said, "Using numbers to bully someone weaker than me is something that should be disdained. I disdain from doing such a thing!"
This made his eight teammates want to turn around and beat him up. How could there be such a pedantic person?
Oh, in a life-and-death battle, do you also have to speak of such so-called righteousness?
Peng!
The black-robed young man shot out a foot, and sent another person flying. He had directly broken three of the latter’s bones, and dealt with another opponent.

He attacked aggressively. If he attacked without any reservations, his battle results would definitely be even more fruitful, but the present him had to hold back when he attacked, which naturally affected his battle prowess.
Even so, his efficiency was still astonishingly high. He would be able to dispose of an opponent in a few exchanges.

And as the number of people ganging up on him became lesser and lesser, the pressure on the black-robed young man also became lesser and lesser, and his expression naturally became more and more relaxed.
In a total of ten minutes, he had defeated all nine of them.
The black-robed young man sheathed his sword, then turned to look at Ling Han, and said calmly, "Do you think that I would spare you since you had not made your move just now?"
Meanwhile, Ling Han’s expression was stern, "Are you doubting my character?"
"Haha, are there really such foolish people nowadays? That would be adhering to the rules of fairness?" The black-robed young man shook his head, appearing very disdainful.
"Of course there is. I am this kind of righteous, good young man," Ling Han said with a smile.
Pei!
His nine teammates all grumbled in their minds. If they had known this earlier, they would have let Ling Han attack first. Why had they gone to so much trouble?

The black-robed young man gave an ’oh’, and drew his sword again, "Whether you are really stupid or just pretending to be stupid, since you have encountered me, your path of advancement will end here."
"Come." Ling Han crooked a finger at him.
The black-robed young man immediately charged over with sword in hand. Shua, the strike turned into a cold light. He was one with his sword, showing extremely high natural talent in cultivation.
Ling Han’s feet moved, and he shot out a palm strike.
His movement just happened to dodge the black-robed young man’s attack, and the timing of his palm strike was calculated to the extreme, just landing on the black-robed young man’s waist.

Peng, the black cloth flew like butterflies scattering, and the black-robed young man was instantly sent flying. A patch of white appeared on his waist. As it turned out, his clothes had been shattered by Ling Han’s palm strike.
If it was just a sparring match, the black-robed young man should have already admitted defeat, but now, one had to defeat his opponent.
The black-robed young man lowered his eyes for a look, and couldn’t help but frown, "I have underestimated you. After all, you are a Six Cauldrons."
Weng, he lightly channelled the long sword, and instantly, a coldness rose up.
Ling Han gave an ’oh’, and said, "So you don’t have any ice physique. This special ability comes from this sword."
This was a Spirit Tool.
What!
The people who were knocked down were stunned. A Spirit Tool?
’F*ck! A Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator already possesses a Spirit Tool?’
Did you have heaven-defying luck? Or did you come from a noble clan? Is that why you managed to possess a Spirit Tool so early?
They were also extremely dissatisfied, and thought that they had lost unjustly. They had clearly lost to the other’s Spirit Tool.
The black-robed young man was astounded. "I didn’t expect your insight to be so good."
Ling Han laughed loudly, "It’s not like you haven’t seen that I am stronger."
The expression of the black-robed young man changed drastically, looking a little ugly. The torn clothing at his waist was clear proof of Ling Han’s words.
"That was just my negligence." He humphed, then brandished his sword and charged towards Ling Han.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Coldness continued to form on the blade of the sword, shooting rapidly towards Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t attack at all. He simply formed a shield in front of him, blocking all the coldness that assaulted him.
The black-robed young man had already charged over, his sword slashing towards Ling Han’s neck.
Looking at his ruthless expression, it seemed like he really wanted to chop off Ling Han’s head.

Ling Han’s feet moved, and there was no need for him to use any movement techniques. He had already walked out his own path. Every move, every blow was an amazing move, which conformed to the principles of heaven and earth.
He easily dodged this vicious sword strike, and delivered another light palm strike.
Peng, the black-robed young man was sent flying again. Pieces of cloth flew in the air, and another large part of the fabric at his waist was missing, almost revealing his entire waist.
This strike was not heavy, but the black-robed young man’s expression was ugly.
To him, this was a humiliation.
’You did it on purpose, didn’t you?’
He roared loudly, and charged back again.
Ling Han used the same trick again, easily dodging the attack. Then, he sent out a palm strike.

Peng, this palm strike still landed on the black-robed young man’s waist, but the black-robed young man’s body seemed to have turned into mud. The part that had sustained the force directly collapsed, making Ling Han’s hand seem to have sunk into the other’s body.
Yi?

"Haha, do you think I’ll fall for this trick after suffering twice?" the black-robed young man sneered. It was as if the sunken part of his body had turned into threads that wrapped around Ling Han’s wrist.
"Die!" He turned around and stabbed his sword at Ling Han’s chest.
In this strike, he had avoided Ling Han’s heart, but as long as it pierced through, it would definitely be considered Ling Han’s loss.
The other nine were all watching dumbfounded. They had never imagined that the black-robed young man’s body would actually undergo such a bizarre change.
"He certainly has a special physique!"
"It’s not something like an ice physique, but something like mud. He can avoid damage and cling to his opponent."
"Hiss!"
This was too unexpected. After "revealing" that he did not have a special physique, no one could have possibly imagined that this guy really did have a special physique.
How could Ling Han block this strike?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and directly shot out a punch.
Peng!
This punch was extremely accurate, and when it landed on the sword’s blade, it avoided the sharp blade. A massive force landed, and the sword’s blade was instantly sent flying.
Simple, rough, but effective.
This was the benefit of having overwhelming power.
Ling Han smiled, and swung his right arm. Because his wrist was "stuck" by the black-robed young man, with this wave, the black-robed young man’s whole body was also swung.
Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!
The black-robed young man was instantly smashed madly, and in a few moments, he was knocked unconscious. His limbs were spread out, and white foam was spewing from his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 4670: Mo Taiping
paragraphs: The battle had ended.
However, when everyone looked at Ling Han, their eyes were filled with resentment.
Wasn’t it?
He clearly could have easily defeated this black-robed young man, so why didn’t he make his move earlier? He caused all of them to be eliminated.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He didn’t have any friendship with these people, so why did he need them to cozy up to him?

Moreover, defeating one’s opponent was a personal responsibility, not accumulate to become points for the whole team. Could it be that they wanted Ling Han to beat their opponent half to death before letting these teammates finish him off to collect points?
This was a tournament!

Ling Han strode away. The flag had not appeared yet. Otherwise, he only had to obtain the battle flag, and he would be able to sit by and wait for others to come one by one to deliver points to his doorstep.
He was not in a rush either. By now, the majority should be hiding, waiting for the appearance of the flag, snatching it and last for the three days of the tournament.
For those whose abilities were not all that strong, this was the best chance for them to win.

That was because the brilliance of the flag soared into the skies. It could be seen from anywhere, and the target was too obvious. If it appeared too early, the chaotic battle it would cause would be too frightening, and the meaning of the tournament was lost.
Thus, the flag would only appear on the morning of the third day, and there was more than half a day’s time to contend for it.
Ling Han strolled slowly. If he encountered anyone, he would beat them up. If he didn’t, he would just treat it as a sightseeing trip.
Time passed very quickly, and two days flew by.
The sun rose on the third day, and at the same time, a dazzling light rose from the mountains, soaring into the skies. No matter which corner of the great mountain one was, they could clearly see it.
Ling Han smiled, and walked towards that streak of light.
In these two days, he had not defeated many people. There were only a mere eight, and they were not even as good as the black-robed young man from before.
—If the tournament ended at this time, then though the black-robed young man had been defeated by Ling Han, his ranking would be higher than Ling Han’s.
However, it didn’t matter how many people they defeated. The one who obtained the flag would definitely win.
This ensured that a great many elites would also come over to compete for the flag.
Obtaining the flag was a sure bet for a winning spot. Otherwise, how would you know if those weaker than you had defeated even more weaklings?
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Figures flew through the forest. Even those with weak abilities could no longer hold themselves back, and headed towards the flag.
Who knows, when others fought to the point that both sides were injured, he might be able to take advantage of the situation?
How fast was the speed of Celestial Path-level cultivators?

In a short while, Ling Han arrived at where the light had come from, and he was not the first person to come here. There were already seven people engaged in a battle royale, fighting for the flag. It was about three meters long, and the flag fluttered in the wind.
Ling Han strode over, and when he neared the battle, he saw that the seven people who were embroiled in the chaotic battle had actually all stopped, and then attacked him.
This attack was coordinated and extremely well coordinated.
If they teamed up at the last moment, their cooperation could not possibly be so good.
Thus, these seven people were simply faking it, causing others to be careless, thinking that they could take advantage of the situation. In the end, they would fall for the trap.

He had been caught off guard, and it was a team of seven at that. They were all at Cauldron Forging Tier—although the strongest was only at Three Cauldrons, it was believed that even a Six Cauldrons or even Seven Cauldrons would be affected.
Joy appeared on the seven people’s faces at the same time. If he only reacted now, he would definitely be hit.
Peng!
The seven attacks landed, but the joy on their faces suddenly disappeared.
Where was he?
There was no sign of Ling Han among the seven of them.
"Are you guys looking for me?" Ling Han’s calm voice sounded from the sidelines.
"You!" The seven of them were both stunned and terrified. How had Ling Han managed to escape from their siege?
"Because I’m strong!" Ling Han said with a smile, launching an attack.
Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!
Even if he had only unleashed the power of Six Cauldrons, his battle awareness was still Saint-level. Wouldn’t it be easy for him to defeat a few cultivators who were only at Three Cauldrons at most?
In just two or three moves, Ling Han defeated all seven of them.
He twisted his neck, and looked towards the forest on his left side, "How much longer do you want to continue watching?"
A young man walked out of the forest, his figure as straight as a spear.
"Zhang Hanjun?" the young man asked.
"That’s me." Ling Han nodded.
The young man bared his teeth in a grin, "I am Mo Taiping!"
Mo Taiping!
The person with the highest cultivation level in this tournament.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t take it to heart. To him, this kind of martial arts competition was only for show, and wasn’t challenging at all.

"The flag is in my hands now, and you’re here to snatch it?" Ling Han pulled up the flag that had been planted into the ground, and waved it in a circle in his hands. Then, he gripped it with both hands. It could be used as both a spear and a staff.
Mo Taiping stared at Ling Han and said, "If you haven’t earned enough points yet, I advise you to hand over the flag. Otherwise, if you’re defeated by me, you won’t be able to enter the top five."
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Yi, why did you snatch my lines?"
Mo Taiping showed a hint of pride, "In this place, no one can defeat me!"
What confidence.
However, he was a Seven Cauldrons. How many people in the world could cultivate to this kind of height?
"I have a nickname, Miracle Creator," Ling Han said. "If you don’t believe it, don’t blame me if you cry after being beaten."
"Hahaha!" Mo Taiping laughed loudly, and then became baleful, "Then your path of advancement will end here."
Xiu, his figure moved, and charged towards Ling Han.
So fast, as expected of Seven Cauldrons.

Ling Han was unconcerned. No matter how heaven-defying this guy’s abilities were, he could still increase his cultivation accordingly. In any case, he was a "Spirit Devouring Physique", and whatever cultivation level he was, wasn’t it up to him to decide?
He used the flag like a staff, and smashed it directly towards Mo Taiping.

The staff was a long weapon, and the longer the weapon, the stronger it was. Condensing the power of Six Cauldrons, it was definitely more terrifying than the crushing power of a mountain.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
The might of this weapon had already been unleashed, and even Mo Taiping did not dare to take it head-on. He hurriedly leaped out to dodge.

After dodging this strike, he was about to counterattack, but Ling Han’s staff swept over again. Borrowing the momentum of the previous strike, not only was the force stronger, the attack speed was even faster.
Mo Taiping’s counterattack came to an abrupt stop, and he had no choice but to dodge again.
However, just as he was about to attack again, the staff smashed over again.
Mo Taiping cursed in his heart, but could only dodge again.

After over a dozen consecutive exchanges, he was completely suppressed. Ling Han’s staff strikes were seamless, and every strike could borrow the power of the previous strike to increase the might of his attack, completely unleashing the weight and ferocity of the long weapon.
If he could suppress Ling Han in terms of power, he could completely take it head-on, but the problem was that he was only "higher" than Ling Han by a minor level.
This made him feel depressed and driven mad.

Even against an opponent one or two minor levels higher than himself, he hadn’t felt so aggrieved. He could look for an opportunity to win while being suppressed. In fact, he could directly suppress his opponent.
Hiss, could it be that this opponent was even more awesome than him in terms of natural talent in cultivation?
This thought flashed through Mo Taiping’s mind, and he hurriedly shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 4671: No regrets?
paragraphs: The brilliance of the flag was so dazzling, how could they not see it?

When Ling Han and Mo Taiping were battling, people gradually arrived. However, when they discovered that one of the two sides in the battle was a Six Cauldrons, and the other was a Seven Cauldrons, none of them dared to step forward to participate.
The gap in battle prowess was too wide. If they stepped forwards, they would only be delivering themselves up to be defeated.
However, this was good too. They would have these two strongest people to fight to the point that both of them were injured, and then they would be able to eliminate both of them.
"Who do you think will win?" someone asked.
"It should be Mo Taiping."
"Yi, isn’t he unable to even fight back now? You still think highly of him?"
"He’s Seven Cauldrons, after all. The cultivation level is clear for all to see! Moreover, which one of those who can charge up to the Seven Cauldrons isn’t a prodigy among prodigies?"
"But his opponent is not weak either. Furthermore, just look at his attacks. They are like the Yangtze River and the Great Sea, endless and unending. This is too terrifying!"
"That’s right. I am still more optimistic about Zhang Hanjun. Now that he has gained the upper hand, he should be able to maintain this advantage forever."
"Hehe, it doesn’t matter who wins, as long as both sides suffer."
Because they had the thought of eliminating two of their strongest opponents at the same time, these people actually did not make a move on each other. Instead, they were waiting very tacitly.
Mo Taiping felt like he couldn’t hold on any longer.

As he thought about it, if Ling Han focused on attacking, his mystical power would definitely expend far more than his. As long as he could hold on until Ling Han’s power was exhausted, then Ling Han would exhaust it in a single go.
At that time, it would be his turn to counterattack.
But the problem was, Ling Han’s mystical power was endless. On the other hand, as they fought, he was actually starting to feel a little strained.
If this continued, then it would really be like what Ling Han had said, his path of advancement would be cut off here.
But to flee just like that?

He felt humiliated. Previously, he was the one who had told Ling Han to run, and now the one who was running was himself. This was too embarrassing. In future, when he saw Ling Han, wouldn’t he have to cover his face and run?
After exchanging a few more blows, he finally decided to retreat.

Losing face was still better than ruining his future. Moreover, more and more people were coming from the surroundings. It was obvious that they were watching the tigers fight from the sidelines. He didn’t want to fight Ling Han to the point that both sides would suffer, and these people would take advantage of the opening.
Thus, after dodging once, he turned around and shot out quickly.
Everyone was stunned. Then, half of them immediately chased after him, wanting to defeat this competitor, and even more people were eyeing Ling Han covetously.

This person had obtained the flag, so they only had to take advantage of the chaos to snatch the flag. Then, one would have to run around in the mountains, and keep running. After holding on for a while, the three days time limit for the tournament would be over.
Ling Han planted the flag on the ground, swept an eye over everyone, and said with a smile, "Come!"
As his words fell, boom, everyone rushed out, charging towards Ling Han.
Peng! Peng! Peng! Peng!

Shadows flew everywhere. There was not a single person that could withstand a single blow from Ling Han. Those who were close to him were all sent flying with a single punch, and then lay on the ground, completely losing their battle prowess.
When everyone’s attacks reached him, Ling Han could be seen moving around in a very small range, dodging these attacks one after another.
This!
The corners of everyone’s mouths twitched. Such powerful battle prowess made them lose all hope, all right?
Some smart people hurriedly drew out the distance, and began to attack from afar. However, this kind of attack lacked variety, so the threat it posed to Ling Han would be even smaller.
This gave the others a hint, and they all leaped back. No one dared to face Ling Han’s power head-on.
’Heh, you people are far too naive.’
Ling Han raised the flag, turning it into a staff that swept out towards the masses.
This time, he was even more terrifying.
Peng, peng, peng! Human figures flew through the air, as if the sky was filled with flying straws.
F***, this was practically a primitive beast in human form.
The remaining people didn’t dare to have any delusions. They hurriedly turned around and fled.

No, no, this guy was really too fierce. The possibility of snatching the flag from his hands was practically zero. They might as well go and defeat other competitors. Now that there were so many less competitors, who knows, they may have a chance of advancing into the top five.

However, Ling Han didn’t give chase. Just then, he had defeated at least 40 people, so his points had most likely soared to the first place. Being in the top three definitely wouldn’t be a problem. Moreover, he had a flag in his hand, and he had already locked onto a spot to qualify for the next round. Thus, he couldn’t be bothered to waste any more time.
After all, he had the battle prowess of a Saint, so what was the point of competing with a bunch of kids?
He just sat there like that, his flag planted beside him, looking very arrogant.
Gradually, more and more people came over. Some turned around and left, while others went up to challenge him. Some even formed teams to challenge him, but they were all easily defeated by Ling Han.
When the sun set, the three-day advancement competition also ended.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
It wasn’t long before the scores were also tallied. Ling Han was ranked first, and added with the fact that he had also won the battle flag, it could be said that this first place was very valuable.
Mo Taiping was in second place. After all, he had the "highest" cultivation level.
This time, the top five would receive rewards, but the rewards were all the same, and that was entering the Little Pond of Life to cultivate for five days.
—Wouldn’t this allow Ling Han to reasonably level up again?
Because they were entering the Buddhist Tower, this was an extremely sacred matter. Thus, Ling Han and the others all bathed and fasted for three days before heading to the Buddhist Tower together.
The monk led them to the lowest level of the Buddhist Tower. Similar to the White River City, the Pond of Life was located there.
The monk leading the way left, and Ling Han and his group entered into the Pond of Life, beginning to cultivate.
However, Ling Han didn’t enter. Instead, he stood outside.

"Yi, why doesn’t Brother Zhang enter?" someone asked. The five of them had emerged victorious, and in future, they would at least be able to stay in the Martial Hall of Heavenly Prosperity City to cultivate. It could be said that they had already stepped onto the path of rising to the top. In future, it was possible that the five of them would also become Sect Brothers, so they naturally wanted to get closer to the others.
"That’s right. Brother Zhang, are you still going to be reserved with us?" the second person asked with a smile.
"Haha, Brother Zhang must feel that his cultivation level is far above ours, so he wants to give us a handicap," the third person said.
Ling Han also cracked a smile, "You guys don’t know that I am a Spirit Devouring Physique?"

"Brother Zhang, we know that you’re a Spirit Devouring Physique. However, don’t tell us that the moment you enter, all the energy essence will be sucked dry by you," the second person said. He thought that his words were very humorous, and even laughed loudly after he finished speaking.
"How could that be? Although Brother Zhang is a Spirit Devouring Physique, the energy essence here is astonishing! Brother Zhang, it’s best that you hurry up and come down," the first person said.
"That’s right. Hurry up and come down." The third person nodded as well.
Ling Han swept an eye over the three of them, then looked at Mo Taiping, "Are you guys sure?"
"Of course." The three of them were very cordial, and even Mo Taiping nodded. In any case, there was no cost to be paid, so why not do him a favor?
"You really won’t regret it?" Ling Han asked again.

"Brother Zhang, stop showing off." The four of them felt that Ling Han had gone too far. Who didn’t know that you were a Spirit Devouring Physique? Was there any need to repeatedly emphasize and show off your Spirit Devouring Physique?
"All right." Ling Han nodded, and stepped into the pool.
