chapters.title: Chapter 4672: Cry to death
paragraphs: The moment Ling Han’s foot stepped into the pool waters, the entire Pond of Life immediately boiled over.
W-what was going on?
Mo Taiping and the others were all stunned, and a sense of foreboding rose up in their hearts.
It wouldn’t really be like what Ling Han had said, right?
This thought had just arisen when they discovered that the energy in the entire pool, like a thirsty horse was drinking from a spring, was surging madly towards Ling Han.

And under this kind of mad absorption, Mo Taiping and the others couldn’t get a single bit of energy at all. Even if there was an occasional bit that was about to enter their bodies, it would immediately be forcefully absorbed by the powerful suction force.
’Holy f*ck!’
"Brother Zhang!"
"Halt!"
The four of them hurriedly called out, all of them looking like their tails were on fire.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
As long as Ling Han was here, they could not possibly absorb any kind of energy essence, so how could they not be anxious?
The energy of the Pond of Life was their reward, yet it had all been absorbed by Ling Han now. They wouldn’t be able to reap any benefits at all. Who could withstand this?
"What is it?" At this moment, Ling Han asked the four people as he continued to walk, as if he had become stupid.
"Brother Zhang, you’re absorbing too much energy!" The four of them were about to cry.
"Yi, wasn’t it you guys that said it was all right?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
"We were wrong!" the four people hurriedly said.
Hong long long, but right at this moment, a loud boom was heard. The tower trembled violently, and visibly, the water level of the pool was rapidly declining.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! The monks appeared one after another.
"What’s going on?"
"Why would there be such a huge commotion?"
"Heavens, why is the Pond of Life expending so much energy?"
The monks were all shocked, and hurriedly pulled out Ling Han and the others.
Boom!
Right at this moment, Ling Han’s aura surged, and he began his performance.
Core Formation Tier!
Pu!
Mo Taiping and the others were all throwing up blood. F***, they hadn’t gotten any benefits yet, yet Ling Han had broken through to the next major tier. How could they endure this?
"Spirit Devouring Physique!" Realization dawned on the monks as well. They suddenly realized that they had actually allowed a Spirit Devouring Physique in this time.
Who would’ve thought that the Spirit Devouring Physique was so terrifying?

In reality, Ling Han didn’t know how powerful the Spirit Devouring Physique was. In any case, he felt that he should absorb more energy. Otherwise, it would be a bit unreasonable for him to directly advance to the next major tier, wouldn’t it?
Immediately, Ling Han was chased out of the Buddhist Tower, and Mo Taiping and the others were also implicated. They were chased out together with Ling Han.
"Brother Zhang!" The four of them wanted to cry but had no tears.
But would they be able to fight Ling Han to the death?
Cauldron Forging Tier against Core Formation Tier? Wasn’t that courting death?
Moreover, Ling Han could still easily advance to the True Self Tier. Right until the peak stage of the True Self Tier, his rapid breakthrough wouldn’t stop.
In other words, they would be left behind by Ling Han for a very long time.
Thus, how could they go all out against him?
Ling Han simply chuckled. He had already confirmed this several times before, yet they were so determined to force him to come into the waters. What could he do?
After returning to the Martial Hall, Mo Taiping and the others went to sleep with their heads down. They were completely out of spirits now, and nothing they did was fun.
Two days later, they teamed up with the five veteran disciples of the Heavenly Prosperity City’s Martial Hall, heading towards the Imperial Sea Royal Capital.
The Buddhist Land had ten great Royal Capitals, and this Imperial Sea Royal Capital was one of them.

Among the ten team members, the five people selected from the Heavenly Prosperity Martial hall were all in the Core Formation Tier. Their expressions were all very arrogant, but faced with Ling Han, they were slightly awkward.
—Because they were all in the Core Formation Tier, even if there were differences in minor level, they were still on equal footing.
The problem was that Ling Han had just fought his way up from a B-level city this year, and as for them? They had all stayed in an A-level city for a very, very long time.
When they found out that Ling Han was only a Meridian Opening Tie a month ago, they were all stunned, and had even less confidence in front of Ling Han.
Because it was possible that in a few more days, Ling Han would surpass them in terms of cultivation level.

They both looked down on Ling Han, and thought that Ling Han was completely depending on his physique. However, at the same time, they were also filled with fear, because Ling Han could surpass them in cultivation level at any time.
There was a strict hierarchy in the cultivation world. When a Core Formation Tier cultivator encountered a True Self Tier cultivator, they had to treat them with utmost respect.
Thus, these people naturally distanced themselves from Ling Han.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t pay any heed to this. He simply focused on traveling.
A whole twenty-four days later, Ling Han and his group arrived at the Royal Capital.

The Imperial Sea Royal Capital was a few times larger. After all, the Imperial Sea Royal Capital ruled over tens of thousands of ordinary cities. If its bearing wasn’t strong enough, how could it be worthy of the status as a Royal Capital?
The ruler here was the Imperial Sea King. He was the descendant of the general that had followed Ah Han to conquer the world, and was also one of the core members of the Buddhist Race.
It was said that the Imperial Sea King was a high-level Venerate.
After entering into the Royal Capital, everyone exclaimed in shock.

There were quite a number of people here who had come to the Royal Capital for the first time, and were naturally intimidated by the majestic and grand sight of the Royal Capital, and those five veteran disciples were very disdainful: what a bunch of country bumpkins.
When they arrived at the Martial Hall, they showed their proof of identity and were then settled down.

Ling Han wore a smile. After passing through an ordinary city, a B-level city, an A-level city, and then to the Royal Capital, his identity was continuously cleared. By now, would anyone still investigate where he had come from?

Otherwise, if he disguised himself as a prodigy and immediately displayed the cultivation level of Spirit Transformation Tier or Minor Advanced Tier, he would definitely be thoroughly investigated, right?
Right now, his false identity was far too stable. It was impossible for his public persona to collapse.
En, it definitely wouldn’t collapse.
Ling Han emphasized internally.

There were many elites in the Royal Capital, and the people walking on the streets were all either rich or noble, so everyone kept a very low profile. If they trifled with anyone here, it may bring about a calamity.
It was best to keep a low profile first. If they could advance further, and be taken into the Sacred Land, they would really soar into the skies.
Moreover, there was no shortage of True Self Tier disciples in the Martial Hall here. Merely cultivators of this level were not people that they could afford to trifle with.

Below the Imperial Sea Royal Capital, there were a total of 82 A-level vassal cities. In other words, there were a total of 82 teams that would come to the Royal Capital to participate in the advancement battle for the second round.

In the past few days, more and more teams had arrived. They were young people, after all, so they definitely couldn’t sit still. Thus, some people started to gather information about which city had a powerful elite in their teams.

Because they had all fought their way up level by level, the composition of the teams was more or less the same. There were five Cauldron Forging Tiers that had risen above the others in the advancement battles, and added with the Core Formation Tier ss that had been chosen from the Martial Hall of the A-level city.
"Among the new disciples, a prodigy named Jia Tailong has appeared!"
"It’s said that this person is born with wisdom, and has already gained the favor of the Sacred Land. After this competition, he will definitely be absorbed into the sect."
"He’s not even fifty years old, yet he’s already at the Core Formation Tier, which is extremely shocking."
This caused a commotion. Though this kind of aptitude was not comparable to Buddha Son, being able to gain the favour of the Sacred Land was the best proof.
"There’s also a person called Zhang Hanjun, and he’s a Spirit Devouring Physique of the ancient times. He can advance his cultivation as if he’s drinking water."
"Pei, this kind of improvement would only reach the True Self Tier. In future, wouldn’t he still be beaten back to his original state?"
"True."
Thus, Ling Han was ostentatiously ignored by everyone.

Otherwise, if he disguised himself as a prodigy and immediately displayed the cultivation level of Spirit Transformation Tier or Minor Advanced Tier, he would definitely be thoroughly investigated, right?
Right now, his false identity was far too stable.
It was impossible for his public persona to collapse.
En, it definitely wouldn’t collapse.
Ling Han emphasized internally.
There were many elites in the Royal Capital, and the people walking on the streets were all either rich or noble, so everyone kept a very low profile.
If they trifled with anyone here, it may bring about a calamity.
It was best to keep a low profile first.
If they could advance further, and be taken into the Sacred Land, they would really soar into the skies.
Moreover, there was no shortage of True Self Tier disciples in the Martial Hall here.
Merely cultivators of this level were not people that they could afford to trifle with.
Below the Imperial Sea Royal Capital, there were a total of 82 A-level vassal cities.
In other words, there were a total of 82 teams that would come to the Royal Capital to participate in the advancement battle for the second round.
In the past few days, more and more teams had arrived.
They were young people, after all, so they definitely couldn’t sit still.
Thus, some people started to gather information about which city had a powerful elite in their teams.
Because they had all fought their way up level by level, the composition of the teams was more or less the same.

There were five Cauldron Forging Tiers that had risen above the others in the advancement battles, and added with the Core Formation Tier ss that had been chosen from the Martial Hall of the A-level city.
"Among the new disciples, a prodigy named Jia Tailong has appeared!"
"It’s said that this person is born with wisdom, and has already gained the favor of the Sacred Land.
After this competition, he will definitely be absorbed into the sect."
"He’s not even fifty years old, yet he’s already at the Core Formation Tier, which is extremely shocking."
This caused a commotion.
Though this kind of aptitude was not comparable to Buddha Son, being able to gain the favour of the Sacred Land was the best proof.
"There’s also a person called Zhang Hanjun, and he’s a Spirit Devouring Physique of the ancient times.
He can advance his cultivation as if he’s drinking water."
"Pei, this kind of improvement would only reach the True Self Tier.
In future, wouldn’t he still be beaten back to his original state?"
"True."
Thus, Ling Han was ostentatiously ignored by everyone.

chapters.title: Chapter 4673: Imperial Sea Prince?
paragraphs: It couldn’t be helped. Rapid advancement of cultivation level would always be looked down on, and one of the reasons was naturally jealousy.
Oh, I have worked so hard to cultivate to this cultivation level, and you have easily caught up to me?
How could they not be envious, jealous, and hateful?

Ling Han naturally wouldn’t care. He only hoped that the competition would begin soon. After winning this time, he would be able to enter into the final battle between the Sacred Land and begin the final battle with the other contestants from the other nine Royal Capitals.
If he took another step further, he would be very, very close to the Pond of Life.
He didn’t step out of the Martial Hall, simply staying inside and counting down the days.
A few days later, he suddenly discovered a commotion in the courtyard.
—Every team that had come from an A-grade city had been arranged to stay in an independent courtyard. Logically speaking, it should be very quiet.𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Ling Han exited, only to see a handsome young man in embroidered robes standing in the courtyard. He had a dignified air about him, and it was as if he had enjoyed a high position for a long time.
Yi?
His eyes narrowed slightly, then revealed a smile.

"You’ve seen me, hurry up and pay your respects!" This young man in embroidered robes was currently shouting at the masses, and after hearing the commotion, more and more people came out. When they saw this young man, they were all slightly stunned.
Who was this? How could he be so arrogant?
If this were their own territory, they would definitely have rushed out and slapped the other party long ago, but now, they did not dare to make any rash moves.
"Who are you?" someone asked.
"You guys don’t even know who I am?" the young man in embroidered robes asked in a very arrogant manner.
Er, they really didn’t know.

These people had just arrived, and there were even some that had come to participate in the competition three years ago. However, they had come and gone in a hurry, so how could they possibly have any knowledge?
Everyone shook their heads. They were also curious. Who exactly was this person?
"I am Huangfu Cong, the fifteenth son of the Imperial Sea King!" This young man in fine clothes declared proudly.
Imperial Sea King!
When everyone heard this, their hearts trembled.
This was the ruler of the Imperial Sea Royal Capital, and furthermore, belonged to the higher ranks of the Buddhist Race. Just how high and mighty was he?
His son... would naturally be able to do as he liked in the Royal Capital.

"Yi, there is finally someone who is slightly more beautiful." Huangfu Cong stared at a woman that had just arrived. This was one of the five "older" disciples that had been selected by the Heavenly Prosperity Martial Hall, and was also the only woman in the team.
She was indeed quite good-looking, because there were less women among the cultivators, and beauties were even rarer. Thus, she was also very popular in the team, and was always surrounded by others.
It was also because of this that many people looked furious upon seeing her being teased by Huangfu Cong.
However, no one dared to say anything, let alone step forward to stop him.
—As the son of the Imperial Sea King, who would dare stop him?
Huangfu Cong walked towards the woman, and stretched out a hand to touch her face.
The woman instinctively took a step back, dodging this groping hand.

If this Huangfu Cong had fallen in love with her at first sight, then she would definitely not mind marrying into a noble clan. However, this person was obviously a playboy at first glance, so she was naturally unwilling to be reduced to a plaything.
When he saw the woman move aside, Huangfu Cong immediately looked displeased, "This young master thinks highly of you, so don’t be so ungrateful!"
These words caused the woman to feel humiliated and furious. Being toyed with, did she still have to feel honored?
She looked at her teammates around her, but these people either lowered their eyes and pretended not to see it, or only dared to be angry but did not dare to say anything.
She couldn’t help but feel hopeless.
"Your skin is so soft, let me touch it." Huangfu Cong stretched out his hand again, to touch the beautiful face of the woman.
This time, the woman accepted her fate and didn’t dodge.
Pa!
Huangfu Cong’s hand had not even landed on the woman’s face, when it was firmly grabbed by a large hand.
Yi?
It was Ling Han!
Everyone could clearly see that Ling Han had arrived at the woman’s side at some point in time and grabbed onto Huangfu Cong’s wrist.
This guy... how dare he!
You dare to interfere in the business of the Imperial Sea King’s son?
Huangfu Cong looked furious, "You despicable person, you actually dare touch me?"
Ling Han cracked a smile, "What kind of person you are, you yourself should know very well."
Huangfu Cong’s expression involuntarily changed drastically, and he looked suspicious.
Yi, could it be that this person could see through to his real self?
"This is my last warning, let go immediately!" he said harshly.

"Zhang Hanjun, hurry up and let go!" His teammates hurriedly rebuked. What if they angered Huangfu Cong, or even in fact injured this royal prince? Would it be the elites of the Royal Capital that would move out next, capturing all of them?
At that time, to say nothing of not being able to participate in the second round of advancement battles, they might even lose their lives.
"Don’t drag others down with you!"
"Don’t hurt Young Master Huangfu!"
They said one after another, and even that woman looked at Ling Han like he was being too nosy.
Did he think that he was the savior of the world? If he stubbornly stepped out, not only would he not be able to save her, he would even push her into an even deeper dilemma!
"Did you hear that?" Huangfu Cong said proudly.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Before you guys cower, why didn’t you confirm his identity first?"
’What do you mean?’
"He said he’s the son of the Imperial Sea King, and you guys believe him?" Ling Han asked with a smile.
Yi?
With this reminder, the others all looked doubtful.
That’s right. Huangfu Cong’s identity was only his own declaration, so who would know if it was true or false?
Huangfu Cong’s expression also changed drastically, and he hurriedly said, "I am naturally the son of the Imperial Sea King. You lowly commoners actually dare to doubt my identity?"
Ling Han slightly exerted force with his fingers, and Huangfu Cong immediately screamed in pain, tears streaming down his face.
"Come, tell me your identity obediently," Ling Han said with a smile.
"You lowly commoners are dead if you dare to harm a single hair on my head!" Huangfu Cong shouted. His mouth was quite stubborn.
No one dared to confirm it, because Huangfu Cong seemed to be very confident.
"Zhang Hanjun, let go of him first. We’ll see after we’ve investigated thoroughly."
"That’s right, let go first."
They all advised. If Huangfu Cong was really injured, and this person was really the son of the Imperial Sea King, then the matter would become serious.
Ling Han ignored them. How could he possibly care about the words of these people?
"This Young Master, why don’t you let go first?" At this moment, a woman’s voice rang out, gentle and melodious.

Everyone looked over, only to see a woman in white standing at the entrance. She was clearly dressed in an extremely plain white dress, and she wasn’t wearing any makeup at all. However, she radiated with an aura of elegance and beauty.
What a beautiful woman in an empty <anno data-annotation-id="d548c7a5-f852-451f-8e8a-6270451ce34b" data-title="valley">valley1</anno>. She was too beautiful.
In comparison, that first woman was practically a village girl, without any bearing at all.
"Why?" Ling Han asked.
This caused everyone to glare angrily at him. How could he refuse such a beautiful woman?
The woman in white smiled faintly, yet it was as if 100 flowers had bloomed at the same time. Her beauty was indescribable, and everyone was captivated by her beauty, unable to extricate themselves.
"It’s indeed Xiaoyun’s fault this time. I’ll apologize on his behalf." She curtsied slightly and bowed to everyone.
This caused everyone to be at a loss for what to do. They only felt as if they had made a colossal mistake, and had greatly offended the beauty.

chapters.title: Chapter 4674: The woman in white
paragraphs: Ling Han thought for a moment, then released his grip.
Huangfu Cong immediately dashed toward the woman in white as if he were fleeing. He then dove into her embrace.
"Wuwuwu, he bullied Xiaoyun!"
Seeing this scene, everyone couldn’t help but feel a strong urge to kill this guy.
’You f*cking dare to bury your head into the woman in white’s chest? And you’re even rubbing your face back and forth?’
He was really too shameless!
The woman in white stroked Huangfu Cong’s head, and said, "Return to your original appearance and apologize to everyone!"
"Sister!" Huangfu Cong was still very dissatisfied, and kept shaking his head, rubbing even more happily in the woman in white’s arms.
Everyone stared at him, wanting to kill even more.
"Be good!" the woman in white said softly.

Only then did Huangfu Cong raise his head. Then, everyone felt their vision blur. The body of this arrogant young man was actually shrinking rapidly. Even his clothes were shrinking, and he had become a little boy who was only four or five years old.
This!
Everyone gritted their teeth. They were actually being toyed around with by a little brat?
Heavens, if this spread out, wouldn’t they become eternal jokes?
"This is my younger brother, Guo Yun," the woman in white said. "He was young and ignorant, so please bear with him."

When they discovered that "Huangfu Cong" was only a little boy, the killing intent in everyone’s hearts naturally vanished without a trace. Even if this brat had previously played around with them, but for the sake of the woman in white, who would really be angry?
"It’s fine, it’s fine."
"He’s a child, after all, so it’s normal for him to be a little mischievous."
"Oh, that’s right. How should I address you, Miss? Which city are you from?"
Everyone began to ask questions, their eyes burning.
The woman in white was very reserved, and said calmly, "My name is Guo Shuang, and I am not a contestant. I have come out to plau, and just happened to pass by here."
Oh, so that was the case.
Everyone nodded. Since this woman wasn’t from the Martial Hall, it should be easier to court her, right?
They all stepped forward, saying all kinds of flattering words, trying their best to attract the attention of this beauty.
However, though Guo Shuang did not refuse coldly, her pretty face was calm, making it difficult for anyone to get close to her.
Meanwhile, Guo Yun would occasionally stare at Ling Han. As he touched the wrist that Ling Han had gripped previously, he was still gritting his teeth.
This b@stard! He had hurt him so much!
Ling Han acted as if he hadn’t seen anything, and directly returned to his room.
Guo Shuang was indeed beautiful, and was definitely no less beautiful than Chi Menghan, Song Lan and the others. However, what did this have to do with him?
He had come to break through to Saint Tier, not to pick up girls.
Furthermore, he felt that this woman actually had an unfathomable feeling, which made him feel slightly wary.
However, he wasn’t afraid that he couldn’t defeat her. Instead, he was afraid that his identity would be exposed.
This woman seemed to be enshrouded in a layer of fog. She was definitely not as simple as she seemed.
Thus, it was best not to trifle with her.
Guo Shuang watched as he walked into the room. She withdrew her gaze, and apologized to everyone again. Then, she left with Guo Yun.

Pu, when they had walked to an uninhabited place, Guo Yun actually changed once more, turning into a crimson-coloured squirrel. He leaped onto Guo Shuang’s shoulder, and asked, "Milady, why do we have to put on such an act?"
What was surprising was the fact that "his" voice had also become a female voice.
Meanwhile, Guo Shuang smiled faintly, "Only in this way can I see through people’s hearts."
"Milady, are you looking for those who dare to step out?" the crimson-colored squirrel asked.
Guo Shuang nodded, "This is only the first stage of the selection. If you don’t even have this little bit of courage, how can you achieve great things?"
"Milady, then what should I pretend to be next? Is it still an evil young master?" the crimson squirrel asked excitedly.
After this small interlude, nothing else happened. Everyone waited for another seven days, and it was time for the Royal Capital’s tournament to commence.
The 82 teams from the A-level cities all arrived, and the second round of advancement battles began.

The rules were still the same. Everyone would be placed in a forest, and survival of the fittest. The five people who obtained the highest score would be able to rise above the rest, and together with the contestants from the Royal Capital, enter into the Sacred Land and begin the final competition with the teams from the other nine great Royal Capitals.
Team after team entered into the forest in batches, and in a short while, the 82 teams were all released.

In this competition, the standards would be much more relaxed, allowing the contestants to go all out in battle. The king would send out elites to keep watch. Firstly, it was to ensure that there would be no serious casualties, and secondly, it was also to play the role of referee.

Some teams chose to fight side by side. First, they would use the advantage of a team to increase everyone’s points as much as possible, and lastly, they would carry out internal strife, and some teams had moved separately from the very beginning, fighting individually.
Ling Han paid no heed to the others. He set out alone, walking casually.
This kind of lone person would very easily be targeted by a team.
Sure enough, it wasn’t long before a team of 10 caught up to him.
Ling Han stopped in his tracks, and revealed a faint smile. The fish had taken the bait.

He didn’t know which city this team was from, but he truly didn’t care about the composition of five Cauldron Forging Tiers and five Core Formation Tiers—even if he only used the power of the Core Formation Tier.

"Brat, you’re moving alone, and you actually dare to act so boldly! Hehe, I really don’t know if you’re an idiot, or if you’re too confident," one of the people on the opposing side said with a smile, obviously thinking that Ling Han was in their grasp.
Ling Han crooked a finger at them, "Why don’t you guys step forwards and give it a try? Won’t you find out?"
"All right, I’ll oblige you!" The ten people charged over, one after another. Even the five Cauldron Forging Tiers were no exception.
Ling Han smiled, and exerted force with his feet, charging back at the ten people.
Boom, he was like a primitive beast. He didn’t care about any technique at all, and just charged forward with his body.
What was terrifying was that his power was too strong. With a crash, one of them was sent flying, and several of his bones were directly broken. He had practically lost his battle prowess.
"F***!" This shocked the others greatly. This guy was too fierce, wasn’t he?
However, once Ling Han launched an attack, he would never be able to stop.
He charged madly, and practically every time he charged, one person would be sent flying. After a dozen over times, only one of the ten people could still stand.
However, it wasn’t because this person was more powerful, but rather because he was the fastest. It was because of this that he managed to dodge Ling Han’s few attacks.
"Come," Ling Han said with a smile.
That person trembled, and suddenly let out an exclamation. Then, he turned around and fled.
He was scared out of his wits. It had only been a short while, and his teammates had all been defeated. Furthermore, they had all been knocked down, which scared him out of his wits.
Ling Han didn’t give chase. He was not short of that one point.

He continued to walk in the mountains. There would always be teams or contestants that were filled with confidence that thought he was an easy target to bully, and would make a move on him. In the end, they would all be horribly defeated.
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed, and there was still one day until the end of the tournament.

At this time, the Martial Hall temporarily announced that there would be a fierce beast of the Core Formation Tier in each of the ten areas marked outside the mountain. If one could kill it, they would be rewarded with fifty points.

She was definitely not as simple as she seemed.
Thus, it was best not to trifle with her.
Guo Shuang watched as he walked into the room.
She withdrew her gaze, and apologized to everyone again.
Then, she left with Guo Yun.
Pu, when they had walked to an uninhabited place, Guo Yun actually changed once more, turning into a crimson-coloured squirrel.
He leaped onto Guo Shuang’s shoulder, and asked, "Milady, why do we have to put on such an act?"
What was surprising was the fact that "his" voice had also become a female voice.
Meanwhile, Guo Shuang smiled faintly, "Only in this way can I see through people’s hearts."
"Milady, are you looking for those who dare to step out?" the crimson-colored squirrel asked.
Guo Shuang nodded, "This is only the first stage of the selection.
If you don’t even have this little bit of courage, how can you achieve great things?"
"Milady, then what should I pretend to be next?
Is it still an evil young master?" the crimson squirrel asked excitedly.
After this small interlude, nothing else happened.
Everyone waited for another seven days, and it was time for the Royal Capital’s tournament to commence.
The 82 teams from the A-level cities all arrived, and the second round of advancement battles began.
The rules were still the same.
Everyone would be placed in a forest, and survival of the fittest.

The five people who obtained the highest score would be able to rise above the rest, and together with the contestants from the Royal Capital, enter into the Sacred Land and begin the final competition with the teams from the other nine great Royal Capitals.
Team after team entered into the forest in batches, and in a short while, the 82 teams were all released.
In this competition, the standards would be much more relaxed, allowing the contestants to go all out in battle.
The king would send out elites to keep watch.
Firstly, it was to ensure that there would be no serious casualties, and secondly, it was also to play the role of referee.
Some teams chose to fight side by side.

First, they would use the advantage of a team to increase everyone’s points as much as possible, and lastly, they would carry out internal strife, and some teams had moved separately from the very beginning, fighting individually.
Ling Han paid no heed to the others.
He set out alone, walking casually.
This kind of lone person would very easily be targeted by a team.
Sure enough, it wasn’t long before a team of 10 caught up to him.
Ling Han stopped in his tracks, and revealed a faint smile.
The fish had taken the bait.

He didn’t know which city this team was from, but he truly didn’t care about the composition of five Cauldron Forging Tiers and five Core Formation Tiers—even if he only used the power of the Core Formation Tier.
"Brat, you’re moving alone, and you actually dare to act so boldly!
Hehe, I really don’t know if you’re an idiot, or if you’re too confident," one of the people on the opposing side said with a smile, obviously thinking that Ling Han was in their grasp.
Ling Han crooked a finger at them, "Why don’t you guys step forwards and give it a try?
Won’t you find out?"
"All right, I’ll oblige you!" The ten people charged over, one after another.
Even the five Cauldron Forging Tiers were no exception.
Ling Han smiled, and exerted force with his feet, charging back at the ten people.
Boom, he was like a primitive beast.
He didn’t care about any technique at all, and just charged forward with his body.
What was terrifying was that his power was too strong.
With a crash, one of them was sent flying, and several of his bones were directly broken.
He had practically lost his battle prowess.
"F***!" This shocked the others greatly.
This guy was too fierce, wasn’t he?
However, once Ling Han launched an attack, he would never be able to stop.
He charged madly, and practically every time he charged, one person would be sent flying.
After a dozen over times, only one of the ten people could still stand.
However, it wasn’t because this person was more powerful, but rather because he was the fastest.
It was because of this that he managed to dodge Ling Han’s few attacks.
"Come," Ling Han said with a smile.
That person trembled, and suddenly let out an exclamation.
Then, he turned around and fled.
He was scared out of his wits.
It had only been a short while, and his teammates had all been defeated.
Furthermore, they had all been knocked down, which scared him out of his wits.
Ling Han didn’t give chase.
He was not short of that one point.
He continued to walk in the mountains.
There would always be teams or contestants that were filled with confidence that thought he was an easy target to bully, and would make a move on him.
In the end, they would all be horribly defeated.
In the blink of an eye, two days had passed, and there was still one day until the end of the tournament.
At this time, the Martial Hall temporarily announced that there would be a fierce beast of the Core Formation Tier in each of the ten areas marked outside the mountain.
If one could kill it, they would be rewarded with fifty points.

chapters.title: Chapter 4675: Act of Violence
paragraphs: This was a good opportunity to catch up in points, or pull apart from the other contestants in points.
A great many people immediately moved, heading towards those ten areas.
And in the skies, Guo Shuang was presently standing proudly. Her divine sense spread out, enshrouding the entire forest.
The crimson squirrel asked, "Milady, why did you suddenly change the rules of the tournament?"
Guo Shuang said calmly, "A real battle changes in an instant. I want to see how these people can adapt on the spot."
"Oh." The crimson squirrel nodded, then asked curiously, "Which contestant does Miladyhave high hopes for?"
Guo Shuang smiled, and cast her gaze downwards, looking at an area below them.
The crimson squirrel followed her gaze, and involuntarily couldn’t help but bare his teeth.
He was angered!
It was the guy that had hurt it!

Ling Han sensed that someone was spying on him from the sky. One was very strong, and in fact, even he was slightly apprehensive of that person, while the other was very weak. He was only in the Core Formation Tier.

He didn’t raise his head to look. Theoretically speaking, they had hidden themselves very well. Even the weakest person had been enveloped by a layer of energy. Thus, even a Sect Master wouldn’t have been able to discover their presence.
Thus, he was now in the Core Formation Tier, so he couldn’t discover these two existences.
Who was monitoring him?
Where had he revealed a weakness?

Impossible. On the way here, his identity should have already been cleared. Furthermore, everyone knew that he was a Spirit Devouring Physique. They had watched him "grow" step by step, and that would be very clear with a single investigation.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He didn’t care about ruining his image. What was important was time.
No matter what, he had to wait until he became a Saint.
Forget it. He would just pretend that he had not discovered anything, and do whatever he had to do.
Ling Han strode forwards, heading in a certain direction.
Not long after, a giant beast that was as tall as 30 meters appeared ahead of him. It had the shape of a tiger, but had wings, and was filled with might.

However, this giant beast seemed to have been restricted in some way, and could only circle around in a fixed area. Even if it flapped its wings and flew, it could only reach a fixed height, as if there was an invisible cage that was trapping it.
Ling Han smiled, and walked towards this great beast.
"Ang!" The giant beast immediately roared at Ling Han. Its voice rumbled, forming a powerful hurricane.
Ling Han’s hair billowed in the wind. However, he simply smiled and said, "Little cat, let’s cooperate."
Vicious beasts didn’t have intelligence—even if they did, they wouldn’t be much smarter than a three-year-old child. How could it possibly pay attention to Ling Han? It directly pounced over.
Ling Han moved to parry.

The power he could unleash was far inferior to this giant beast, but he had used every bit of power to the extreme, and added with his exquisite battle techniques, his actual battle prowess was actually superior to the giant beast.
Thus, it was clear that the giant beast was theoretically stronger, yet it was only qualified to be toyed around with by Ling Han.
Finally, Ling Han leaped onto the giant beast’s head, making the giant beast not dare to move at all.
No matter how weak its intelligence was, it knew that its vital points were already restrained by Ling Han, so how could it dare to move recklessly again?
"Now that’s a good boy, kitten," Ling Han said with a smile. He told the giant beast to calm down and wait quietly.
Not long after, someone ran over.
This was a lone contestant who was fighting alone. When he saw the giant beast, he revealed a hint of wariness.

The wild beast’s power was too violent, and its physique was also tough. Without the restriction of cultivation level, as long as it grew normally, whatever cultivation level it was supposed to be at would be its cultivation level.
However, cultivators were different. Breaking through the limits was too difficult.
It was clear from a single glance that this fierce beast’s bloodline was powerful, and its abilities should be superior to his, so he did not dare make any rash moves.
He had best wait. He would first join forces with others, and severely injure this fierce beast, then think of a way to snatch its head.
However, right at this moment, a loud bang was heard. That massive beast was actually charging towards him.
His speed was extremely fast!
That person was shocked. He had clearly not exposed himself, so how had this fierce beast discovered him?

He wanted to flee, but he had started too late, and added with the fact that the ferocious beast was too fast, he had not even unleashed his full speed, when he saw that the ferocious beast had already caught up to him. With a pounce, a terrifying power surged out.
The man was exasperated, and could only turn around to parry.
Peng!

There was absolutely no way he could match the strength of the wild beast, and he was instantly sent flying. And it was at this moment that he suddenly saw a person fly out from the head of the wild beast, his fist directly smashing into his face.
In such a situation, how could he possibly dodge? In fact, he didn’t even have the ability to parry, and could only watch helplessly as this punch landed.
Peng! He instantly fainted.
Before he fell unconscious, he was still filled with confusion.
What was going on?
Why was there a person on the head of the beast?
Wasn’t this just screwing him over?
Ling Han smiled sheepishly. He had obtained another kill, easily and happily.

"Ang!" The colossal beast also roared loudly. Being bullied by Ling Han, it was about to doubt its life as a beast. Now, it was finally showing its might, making it feel that this world had become beautiful again.
"Come, let’s continue waiting," Ling Han said with a smile.
Boom!
The sound of a great battle was heard from afar. That was a battle with other fierce beasts. Furthermore, this kind of sound rose and fell, spreading out from various places.
Meanwhile, Ling Han was waiting for a chance to strike. He would defeat anyone that came.

Merely a fierce beast was already terrifying enough, and they had to form a team to be able to defeat it. Now, there was also Ling Han commanding it, which compensated for the fact that the brain of the fierce beast was only the size of a walnut.
How could this not be powerful?
Not long after, more than a hundred people had fallen here, far exceeding the "value" of a fierce beast.
Ling Han laughed loudly, and patted the beast’s head, "You have finally realized the value of your life as a beast. Congratulations."
After a while, a team arrived.
All of them had blood on them, but they were all exuding an air of ferocity.
—They had just killed a fierce beast, so their morale was still high.
"Die!"
The ten of them charged over, besieging and attempting to kill the wild beast.
One person commanded, and the ten of them coordinated very well. Practically every single person’s battle prowess was displayed to the fullest.
If it wasn’t for Ling Han, the fate of this fierce beast would definitely be death, but it was a different story now.
Ling Han did not appear, but rather crouched in the thick and long fur of the wild beast. Ling Han commanded.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Wild beasts were incredibly tenacious, and it fought back and forth with the team of ten.
"Yi, why is the intelligence of this fierce beast so high?" This team was very stunned.
"Isn’t it said that the brains of wild beasts are only the size of walnuts?"
The wild beast was furious. Whose brain was only the size of a walnut?
Yours, your whole family’s!
It pounced madly, completely disregarding its own safety — wasn’t there someone even more ruthless on it?
The wild beast was strong in the first place, and with its display of might, the pressure on the team of ten instantly increased greatly.
"Retreat! Retreat! Retreat!" the person in charge hurriedly shouted.
Xiu, right at this moment, Ling Han charged out.
Who would have thought?
Peng, peng, peng! Ling Han’s fists rained down, and instantly, multiple figures streaked through the skies, as if they were straws.
Eight of the 10 people were instantly knocked out.

Only two of them managed to fortunately escape from the area of activity of the vicious beast. This was something that the vicious beast could not traverse, as there was an invisible power restraining them.
They looked at Ling Han with deep hatred.𝑓𝘳𝑒𝑒𝓌𝘦𝘣𝘯ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝑚

chapters.title: Chapter 4676: Care
paragraphs: Why had a wild beast that had a brain that was only the size of a walnut suddenly become smarter?
The reason was found.
There was actually someone commanding it?
But the problem was this was clearly a stage set by the Martial Hall, so why had a person suddenly appeared?
Moreover, they had killed a fierce beast previously, and had not seen anyone on it.
"Hiss, he’s the Spirit Devouring Physique!"
"Zhang Hanjun of Heavenly Prosperity City!"
The two of them stared at Ling Han for a while, and finally recognized him.
However, they could not accept this.
Why was Ling Han able to mingle with the wild beasts?
Could it be that this guy could communicate with wild beasts?
F***, that was really too unfair.
"We definitely have to protest to the Martial Hall!"
"That’s right, this is not his strength at all!"
After this team, other teams arrived, wanting to take down this fierce beast and earn fifty points. However, they were all defeated by Ling Han and the fierce beast.
Some teams were wiped out, while others had survivors. Ling Han didn’t take follow up on his victory and pursue them. This also made those survivors think that Ling Han had cheated.
Who didn’t know that wild beasts couldn’t be tamed? At least, it wasn’t something that could be done in such a short period of time.
Thus, there was definitely something fishy going on here.
Right at this moment, Ling Han also welcomed an "elite".
Jia Tailong.
This was the true prodigy of this tournament, and had long since gained the notice of the Sacred Land. They would immediately take him in after this tournament, and focus on nurturing him.
He was all alone, and he held a Demon Subduing Staff in his hand. This was the standard Tool of the Buddhist Race. It was forged as an imitation of the Imperial Weapon.

Tsk, he had not truly entered into the Buddhist Race yet, yet already possessed the standard Buddhist Race Spirit Tool. Merely from this aspect, it was clear how highly this person was valued by the Sacred Land.
"Zhang Hanjun!" He stood in front of the colossal beast, and faced with such a colossal creature, he was completely calm, as if this colossal beast was only a docile kitten in front of him.
"I don’t know what method you have used to cooperate with this fierce beast, but this is contrary to the original intention of the tournament. I hope you can desist from this before it is too late."

Ling Han was astonished. No wonder he had been so heavily targeted by the Buddhist Race. He hadn’t even truly entered the Buddhist Race yet, yet he was already so proficient in the brainwashing techniques of the Buddhist Race.
He smiled faintly, and asked, "What is it? Are you afraid now?"
"Humph, I just don’t want you to sink deeper and deeper," Jia Tailong said disdainfully.
"All right, come fight me." Ling Han laughed loudly. With a pat, this great beast immediately pounced towards Jia Tailong.
It had long since become impatient from waiting.
"An!" Jia Tailong roared loudly, his voice reverberating and deafening.
Six Characters Bright King Curse?
He was astonished. He hadn’t imagined that Jia Tailong had actually learned the secret technique of the Buddhist Race.
This was the Imperial Technique, which had a great influence on the mind.
Even the wild beast was affected, and couldn’t help but pause in its movements, looking confused.

According to legends, the Ancestral Buddha delivered a sermon, and even Saint-level fierce beasts would be influenced, their viciousness erased, and willingly become the guardian beasts of the Buddhist Race.
From this, it could be seen just how terrifying the effects of the Six Characters Bright King Curse on the mind were.

Jia Tailong’s grasp of the Six Characters Bright King Curse was naturally far inferior to the Ancestral Buddha. Moreover, he had only mastered the "An" character, so he could only temporarily affect the wild beast.

However, taking advantage of this opportunity, Jia Tailong had already charged over with his Demon Subduing Staff. Golden light radiated in all directions, and it was as if he had transformed into the Guardian Deity of the Buddhist Sect. His eyes were wide with fury, and he was capable of destroying all the demons in the world.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and with a press of his hand, his whole person immediately flew from the beast’s body, greeting Jia Tailong’s attack.
He didn’t battle against the Spirit Tool head-on, but each move was smooth and natural, instantly grasping the rhythm of the battle.

It should be known that not only was he invincible among his peers, he could even win against an opponent at a higher cultivation level. Now that he had lowered his own cultivation level, his ability to battle above his own cultivation level would only be even more terrifying, because he had wider horizons.
Even if Ling Han was extremely reserved, he still easily gained the upper hand.
"Yi!" In the skies, the crimson squirrel released an exclamation of surprise, "Jia Tailong is actually no match for this guy!"

For an elite of this level, one or two exchanges would reveal who was stronger and who was weaker, and Ling Han had suppressed Jia Tailong without using a Spirit Tool. His strength was not just a little bit stronger.
Guo Shuang was also watching. There was a layer of light on her beautiful face, and she actually seemed incredibly sacred.
After a while, she said in a low voice, "If we were at the same cultivation level, I don’t have the confidence to defeat him."
"What?!" The crimson squirrel was astonished. Others might not be aware, but it was aware of the astonishing background of this Lady.
Even she admitted that she could not defeat that brat in a battle of equal cultivation levels, hiss!
Though she had not said that she would lose, this was already shocking enough.
"Milady, does this brat really have such a freakish talent?" it asked.
Guo Shuang nodded, "Looks like this Spirit Devouring Physique does not just have the two strengths of physique and courage."
The crimson squirrel was even more stunned, because it knew just how difficult it was for this person to praise others.
Beneath them, no matter what Jia Tailong did, Ling Han’s response was extremely simple, yet also incredibly effective.
He was suppressed all this while, completely unable to turn the tables.
After fighting for 300 rounds, he had no choice but to turn around and flee. However, with a pounce from that ferocious beast, he was instantly turned into a rolling gourd.
Ling Han caught up to him, and with a punch, peng, this rookie was knocked unconscious.
After this, no one dared to challenge Ling Han again.
Everyone knew that he could join forces with that fierce beast, so how could they match that?
Now, everyone was waiting for the tournament to end, and then protest to the Martial Hall.
Soon, three days had passed, and the tournament had ended.
However, the Martial Hall didn’t accept everyone’s protests at all. Instead, they forcefully declared that Ling Han hadn’t cheated and told them not to cause trouble for no reason.
When the results of the tournament came out, Ling Han was naturally ranked first, and second was Jia Tailong.
Though he had been defeated by Ling Han, the number of opponents he had defeated previously was also astonishing, which was still enough to place him in second place.
The top five disciples were decided. Then, the Martial Hall would pick five more people to replenish numbers, and they would be able to enter into the Sacred Land for the final competition.
As a reward for the five victors, they were able to enter into the Royal Capital’s Pond of Life and cultivate for three days. However, Ling Han was refused entry.
Having happened twice, the incident with him absorbing exorbitant amounts of energy essence from the Pond of Life could not be repeated.
Just as Ling Han was feeling regretful that he couldn’t increase his cultivation level in public, a monk suddenly came to pay him a visit, inviting him to the Buddhist Tower.
This surprised him. What was going on?
He went to the Buddhist Tower, and after a short tour, he was allowed to enter the Pond of Life to cultivate. Furthermore, the duration was as long as five days.
Yi, who was secretly taking care of him?
Although Ling Han was puzzled, he didn’t stand on ceremony. He indeed needed a reason to increase his cultivation level.
When he entered into the Pond of Life, he saw the faces of Jia Tailong and the others instantly turn green.
Looks like Ling Han’s previous "evil deeds" should have been exposed. Naturally, he had become a rat that everyone despised.
Once this guy entered the pool, wouldn’t the others be immediately chased out?

After this team, other teams arrived, wanting to take down this fierce beast and earn fifty points.
However, they were all defeated by Ling Han and the fierce beast.
Some teams were wiped out, while others had survivors.
Ling Han didn’t take follow up on his victory and pursue them.
This also made those survivors think that Ling Han had cheated.
Who didn’t know that wild beasts couldn’t be tamed?
At least, it wasn’t something that could be done in such a short period of time.
Thus, there was definitely something fishy going on here.
Right at this moment, Ling Han also welcomed an "elite".
Jia Tailong.
This was the true prodigy of this tournament, and had long since gained the notice of the Sacred Land.
They would immediately take him in after this tournament, and focus on nurturing him.
He was all alone, and he held a Demon Subduing Staff in his hand.
This was the standard Tool of the Buddhist Race.
It was forged as an imitation of the Imperial Weapon.
Tsk, he had not truly entered into the Buddhist Race yet, yet already possessed the standard Buddhist Race Spirit Tool.
Merely from this aspect, it was clear how highly this person was valued by the Sacred Land.
"Zhang Hanjun!" He stood in front of the colossal beast, and faced with such a colossal creature, he was completely calm, as if this colossal beast was only a docile kitten in front of him.
"I don’t know what method you have used to cooperate with this fierce beast, but this is contrary to the original intention of the tournament.
I hope you can desist from this before it is too late."
Ling Han was astonished.
No wonder he had been so heavily targeted by the Buddhist Race.
He hadn’t even truly entered the Buddhist Race yet, yet he was already so proficient in the brainwashing techniques of the Buddhist Race.
He smiled faintly, and asked, "What is it?
Are you afraid now?"
"Humph, I just don’t want you to sink deeper and deeper," Jia Tailong said disdainfully.
"All right, come fight me." Ling Han laughed loudly.
With a pat, this great beast immediately pounced towards Jia Tailong.
It had long since become impatient from waiting.
"An!" Jia Tailong roared loudly, his voice reverberating and deafening.
Six Characters Bright King Curse?
He was astonished.
He hadn’t imagined that Jia Tailong had actually learned the secret technique of the Buddhist Race.
This was the Imperial Technique, which had a great influence on the mind.
Even the wild beast was affected, and couldn’t help but pause in its movements, looking confused.

According to legends, the Ancestral Buddha delivered a sermon, and even Saint-level fierce beasts would be influenced, their viciousness erased, and willingly become the guardian beasts of the Buddhist Race.
From this, it could be seen just how terrifying the effects of the Six Characters Bright King Curse on the mind were.
Jia Tailong’s grasp of the Six Characters Bright King Curse was naturally far inferior to the Ancestral Buddha.
Moreover, he had only mastered the "An" character, so he could only temporarily affect the wild beast.
However, taking advantage of this opportunity, Jia Tailong had already charged over with his Demon Subduing Staff.
Golden light radiated in all directions, and it was as if he had transformed into the Guardian Deity of the Buddhist Sect.
His eyes were wide with fury, and he was capable of destroying all the demons in the world.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and with a press of his hand, his whole person immediately flew from the beast’s body, greeting Jia Tailong’s attack.
He didn’t battle against the Spirit Tool head-on, but each move was smooth and natural, instantly grasping the rhythm of the battle.
It should be known that not only was he invincible among his peers, he could even win against an opponent at a higher cultivation level.
Now that he had lowered his own cultivation level, his ability to battle above his own cultivation level would only be even more terrifying, because he had wider horizons.
Even if Ling Han was extremely reserved, he still easily gained the upper hand.
"Yi!" In the skies, the crimson squirrel released an exclamation of surprise, "Jia Tailong is actually no match for this guy!"
For an elite of this level, one or two exchanges would reveal who was stronger and who was weaker, and Ling Han had suppressed Jia Tailong without using a Spirit Tool.
His strength was not just a little bit stronger.
Guo Shuang was also watching.
There was a layer of light on her beautiful face, and she actually seemed incredibly sacred.
After a while, she said in a low voice, "If we were at the same cultivation level, I don’t have the confidence to defeat him."
"What?!" The crimson squirrel was astonished.
Others might not be aware, but it was aware of the astonishing background of this Lady.
Even she admitted that she could not defeat that brat in a battle of equal cultivation levels, hiss!
Though she had not said that she would lose, this was already shocking enough.
"Milady, does this brat really have such a freakish talent?" it asked.
Guo Shuang nodded, "Looks like this Spirit Devouring Physique does not just have the two strengths of physique and courage."
The crimson squirrel was even more stunned, because it knew just how difficult it was for this person to praise others.
Beneath them, no matter what Jia Tailong did, Ling Han’s response was extremely simple, yet also incredibly effective.
He was suppressed all this while, completely unable to turn the tables.
After fighting for 300 rounds, he had no choice but to turn around and flee.
However, with a pounce from that ferocious beast, he was instantly turned into a rolling gourd.
Ling Han caught up to him, and with a punch, peng, this rookie was knocked unconscious.
After this, no one dared to challenge Ling Han again.
Everyone knew that he could join forces with that fierce beast, so how could they match that?
Now, everyone was waiting for the tournament to end, and then protest to the Martial Hall.
Soon, three days had passed, and the tournament had ended.
However, the Martial Hall didn’t accept everyone’s protests at all.
Instead, they forcefully declared that Ling Han hadn’t cheated and told them not to cause trouble for no reason.
When the results of the tournament came out, Ling Han was naturally ranked first, and second was Jia Tailong.
Though he had been defeated by Ling Han, the number of opponents he had defeated previously was also astonishing, which was still enough to place him in second place.
The top five disciples were decided.
Then, the Martial Hall would pick five more people to replenish numbers, and they would be able to enter into the Sacred Land for the final competition.
As a reward for the five victors, they were able to enter into the Royal Capital’s Pond of Life and cultivate for three days.
However, Ling Han was refused entry.
Having happened twice, the incident with him absorbing exorbitant amounts of energy essence from the Pond of Life could not be repeated.
Just as Ling Han was feeling regretful that he couldn’t increase his cultivation level in public, a monk suddenly came to pay him a visit, inviting him to the Buddhist Tower.
This surprised him.
What was going on?
He went to the Buddhist Tower, and after a short tour, he was allowed to enter the Pond of Life to cultivate.
Furthermore, the duration was as long as five days.
Yi, who was secretly taking care of him?
Although Ling Han was puzzled, he didn’t stand on ceremony.
He indeed needed a reason to increase his cultivation level.
When he entered into the Pond of Life, he saw the faces of Jia Tailong and the others instantly turn green.
Looks like Ling Han’s previous "evil deeds" should have been exposed.
Naturally, he had become a rat that everyone despised.
Once this guy entered the pool, wouldn’t the others be immediately chased out?

chapters.title: Chapter 4677: Entering the Sacred Land
paragraphs: Upon seeing Ling Han, Jia Tailong and the others all paled in fright.
This was a star of calamity!
"Zhang Hanjun, don’t harm others!" they hurriedly said.
It was only one matter for you to be chased away, but don’t implicate them.
Ling Han wore an expression of righteousness, and he said, "As the saying goes, we share the burden of misfortune and fortune."
’Who will share burdens of misfortune and fortune with you? We’re not familiar with each other.’
Seeing Ling Han walk over step by step, the four of them felt their hair stand on end, and they wanted to make a move on Ling Han.

However, they immediately recalled Ling Han’s terrifying abilities. Furthermore, the moment he entered this place, this guy’s cultivation level would probably immediately begin to soar, and they would be even more outmatched.
There was nothing else that could be done. They could only absorb the essence of the energy with all their might. Every bit counted.
Thus, the four of them released their reservations. Previously, they had been afraid that absorbing too strongly would cause harm to their bodies, but how could they care now?
"Pu!"
"Oh!"
They were all throwing up blood madly, or bleeding from their seven apertures. This was the aftereffect of absorbing too much.
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. "I received special permission to enter this space to cultivate. There should be... no one who would come to chase me away."
They clearly knew that Ling Han was a Spirit Devouring Physique, yet they still let him in. Thus, they naturally wouldn’t chase him out again. Otherwise, wouldn’t that be a superfluous action?
He could vaguely guess that this might be related to the people who had been monitoring him in the sky previously.
However, because he hadn’t used his divine sense to observe them, he couldn’t confirm who this person was.
Hearing Ling Han’s words, Jia Tailong and the others wanted to vomit blood again.
F***, why didn’t you say so earlier?
Ling Han began to absorb the energy in the pool waters. Then, he slightly released his aura, and continued his performance.
Hong, long, long! With this absorption, the waters of the pool instantly boiled, and the whole Buddhist Tower was also trembling endlessly.
This caused even Jia Tailong to pale in shock and feel uneasy. Would the monks immediately come out and chase them away?𝚏𝕣𝕖𝚎𝚠𝚎𝚋𝚗𝐨𝐯𝕖𝕝.𝕔𝐨𝕞
Thankfully, no one appeared all this while, which made them gradually feel more at ease.
Ling Han seemed to be right.
However, though no one stepped out to chase them away, looking at Ling Han rapidly breaking through one minor level after another, they were driven mad with jealousy.
Especially after half a day, when Ling Han completed his final leap and became a True Self Tier, they wanted nothing more than to kill Ling Han.
Comparisons would drive one crazy.

They could only comfort themselves in this way. When he reached the True Self Tier, Ling Han’s physique would no longer be able to take effect. At most, he would only reach the peak stage of the True Self Tier, and by then, he would be no different from an ordinary cultivator.
You may be one step ahead now, but they would definitely be able to catch up in future.

Ling Han absorbed the pool water’s energy for a while longer, but because the Spirit Devouring Physique’s limit was peak stage of True Self Tier, Ling Han couldn’t raise his cultivation level to Spirit Transformation Tier all at once.
Sigh!
Now that he was here, he "would have" a bottleneck in his cultivation. He could not break through too quickly, which would draw suspicion.
Even so, Jia Tailong and the others were still envious.
Because there was already "no further room for advancement", three days later, Ling Han left the Pond of Life with Jia Tailong and the others.
When they left, they discovered that the monks were all staring at them with deep hatred, causing a chill to run down their backs.

This was obviously because Ling Han had absorbed too much of the Pond of Life’s energy essence, which was why the monks were glaring at them. But the problem here was, you clearly knew that, so why did you still let Ling Han in?
Wasn’t this just asking for trouble?
The five of them returned to the Martial Hall. After resting for a few days, they would head to the Sacred Land and begin the final contest.
If one could still stand out, he would be directly taken in as a disciple by the Sacred Land, and may even become a Buddha Son in future!
Buddha Son!

When they thought of this word, everyone’s eyes lit up. That was because they already knew that Buddha Son Ah Han had not died, but was still living in this world. As long as one became the Buddha Son, he would definitely be able to receive personal guidance from the Great Emperor.
Just how tempting was this?
Several days later, they set out. Led personally by the Master of the Martial Ha;; of the Imperial Sea City, they headed towards the Sacred Land.
This was a show of respect for the Sacred Land.

The ten Royal Capitals were spread out all around the Sacred Land, guarding the true core of the Buddhist Race. After travelleing for a few days, Ling Han sensed a bitingly cold killing intent ahead of him, causing his hair to stand on end.
Great Emperor killing formation!

Ling Han was both excited and nervous. After lying low for so long, he was finally going to enter into the Sacred Land. However, the Great Emperor killing formation in front of him was the most difficult stage.
Afterward, with his strength of 10 Stars Saint-level and above, who could stop him from stealthily sneaking into the Pond of Life?
The holy flame... was finally about to ignite!

When they arrived at the edge of the Imperial Formation, the Master of the Martial Hall did not immediately step in. Instead, he took out a joss stick of sandalwood, and after respectfully lighting it, he sat down in a cross-legged position, and waited quietly.
Everyone followed suit, and sat down cross-legged.
After a while, a figure walked out of the Great Emperor Formation.

Under the envelopment of the Great Emperor’s killing formation, the entire area ahead of them was filled with fog. Now, in this fog, a hazy light first appeared. After waiting for a while, it could be seen that it was an oil lamp. Then, a person holding an oil lamp was seen walking slowly.
This was a monk. His head was bare, and he was wearing a purple kasaya. He was young, at most 17 or 18 years old, but he actually had a majestic and dignified aura.
"Benefactors, please follow me," the young monk said as he clasped his hands in respect. He then turned around and started to walk toward the Great Emperor Formation.

The Master of the Martial Hall hurriedly called for everyone to follow him. They had to stay under the light enshrouded by the oil lamp. Otherwise, the Great Emperor killing formation would attack them without mercy. No matter how many stars of Saint-level you were, the only result would be death.
Ling Han was also serious. He didn’t dare to be careless, and followed closely behind.
After walking for a while, everything suddenly became clear ahead of them.
They finally walked out of the Great Emperor killing formation.

Ling Han gazed into the distance, only to see the precious towers standing tall and low in the vast expanse of land before him. Apart from these towers, there were also numerous temples. Countless streaks of power of belief hovered above them, some of them directly transforming into a shower that rained down.
Hiss!
In the outside world, only those who had performed a great service could enter into the Buddhist Tower and absorb the energy essence of the Pond of Life, but it would only be for a mere few days.
But here?
There was an endless supply of power of belief, and it directly transformed into a rain of power that fell!
Just how wide was the gap between them?
Although the power of belief couldn’t be absorbed by cultivators without being converted, it was still fine even if they could only obtain a tiny bit of benefit.
Moreover, there was so much that there was no time to convert it, so wouldn’t pure energy be easily obtained?
In this place, perhaps the least valuable item was the power of belief.

Ling Han was also feeling rueful internally. As expected of the force that had the most territory and the most believers in the universe. Even if at least half of the universe had already fallen, the power of belief of the Buddhist Race was still incredibly strong, and could be used for a very, very long time, right?
"Benefactors, please," the young monk said calmly from the sidelines. He was already used to the stunned expressions of those who had just entered the Sacred Land.
