chapters.title: Chapter 4678: Search
paragraphs: Including the Master of the Martial Hall, everyone followed the young monk cautiously.

Though this little novice monk was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, while the Master of the Martial Hall was a great elite of Sect Master-level, this was the true core of the Buddhist Race. In fact, even Buddha Ah Han could possibly be here, so what was a Sect Master worth?

The young monk led them into a temple. The chanting of sutras was endless here, causing one to feel refreshed and energetic after hearing it. It was as if it had become easier to think about problems.
Yet Ling Han knew that this was an illusion.
The brainwashing ability of the Buddhist Race was number one in the world.

It was possible that even Venerate Tiers wouldn’t be able to discover this misconception, and would think that this was a Holy Land of cultivation. As time passed, they would subtly be inclined towards the Buddhist Race and completely submit to them.

In the past, when Ah Han had preached Buddhist sermons, he had even caused a Saint-level beast to "come to its senses", and throw itself into becoming the guardian beast of the Buddhist Race, which showed how terrifying the effects this had on the spirit was.
No matter how strong your willpower was, could it withstand millions of years of continuous brainwashing?
Thus, within the Sacred Land, everyone was definitely the most loyal believers and death warriors of the Buddhist Race.
Ling Han guarded his divine sense closely. He didn’t want to be brainwashed into becoming a member of the Buddhist Race before he even entered the Pond of Life.

The young novice monk left very quickly, and everyone hurriedly tried their best to gain appreciation. This was the Sacred Land. If they cultivated here for a day, it would be equivalent to a month outside, or even a year in fact!
Ling Han very much wanted to release his divine sense to sense for the Pond of Life.
Once he found it, he would be able to immediately sneak in and leave, ending this journey to the Buddhist Race.
Unfortunately, he did not dare.

That was because it was very possible that there was a Great Emperor here. Even if due to circumstances, it was impossible for him to fully unleash the Imperial Might, he was still not something that Ling Han could stand against.
Thus, he still had to maintain an absolute low profile.
While others were meditating, he exited the temple and started to walk around.
—No one had made it a rule that anyone who entered here would have to stay in the temple.
When others asked, he could also say that he was curious.
Who could blame the curiosity of a seventeen-year-old country boy?

If he could find the Pond of Life just like that, that was naturally best. If he couldn’t, he could only follow the plan and break through to the core level of the Sacred Land with an outstanding performance. Then, he would naturally have a chance to enter the Pond of Life.
In the Sacred Land, there were temples everywhere. The people living here were the most devout believers of Buddha Ah Han. They recited sutras every day, and did not care about worldly matters.
Hence, no matter where it was, the chanting of sutras would not cease, forming a mysterious power.
"The power of belief can form a type of Regulation, and in this world, the belief of monks are even firmer, and will form a stronger effect of Regulations."

Ling Han reminded himself to be careful. When two opposing Regulations clashed, it would definitely be the stronger Regulation that would emerge victorious. The heaven and earth would act according to these Regulations.
He walked around. There was practically no one walking on the streets here. It was empty. If it was not for the endless chanting of sutras, one would really think that this was a ghost realm.
No one came out to stop Ling Han from going anywhere. It seemed like there were no secrets hidden in the Sacred Land.

Most importantly, there were too many buildings here, and the place was too big. Even if there was no one to stop Ling Han, without releasing his divine sense, Ling Han’s speed of exploration wouldn’t be much faster.
If he wanted to explore the entirety of the Sacred Land, it would take at least a few months. Furthermore, even if he did, it did not mean that he would definitely be able to find the Pond of Life.
The strange thing was that even after a day had passed, there was still no sign of the sun setting. Instead, it continued to circle around the Sacred Land.

In truth, there was no sun in the entire outer circle of the Buddhist Land. It was unknown in the past, but the present sun had long since been extinguished by the invasion of the Netherworld, but in the Buddhist Land, there were still the normal rising and setting of the sun and moon.
This was naturally the handiwork of great elites, who artificially caused day and night to change.
When it came to the \Sacred Land, the change of day and night was even stranger, directly erasing the darkness of the night.
Fortunately, the people here were all elites above Celestial Path. If they wanted to rest, they could simply meditate. They didn’t need to sleep at all.

In that case, one circle of the sun here would be counted as a day. Ling Han had already walked for two days, but did not discover anything. Thus, he planned to return first, not knowing when the final tournament would be held.
He walked back, and after taking a few steps, a woman in white walked towards him.
Yi, Guo Shuang.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over, and discovered that there was a crimson squirrel on this woman’s shoulder. It was currently staring at him, baring its teeth, as if it had some great enmity with him.
Why had this woman appeared here?

Ling Han couldn’t help but let his imagination run wild. He didn’t dare to observe the other party with his eye technique, because he could sense that the other party was unfathomable. If she really was a super elite, then being observed by him like this would definitely expose him as well.

However, this woman was mysterious, and added with the fact that he had previously felt that an elite was observing him, these two factors added together gave him a feeling that this woman was very possibly the person who had been observing him secretly.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
He smiled, and took the initiative to say, "Lady Guo, what a coincidence."
"It’s not a coincidence." Guo Shuang said calmly, "I have deliberately come to find you."
"Oh, is anything the matter?" Ling Han asked.
Guo Shuang smiled faintly, and instantly, it was as if hundreds of flowers had bloomed at the same time, indescribably beautiful.
She said calmly, "I see that you have been roaming around, so I wanted to ask you, where do you want to go? I can be a guide."
Ling Han was astonished, and he asked, "Miss, are you staying here?"
"Are you trying to get information out of me?" Guo Shuang countered.
Ling Han shrugged and said, "I’m just curious."
"I do indeed live here, so I’m very familiar with this place," Guo Shuang said calmly.

Ling Han also admitted honestly, "This is my first time entering into the Sacred Land, so I’m curious about everywhere. I especially want to see the place where the Ancestral Buddha preached in the past."
"I’ll take you there," Guo Shuang said.
"Then thank you."

Ling Han caught up withh her in a few steps, and walked side by side with Guo Shuang. Immediately, he was glared at by that squirrel, as if it was saying, ’Who do you think you are? How dare you walk side by side with this Lady?’
The two of them continued onwards, circling here and there, and finally arrived in front of a temple that was not too conspicuous.
Though there were doors in the temples here, all of them were wide open, and there was no one standing guard.
The two of them entered, yet immediately felt an incredibly powerful aura approach them.
However, this aura immediately withdrew. Furthermore, there was no sign of anyone walking out, as if they were extremely at ease.
Ling Han couldn’t help but look at Guo Shuang, who was beside him. Was it because of this woman?
Guo Shuang smiled sheepishly, "Like I said, I live here."
Ling Han also smiled. He entered the temple, and walked around.

Guo Shuang was really familiar with this place, and gave a lecture to Ling Han. This was the Buddhist staff that the Ancestral Buddha had used before. This was the praying mat that the Ancestral Buddha had sat on. It really seemed like there was nothing that she didn’t know.
Ling Han was naturally not interested in this kind of history, but no matter what, he had to put on an act, so he could only show an expression of high spirits.
He was beginning to regret it.

sentences.text: Including the Master of the Martial Hall, everyone followed the young monk cautiously.
Though this little novice monk was only a Cauldron Forging Tier, while the Master of the Martial Hall was a great elite of Sect Master-level, this was the true core of the Buddhist Race.
In fact, even Buddha Ah Han could possibly be here, so what was a Sect Master worth?
The young monk led them into a temple.
The chanting of sutras was endless here, causing one to feel refreshed and energetic after hearing it.
It was as if it had become easier to think about problems.
Yet Ling Han knew that this was an illusion.
The brainwashing ability of the Buddhist Race was number one in the world.
It was possible that even Venerate Tiers wouldn’t be able to discover this misconception, and would think that this was a Holy Land of cultivation.
As time passed, they would subtly be inclined towards the Buddhist Race and completely submit to them.

In the past, when Ah Han had preached Buddhist sermons, he had even caused a Saint-level beast to "come to its senses", and throw itself into becoming the guardian beast of the Buddhist Race, which showed how terrifying the effects this had on the spirit was.
No matter how strong your willpower was, could it withstand millions of years of continuous brainwashing?
Thus, within the Sacred Land, everyone was definitely the most loyal believers and death warriors of the Buddhist Race.
Ling Han guarded his divine sense closely.
He didn’t want to be brainwashed into becoming a member of the Buddhist Race before he even entered the Pond of Life.
The young novice monk left very quickly, and everyone hurriedly tried their best to gain appreciation.
This was the Sacred Land.
If they cultivated here for a day, it would be equivalent to a month outside, or even a year in fact!
Ling Han very much wanted to release his divine sense to sense for the Pond of Life.
Once he found it, he would be able to immediately sneak in and leave, ending this journey to the Buddhist Race.
Unfortunately, he did not dare.
That was because it was very possible that there was a Great Emperor here.
Even if due to circumstances, it was impossible for him to fully unleash the Imperial Might, he was still not something that Ling Han could stand against.
Thus, he still had to maintain an absolute low profile.
While others were meditating, he exited the temple and started to walk around.
—No one had made it a rule that anyone who entered here would have to stay in the temple.
When others asked, he could also say that he was curious.
Who could blame the curiosity of a seventeen-year-old country boy?
If he could find the Pond of Life just like that, that was naturally best.
If he couldn’t, he could only follow the plan and break through to the core level of the Sacred Land with an outstanding performance.
Then, he would naturally have a chance to enter the Pond of Life.
In the Sacred Land, there were temples everywhere.
The people living here were the most devout believers of Buddha Ah Han.
They recited sutras every day, and did not care about worldly matters.
Hence, no matter where it was, the chanting of sutras would not cease, forming a mysterious power.
"The power of belief can form a type of Regulation, and in this world, the belief of monks are even firmer, and will form a stronger effect of Regulations."
Ling Han reminded himself to be careful.
When two opposing Regulations clashed, it would definitely be the stronger Regulation that would emerge victorious.
The heaven and earth would act according to these Regulations.
He walked around.
There was practically no one walking on the streets here.
It was empty.
If it was not for the endless chanting of sutras, one would really think that this was a ghost realm.
No one came out to stop Ling Han from going anywhere.
It seemed like there were no secrets hidden in the Sacred Land.
Most importantly, there were too many buildings here, and the place was too big.
Even if there was no one to stop Ling Han, without releasing his divine sense, Ling Han’s speed of exploration wouldn’t be much faster.
If he wanted to explore the entirety of the Sacred Land, it would take at least a few months.
Furthermore, even if he did, it did not mean that he would definitely be able to find the Pond of Life.
The strange thing was that even after a day had passed, there was still no sign of the sun setting.
Instead, it continued to circle around the Sacred Land.
In truth, there was no sun in the entire outer circle of the Buddhist Land.

It was unknown in the past, but the present sun had long since been extinguished by the invasion of the Netherworld, but in the Buddhist Land, there were still the normal rising and setting of the sun and moon.
This was naturally the handiwork of great elites, who artificially caused day and night to change.
When it came to the \Sacred Land, the change of day and night was even stranger, directly erasing the darkness of the night.
Fortunately, the people here were all elites above Celestial Path.
If they wanted to rest, they could simply meditate.
They didn’t need to sleep at all.
In that case, one circle of the sun here would be counted as a day.
Ling Han had already walked for two days, but did not discover anything.
Thus, he planned to return first, not knowing when the final tournament would be held.
He walked back, and after taking a few steps, a woman in white walked towards him.
Yi, Guo Shuang.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over, and discovered that there was a crimson squirrel on this woman’s shoulder.
It was currently staring at him, baring its teeth, as if it had some great enmity with him.
Why had this woman appeared here?
Ling Han couldn’t help but let his imagination run wild.
He didn’t dare to observe the other party with his eye technique, because he could sense that the other party was unfathomable.
If she really was a super elite, then being observed by him like this would definitely expose him as well.

However, this woman was mysterious, and added with the fact that he had previously felt that an elite was observing him, these two factors added together gave him a feeling that this woman was very possibly the person who had been observing him secretly.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺

She said calmly, "I see that you have been roaming around, so I wanted to ask you, where do you want to go?
I can be a guide."

Ling Han shrugged and said, "I’m just curious."
"I do indeed live here, so I’m very familiar with this place," Guo Shuang said calmly.
Ling Han also admitted honestly, "This is my first time entering into the Sacred Land, so I’m curious about everywhere.
I especially want to see the place where the Ancestral Buddha preached in the past."
"I’ll take you there," Guo Shuang said.
"Then thank you."

chapters.title: Chapter 4679: Final Tournament
paragraphs: Another day later, Ling Han returned to the temple where he was staying.
He did not go out again, fearing that he would encounter Guo Shuang again.
This woman was not ordinary.
Though he had the Soul Forming Technique, if he spent too much time with this woman, it was very possible that she would see through his disguise.
After all, he was pretending to be someone else. As time passed, there would definitely be flaws in his disguise.
Several days later, the ten teams from the Royal Capitals had all arrived.
Next, it was the final battle.
The rules of the competition had finally been changed.
Everyone drew lots, and then battled one-on-one. They would be continuously eliminated, right until the first and second place were decided.
In the face of such rules, cultivation level was too important.

After all, there weren’t many people who could challenge those above their cultivation level. Regardless of how prodigious one was, there was still an insurmountable gulf between his cultivation level and the next major tier.

Thus, those with low cultivation levels could only hope that they would draw a good lot and try their best to fight a few more battles, so that they could unleash their full strength as much as possible.
In this way, it was possible that they would be taken into the Sacred Land.
Cultivating here for a day was equivalent to a month or even a year in the outside world.
There were a total of 100 members in the 10 teams. In the first round, there were 28 people who had passed.

Some people would be happy if they drew an empty lot, because this meant that they would enter into the second round without having to fight, but there were also those who were unhappy if they drew an empty lot, because they were only in the Core Formation Tier. Originally, they had hoped to encounter an opponent who was similarly Core Formation Tier, and show off their strength.
Now that they had directly entered into the second round, the chances of encountering a Core Formation Tier cultivator would be greatly decreased, so it was naturally disadvantageous.
But no matter what, it could not be changed now that the lots were drawn. It could only be left to fate.
On the second day, the final round of advancement battles began.
The Sacred Land also dispatched a Bodhisattva, a Venerate, to observe the tournament, and on the other hand, to keep watch.
The highest level of battle here was True Self Tier. With a Venerate Tier overseer, what need was there for them to fear that they would not be able to go all out?
However, a piece of news immediately broke out. Among the contestants this time, there was actually a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator!
After learning of this, everyone was stunned.
How was this going to be dealt with now?
There was definitely no way they could compete for the place of champion.
No matter how freakish you were, could a True Self Tier cultivator match a Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator?
It was impossible. Even the Ancestral Buddha had not been able to do so in the past.

This person’s name was "Ji Liren", and he was from the Martial King Royal Capital. It was said that he had participated in several major battles at the Sacred Land—there was an upper limit, and one could only participate a total of three times. Then one had to make way for others, and couldn’t keep occupying the territory.

However, the last time he participated in a battle at the Sacred Land was two hundred years ago. After that, he had been touring the Buddhist Land, issuing challenges everywhere, and tempering his battle prowess.
According to the rules, the age of the participants in the Sacred Land tournament could not exceed three hundred years old, and he just happened to be right in front of this restriction.
However, the selection of talents for the Sacred Land was not just based on battle prowess and cultivation level. More importantly, it was based on natural talent.
Hence, even if Ji Liren should have ascended to the throne of champion without a doubt, everyone didn’t lose their fighting spirit.
The opponent that Ling Han had drawn in the first round was also a True Self Tier. Thus, the battle did not lose the "suspense".

The battles began. Because a Venerate was present, battlegrounds could be created at will, allowing everyone to battle at the same time. Thus, the first round of elimination battles began at the same time.
"Haha, my luck is not too bad. I encountered a rookie that is participating for the first time." When Ling Han’s opponent saw him, he immediately bared his teeth in a grin.
Ling Han smiled, "You should be a rash person."
"Why do you say that?" His opponent was not in a rush either.
"Because when you saw my information, you only saw that I was a rookie this year, but forgot to take note of my cultivation level," Ling Han said.
"Could it be that you are in the True Self Tier?" the opponent said, then laughed out loud himself.
Wasn’t this a huge joke?
This was his first time participating in the Sacred Land Tournament, so how could he possibly be a True Self Tier!
Ling Han smiled as well. It was as if the two of them weren’t rivals, but rather old friends who had known each other for many years.
"Alright, now that the joke’s over, it’s time to deal with you!" the opponent said.
Ling Han smiled, "Come on then."
"Humph, I have to say, as a Core Formation Tier cultivator, your courage is truly commendable," the opponent sneered, and delivered a palm strike.
Peng!
Ling Han casually threw a punch, easily dispersing this palm strike.
"Yi!" The opponent was stunned. This had exceeded his expectations. "Are you really a True Self Tier?"
Ling Han smiled, "I told you just now."

"How is this possible?!" The opponent still couldn’t believe it. Those who were only participating in the tournament at the Sacred Land for the first time were definitely Core Formation Tier. This was decided through multiple rounds of selection.
You are really too freakish, aren’t you?
"Humph, even if you are in the True Self Tier, I can still defeat you!" That opponent charged over again. This time, his battle prowess was fully unleashed.
He didn’t believe that he wouldn’t be able to suppress this opponent if he went all out.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
The two of them battled fiercely, and the opponent shockingly discovered that Ling Han was not only in the True Self Tier, but also in terms of minor level, Ling Han was actually superior to him.
He could not believe it at all. How could it be possible that this kind of contestant would be participating in the Sacred Land Tournament for the first time?
What a joke!
No matter how he tried, he was still unable to turn the tables. In less than a dozen moves, he was defeated.
Ling Han had won, and this was a matter of course. He did not look overjoyed, and quietly waited for the battles of the others to end, and the second round of elimination battles to begin.

Some battles lasted longer, while others were very short. However, they wouldn’t last for more than a day. The Venerate from the Sacred Land would determine who would emerge victorious based on the performance of both sides.
On the second day, the second round of battles finally began.
This time, there was no one else who had gotten an empty turn. One after another, great battles broke out.
Being able to pass through multiple selections and be chosen to participate in the final competition, which one of them was not a prodigy?
Thus, unless a True Self Tier cultivator encountered a Core Formation Tier cultivator and could quickly end the battle, it would be an extremely intense and drawn-out battle.
One day later, the thirty two battles all ended, and only five Core Formation Tiers remained on the field.
After another round of elimination battles, only one Core Formation Tier cultivator remained.

When they reached the quarterfinals, all the Core Formation Tiers finally disappeared. Because there was only one Core Formation Tier, he would definitely encounter a True Self Tier, so how could he not lose?
Coincidentally, it just so happened that Ling Han encountered the only Core Formation Tier cultivator, which also made everyone think that his placement in the top eight was too weak.
However, in the following battle of the semifinals, Ling Han actually encountered Ji Liren.
Hehe, this guy’s good luck had been used up.
As the only Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator, whoever Ji Liren encountered could only be defeated, unable to take another step forward.
"It can’t be helped. The heavens are fair. He first encountered a Core Formation Tier cultivator, and took full advantage of him, so of course he has to spit back out his unfair advantage."
"Being able to advance into the top eight is already very impressive."
"That’s right. Could it be that he wants to rely on luck to advance into the top four?"
Just as everyone was discussing this, the battle for the top four began.
There were many people watching this battle, and thinking about it, it would end very quickly. If they wanted to watch the other battles, this would not take up too much time.

chapters.title: Chapter 4680: Failed?
paragraphs: Ji Liren faced Ling Han proudly, as if he was a supreme god.
As he saw it, any battle would be meaningless — he was a Spirit Transformation True Lord. Who wouldn’t be crushed by him?
Thus, his competition battles were only going through the motions.
"Just admit defeat," he said calmly.
Ling Han smiled, "You’re that confident?"
"This is reality." It was rare for Ji Liren to say more. "I’m a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and you’re only a True Self Tier. Is there any need to say anything else?"
This was a one-sided suppression. This was the truth of the cultivation world; no one could win against a higher cultivation level!
Of course, Ling Han was an exception. However, there was only one such monster.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, "Then I’m sorry. I broke through yesterday, and I’m no longer a True Self Tier."
Yi?
Ji Liren faltered upon hearing this. Was this real?
’You’re bluffing, aren’t you? Who doesn’t need to accumulate experience for several years to break through? How can you break through just because you want to?’
"Hehe, you really know how to brag!" He shook his head, filled with absolute disbelief.
"Come." Ling Han crooked a finger at him, "What I like the most is to use my fists to subdue others."
How arrogant!
Ji Liren smirked coldly. Even if you truly broke through, you would only be a First Change, and he was a Third Change!
"Then let me experience it!" Ji Liren moved, sending out a palm strike towards Ling Han.
Peng!
Ling Han didn’t dodge. Instead, he chose to counterattack.

There was a loud bang, and Ji Liren’s attack was instantly dispersed. However, to complement the fact that he was a First Change of Spirit Transformation Tier, Ling Han also stumbled back continuously.
Now that things had progressed to this point, his image naturally could not be destroyed.
Pu!
Seeing this scene, everyone vomited blood.
How was this possible?
This guy was actually a Spirit Transformation True Lord?

Previously, they had said that this guy was lucky, and encountered the only Core Formation Tier cultivator, easily advancing into the top eight. However, his path of advancement would thus be severed. Who would have thought that this guy would actually break through at such a critical moment?
The second Spirit Transformation True Lord in the tournament, logically speaking, he should be able to secure the second place.
Sigh!
This time, no one thought that he was lucky, but rather unlucky to have encountered Ji Liren so quickly.
You see, the difference between First Change and Third Change was clear at a glance.
However, everyone could see that Ling Han didn’t have the slightest awareness of being a weakling, and actually took the initiative to attack first.
Wasn’t this just asking for a beating?
Everyone shook their heads. This time, Ling Han’s defeat would be very, very soon.

Ji Liren smirked coldly. He had confirmed Ling Han’s cultivation level. He was indeed a Spirit Transformation Tier. However, he was naturally confident that a Third Change would be able to defeat a First Change.
He still dared to attack first?
Where had his courage come from?
He sent out a palm strike, using his full power, wanting to end the battle as soon as possible.
With his cultivation level, it was only right for him to win. Thus, only by ending the battle as quickly as possible would he be able to slightly reflect his natural talent in cultivation.
However, the truth was completely different from what he had imagined.
Ling Han used all his movement techniques, extremely agile, and his punches and kicks were just right, dispersing Ji Liren’s attacks completely.
Ji Liren was clearly at an advantage in terms of power, and he was also at an advantage in terms of cultivation level, yet he couldn’t unleash his full power at all.
Hiss, this was actually a tie?
No!
Those with sharp eyes discovered that the situation was slowly tilting in Ling Han’s direction.
This guy’s natural talent in battle was too terrifying. He had used every single bit of power to the extreme, showing them perfectly how they could defeat the strong as the weak.
As expected, Ji Liren’s advantage gradually fell to a stalemate, and then to a disadvantage.
At this moment, everyone felt that the chances of Ling Han winning were infinitely high.
After another 300 rounds, Ji Liren had no choice but to admit defeat.
If they continued to fight, he would be forcefully defeated. That would really be too ugly. It would be better for him to admit defeat himself. At least, he would still have some face.
He looked at Ling Han, and could not accept this at all.
How could this guy be so freakish? He was clearly not weak either, yet the other had defeated him with a gap of two minor levels.
Ling Han smiled in reply. If it weren’t for the fact that he had held back, he would have been able to surpass seven or eight minor levels, at least, to say nothing of two minor levels.
After this battle, though Ling Han was temporarily ranked in the top four, everyone knew that he was already the champion in reality.
Could it be that there was a second person who could complete the breakthrough from the True Self Tier to the Spirit Transformation Tier in a short one to two days?
That was impossible.
As expected, the outcome of the following two rounds of the competition had no suspense. Ling Han easily won, and locked in on the position of champion.

At this point, the tournament for the Martial Halls had all ended. The majority of people had returned, and only a very limited number of people were able to stay behind. They had been chosen by the Sacred Land, and when they came out in future, they would at least reach the height of a City Lord.
In the past, they could still be sent to the various Heavenly Realms. That could easily become the ruler of a planet or even galaxy, which was even more awesome.

Of course, there was no need to worry about those who returned. After all, there would still be a chance for them to come back again in future. Moreover, even if the Sacred Land did not want them, they would definitely be wanted by the Martial Halls in the various Royal Capitals. That was still an excellent choice.
Unexpectedly, Ling Han wasn’t retained either.
This shocked everyone.

Although Ling Han’s cultivation level had skyrocketed because of the Spirit Devouring Physique, and his cultivation level had accelerated unfairly, his battle with Ji Liren had already fully explained his natural talent in battle.
Why didn’t the Sacred Land want him?
However, how could they question this decision?
Though some people felt that this was unfair to Ling Han, they did not dare say anything, and even more people were rejoicing in his misfortune.
Even Ling Han hadn’t expected this. His performance had been so outstanding, yet he hadn’t been chosen as a member of the Sacred Land?
What was he to do now?
Do everthing again?
What if he was still not chosen?
Time would not wait for him. Now was a time when every second counted. If an ancient Imperial Son became Emperor, he would only be able to watch helplessly.
What was even more terrifying?

If this ancient Imperial Son that had become Emperor belonged to the Twelve Lands of Death, then with a new Emperor and twelve veteran Emperors, who in this world would be able to match such a powerful force?
Without becoming a Great Emperor, so what if Ling Han possessed the Seed of the Holy Flame?
The strongest Saint in history?
So what if this strongest Saint could match the Pseudo-Emperor?
Thoughts raced through Ling Han’s mind, but he didn’t cause a commotion. Instead, he returned with the others in the team.
He was clearly so outstanding, yet had not been detained. That could only mean one thing.
He was presently being examined, and there was a more important purpose for him.
Thus, Ling Han followed everyone back to the Imperial Sea Royal Capital, and agreed to the invitation of the local Martial Hall to stay there.
He cultivated every day, and when he was free, he would also go out for a walk, appearing to be very relaxed.
These days continued for two months, and finally, a change took place.
Someone came to visit Ling Han.
It was Guo Shuang again.

Ling Han understood. The fact that he was allowed to enter into the Pond of Life inside the Buddhist Tower of the Royal Capital was definitely the interference of this woman, and the fact that he couldn’t stay in the Sacred Land was probably also her doing.
He was very curious. Who exactly was this woman?
Unfortunately, he couldn’t use his eye technique. Otherwise, he should have been able to see some clues.
"Lady Guo, have you come to take me to the Sacred Land?" he asked bluntly, not beating around the bush.

Who wouldn’t be crushed by him?

"I’m a Spirit Transformation True Lord, and you’re only a True Self Tier.
Is there any need to say anything else?"
This was a one-sided suppression.

chapters.title: Chapter 4681: Illuminating oneself
paragraphs: "Why do you think that?" Guo Shuang didn’t answer, but instead asked a question of her own.
Ling Han wore a confident expression, and he said, "With my performance, who can compare to me? However, I failed to make the cut. Thus, I can only conclude that this is a test of my willpower."

Guo Shuang couldn’t help but laugh in spite of herself. However, she nodded and said, "You’re really confident. However, you guessed correctly. At the peak of your life, you suddenly encountered a head-on blow, and you can still maintain such composure. You indeed have a promising future."
Ling Han did not show any joy on his face. Instead, he asked curiously, "Who exactly are you?"
"You will find out in future. Now, follow me," Guo Shuang said.
"Don’t I need to inform the Martial Hall?"
"No need."
Ling Han nodded, and followed Guo Shuang away. They once again arrived at the Great Emperor formation.
This time, Guo Shuang did not take out sandalwood joss stick to light up. Instead, she took out an oil lamp himself, and after lighting it, she led the way.
Ling Han hurriedly followed after her.

When the two of them walked out of the Great Emperor formation — or rather, when they really walked in, Guo Shuang’s body was seen to suddenly exude a powerful aura. There was also a soft lustre on her body, and she looked incredibly sacred.
This was actually a Saint!
Ling Han only gave an "oh" in his mind. This was within his expectations, but a shocked expression appeared on his face, "Who exactly are you?"
Guo Shuang glanced at him, her eyes filled with incomparable authority, but did not say anything.
This glance carried endless pressure.

Ling Han was naturally unafraid, but he was presently only a mere Spirit Transformation True Lord. Thus, he naturally had to act as he should. Otherwise, if he really managed to sneak into the Sacred Land with great difficulty, and his public image was ruined, that would really be too unjust.
Guo Shuang waved her hand dismissively, "Someone will bring you to your accommodations."
She took a step, and in an instant, there was no sign of her.
"A Saint of around 10,000 years old, at most." Ling Han looked at Guo Shuang’s back. This time, he could finally use his eye technique. Guo Shuang definitely wouldn’t notice it.
"It’s said that Ah Han doesn’t have any children, so this should be the personal disciple of Ah Han?"
"The Holy Daughter of the first generation?"
"In that case, Guo Shuang may not be her real name either."
"That’s right. Even that squirrel can be called Guo Yun so Guo Shuang definitely isn’t her real name."
"But who cares? I only want to enter the Pond of Life."
Ling Han felt rueful. He had already been here for so long, and he had indeed entered three times the Little Pond of Life, but what about the real Pond of Life?
It wasn’t long before a young monk came over and led Ling Han to his residence.
It was naturally a temple. Ling Han’s residence was in a small courtyard, and there were three people living here.
When the three people inside saw Ling Han, they were all gaping in shock.
How could it be Ling Han?
These three people were Jia Tailong, Ji Liren and another prodigy who had emerged victorious from this competition. They were all settled here.
They had thought that Ling Han had already been chased off. Who would have thought that he would suddenly appear in front of them again? Naturally, they were incredibly surprised.
Ling Han smiled, "Everyone, looks like I’ll have to be your neighbor for a while."

The three of them sighed. Previously, the Sacred Land had not chosen to retain Ling Han. They all found this strange, because Ling Han’s natural talent in martial arts was clearly superior to Ji Liren’s, and Ji Liren had been retained. Why was it that Ling Han was not?
Now that Ling Han had returned, they all understood that there was something hidden that they did not know, but Sacred Land definitely had a high opinion of Ling Han.
They stayed here for a few days, then were brought to another temple by a young monk.
This temple was much larger.
They arrived at a meditation hall. Strangely, there was a white jade-like wall in the middle of the meditation hall, but it did not connect to the roof. It was about the height of a person.

Aside from Ling Han and the others, there were also a great many people here. They were presently seated in cross-legged positions. It was unknown whether they were meditating, or resting to pass the time.
After the young monk brought the four of them in, he left directly.
Ling Han and the others imitated the others, finding a place to sit cross-legged.

Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and saw that the cultivation levels of the people here were not uniform. Some were only in Cauldron Forging Tier, while some had even reached Sect Master-level. Some were dressed like monks, while some were people of the mortal <anno data-annotation-id="7454bca0-adda-4faf-8ba1-d867cf390048" data-title="world">world1</anno>.
Very soon, he withdrew his gaze. He lowered his head, lowered his head and waited quietly.
After a long while, an old monk appeared.
This was a Venerate, and in the Buddhist Race, Venerate Tiers were also called Bodhisattvas. This one was called Bodhisattva Luo Shu.
The old monk opened his mouth, and said, "Let us begin today’s contest."
Yi, was there a fight?
Ling Han faltered for a moment. The cultivation levels of the people here were all uneven, so how were they supposed to fight?
However, he discovered that the others had all stood up and walked in front of the white jade wall. Then, they turned around and sat with their backs against the wall.
What was going on here?
He followed suit. When he sat down and leaned his back against the white jade wall, he suddenly realized that his mind had actually been connected to a separate dimension.
This?
He thought for a moment, then released a sliver of divine sense, which entered into this space.
Instantly, multiple human figures appeared in front of him.
"The Void Emperor!"
"Ancestral King Lingtian!"
"Nine Suns Saint!"
Ling Han was astounded. Whenever he touched these humanoid figures with his divine sense, information would immediately form in his mind.

These human figures were all mighty figures who had once been all-powerful. Now, as long as he fused his divine sense with this human figure, he could temporarily transform into this kind of existence. It was equivalent to possessing an "incarnation".
He understood now. The so-called battle was a contest of manifestations.
Every manifestation had their own techniques, and each had their own specialty.
For example, the unique trait of the True Phoenix was its speed, while the True Dragon had an incredibly tough physique and overwhelming brute force, which was reflected through its abilities.
"Quickly choose your own battle vehicle." A voice rang out. It was precisely that old monk.
Ling Han’s eyes swept over them, and in an instant, he had seen all the manifestations.
There were manifestations of Great Emperors here, incomparably powerful ancient Saints, and even Divine Beasts from the ancient times. However, Ling Han was not satisfied with any of them.
He firmly believed that he himself was the strongest.
Yi?
Shockingly, he discovered that at the end of these figures, there was an embodiment whose features were even blurred.
When he touched it with his divine sense, the information he received was that this could reflect his own body.
—With himself as the template for the embodiment.
Ling Han smiled, and that was it.
He fused his divine sense, and his manifestation immediately analyzed his divine sense, digitizing his power and speed.
However, Ling Han had the Soul Forming Technique, and simulated himself in the Spirit Transformation Tier. All the numbers were what he wanted to show.
This number naturally wouldn’t be excessive. At most, he could only be regarded as a prodigy, or a slightly above average prodigy.
When all this was done, the scene in front of him immediately changed. He had actually appeared in space.
The old monk also appeared. His figure was massive, and his head was even larger than a planet.
"Let the battle begin!"

chapters.title: Chapter 4682: Battle of Manifestations
paragraphs: Ling Han was still confused. The battle had begun?
Who should he hit? There were so many of them.
However, right at this moment, a "Great Emperor" suddenly charged over.

This was the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor. He had personally witnessed the corpse of the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor, though the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s corpse had been even larger than a planet at that time. If he had been standing in one place, he would only have been able to see a single side of it.
When his divine sense swept over, he shockingly discovered that there was actually information being fed back.
This was Jia Tailong!
Great, he had defeated him previously, and he could not swallow this anger, so now he wanted to get his revenge?
However, how could the Great Emperor be blocked?
Boom!
Jia Tailong slashed down with his sword, causing the river of stars to boil.
Yet Ling Han’s heart calmed, because this Great Emperor actually only had the battle prowess of True Self Tier.
He also threw a punch in response.
Only now did he realize that he could only unleash the battle prowess of a True Self Tier.
Oh, their cultivation levels were the same.

No wonder everyone had chosen the Great Emperor’s body as their "vehicle". That was because under the prerequisite that their cultivation levels were equal, the Great Emperor’s bodt was naturally the strongest. Only incredibly powerful Saints like the Nine Suns Saint could compare.

Ling Han shook his head. In the beginning, he had really gotten a scare. He had thought that he could simulate the Great Emperor, but from the look of things now, this was only an empty image of the Great Emperor. As for other details, it was all numericalized.
For example, if the Great Emperor’s power was set to the highest level of 100, then the powerful Saint’s power could be set to 99 or something of the sort.
In truth, this had absolutely nothing to do with a Great Emperor.

However, because Ling Han was reflecting his own data, and he was extremely good at hiding his strength, it caused his power and speed to be far inferior. Going by the limit of 100, he could only be 80, or even lower.
Peng!
It was only a single strike, and Ling Han was sent flying, stumbling.
"Zhang Hanjun, in a true battle of equals, how could I possibly lose to you!" Jia Tailong said proudly.
Ling Han couldn’t help but wear a strange expression.
Where did your confidence come from?𝐟𝕣𝕖𝐞𝐰𝕖𝚋𝐧𝗼𝚟𝐞𝕝.𝗰𝐨𝐦
He was clearly relying on the fact that his incarnation had higher statistics, yet he actually came over to tell him to battle at the same cultivation level?
He steadied his body. The advantage of this kind of battle was that he would not be injured, but he could get experience that was close to the experience of actual battle.
"The battle has just begun, so don’t you think it’s a joke to talk about victory and defeat now?" Ling Han said calmly.
"You are destined to lose!" Jia Tailong shot over, and struck again with his sword.
Whether it was in terms of speed or power, he had the absolute upper hand.

Using a manifestation as his vehicle, the techniques channeled out were also unique to the vehicle. This had also been digitized. For example, the Great Emperor had a super ultimate move, which was extremely terrifying in might, but after using it, there would be a few seconds of weakness.
Because Ling Han was a clone of himself, he didn’t unleash any powerful attacks. Thus, he was clearly at a huge disadvantage.

A powerful move could instantly burst forth with ten times or even stronger battle prowess. As long as one could grasp the right moment to land a direct hit, he would be able to immediately end the battle.
However, Ling Han was completely unconcerned.
He was only using his own abilities. This was the true path of the greatest strength.
Boom!

Jia Tailong brandished his sword in a slash. This was the Descending Heaven Holy Emperor’s sword technique. However, because it was only an imitation, and not the true Imperial Technique of the Holy Emperor, its might had been forcefully magnified to the level that it should have been.
In any case, this was all a simulation, so the authenticity of it was completely unimportant.

Ling Han was experiencing great difficulty. What he was simulating was his weakened self. In terms of power, speed, and celestial techniques, he was at too much of a disadvantage. However, he was only adapting on the spot, unleashing his battle prowess to the extreme.
—No matter how perfect the data was, that was only theoretical. To truly convert this quantified power and speed into battle prowess, it still required one’s own control.
Could Jia Tailong compare to Ling Han?
Thus, a shocking scene appeared. Ling Han managed to turn the tables with great difficulty, and gradually gained the upper hand.
At the beginning, the others were all focused on their own battles, but there would always be those who glimpsed the battles on this side, and then they would be stunned.
One, two, three, more and more people stopped, watching in disbelief.
Heavens!
Someone had actually used such a crappy vehicle to contend against a Great Emperor-level vehicle?
Just look, which of them hadn’t chosen a Great Emperor? If they were slightly weaker, they would have chosen the Saint. In fact, no one had even chosen the Saint who was only a slight bit weaker.
However, this Zhang Hanjun actually chose to... imitate himself!
Hiss, what kind of powerful confidence was this?
And in truth, this really wasn’t arrogance, but true strength.

Jia Tailong unleashed a powerful attack, yet Ling Han managed to narrowly dodge it. Moreover, after unleashing his powerful attack, Jia Tailong had a short period of weakness. Ling Han seized this opportunity to deal with him in a few moves.
At this point, the battle had ended.
Everyone was in an uproar. In this kind of battle, everyone’s power and speed was limited. The might of the celestial technique was also the same. Weaknesses and advantages were very obvious.
Theoretically speaking, under the condition that all kinds of numerical values were suppressed, it was absolutely impossible to turn the tables.
However, Ling Han had succeeded.
This guy... was too terrifying.
Ling Han, meanwhile, was unconcerned. He had not defeated the Great Emperor in his youth, but merely a bunch of numbers.
What was this?
Of course, if he went all out, he believed that even the young Great Emperor would not be a match for him.
"Don’t be arrogant, I’ll fight you!" Another "Great Emperor" charged over.
It was Ji Liren.
He chose the White Feather Holy Emperor. With a shake of his arms, countless white feathers shot over, turning into divine light.
This battle prowess had shockingly reached the Spirit Transformation Tier.
Ling Han understood. This would be adjusted according to the cultivation level of both sides, and would be based on the weaker cultivation level.

Previously, Jia Tailong’s cultivation level was "one" level weaker than his, so they used the True Self Tier as a base for their battle. Now, he and Ji Liren were "both" Spirit Transformation Tier, so the level of their battle had increased by another level.
Ling Han was still fighting with great difficulty, but through seizing opportunities time and time again, he was still slowly gaining the upper hand, and finally defeated his opponent.
This stunned everyone. Winning two battles in a row, this was very convincing.
No one challenged Ling Han again. This was simply seeking their own suffering.
Half a day later, the battles ended, and everyone felt appreciation. After leaving the white jade wall, they discussed their insights from the battles.

And Ling Han became the focal point. A great many people had gathered around him, asking him for guidance on battle techniques. Even that Sect Master, though he could not bring himself to lower himself to their level, had still come closer, pricking up his ears to listen.
Ling Han didn’t hold anything back, and frankly revealed his appreciation.
However, this was the experience that he had tempered through countless battles, so how could it be grasped just by saying it?
It sounded very logical to others, but to practice it in actual battle was an absolutely impossible feat.
Thus, they could only feel rueful. As it turned out, there really were prodigies of battle in this world, who were naturally born for battle.
Subsequently, this kind of simulated battle would take place every few days.
The more Ling Han fought, the fiercer he became, confirming his position as invincible in the simulation battles.
And just like that, three months later, Guo Shuang appeared once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 4683: Three Choices
paragraphs: "Your performance has indeed exceeded my expectations," Guo Shuang said, a hint of admiration in her eyes.
She already knew that during the simulation battle, Ling Han hadn’t chosen to use the Great Emperor or Saint as his vehicle. Instead, he had directly imitated himself.
Fighting against the manifestation of the Great Emperor alone required courage.
Of course, it was not that there had never been such people in history. However, reality had proven that these people were all overconfident, and they all ended up in defeat.
Thus, people like Ling Han, who had both incomparable confidence and powerful natural talent in cultivation, were really too rare.
Ling Han smiled, "I am someone that is destined to become a Great Emperor."

These words were too airy. Guo Shuang couldn’t help but laugh. How could this young man possibly know that this era was welcoming a golden age when hundreds of flowers bloomed at the same time? The ancient Imperial Sons had all appeared at this time, and there was also Ling Han, Ding Shu, and other super freakish newcomers.
To become Emperor in this era, luck was actually more important.

In the case of the person in front of her, whether his natural talent was strong or not was set aside for the moment. However, his cultivation level was advancing too slowly, and luck was not on his side.
"To reward you, I can give you three options. You can choose one," Guo Shuangliang said. "First, I’ll teach you the Six Characters Bright King Curse!"
Peng, Ling Han’s heart couldn’t help but beat in excitement. He really, really wanted to learn.
This was a spirit-type Imperial Technique. Though he had only learnt the "An" character, its might was really out of the ordinary.
If he could learn all of them... that would naturally be great.
However, he did not immediately answer, and was very calm.
What were the remaining two options?
"Secondly, I can send you into the Pool of Life to cultivate for three days," Guo Shuang continued.
"This Pond of Life is nothing like the ones you entered before. Instead, it’s the real Pond of Life that was personally built by the Ancestral Buddha."
"Entering it to temper your physical body can allow you to undergo a complete transformation."
"Though your natural talent in battle is extraordinary, your aptitude is still a little lacking. Through the Pond of Life, it can help you compensate for this weakness."
In this instant, Ling Han was elated.
Pond of Life!
He had waited long enough.

"However, the second option won’t cause an obvious change in your cultivation level. It’ll only strengthen your foundations, and the benefits will only be displayed in the future," Guo Shuang continued.
Ling Han nodded. He was still very calm, and did not speak, though there was no need to consider this at all.
"Thirdly, I can teach you the Kasyapa Dhara Scroll. This is a Saint-level cultivation technique, and using it to cultivate, your advancement will be astonishingly fast," Guo Shuang continued.

There were three options. The Imperial Technique directly increased battle prowess, and the Six Characters Bright King Curse could clear one’s heart and suppress one’s internal demon. It was definitely not just an ordinary Imperial Technique. In the case of the Pond of Life, one could get a rebirth, and the Saint Technique would allow the advancement of one’s cultivation level to soar.
If it was someone else who had to choose, it would definitely be difficult.
Every single one of them was very useful to him, so how should he choose?
However, Ling Han didn’t need to hesitate at all. He only pondered for a moment before saying, "I choose the second option."

Guo Shuang couldn’t help but nod in approval, saying, "Imperial Technique and Saint-level cultivation technique... you’ll have the chance to obtain them again in the future. However, the earlier one can temper one’s physique, the better it is. Once one misses the opportunity to strengthen their foundations, it’ll be extremely difficult to compensate for their shortcomings in the future. Moreover, the price they’ll have to pay will also be far greater."
"I gave you three options, which is also a test for you. You have passed again."
Er, was this considered a coincidence?

If Ling Han weren’t going to ignite the holy flame, he would have chosen the Six Characters Bright King Curse. This was because he was already freakishly talented, so the Pond of Life’s tempering effects would definitely be ineffective on him. As for Saint-level cultivation technique... wasn’t this a joke?
He himself already possessed battle prowess that could defeat 99% of Saints, so what need was there for him to use a Saint-level cultivation technique?
"Take a bath and fast for three days. I’ll have someone bring you to the Pond of Life," Guo Shuang said. She then turned around to leave.
Ling Han was certain that this must be the personal disciple of Ah Han. Otherwise, even if she was a Saint, how could she possibly possess such great authority, and make major decisions?
It was said that the Buddhist Race also had a personal disciple of the Great Emperor called Shi Gang. This should be the earliest Buddha Son, right?
Ling Han sat down quietly to calm his emotions.
He could finally enter the Pond of Life.
The position of Saint was finally right in front of his eyes.
He was a little excited.
He had indeed taken a bath and fasted. He had done so much foreplay, so how could he fall on the last stage?
Three days later, a young monk came over and brought him to the Pond of Life.
After going through so many twists and turns, they finally arrived at an extremely large temple. Then, the little monk left, and it was an old monk who continued to lead him.
This old monk... was a Saint!
Though his aura was not apparent, and even his back was stooped, looking old and decrepit, just a sliver of aura that would occasionally seep out was incredibly terrifying.
This was a nine-star Saint.
Ling Han thought. It was possible that he was only a sliver away from becoming a Pseudo-Emperor.
However, even though it was only a sliver, 99% of Saints would never be able to touch it.
Moreover, throughout history, how many Saints had managed to become nine-star Saints?
The old monk took a few steps with Ling Han, and immediately began to pant.
"Old man, why don’t you take a rest first?" Ling Han said. Meanwhile, he grumbled in his mind. ’You’re a nine-star Saint, so why are you acting so tired?’
The old monk nodded at him, and really sat on the ground. Then, he said, "In this day and age, there are not many young people that have patience like you."
Ling Han smiled and said, "Respecting the elderly and caring for the young is a traditional virtue."
The old monk nodded, and closed his eyes to rest.
Ten minutes, half an hour, three hours!
The old monk seemed to have turned into stone, and actually did not open his eyes again.
Ling Han did not rush him either. He too sat at the sidelines, and waited quietly.
After a whole seven days, the old monk suddenly opened his eyes, and said, "Aiyo, I accidentally fell asleep."
"It’s fine," Ling Han said with a smile. His expression was calm, and there was no hint of impatience.
This was clearly another test.
Sigh, the people of the Buddhist Race were really petty, and not the slightest bit straightforward.

The old monk stood up and continued forward. However, after taking a few steps, he started to pant again. This time, he didn’t wait for Ling Han to speak before immediately sitting down again and continuing to rest with his eyes closed.
Ling Han smiled, and similarly sat with the other, still having no intention to rush him.

This happened again and again. The old monk would sit down to rest at the drop of a hat, and the time was indefinite. Sometimes, it would only be three minutes, and sometimes, it would be half a month, but no matter how much the old monk sat down at the drop of a hat, Ling Han did not rush him at all.
Just like that, half a year passed in the blink of an eye.
The old monk finally smiled, and said, "Young man, you are not too bad."
Ling Han also smiled, though he was muttering internally, ’If it was not for the Pond of Life, you would have long since been beaten to death, all right?’
The old monk didn’t rest any longer. He brought Ling Han to a Buddha statue, then pointed at it. The Buddha statue immediately turned around, revealing a secret passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 4684: Pond of Life!
paragraphs: This was their home base, so what need was there to set up a secret passage?
Just how dark is your mentality?
Ling Han mocked internally. He believed that Ah Han definitely couldn’t be so petty. As a dignified Great Emperor, what need was there for him to fear that someone would sneak into the Pond of Life?
Thus, this must have been set up by someone in the later generations.
He followed the old monk into the secret passage, and went all the way downwards. After a very, very long time, the path ahead of him suddenly opened up, revealing an ocean.
This was... the Pond of Life!
Because the power of will of all living beings was too colossal, the energy essence formed actually turned into a boundless ocean.
Impressive.
Just how terrifying was this?
In this world, only the Buddhist Race had such a background. As for the others, even the Chang Clan could not compare.
—In terms of wealth, the Chang Clan was definitely number one, but in terms of the power of faith of all living beings, the Buddhist Race was definitely the strongest.
"Go on," the old monk said. After saying this, he turned around and left.

To say nothing of the fact that this "Spirit Devouring Physique" had already reached the upper limit of his cultivation level, even if he hadn’t, starting from zero, he would only be able to absorb a drop of the colossal power of will from all living beings, at most.
However, he would soon know that he had been wrong, and just how overwhelmingly wrong he had been.
Ling Han rubbed his hands together, looking excited.
He could feel that the Seed of the Holy Flame in his mind was also throbbing, as if it could no longer hold itself back.
"Alright, I’ll satisfy you."
Ling Han leaped up, and flew towards the depths of the great ocean.
He still suppressed his cultivation level, but even a Spirit Transformation Tier was fast enough. Thus, he stopped after a few steps, and then dove into the sea, heading downwards.
Boom, endless energy surged out, pure and vast.
Come on then!
Ling Han did not refuse any of it, and began to absorb madly.
There were only three days, so could the Seed of the Holy Flame be completely "matured" in that amount of time?

Boom! Endless energy surged into Ling Han’s body and was then absorbed by the Seed of the Holy Flame, and in this process, Ling Han actually didn’t do anything. He only acted as a bridge, pulling the strings between the two of them.
He released his restraints, and absorbed with all his might.
A terrifying scene appeared. Visibly, the water level of this great ocean was actually declining!

It should be known that this great ocean was completely formed from energy essence. The decline in the water level was actually the consumption of the energy essence, and in such a wide ocean, the decline in the water level was actually so obvious, which showed how terrifying Ling Han’s swallowing ability was.
And in his mind, the Seed of the Holy Flame was currently throbbing, ready to "sprout" or "burn" at any time.
Ling Han didn’t know what would happen, but he believed that once any changes took place, he would definitely be able to ignite the holy flame.
He already had enough Regulations, and was only lacking a little bit of energy.
’Light it up, my holy flame!’
Hong long long, the great ocean howled, forming an endless whirlpool, and the water level was still rapidly receding. The commotion was overwhelmingly great.

This was the Sacred Land, the core area of the Buddhist Race. One could only enter through the Great Emperor Formation, and there was also an old Saint standing guard outside. It could be said that this was one of the safest places in the world.
Who would have thought that an accident would happen here?
Thus, when the water level of the sea had fallen by half, someone finally rushed over. There was not just one, and they were all Saints.
"What’s going on?"
"Why is the Pond of Life’s energy being expended so heavily?"
"Has some great change happened?"

They were stunned, but the energy of the Pond of Life was too colossal. It had turned into a dense mist that rose, greatly affecting the divine sense of the Saints, so they were unable to immediately discover that it was Ling Han who was absorbing the energy.
"Hurry up and check if anyone has entered the Pond of Life recently."
In just an instant, the answer was revealed.
"Zhang Hanjun?"
"Spirit Devouring Physique?"𝘧𝓇𝑒𝑒𝑤ℯ𝑏𝓃𝘰𝑣ℯ𝘭.𝘤ℴ𝘮
"Even if it’s the Spirit Devouring Physique, after reaching the peak stage of the True Self Tier, it’ll be the end."
"Moreover, even if he starts from the beginning, how cana Spirit Devouring Physique absorb one-ten-thousandth of the energy essence?!"
All the Saints were confused. This was completely inexplicable.
Right at this moment, the old monk also appeared.
"Greetings, Buddha Three Miseries!" When they saw the old monk, the other Saints all paid their respects.
This was a nine-star Saint, a supreme elite that could advance into Pseudo-Emperor at any time.

The old monk nodded. He too looked surprised. Just now, he had gone out for a while, so he had come back a little later. However, he was sure that the only person in the Pond of Life now was Zhang Hanjun.
How could a measly Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator create such a commotion?
"How could it be!" He couldn’t help but let out a hiss, "Buddha Doga is here!"
Only this great elite knew the Buddhist Race like the back of his hand, and that was why he was able to tread on the Great Emperor formation as if it was flat land, without making a sound.
And it was naturally nothing strange for a Pseudo-Emperor to move and absorb a great amount of the Pond of Life’s energy.
Hearing the words ’Buddha Doga’, the Saints all inhaled sharply.
The Imperial Clan didn’t produce a second Great Emperor. To say nothing of Great Emperors, they didn’t even produce Pseudo-Emperors. It was like a curse.
However, the Buddhist Race had once produced a Pseudo-Emperor, which became the only exception.

Of course, at that time, Buddha Doga and Buddha Ah Han had both become Pseudo-Emperors. However Buddha Ah Han had better luck, or had stronger natural talent, which was why he had advanced another step further, and become a true Great Emperor.
Hence, this kind of example was hard to replicate.
"The energy of the Pond of Life is still being expended!" a Saint shouted. The water level was declining far too quickly.
All the Saints were anxious. It should be known that now that the Netherworld was invading, and countless living beings had died, it would be difficult to harvest the power of belief in future.
—If it was not for the fact that this was the Buddhist decree of Ah Han, it was guaranteed that all these Saints would rebel. Wouldn’t that be destroying their own foundations?
Thus, when they saw the Pond of Life being greatly expended, all the Saints were naturally anxious.
"Hurry up and check out the situation. What on earth is going on?"
All the Saints moved out. Even if it was really Buddha Doga that had come, they still had to fight. They couldn’t allow others to bully them, right?
Moreover, this was Buddhist Land, which had an Imperial Weapon and an Imperial Formation.
"Yi!"
With how fast Saints were, it was not long before they had searched through the Pond of Life, and then located Ling Han.
This!
They could not believe it at all. This was actually the source of everything!
A mere Spirit Transformation Tier cultivator was actually absorbing the energy essence at a terrifying speed.
It should be known that even if it was them doing this, their physical bodies would definitely be crushed by such a colossal amount of energy.

This was accumulated over countless billions of years. Though there had always been a large amount of expenditure, it could not hold up against the Buddhist Race’s continuous expansion of territory, and there was always more profit than expenditure.
As they saw it, this was a suicidal action, but the measly Spirit Transformation Tier below didn’t die, and was still absorbing energy.
"What kind of freak is this?!" a Saint exclaimed in astonishment.
"Could it be that, in this world, there are still mutated Spirit Devouring Physiques that can race madly all the way to the position of Great Emperor?" another Saint said.
It was impossible for Saints to absorb energy like this. It was simply courting death. Hence, if this "Spirit Devouring Physique" was not about to soar to become Emperor, how could it be explained?
"No matter what it is, we can’t allow him to continue absorbing like this!" the old monk said. "Pick him up!"
"Yes!" A Saint nodded, and moved to grab out at Ling Han.
Boom, the large hand spread open, like a mountain.

chapters.title: Chapter 4685: Identity revealed
paragraphs: Boom, the large hand grabbed out, like a monstrous demonic palm.
Ling Han opened his eyes. At this moment, he finally stopped suppressing his cultivation level, and a terrifying aura surged.
With a flick of his finger, a ray of light shot out, and this large hand immediately crumbled.
He was still lacking a bit before the Seed of the Holy Flame would be satiated.
Thus, he had to stay here for a while longer.
"What!" Seeing this scene, all the Saints were stunned.
What was going on here?
Though this Saint that had attacked was not a top-notch Saint, and was only a One Star Saint, wasn’t a Saint awesome enough?
"Fourth Extreme!"
"This guy has become a Venerate!"
"Hiss, there really is a mutated Spirit Devouring Physique, whose limits can actually break out of True Self Tier!"
"He broke through to Fourth Extreme so quickly!"
For a moment, these Saints did not doubt Ling Han’s identity. They only thought that his physique had mutated, and he could advance to a higher cultivation level.
"That’s not right!" A Saint immediately shook his head, "Even if his physique has mutated, the Pond of Life has already expended so much energy, yet he has only advanced to the Fourth Extreme?"
That’s right, this was too illogical.
The Buddha Three Miseries couldn’t help but humph, "Is now the time to consider these things?"
True!
Another Saint moved, grabbing out at Ling Han.
He similarly stretched out his hand to grab, but the might of this grab was much stronger. Eight-star Regulations were wrapped around his palm, and there were as many as four of them.
—For those of an Imperial Clan that could become Saints, they must have been Imperial Son or Buddha Son-level in the past. Their battle prowess was naturally terrifying.
Ling Han continued to absorb the energy as he flicked his finger.
Pu, without a doubt, this large hand shattered again.
So what if there were four eight-star Regulations? In front of Ling Han, they were completely insufficient.
Xiu, a figure appeared. It was a young man with an arrogant aura, his features well-defined.
"Buddha Son!" Including the Buddha Three Miseries, all the Saints paid their respects to this young man.
It was clear that this young man was only a six-star Saint.
He wasn’t the Buddha Son of this generation, but the personal disciple of Ah Han, the Buddha Son of the ancient times.
Shi Gang!
Shi Gang waved his hand, frowned, and asked, "What’s going on?"

Though at his height, the Pond of Life was already ineffective for him, and as long as these billions of years of planning succeeded, the Pond of Life would be even more meaningless, he was still very dissatisfied with the sudden change in circumstances.
It should be known that this was Buddhist Land!
"Zhang Hanjun, Spirit Devouring Physique?" He heard the other Saints briefly explain this to him, and a hint of doubt appeared on his face.

With his extensive knowledge, he naturally knew what the Spirit Devouring Physique was. However, what Spirit Devouring Physiquewas so terrifying that it directly absorbed more than half of the ocean-like energy of the Pond of Life?
Furthermore, there was no sign of it stopping at all.
"Stop him!" Shi Gang said. No matter what, he couldn’t allow Ling Han to absorb it without any reservations.
"As you command." A Five Star Saint moved, launching an attack at Ling Han.
Previously, Ling Han had easily penetrated the attacks of two Saints in a row. Thus, this time, it was the Five-Star Saint that had directly moved.
He only needed a bit more. Ling Han discovered that the Seed of the Holy Flame seemed to really have a life of its own, and was throbbing.
With a thought, he continued to extract energy as he battled with the five-star Saint.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
He controlled his abilities, yet he was still locked in an intense battle with the five-star Saint. It was hard to determine who was stronger between them.
In this way, he could buy time.
Even so, all the Saints were still incredibly stunned.
’F*ck! You’re merely at the Fourth Extreme, yet you’re actually able to block a Five-Star Saint?’
"It is the fortune of our race; we are about to produce a world-defying prodigy!" a Saint said in a trembling voice. His voice was filled with emotion.
If this kind of Venerate became a Saint, just how terrifying would his battle prowess be?
Xiu, another figure appeared. Her white skirts fluttered, as if she was a Celestial.
Guo Shuang.
"You were the one who brought him in?" Shi Gang immediately shouted at her, his voice slightly high, carrying an accusing tone.
Guo Shuang ignored him, and instead stared at Ling Han.
"I was talking to you!" Shi Gang shouted loudly, appearing extremely displeased.
However, Guo Shuangliang still ignored her. Instead, she took a deep breath, and said to Ling Han, "You’re not Zhang Hanjun, but Ling Han!"

Unlike the other Saints, who had been cultivating in seclusion in the Buddhist Land, she travelled the world, and knew all the major events that happened in the outside world like the back of her hand.
Throughout history, had there ever appeared a prodigy that could match a Saint when he was only at the Fourth Extreme himself?
There was none!
It was only recently that Ling Han appeared. He was freakish to the extreme. Not only could he match a Saint, he could even defeat a lower level Saint.
How could there be a second prodigy like him in this world?
Thus, this definitely wasn’t Zhang Hanjun, and his true identity had already been revealed.
Ling Han cracked a smile. Finally, there were smart people.
"That’s right. I am Ling Han." With a thought, he had already returned to his original appearance.
Ling Han!
All the Saints were stunned. They had indeed heard of Ling Han’s name. It was said that this boy was incredibly freakish, and when he was a Venerate, he could already match a Saint.
Regarding this kind of legend, they were all doubtful.
How was this possible?
But now that they had witnessed it with their own eyes, they finally knew that the rumors were not false. In fact, they had even underestimated Ling Han.
Being able to match a Five-Star Saint, he was completely capable of defeating all Saints below that level. He was extremely awesome.
Then, they flew into a thunderous rage.
This person actually dared to sneak into Buddhist Land alone and steal the energy essence of the Pond of Life. Just how outrageously bold was he?
Did he still take them seriously?
All of a sudden, all the Saints were filled with killing intent.

"You’re seeking death!" The killing intent of the Five-Star Saint was also boiling. Previously, he had only wanted to stop Ling Han, and had no intention of killing him. But now, his mindset had changed.
’Die!’
He used the Imperial Technique, and a Buddha Halo formed behind his head. His hands formed a seal, and then blasted towards Ling Han.
"Lion Seal!"
Boom, with the blessing of the power of belief, a total of thirteen eight-star Regulations surged, which was incredibly terrifying.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
In fact, he could even battle against some eight-star Saints!
Ling Han let out a battle cry, soared into the skies, and threw a punch.
Peng!
Endless light blossomed, and energy surged. Regulations turned into a shockwave, setting off layers of terrifying waves.
All the Saints were shocked, because in the clash of this blow, Ling Han actually did not fall into a disadvantage.
He had withstood this blow.
Heavens, what kind of freakish Fourth Extreme was this?

However, all the Saints smirked coldly. ’You have come alone, yet there are a great many Saints here. There are also ancient king tiers like Buddha Son and Holy Daughter, and even the Buddha Three Miseries is a nine-star Saint. How are you going to match that?’
Furthermore, there was still an imperial formation outside, so how could you possibly escape?
He was like a turtle in a jar.

"Ling Han, I have to admit that you are indeed outrageously bold." Shi Gang nodded. He did not continue to argue with Guo Shuang, "However, you are too arrogant. You actually dare to barge into the Buddhist Land. This is an act of courting death."
"Oh?" Ling Han battled fiercely with that Five Star Saint. Though both sides were more or less equal in terms of power and Regulations, he was clearly stronger.
That was because in terms of power, and the use of Regulations, he was more proficient. Spending 10% of strength could achieve 20% of success, so how could he not be strong?
He was at ease, and could even argue with Shi Gang in the midst of battle.
