He used the Imperial Technique, and a Buddha Halo formed behind his head.
His hands formed a seal, and then blasted towards Ling Han.
"Lion Seal!"
Boom, with the blessing of the power of belief, a total of thirteen eight-star Regulations surged, which was incredibly terrifying.𝗳𝗿𝐞𝕖𝘄𝗲𝕓𝗻𝚘𝚟𝕖𝐥.𝚌𝕠𝕞
In fact, he could even battle against some eight-star Saints!
Ling Han let out a battle cry, soared into the skies, and threw a punch.
Peng!
Endless light blossomed, and energy surged.
Regulations turned into a shockwave, setting off layers of terrifying waves.
All the Saints were shocked, because in the clash of this blow, Ling Han actually did not fall into a disadvantage.
He had withstood this blow.
Heavens, what kind of freakish Fourth Extreme was this?
However, all the Saints smirked coldly. ’You have come alone, yet there are a great many Saints here.
There are also ancient king tiers like Buddha Son and Holy Daughter, and even the Buddha Three Miseries is a nine-star Saint.
How are you going to match that?’
Furthermore, there was still an imperial formation outside, so how could you possibly escape?
He was like a turtle in a jar.
"Ling Han, I have to admit that you are indeed outrageously bold." Shi Gang nodded.
He did not continue to argue with Guo Shuang, "However, you are too arrogant.
You actually dare to barge into the Buddhist Land.
This is an act of courting death."
"Oh?" Ling Han battled fiercely with that Five Star Saint.
Though both sides were more or less equal in terms of power and Regulations, he was clearly stronger.
That was because in terms of power, and the use of Regulations, he was more proficient.
Spending 10% of strength could achieve 20% of success, so how could he not be strong?
He was at ease, and could even argue with Shi Gang in the midst of battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 4686: Fighting
paragraphs: "I’m right here. Come and beat me to death," Ling Han provoked.
In this aspect, he was indeed very talented. Of course, the large black dog was also an absolutely good teacher and friend in this aspect.
Shi Gang sneered, "There is no need for me to move. Since you have already come here, you still want to leave alive? The consequence of being outrageously bold would be a tragic end!"
Ling Han shook his head, "Do you only know how to shoot your mouth off?"
"Kill him!" Shi Gang said coldly. He still disdained from making a move. As the first generation Buddha Son, he was naturally very proud.
"As you decree!" The Five-Star Saint nodded, and once again increased his battle prowess, launching a mad barrage of attacks at Ling Han.
Ling Han casually parried, appearing to be completely unconcerned. In truth, a massive change was presently brewing in his mind.
The Seed of the Holy Flame had already absorbed enough energy and entered a temporary hibernation state. Once it exploded, the transformation would be extremely terrifying.
The holy flame would be ignited!
Thus, he wasn’t going all out to battle now. Instead, he was studying how to end this hibernating state as soon as possible.
After all, this was Buddhist Land, where there was an ancient Great Emperor.
Even if Ling Han became a Saint, he could only retreat in the face of a Great Emperor.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The attacks of the five-star Saint became increasingly fierce. This was a battle between a Saint and a Venerate, yet he was actually unable to end the battle even after so long. This was a great humiliation to him.
Thus, he definitely had to get rid of Ling Han as soon as possible.

However, Ling Han had long since walked out on his own path. Furthermore, previously, he had suppressed his cultivation level in battle, so his use of power had improved further, and became truly and extremely meticulous in his use of power.
Thus, even if his power was actually inferior to that Five Star Saint, he was not the slightest bit inferior in this situation.
The longer this battle continued, the uglier Shi Gang’s expression became.
How humiliating!
This was the Buddhist Land. Years ago, Ah Han’s Buddhist might had suppressed the world. Many forces had come deliberately to pay their respects, and which one of them was not incredibly reverent?
Now, however, a measly Fourth Extreme was allowed to act so wantonly here!
"Could it be that I really have to move personally?" he asked in displeasure.
The Five-Star Saint’s face flushed red.

He also felt humiliated. However, though Ling Han was at the Fourth Extreme, 99 Seven Star Regulations were entwined around him as he launched his attack. He was extraordinarily powerful, and he was completely capable of matching him. Even if he was boosted by the power of belief, he would only be able to fight him to a tie.
"Die!" he roared. He swung his saber again. Boom! The holy flame blazed.
He was forced into desperate straits, and even used the holy flame.

It should be known that the holy flame was the foundation of a Saint. Every time it was used, it would decrease, and once the holy flame was completely exhausted, the cultivation level of the Saint would drop drastically. In future, if he wanted to light up the holy flame again, it was practically impossible for him to return to Saint Tier.
But now, he was really desperate to take Ling Han down, so he had no choice but to use the holy flame.
Of course, it was definite that an amount of the holy flame would be exhausted, but it was impossible that it would be completely exhausted. After all, it was only a single battle.
Now that he had used the holy flame, the situation was completely different.
The might of the holy flame was too terrifying, and its destructive power was incomparably powerful. If one wanted to resist, they could only use their own holy flame to counter.
But where would Ling Han get the holy flame from?
Thus, he could only continuously dodge. Using Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, he was still unafraid.
One round, two rounds, and another hundred moves had passed.
Peng!
Ling Han flew upwards. Since his identity had already been exposed, there was naturally no need for him to have any more reservations. He directly shot out from the ground.
All of a sudden, the entire Buddhist Land rumbled and shook.

This was Saint-level battle prowess, and if it was not for the fact that the Buddhist Land was continuously strengthened by the divine power of the Great Emperor, a single strike would be enough to make the entire Buddhist Land crumble.
What was going on?
The people on the surface were completely unaware of the situation, appearing extremely dumbfounded.
Had a battle taken place?
How was this possible?
This was Buddhist Land, and furthermore, it was the Sacred Land at that. Who would dare to be insolent here?
Even the ascetic monks that were cultivating in seclusion in the Buddhist Hall ran out, and raised their heads to look at the skies, revealing expressions of shock.
That was because there really was someone fighting.
"Who would be so outrageously bold to dare make a move in the Sacred Land?"
"Hiss, that’s the Smiling Buddha!"
"What, Smiling Buddha who is a Five Star Saint?"
Everyone was astounded. A Five-Star Saint had moved, and he was actually still unable to obtain victory in the battle?
Who was this opponent?
"So young!" a Venerate exclaimed.
"Heavens, I know who this person is!"
"Ling Han!"𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
When this name was spoken, it instantly stunned a great many people into dumbfounded shock.
Ling Han was publicly acknowledged as the number one prodigy. If it wasn’t for the fact that his cultivation level was a little low, he would also be the best candidate for becoming Emperor!
"This guy actually dares to come to our Buddhist Race?"
"Humph, does he really think that just because he’s a prodigious freak, he can do as he pleases?"
"We are an Imperial Clan!"
"Furthermore, our Ancestral Buddha is still alive!"
After the shock, everyone was furious. This Ling Han was really too condescending.
"Yi, how did he sneak in?"
That’s right, everyone was curious again.
It should be known that the Sacred Land was protected by the Great Emperor Formation, and he still managed to barge in?
Have you become a Pseudo-Emperor?
—Even if it was a Pseudo-Emperor, could he really force his way through the Great Emperor formation?
A Saint heard this, and did not want everyone to beautify or exaggerate Ling Han’s strength. Immediately, he revealed the truth.
Oh, everyone finally understood. As it turned out, Ling Han had disguised himself and snuck in quietly.
Others would only admire Ling Han’s courage, but those like Ji Liren and Jia Tailong were directly scared silly.
As it turned out, the person who had been with them all these days was Ling Han.
That strongest prodigy of all eternity?
Heavens, they had actually not been killed.
Thinking about it, they were also a little excited. To actually be able to exchange blows with the strongest prodigy of all eternity, they could brag about it for a few years in future.
They looked at Ling Han, whose battle prowess was fully unleashed. As his flaming wings flapped, his speed was extraordinarily fast. Even the Saint could not catch up to him.
However, no matter how hard Ling Han struggled, he could only circle around within the limited range of the Sacred Land, and could not go out.
Because they had the Great Emperor Formation, even Saints would only die if they barged in forcefully, what more when it was a Fourth Extreme.
"You’re like a turtle trapped in a jar. What need is there for you to stubbornly resist?" Shi Gang asked coldly, a strong displeasure in his expression.
It had been so long, yet he was still unable to capture Ling Han. This was humiliating to him, a leader of the Buddhist Race.

Meanwhile, Guo Shuang was curious. She only knew that Ling Han was freakish, but if she had not seen it with her own eyes, she really could not imagine that Ling Han was actually capable of contending against a Saint, and one that was not a low-level Saint either.
However, why had the other party gone to so much effort to enter into the Sacred Land?
She could guess that Ling Han was definitely doing this for the Pond of Life, but what was his purpose for entering the Pond of Life?
Now, two thirds of the energy in the Pond of Life had been directly consumed, which showed how much energy Ling Han had absorbed. The question was, what use did he have for this?

For a peak stage Venerate like Ling Han, the tempering effects of the Pond of Life was already meaningless. Moreover, it would not help him to light up the holy flame, because this was the converted power of belief.
Thus, she was extremely curious, but could not figure it out no matter what.
"Is there something between you and him that can’t be revealed?" Shi Gang suddenly targeted Guo Shuang and asked through divine sense.

chapters.title: Chapter 4687: Battling a nine-star Saint
paragraphs: Guo Shuang ignored him completely.
"I hit the nail on the head, so you’re speechless?" Shi Gang gritted his teeth, "Don’t forget, our betrothal was approved by the Ancestral Buddha!"
Guo Shuang looked at him coldly, her heart filled with utter disdain.

Speaking of natural talent in martial arts, this Shi Gang was indeed very talented, and was the top prodigy of his generation. Otherwise, he would not have been qualified to be taken as disciple by Buddha Ah Han. However, in terms of magnanimity, this person was too narrow-minded. Thus, she had chosen to have the Ancestral Buddha seal herself in advance because she did not want to take another look at this guy.
But destiny... sigh!
Right at this moment, Ling Han suddenly revealed a smile.
The Seed of the Holy Flame finally ended its hibernation state and underwent a change.
Fine, there was no need for him to waste any more time.
Ling Han stretched out a hand and pressed down. The four pinnacle pillars appeared, and trapped the five-star Saint within.
"Using the four pinnacle pillars to create a cage?" The five-star Saint sneered, "Do you think I’m a Venerate?"
This was too funny. The four pinnacle pillars could indeed trap people, but would they be effective against Saints?
’Fine, I’ll shatter your pinnacle pillars. Let’s see how you can continue to be a prodigy!’
The five-star Saint condensed the holy flame and shot it toward one of the pillars.
Peng!
His palm struck the pinnalce pillar, and a scene that stunned him appeared. With this palm strike, the four pinnacle pillars were all glowing, but they did not shatter in the slightest.
What!

The Five-Star Saint was so stunned that his scalp was slightly numb. It was one thing for Ling Han to possess a battle prowess that could match him, but even the four pinnacle pillars were so awesome... how could he accept this?
"Freeze!" Ling Han said. Weng, the seals on each four pinnacle pillars lit up.
The Five-Star Saint was stunned to discover that he was actually unable to move.
How was this possible?
A dignified Saint was actually trapped by the four pinnacle pillars? Who would believe this?
Others would probably be laughing their heads off.
Seeing this scene, everyone’s eyes widened, and their minds went blank.
This!
Were they dreaming?
Ling Han threw another punch. Peng! The five-star Saint was sent flying, blood spraying through the air.
He smiled faintly, and looked towards Shi Gang, "Are you prepared to be beaten by me?"
Shi Gang’s expression was dark. This was practically a slap to his face.
"Three Miseries, deal with this guy!" he spat out word by word, his killing intent overflowing.
"As you decree!" Buddha Three Miseries recited a Buddhist proclamation. With a single step, he had already arrived in midair, standing face to face with Ling Han.
"Young man, you had best surrender yourself," he said calmly. As a nine-star Saint, he naturally had the pride of a nine-star Saint.

All this while, there had been no Emperor in the world. The nine-star Saint was the absolute overlord, the strongest existence in the world. Naturally, his every word and action would be filled with arrogance.
Ling Han broke into a grin, and put away the four pinnacle pillars. Faced with a nine-star Saint, he did not dare to be careless.

It was extremely likely that his opponent’s battle prowess had surpassed the limit of the four pinnacle pillars. If he really destroyed the four pinnacle pillars, he would definitely cry himself to death.
"Nine-star Saint?" Ling Han murmured. "Come, I want to see how strong you are."
"Young man, you are too arrogant!" Buddha Three Miseries snorted, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.

This palm strike was clearly light and nonchalant, without the slightest bit of anger, but its might was terrifying without bounds. The whole heaven and earth was responding, and tens of thousands of Dao were illuminated by auspicious red clouds. Buddhist lotuses bloomed everywhere.
When a Saint absorbed Regulations, they could be viewed as the embodiment of heaven and earth, and the Nine-Star Saint had reached the pinnacle.
Amidst the myriad of auspicious clouds, a large hand suddenly swatted out. Its fingers were slender, and its skin was snow-white and lustrous, like fine jade.
However, there were eighteen eight-star Regulations entwined around this large hand.
Eighteen flashes!
Sure enough, those who could become nine-star Saints were definitely prodigies among prodigies.
And this was still because the Buddha Three Miseries hadn’t used the power of belief. Otherwise, his battle prowess would have increased a few more levels.
Ling Han didn’t take it head-on—he wouldn’t be a match if he took it head-on. He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his figure flew through the air at an indescribably fast speed.
"Humph!" Buddha Three Miseries advanced. Though the Sacred Land was not small, it was not big for a Saint. With such a small place, where could you hide?
He began to seal off the space with Regulations, compressing the area that Ling Han could move in.

This was something that only he could do. That was because the strength of the five-star Saint from before was not stronger than Ling Han, so Ling Han was completely capable of breaking through his blockade by force.

However, in the hands of Buddha Three Miseries, the number of Regulations that were used as a seal had reached as many as eighteen, and they were definitely not something that Ling Han could easily destroy.
And with the Saint’s speed, as long as Ling Han was unable to succeed with a single blow, he would be caught up to. If he did not parry, he would die!
Thus, under the control of the Buddha Three Miseries, Ling Han’s range of activity began to shrink bit by bit.
Beneath them, whether it was Saints or others, they all smirked coldly.
Ling Han’s fate had already been decided.
This was the consequence of provoking the Buddhist Race. He would die to atone for his crime.
However, everyone couldn’t help but admire Ling Han’s strength, because he was only at the Fourth Extreme.
"As expected of the strongest Fourth Extreme in history."
"It’s a shame that he’s going to die in the end."
"Humph, who asked him to be so outrageously bold? He actually dared to come to our Buddhist Race!"
Shi Gang also smirked coldly. His natural talent in cultivation was extremely high, but he was too narrow-minded, and could not allow anyone’s natural talent to be superior to his.
And now, this publicly acknowledged number one prodigy of all eternity was finally about to disappear.
Very good!
Ling Han’s space of movement became smaller and smaller, but he wasn’t nervous at all.
In his mind, the Seed of the Holy Flame had completely combusted, and his four pinnacle pillars had also automatically fused together, turning into a pillar that connected to the heavens.
The Seed of the Holy Flame was at the top of this pillar. After burning to a certain extent, the four pinnacle pillars were also ignited.
Boom!
An astonishing wave instantly surged out of Ling Han’s body, spreading out in all directions.
"W-what?!"
All of a sudden, everyone was stunned.
"This is the fluctuation of the holy flame!"
"This guy is actually going to break through during battle, and advance into Saint Tier!"
"Impossible!"

"How important is breaking through to Saint Tier? One would need to be extremely cautious. It would not be strange for one to cultivate in seclusion for a few thousand years, so how could one possibly break through in battle?"
No one believed that Ling Han could break through. This was too exaggerated. Breaking through in battle was really too much of a joke!
"I know now. This guy is in desperate straits, and has no choice but to take a gamble."
"En, that must be the case!"
"Though it is definitely impossible for this guy to succeed, but to avoid any further delays, we had best dispose of him as soon as possible."
"That’s right."
Everyone nodded. Though they definitely did not believe that Ling Han could break through during battle, this guy was too freakish. Everyone was afraid of what if.
Buddha Three Miseries no longer hesitated. He chanted a Buddhist chant, and when he delivered another palm strike, boom, there were shockingly 22 eight-star Regulations wrapped around him.

"An, ma, ne, ba, mi, mo!" In the heaven and earth, the Buddhist lotuses bloomed everywhere, and there was also the chanting of the Six Characters Bright King Curse. Each character took form, and charged towards Ling Han.
Boom! This palm strike locked down Ling Han’s escape route.

If he really destroyed the four pinnacle pillars, he would definitely cry himself to death.
"Nine-star Saint?" Ling Han murmured.
"Come, I want to see how strong you are."
"Young man, you are too arrogant!" Buddha Three Miseries snorted, and delivered a palm strike towards Ling Han.
This palm strike was clearly light and nonchalant, without the slightest bit of anger, but its might was terrifying without bounds.
The whole heaven and earth was responding, and tens of thousands of Dao were illuminated by auspicious red clouds.
Buddhist lotuses bloomed everywhere.
When a Saint absorbed Regulations, they could be viewed as the embodiment of heaven and earth, and the Nine-Star Saint had reached the pinnacle.
Amidst the myriad of auspicious clouds, a large hand suddenly swatted out.
Its fingers were slender, and its skin was snow-white and lustrous, like fine jade.
However, there were eighteen eight-star Regulations entwined around this large hand.
Eighteen flashes!
Sure enough, those who could become nine-star Saints were definitely prodigies among prodigies.
And this was still because the Buddha Three Miseries hadn’t used the power of belief.
Otherwise, his battle prowess would have increased a few more levels.
Ling Han didn’t take it head-on—he wouldn’t be a match if he took it head-on.
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and his figure flew through the air at an indescribably fast speed.
"Humph!" Buddha Three Miseries advanced.
Though the Sacred Land was not small, it was not big for a Saint.
With such a small place, where could you hide?
He began to seal off the space with Regulations, compressing the area that Ling Han could move in.
This was something that only he could do.
That was because the strength of the five-star Saint from before was not stronger than Ling Han, so Ling Han was completely capable of breaking through his blockade by force.

However, in the hands of Buddha Three Miseries, the number of Regulations that were used as a seal had reached as many as eighteen, and they were definitely not something that Ling Han could easily destroy.
And with the Saint’s speed, as long as Ling Han was unable to succeed with a single blow, he would be caught up to.
If he did not parry, he would die!
Thus, under the control of the Buddha Three Miseries, Ling Han’s range of activity began to shrink bit by bit.
Beneath them, whether it was Saints or others, they all smirked coldly.
Ling Han’s fate had already been decided.
This was the consequence of provoking the Buddhist Race.
He would die to atone for his crime.
However, everyone couldn’t help but admire Ling Han’s strength, because he was only at the Fourth Extreme.
"As expected of the strongest Fourth Extreme in history."
"It’s a shame that he’s going to die in the end."
"Humph, who asked him to be so outrageously bold?
He actually dared to come to our Buddhist Race!"
Shi Gang also smirked coldly.
His natural talent in cultivation was extremely high, but he was too narrow-minded, and could not allow anyone’s natural talent to be superior to his.
And now, this publicly acknowledged number one prodigy of all eternity was finally about to disappear.
Very good!
Ling Han’s space of movement became smaller and smaller, but he wasn’t nervous at all.
In his mind, the Seed of the Holy Flame had completely combusted, and his four pinnacle pillars had also automatically fused together, turning into a pillar that connected to the heavens.
The Seed of the Holy Flame was at the top of this pillar.
After burning to a certain extent, the four pinnacle pillars were also ignited.
Boom!
An astonishing wave instantly surged out of Ling Han’s body, spreading out in all directions.
"W-what?!"
All of a sudden, everyone was stunned.
"This is the fluctuation of the holy flame!"
"This guy is actually going to break through during battle, and advance into Saint Tier!"
"Impossible!"
"How important is breaking through to Saint Tier?
One would need to be extremely cautious.
It would not be strange for one to cultivate in seclusion for a few thousand years, so how could one possibly break through in battle?"
No one believed that Ling Han could break through.
This was too exaggerated.
Breaking through in battle was really too much of a joke!
"I know now.
This guy is in desperate straits, and has no choice but to take a gamble."
"En, that must be the case!"
"Though it is definitely impossible for this guy to succeed, but to avoid any further delays, we had best dispose of him as soon as possible."
"That’s right."
Everyone nodded.
Though they definitely did not believe that Ling Han could break through during battle, this guy was too freakish.
Everyone was afraid of what if.
Buddha Three Miseries no longer hesitated.
He chanted a Buddhist chant, and when he delivered another palm strike, boom, there were shockingly 22 eight-star Regulations wrapped around him.
"An, ma, ne, ba, mi, mo!" In the heaven and earth, the Buddhist lotuses bloomed everywhere, and there was also the chanting of the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
Each character took form, and charged towards Ling Han.
Boom!
This palm strike locked down Ling Han’s escape route.

chapters.title: Chapter 4688: Igniting the holy flame
paragraphs: The larger the surface of the attack, the weaker the power would definitely be. This was inevitable.

Thus, the more elites battled, the less large-scale destructive moves would be used. This was because it would be too easy for their opponents to break through their defenses and easily disperse their attacks.

Unless one’s battle prowess was overwhelming, then so what if they expanded their attack range? Even if their power was dispersed over a larger area, they would still possess the ability to crush their opponents.
Now, Buddha Three Miseries had used the power of belief, and the attacks he delivered had reached the height of 22 eight-star Regulations. This naturally was completely overwhelming.
Moreover, he had already sealed off the entire space. Ling Han would definitely have to face this palm strike head-on.
Taking it head-on?
Wouldn’t that be a path of death?
However, what could he do even if he didn’t face it head-on? Space had already been sealed off, so where could he hide?
Thus, no matter how one looked at it, Ling Han definitely wouldn’t be able to escape from this tribulation.
Everyone nodded. This time, this prodigy of all eternity was finally going to die here.
However, Ling Han was completely unfazed.
At this moment, the Seed of the Holy Flame had already combusted completely, and the four pinnacle pillars had also been ignited. In Ling Han’s eyes, the whole world was completely different.
He saw the eight-star Regulations!

If he didn’t ignite the holy flame, he wouldn’t be able to see the eight-star Regulations. He would only be able to vaguely touch a sliver of it. This also allowed a small number of prodigies to ignite the holy flame with their own power when they were at Fourth Extreme.

However, it was far too difficult for Ling Han to reach this level. He had broken through the limits of Fourth Extreme, and he had even obtained the Seed of the Holy Flame, which he had infused with the intertwining Seven Star Regulations. This was equivalent to an eight-star Regulation.
It was equivalent to him first grasping the battle prowess of Saint Tier, and then igniting the holy flame. Was this something that all the other Saints in the world could compare to?
So... that was the case!
Understanding dawned on Ling Han. The eight-star Regulations instantly intertwined in his mind, as if he had long since grasped it.
At the same time, the millions and millions of living beings in the dimensions inside his body also seemed to be responding. Endless beings were revering him, worshipping him with incense.
Power of belief!
At this moment, the power of belief was no longer untouchable and incomprehensible. Instead, it was truly laid out in front of him.
He stretched out a hand, and multiple Regulations intertwined on his fist. They were not Seven Star Regulations, but rather... Eight Star Regulations!
One, five, ten, fifteen!
Boom, Buddha Three Miseries’ massive palm was already upon him, as if the heaven and earth were collapsing.
His palm strike caused heaven and earth to pale, and brilliance to blaze. Boundless Regulations exploded. So what if he was a Saint? He would still have no choice but to retreat.

Saints were difficult to kill, and that was because they could flee if they were outmatched. If they insisted on fighting head-on, it was guaranteed that they would also die very quickly.𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚

Buddha Three Miseries did not make another move. After suffering such a blow from him, even if Ling Han did not die, he would definitely be severely injured. Next, any Venerate would be able to apprehend Ling Han. If he was to make another move, wouldn’t that be demeaning his own status?
He turned around and strode forward.
"As expected of Buddha Three Miseries!"
"Hehe, when he was young, there was also practically no one in the world that could match him."
"Now, the strongest king tier of all eternity has passed."
"Hmph, this is what happens to those who bite off more than they can chew."
Everyone chanted loudly. Since he was already dead, they would not mind expiating Ling Han’s dead soul.
The brilliance that filled the skies withdrew, and the shards of Regulations also returned to the heaven and earth.
Yet a figure appeared amidst the shattered light. He stood proudly, as straight as a spear.
Instantly, everyone could not help but gape, as if they could not believe it at all.
That was... Ling Han!
He actually didn’t die!
Not only had he not died, there was actually not the slightest injury on his body.
Heavens!
No one dared to believe this. Wasn’t this just nonsense?
"Humph, this brat must have used the Imperial Weapon!" someone immediately said.

With these words, everyone came to a sudden realization. That’s right. Ling Han had also obtained Empres Qingzhu’s Imperial Weapon, so wasn’t it only natural that the Imperial Weapon would be able to block the attack of a nine-star Saint?
However, the Saints all frowned slightly, because they did not sense Imperial Might.
When the Imperial Weapon was activated, how could Imperial Might not permeate the whole area?

Thus, they suspected that it was extremely likely that Ling Han hadn’t used the Imperial Weapon. However, this confused them even more. If he didn’t use the Imperial Weapon, how could he possibly block the attack of a nine-star Saint?
Ling Han slowly withdrew his fist, then opened his mouth. "Wa," he spat out a mouthful of blood, and the aura all over his body fluctuated endlessly, appearing extremely unstable.
In this strike, he naturally did not use the Imperial Weapon. Thus, it was precisely because of this that his blood boiled, and even his soul was about to be thrown of his mind.
However, he was not shocked, but rather pleased.
Because he had completely relied on his own power to disperse this attack.

It should be known that before this, it was impossible for him to take the attack of a nine-star Saint head-on, what more when it was a Saint who had been further boosted with the power of belief to the point of 22 flashes of eight-star Regulations.
But now, he had withstood it, though this made him feel very terrible.
More importantly, what was it?
His four pinnacle pillars were burning fiercely, causing the number of Regulations he had grasped to continue increasing.

The reason why his eyes were still tightly closed was because he was rapidly improving. With every second that passed, he would be able to capture an additional portion of the eight-star Regulations, which was contained in his body.

Saints possessed Regulations, and it was as if they were manifestations of heaven and earth. It was because of this that they could wield the power of belief. It was also because of this that eight-star Regulations possessed a crushing might.

Sixteen flashes, seventeen flashes, eighteen flashes... this speed wasn’t as exaggerated as it had been at the beginning, and it was still decelerating continuously. However, the number of Regulations in Ling Han’s body was still increasing.
Ahead of him, Buddha Three Miseries also stopped.
He turned around slowly, his eyes fixed on Ling Han, as if he was observing.
"Half-Saint!" he spoke up.

With his keen senses as a Nine-Star Saint, he could confirm that Ling Han had already ignited the holy flame. However, the Fourth Extreme pillar had not been completely ignited yet. Thus, he was presently in the state of Half-Saint.

This process could be long or short. Some people did not have enough comprehension, or the power of belief was not enough to support their comprehension. Then, the Fourth Extreme pillar would stop burning, and the holy flame would naturally be extinguished.

However, it did not mean the longer it took to burn, the better it was. On the other hand, the faster the Fourth Extreme pillar was burnt to nothing, the deeper and more thorough one’s grasp of Regulations would be. Only if one’s grasp of Regulations was just barely enough, would it be slow and take a very long time. Furthermore, it was very likely that it would be extinguished midway.
However, no matter what, the burning of the Fourth Extreme pillar would have to continue for about ten days. This was already publicly acknowledged as the fastest record.
Even for Buddha Three Miseries, he had also used seventeen days to incinerate the Fourth Extreme pillar.

"As expected of the strongest prodigy of all eternity. He actually managed to successfully combust the holy flame under such great pressure, and became a Half-Saint!" Buddha Three Miseries did not hide his admiration at all, and this caused Shi Gang’s expression to become very ugly — this guy was really narrow-minded.
"However!" Buddha Three Miseries suddenly changed the topic, and said, "No matter what, you’re still only a Half-Saint. It’s still difficult to change your fate."
Boom, he controlled his Saint-level power, which blasted towards Ling Han.
—So what if you have the Imperial Weapon? I only have to force you to expend all your power, and the Imperial Weapon would only be a decoration.

chapters.title: Chapter 4689: The Strongest Saint
paragraphs: Ling Han cracked a smile, and charged forwards fearlessly.

That’s right. At present, he could indeed only be considered a Half Saint. However, his Fourth Extreme pillar was burning at an astonishing speed. At most, it would be completely burnt to nothing in half an hour, and by then, he would be a true Saint.
And even now, his body could accommodate as many as nineteen Regulations. In truth, he had already surpassed Buddha Three Miseries.
Thus, what did he have to fear?
He was no longer concerned about a Nine-Star Saint!

It couldn’t be helped. In the first place, he was freakish, what more when he had a holy flame that was burning with the Seed of the Holy Flame. It should be known that in order to burn this Seed of the Holy Flame, how much energy had he used to nurture it?
If he was not boosted with incredibly awesome battle prowess, could this still be called the Seed of the Holy Flame? Would it still be able to produce the strongest Great Emperor in history?
Ling Han’s excitement soared. He wanted to see just what kind of terrifying battle prowess he could unleash.
’Die!’
He let out a battle cry, and with a shake of his fists, nineteen eight-star Regulations wrapped around him, blasting towards Buddha Three Miseries.
F*ck!
Seeing this scene, everyone was numb with shock.
They all thought that Ling Han had been able to block the attack of Buddha Three Miseries because he had used the Imperial Weapon, but now... they could see it clearly. Where was the Imperial Weapon?
It was just a pair of bare fists.

Heavens, they only wanted to grab their heads and exclaim in shock. What kind of monster was this? He had clearly just advanced into Saint Tier, no, he was still only a Half-Saint, and could already fire out nineteen flashes of Eight Star Regulations.
Even if he had borrowed the power of belief, it was still indescribably terrifying.
Then, when this guy truly advanced into Saint Tier, just how much would his strength increase to?

The process of burning the Fourth Extreme pillar was the process of quickly transforming the accumulated energy into true strength. Thus, with every second that passed, Ling Han’s strength would become slightly stronger.
Which also meant that nineteen flashes of eight-star Regulations was actually not Ling Han’s limit!
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!
The most terrifying miracle in history was about to happen. He had just advanced into Saint Tier, and he was already capable of matching a Nine-Star Saint.
This was practically, practically...!
Everyone was speechless. This kind of miracle was too shocking, causing their minds to go blank.
Guo Shuang was also stunned. In the past, she had accompanied the Ancestral Buddha by his side. As the personal disciple of Ah Han, she naturally knew just how powerful the Great Emperor was.
However, if Ah Han suppressed his cultivation level, would he be a match for Ling Han if they were both One Star Saints?
She actually had no wish to know this answer!
"Damn it!" Shi Gang clenched his fists tightly, his expression slightly twisted.
He was really too narrow-minded. Seeing a freak like Ling Han, he was naturally filled with jealousy.
Buddha Three Miseries was also dazed with shock. The strength and freakishness of this opponent was unimaginable to him.
There was actually such a monster in this world?
How could the heaven and earth allow this?
And this was only a Half-Saint. If this guy became a Nine Star Saint, then wouldn’t he be able to pull down even a Pseudo-Emperor from his pedestal?

Buddha Three Miseries was internally stunned, but his fighting spirit increased madly. As a Nine Star Saint, he would definitely not allow himself to lose to a Half-Saint. Furthermore, this was an important place of the Buddhist Race, and an outsider actually managed to barge in. If he did not suppress this outsider, not only would he be humiliated, this would also be a great humiliation to the entire Buddhist Race.
"An!" He used the Six Characters Bright King Curse again. Not only could it suppress the internal demon in one’s heart, it also had an astonishing intimidating effect on the human heart.
Ling Han smiled faintly as he unleashed his murderous aura.
This time, the effects of the barrage of murderous aura were completely different.
Weng, the barrage of murderous aura surged out, and actually turned into a fist that blasted towards the "An" character.
This punch was indescribably fast, because it was on the level of divine sense.
Ling Han was also surprised. He himself had not foreseen that after he had advanced into Saint Tier, the barrage of murderous aura would undergo such a change.
Peng, under the strike of the murderous aura, the "An" character immediately crumbled, and this fist was completely unaffected, continuing to attack Buddha Three Miseries.

This was too fast. Even a Nine-Star Saint would only be able to dodge three feet away in time, and this fist was comparable to the size of a house. How could he possibly dodge it entirely when he could only dodge a mere three feet away?
With a single strike, the Buddha Three Miseries’ figure instantly slid backwards, retreating a total of over 50km before finally coming to a stop.
But looking at him, he was completely unscathed.
This was natural. The barrage of murderous aura was on the spiritual level, and would not cause any physical damage.
However!
Buddha Three Miseries’ face was as white as a sheet, and even the old skin on his neck was trembling. Even his pupils had shrunk to a point.
From this, it could be seen how terrifying the impact he had sustained was.
After resting for at least three seconds, Buddha Three Miseries took a deep breath, "Perhaps, you are already the strongest Saint in history."

Though Buddha Three Miseries was a Nine Star Saint, he definitely could not represent the strongest Saint in history. But the problem was, he was definitely not too weak either. Otherwise, he would not have been able to become a Nine Star Saint.
Thus, his words naturally carried a lot of weight.
Hearing these words, the whole area was in an uproar.
This guy... was still only a Half-Saint, yet had already been acclaimed as the strongest Saint in history. Was it really that exaggerated?
Shi Gang humphed heavily, appearing very displeased.
This old b@stard, not working hard in battle, he was actually praising his opponent. Did he want to defect to the enemy?
"However, this is ultimately Buddhist Land!" Buddha Three Miseries said calmly, "This is your greatest mistake, and will also cause the calamity of death for you."
These words were powerful and resonating, filled with the pride of Buddhist Race.
That’s right, this was Buddhist Land!
Everyone calmed down. No matter how prodigious you were, so what if you were the number one Saint in history? You have already come to the Buddhist Land, and you still want to leave alive?
To say nothing of the fact that the Great Emperor had awakened, as long as the Great Emperor killing formation was activated, it would be able to easily kill Ling Han.
You are merely a trapped beast. Even if you are courageous, it would only be short-lived.
The older one was, the wiser they were. This was a mental attack!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "It’s really a waste of your eloquence that you didn’t become a lobbyist."
"I’m only telling the truth." Buddha Three Miseries had already gotten his breath back. He sent out a palm strike, which turned into a massive lotus seat that pressed down on Ling Han.

Ling Han extracted the power of belief from within his body, and instantly, it was seen that there were originally only nineteen streaks of Regulations entwined around his fist, but now, there were shockingly twenty streaks of Regulations.
Yi?
This wasn’t the power of belief directly transforming into Regulations, but rather stimulating some kind of change in heaven and earth, boosting his body.
He didn’t use his full power. He only chose to extract a bit more. The number of Regulations instantly increased to 21, then 22.
At this moment, he was already no weaker than Buddha Three Miseries in terms of Regulations.
Peng!
He threw a punch, and the lotus seat was instantly destroyed.
They were equal in Regulations, so who would be weaker than the other?
Everyone was dumbfounded. 22 flashes of eight-star Regulations.
Heavens! Heavens! Heavens!
Was this really a Half-Saint?
Buddha Three Miseries was also stunned, then felt a deep sense of powerlessness.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺

If he was not boosted with incredibly awesome battle prowess, could this still be called the Seed of the Holy Flame?
Would it still be able to produce the strongest Great Emperor in history?
Ling Han’s excitement soared.
He wanted to see just what kind of terrifying battle prowess he could unleash.
’Die!’
He let out a battle cry, and with a shake of his fists, nineteen eight-star Regulations wrapped around him, blasting towards Buddha Three Miseries.
F*ck!
Seeing this scene, everyone was numb with shock.
They all thought that Ling Han had been able to block the attack of Buddha Three Miseries because he had used the Imperial Weapon, but now... they could see it clearly.
Where was the Imperial Weapon?
It was just a pair of bare fists.
Heavens, they only wanted to grab their heads and exclaim in shock.
What kind of monster was this?
He had clearly just advanced into Saint Tier, no, he was still only a Half-Saint, and could already fire out nineteen flashes of Eight Star Regulations.
Even if he had borrowed the power of belief, it was still indescribably terrifying.
Then, when this guy truly advanced into Saint Tier, just how much would his strength increase to?
The process of burning the Fourth Extreme pillar was the process of quickly transforming the accumulated energy into true strength.
Thus, with every second that passed, Ling Han’s strength would become slightly stronger.
Which also meant that nineteen flashes of eight-star Regulations was actually not Ling Han’s limit!
Heavens!
Heavens!
Heavens!
The most terrifying miracle in history was about to happen.
He had just advanced into Saint Tier, and he was already capable of matching a Nine-Star Saint.
This was practically, practically...!
Everyone was speechless.
This kind of miracle was too shocking, causing their minds to go blank.
Guo Shuang was also stunned.
In the past, she had accompanied the Ancestral Buddha by his side.
As the personal disciple of Ah Han, she naturally knew just how powerful the Great Emperor was.
However, if Ah Han suppressed his cultivation level, would he be a match for Ling Han if they were both One Star Saints?
She actually had no wish to know this answer!
"Damn it!" Shi Gang clenched his fists tightly, his expression slightly twisted.
He was really too narrow-minded.
Seeing a freak like Ling Han, he was naturally filled with jealousy.
Buddha Three Miseries was also dazed with shock.
The strength and freakishness of this opponent was unimaginable to him.
There was actually such a monster in this world?
How could the heaven and earth allow this?
And this was only a Half-Saint.
If this guy became a Nine Star Saint, then wouldn’t he be able to pull down even a Pseudo-Emperor from his pedestal?
Buddha Three Miseries was internally stunned, but his fighting spirit increased madly.
As a Nine Star Saint, he would definitely not allow himself to lose to a Half-Saint.
Furthermore, this was an important place of the Buddhist Race, and an outsider actually managed to barge in.
If he did not suppress this outsider, not only would he be humiliated, this would also be a great humiliation to the entire Buddhist Race.
"An!" He used the Six Characters Bright King Curse again.
Not only could it suppress the internal demon in one’s heart, it also had an astonishing intimidating effect on the human heart.
Ling Han smiled faintly as he unleashed his murderous aura.
This time, the effects of the barrage of murderous aura were completely different.
Weng, the barrage of murderous aura surged out, and actually turned into a fist that blasted towards the "An" character.
This punch was indescribably fast, because it was on the level of divine sense.
Ling Han was also surprised.
He himself had not foreseen that after he had advanced into Saint Tier, the barrage of murderous aura would undergo such a change.
Peng, under the strike of the murderous aura, the "An" character immediately crumbled, and this fist was completely unaffected, continuing to attack Buddha Three Miseries.
This was too fast.
Even a Nine-Star Saint would only be able to dodge three feet away in time, and this fist was comparable to the size of a house.
How could he possibly dodge it entirely when he could only dodge a mere three feet away?
With a single strike, the Buddha Three Miseries’ figure instantly slid backwards, retreating a total of over 50km before finally coming to a stop.
But looking at him, he was completely unscathed.
This was natural.
The barrage of murderous aura was on the spiritual level, and would not cause any physical damage.
However!
Buddha Three Miseries’ face was as white as a sheet, and even the old skin on his neck was trembling.
Even his pupils had shrunk to a point.
From this, it could be seen how terrifying the impact he had sustained was.
After resting for at least three seconds, Buddha Three Miseries took a deep breath, "Perhaps, you are already the strongest Saint in history."
Though Buddha Three Miseries was a Nine Star Saint, he definitely could not represent the strongest Saint in history.
But the problem was, he was definitely not too weak either.
Otherwise, he would not have been able to become a Nine Star Saint.
Thus, his words naturally carried a lot of weight.
Hearing these words, the whole area was in an uproar.
This guy... was still only a Half-Saint, yet had already been acclaimed as the strongest Saint in history.
Was it really that exaggerated?
Shi Gang humphed heavily, appearing very displeased.
This old b@stard, not working hard in battle, he was actually praising his opponent.
Did he want to defect to the enemy?
"However, this is ultimately Buddhist Land!" Buddha Three Miseries said calmly, "This is your greatest mistake, and will also cause the calamity of death for you."
These words were powerful and resonating, filled with the pride of Buddhist Race.
That’s right, this was Buddhist Land!
Everyone calmed down.
No matter how prodigious you were, so what if you were the number one Saint in history?
You have already come to the Buddhist Land, and you still want to leave alive?
To say nothing of the fact that the Great Emperor had awakened, as long as the Great Emperor killing formation was activated, it would be able to easily kill Ling Han.
You are merely a trapped beast.
Even if you are courageous, it would only be short-lived.
The older one was, the wiser they were.
This was a mental attack!
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, "It’s really a waste of your eloquence that you didn’t become a lobbyist."
"I’m only telling the truth." Buddha Three Miseries had already gotten his breath back.
He sent out a palm strike, which turned into a massive lotus seat that pressed down on Ling Han.

Ling Han extracted the power of belief from within his body, and instantly, it was seen that there were originally only nineteen streaks of Regulations entwined around his fist, but now, there were shockingly twenty streaks of Regulations.
Yi?
This wasn’t the power of belief directly transforming into Regulations, but rather stimulating some kind of change in heaven and earth, boosting his body.
He didn’t use his full power.
He only chose to extract a bit more.
The number of Regulations instantly increased to 21, then 22.
At this moment, he was already no weaker than Buddha Three Miseries in terms of Regulations.
Peng!
He threw a punch, and the lotus seat was instantly destroyed.
They were equal in Regulations, so who would be weaker than the other?
Everyone was dumbfounded.
22 flashes of eight-star Regulations.
Heavens!
Heavens!
Heavens!
Was this really a Half-Saint?
Buddha Three Miseries was also stunned, then felt a deep sense of powerlessness.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺

chapters.title: Chapter 4690: Kicked to burst
paragraphs: A mere Half-Saint actually possessed 22 flashes of eight-star Regulations.
Just how terrifying was this?
This meant that once Ling Han had completely advanced into Saint Tier, his maximum battle prowess would surpass 22 flashes of eight-star Regulations.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
Heavens!

Starting from the Spirit Transformation Tier, especially in the Saint Tier, Regulations were too important. It could be said that the comparison of battle prowess could completely be determined by the number of Regulations.
—Aside from a very small number of prodigies who were able to use battle skill and techniques to compensate for their disadvantage in Regulations.
However, it wasn’t as exaggerated as this extent.
If a Half-Saint was already so awesome, then just how strong would Ling Han be when he became a Nine-Star Saint?
Was this the number one prodigy of all eternity?

Buddha Three Miseries revealed a bitter smile. Though he still had a great many ultimate techniques that he had not used yet, he knew that even if he used these ultimate techniques, it would be useless. How many of them could be more powerful than the Six Characters Bright King Curse?
He took a deep breath and closed his eyes. When he opened them again, boom, flames were shockingly burning on his body.
This flame looked very much like a lotus flower, and was as big as a house.
The holy flame!
The nine-star Saint’s holy flame was actually as large as a house.
He even used the holy flame. Buddha Three Miseries was really going all out.
This time, Ling Han didn’t retreat.
Since they were both Saints, what did he have to fear?
However, he didn’t want to use the holy flame.
F***, he had just ignited the holy flame, and it was only the size of a human head. If he were to expend it now, that would really be a great loss.
However, he still had another trick up his sleeve.
Boom! Black flames ignited on his fist.
Destructive Energy!
"Yi, a black, black holy flame!"
"A nine-star Saint!"
Everyone was stunned. The colour of the holy flame represented one’s cultivation level. Just look at the Buddha Three Miseries’ holy flame; it was as black as ink.
So, Ling Han was a nine-star Saint?
But hadn’t he just broken through?
When they thought that Ling Han was a Nine-Star Saint, everyone instead breathed a sigh of relief. That was because Ling Han wasn’t so freakish anymore.
However, the expressions of the Saints were all grim. They could confirm that this was definitely not the holy flame, but a high-level energy that could make them feel terror.
Buddha Three Miseries had already charged over. After using the holy flame, it was equivalent to him unleashing his full strength and reaching his strongest state.
If his strongest state was still inferior to his opponent, then he would have to resign himself to fate.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Ling Han and Buddha Three Miseries clashed, making everyone want to grab their heads and exclaim in shock.
That was because Ling Han had actually blocked the holy flame.
Heavens!

Just how terrifying was the destructive power of the holy flame? However, it was as if the heavens had placed some restrictions on it. The more the holy flame burned, the less there would be. Thus, unless it was absolutely necessary, no Saint would use it.
However, once it was used, its might would also be world-destroying.
It was said that if a little bit of the holy flame landed on a planet, it could easily destroy a planet.
If it was not for the fact that this was Buddhist Land that had been boosted by the Great Emperor, Buddha Three Miseries wouldn’t dare to act so recklessly at all.
However, Ling Han had blocked it!
This... was it really not the holy flame?
Apart from the holy flame, what other energy could resist the holy flame?
No one dared to believe it, but the truth surpassed all else.
Ling Han aggressively attacked. So what if his opponent was a nine-star Saint? He would still beat him up.
Weng!

He didn’t increase the number of Regulations, suppressing his abilities to the same level as Buddha Three Miseries. Then, he used his murderous aura to attack. Fists of murderous aura continuously appeared out of thin air, blasting towards Buddha Three Miseries.
Although Buddha Three Miseries used the Six Characters Bright King Curse to resist, it was completely no match for the fists of murderous aura.
Thus, this had become his weakness.

Ling Han grabbed onto this weakness, and continued to expand his advantage. The situation could be clearly seen now. Buddha Three Miseries was beginning to fall into a disadvantage, and was becoming more and more passive.
After more than 500 exchanges, Buddha Three Miseries was already unable to attack. He could only defend passively.
This!
If someone had told them beforehand that there was a Half-Saint that could force a Nine-Star Saint into such desperate straits, who would believe it?
However, the bloody truth was right in front of them. They could not believe it, but they had no choice.
Peng!
Ling Han raised his foot and kicked Buddha Three Miseries’ face. The old monk was instantly sent flying.
When he steadied himself, his whole face had caved in, revealing a clear footprint. He opened his mouth and spat out blood, as well as multiple broken teeth.

Though Saints could regrow even their severed limbs, this kind of injury was naturally no big deal, but if they were kicked to the point that their teeth fell out and their face collapsed, how could they still have the face to continue fighting?
"Wa!" Buddha Three Miseries was throwing up blood continuously. Firstly, his injuries were indeed very severe, and secondly, he had been angered.
He was a Nine-Star Saint!
Ling Han wagged his finger, and looked towards Shi Gang, "Little Gang, now, do you want to battle me?"
Little Gang?
Shi Gang couldn’t help as his face twitched. ’You’ve gone too far!’
He humphed, "If you are so determined to seek death, then I shall oblige you!"
The first generation Buddha Son was about to make a move!
Everyone couldn’t help but feel excited. Even if Buddha Three Miseries was a Nine Star Saint, compared to the first Buddha Son... he should still be inferior.
Shi Gang took a step, and was already standing in midair, while a demon-subduing staff appeared in his hand.
This wasn’t the Imperial Weapon, but it wasn’t an ordinary replica of an Imperial Weapon either. Instead, it was a Saint Tool that had been personally forged by Buddha Ah Han and bestowed upon him.
How could the Saint Tool that the Ancestral Buddha had forged be ordinary?
He clenched his fists, and instantly, eighteen eight-star Regulations appeared.
As expected.

Ling Han nodded in understanding. Ordinary Saints would only be able to grasp one more Regulation with every level that they advanced. However, even more powerful Saints would be able to grasp two Regulations. However, this wasn’t something that could be done with every level.
—Even for the Golden Generation, after advancing into Nine Star Saint-level, they could only use 14 to 18 flashes of Eight Star Regulations.
However, the ancient Imperial Son was a different story. Every time they advanced a level in Saint Tier, they would be able to grasp three more Eight Star Regulations.
Ling Han was extremely curious. Then what about Ding Shu and the others?
As he saw it, the Genesis World’s masters were even more naturally talented than the Great Emperors’ children. In that case, it was extremely likely that they could grasp as many as four Regulations.
Of course, he was definitely different. Just look, he had not truly become a Saint, and he could already use nineteen flashes of Eight Star Regulations.
Who asked him to have cultivated every cultivation level to perfection on his way to this point? Add to that the Seed of the Holy Flame, and he had become freakishly powerful.
"Come!" Ling Han crooked a finger at Shi Gang.
He really detested this person’s lofty bearing. So what? Did he think an ancient Imperial Son was superior to others?
I’ll beat you to death.
Shi Gang raised the Demon Subduing Staff, and with the surge of divine sense, this Saint Tool was immediately revived.
Weng, weng, weng! The Demon Subduing Staff released a frightening killing intent.

Shi Gang shouted again, and the power of belief surged over, boosting his body. Instantly, the Buddha Halo behind his head shone brilliantly, and the number of Regulations broke through to as many as 22 flashes in a single stroke. Even that Saint Tool also grew greatly in might.
This time, he pushed his battle prowess to the extreme.
"Die!" Brandishing the Demon Subduing Staff, he charged over.
A top grade Saint Tool added with his battle prowess that was as high as twenty two stars, just how terrifying was that?

chapters.title: Chapter 4691: The Imperial Weapon appears
paragraphs: Ling Han smiled, and brandished his fist towards the Demon Subduing Staff.
Peng!
The light of Regulations burst from his fist, firmly blocking this blow.
This!
Everyone was speechless with shock. This was too ridiculous; taking a Saint Tool head-on with bare hands?
Just what kind of freak are you?
That’s right. It may be true that one could be strong in terms of battle prowess, but taking on a Saint Tool with one’s bare hands would depend on the strength of one’s physique.
Thus, being strong in battle prowess did not mean that one’s physique was strong. These were two different matters.
However, Ling Han had already demonstrated to them what a true freak was.
"Hehe!" Ling Han bared his teeth in a grin. He swung his fist again, and struck out at Shi Gang.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
His hands were the strongest Saintly Material in the world, and each of his strikes greeted the Saint Tool head-on. He did not show the slightest bit of weakness.
Moreover, his strength was still increasing.
The Fourth Extreme pillar was burning fiercely. With every bit burned, the Regulations that Ling Han had grasped would increase slightly.
Twenty flashes! Twenty one flashes! Twenty two flashes!

There was less than one-tenth of the Fourth Extreme pillar remaining. Ling Han had a feeling that when the Fourth Extreme pillar was completely burnt, the Regulations he had grasped would reach around 25.
Twenty-five flashes.
What kind of terrifying number was this? If someone like Buddha Three Miseries knew about this, he would definitely despair.
"Ling Han, you’re dead!" Shi Gang said balefully. Did he think this was his full battle prowess?
Wrong!
"Vajra Subduing Demon Formation!" he exclaimed lightly.
All of a sudden, the Saints in the surroundings began to chant Buddhist chants. They formed seals at the same time, and struck out at Shi Gang.
Shockingly, the aura that Shi Gang Gang released actually became slightly stronger.
Ling Han immediately understood. Every Saint was funneling power into Shi Gang, allowing him to gain strength that surpassed his cultivation level for a short period of time.
"Ignorant brat, die!" Shi Gang threw a heavy punch, and there were shockingly 25 flashes of Regulations entwined around his fist.
It should be known that his battle prowess limit had only been 22 streaks of Regulations.
An increase of three eight-star Regulations in one go was practically terrifying.
Yet Ling Han smiled, and similarly shot out a punch.

This time, he didn’t hold back anymore. Not only did he unleash the 22 Regulations in his body, but he even activated the power of belief to the extreme. There were as many as 27 eight-star Regulations wrapped around his fists.
Heavens!
Shi Gang’s expression instantly became one of utter terror, as well as shock and disbelief.
27 flashes!
How was this possible?
Peng!
Their fists collided. Power collided, and Regulations also collided.
Then, Shi Gang was sent flying. Cracks immediately appeared on his skin, and blood gushed out.
The spectators couldn’t believe their own eyes. It could be said that Shi Gang had used all the trump cards that he could use—the power of belief, the Saint Tool, the formation techniques, but?
He was actually still outmatched.
The greatest prodigy of all eternity, this was the greatest prodigy of all eternity.
Ling Han smiled, "I said I would beat you up, and you still don’t believe me?"
He set off in hot pursuit, throwing punch after punch.
Under the crushing pressure of battle prowess, who would be able to turn the tables in his hands?
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Shi Gang instantly became a punching bag, and Ling Han pummeled him madly.
Below them, everyone was speechless.
Shi Gang was the top elite of their Buddhist Land. Of course, Buddha Ah Han definitely couldn’t be counted in, but now, their top elite was being thrashed by Ling Han, unable to fight back at all.
This was too humiliating.
Every time Ling Han threw a punch, the entire Buddhist Race would lose a little face.
This was a great humiliation, something that had never been experienced in all of history!
As a member of an Imperial Clan, they had always been the ones to rule the world. Now, however, they were being bullied right on their doorstep.
Was this still the Imperial Clan?
"Enough!" Guo Shuang stepped into the air, and shouted coldly at Ling Han.
Though she did not like Shi Gang, no matter what, they were both on the same side now, and Ling Han was an outsider through and through.
Ling Han stopped, looked towards Guo Shuang, and asked calmly, "Does Miss Guo also want to battle me?"
Shi Gang finally breathed a sigh of relief. His expression was twisted. With his narrow-mindedness, how could he swallow this anger?
Furthermore, the moment Guo Shuang opened her mouth, Ling Han immediately stopped. Was there some unspeakable relationship between the two of them?
All of a sudden, he felt as if he had been cuckolded.
"That’s my intention." Guo Shuang brandished her sword. The sword was three feet long, and it was almost transparent, as if it was made of crystal.
With a casual kick, Ling Han sent Shi Gang flying, directly facing Guo Shuang.

Previously, he had already felt that Guo Shuang gave him an unfathomable feeling, and considered her a strong rival. Of course, he was already a Half-Saint now, and was just a little bit away from becoming a true Saint. His abilities had soared, and Guo Shuang could no longer pose a threat to him.
Shi Gang rolled into the distance. His expression was twisted, and there was a murderous glint in his eyes.
However, his abilities were inferior, so what could he do no matter how furious he was?𝒇𝓻𝓮𝓮𝙬𝙚𝒃𝒏𝓸𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝓬𝓸𝒎
Guo Shuang let out a soft exclamation, and brandished her sword in a slash.
Shua, the sword light surged 30,000 meters, incredibly terrifying.
Yi?
Ling Han was astonished. This Guo Shuang was actually a Seven Star Saint!
The sword light slashed over. There were shockingly 21 flashes of Regulations, and this was still without using the power of belief. Otherwise, the battle prowess would be even more terrifying.
However, compared to Ling Han, she was still slightly inferior.

Even if Ling Han didn’t use the power of belief, he could still blast out 22 streaks of Regulations. Even though there was only one additional streak, in a clash of elites, could one afford the difference of one streak?
Moreover, Ling Han was already capable of defeating a stronger opponent as a weaker opponent. Now that he was still the stronger party, how could a weaker opponent possibly turn the tables?
Of course, that was impossible.
Under Ling Han’s powerful suppression, Guo Shuang was at a complete disadvantage, and this was under the condition that Ling Han didn’t use any powerful moves at all.
With a thought, boom, the barrage of murderous aura surged out, turning into a fist that ruthlessly blasted towards Guo Shuang.
"Spiritual Power attack? Humph!" Guo Shuang was completely unafraid. She had a precious tool that had been personally forged by a Great Emperor, and could be immune to all negative effects.
However, when the punch landed, she retreated rapidly, and then her face became incredibly pale. At the same time, she was also incredibly stunned.
She had actually been hit!
How was this possible?
She had a precious tool that had been personally refined by the Great Emperor, and could be immune to all attacks of Spiritual Power.

Meanwhile, Ling Han broke into a grin. After he had advanced into Saint Tier, his Spiritual Power attack had also improved further. More importantly, there was still a sliver of the might of the Seed of the Holy Flame within.
This was obtained from the great fissure at the edge of the universe, and could even allow one to become the strongest Great Emperor!
Even Empress Qingzhu had died because of this, so how could it not be awesome?
Hence, even the precious tool of a Great Emperor would not be able to block it.
Of course, this was unless the Great Emperor made a move himself.
Ling Han stood proudly. This was clearly the territory of the Buddhist Race, yet he was like a ruler, looking down on the heavens.
This infuriated the Buddhist Land elites. This was far too detestable!
Who would deal with him?
It didn’t matter who it was, as long as they could deal with him. Otherwise, what face would the Buddhist Race have?
Weng!

This speed was astonishingly fast, but when the light arrived, it came to an abrupt stop.
Demon Subduing Staff.
It wasn’t a replica, but the genuine Imperial Weapon!

This!

Just what kind of freak are you?
That’s right.
It may be true that one could be strong in terms of battle prowess, but taking on a Saint Tool with one’s bare hands would depend on the strength of one’s physique.

Ling Han had a feeling that when the Fourth Extreme pillar was completely burnt, the Regulations he had grasped would reach around 25.
Twenty-five flashes.
What kind of terrifying number was this?
If someone like Buddha Three Miseries knew about this, he would definitely despair.

How was this possible?
Peng!

chapters.title: Chapter 4692: Saint Tier, Ling Han!
paragraphs: The Demon Subduing Staff was in midair. There was clearly no one controlling it, yet it was exuding an aura of Imperial Might.
The Imperial Weapon... had awakened!𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
Everyone was stunned. There was clearly no one wielding it, so why had the Imperial Weapon awakened?
This was impossible.

It should be known that resuscitating the Imperial Weapon needed a great amount of spiritual power and mystical power. Even a Saint would not be able to last very long. For someone as strong as a Nine-Star Saint, being able to last for ten minutes was already awesome enough.
But now?
The Imperial Weapon awakened on its own, as if it had a life of its own.
But it was only an instant, and realization dawned on them.
Ancestral Buddha!
Buddha Ah Han had revived. Perhaps, it was only a sliver of willpower. Thus, he did not move personally. However, he had revived the Imperial Weapon to kill Ling Han.
Haha, this time, Ling Han would definitely be dead.

The Imperial Weapon had awakened. Moreover, it had been awakened by the Great Emperor, so there was definitely no time limit to how long it could be used. In that case, who in the world could stop it?
Even a Pseudo-Emperor couldn’t do it.
The revived Imperial Weapon was equivalent to a Great Emperor. Aside from another Great Emperor, who could resist it?
How was Ling Han going to resolve this crisis?
Ling Han merely smiled faintly, "Who would’ve thought? I’m quite a respected person. Even Buddha Ah Han personally made a move!"
Weng, the Demon Subduing Staff shone brightly, its might awe-inspiring.
This was the Imperial Weapon, the most powerful weapon in the world. It could easily kill Saints.
No matter what kind of Saint it was, clashing head-on with the Imperial Weapon would only lead to death.
A Great Emperor was superior to the Nine Heavens, and could not be offended.
"How dare you! You actually dare to blaspheme the Ancestral Buddha?!" everyone shouted. They all wore furious expressions.
In their eyes, Ah Han was like a god.
Ling Han cracked a smile. In his mind, the last segment of the Fourth Extreme pillar had also been burnt to nothing. He had also officially advanced into Saint Tier.
A One Star Saint.
Those who possessed Regulations were Saints.
However, Regulations belonged to the heaven and earth, so how could they be absorbed into one’s body?
Ling Han discovered that a part of his body had lost vitality, as if he had been assimilated by the heaven and earth.
He instantly came to a realization. Saint Tier wasn’t the true name of this cultivation level. Instead, it was called Silent Destruction Tier.
Only by assimilating with the heaven and earth could he accommodate the Regulations.
Hence, Saints were called Silent Destruction Tier elites. This was a process of slowly allowing oneself to perish.
While he was lost in thought, the Demon Subduing Staff had already shot over, bringing with it a supreme imperial might. It was really capable of killing gods and demons.
As the attack swept out, a hole was forcefully blasted into the skies. Imperial might blazed, and spread far and wide.
Everyone revealed a smile. This time, Ling Han was definitely going to die.
The Imperial Weapon launched a barrage of attacks. So what if you are the strongest prodigy of all eternity?
However, when the light completely dispersed, Ling Han was still standing proudly, but there was a bamboo sword hanging above his head.
Clear Bamboo Sword, Imperial Weapon!
It could not be helped. The Imperial Weapon had already unleashed its might, and only another Imperial Weapon could stand against it. Otherwise, only a Great Emperor could be mobilized.
He hadn’t died yet!
Everyone was speechless. Why was Ling Han so hard to kill?
However, Ling Han didn’t linger in battle any longer. He grabbed the Clear Bamboo Sword, and using the Imperial Weapon as his blade, he directly charged towards the outskirts of the Sacred Land.
Great Emperor formation?
With the Imperial Weapon protecting him, he could even barge through the Imperial Formation.
Ling Han didn’t want to continue battling with the Demon Subduing Staff.
Although his battle prowess was heaven-defying, he was only a One Star Saint, after all. He couldn’t maintain the recovery of the Imperial Weapon forever.
Thus, it was time for him to retreat.
After all, even the Great Emperor had made a move, though it was only an attack from the Imperial Weapon.
Behind him, the Demon Subduing Staff was presently catching up.
Pu!
The Clear Bamboo Sword barged into the Great Emperor formation. Endless imperial might spread out, forming a fierce collision.
The Great Emperor killing formation was indeed powerful, but the Imperial Weapon wasn’t to be trifled with either. It exuded light that surrounded Ling Han, allowing him to charge forward madly.
Shua, he broke through the blockade of the Imperial Formation, and charged out of the Sacred Land.
He no longer hesitated, tearing open space with both hands, and stepped in.
Boom!
The Demon Subduing Staff arrived, blasting open the Void, forming a powerful shockwave that set off in pursuit of Ling Han.
Ling Han humphed, and brandished the Clear Bamboo Sword in a slash.
Shua, a flash of sword light lit up, illuminating even the Void.
Peng, the strike of the Demon Subduing Staff was instantly dispersed.

Ling Han stopped in his tracks. Right now, he had to return to the Four Origin Planet. However, the Four Origin Planet wasn’t motionless. Instead, it was constantly being pushed by the formation toward the edge of the universe.
Thus, he needed to locate it first.
Yi?

To his shock, he discovered that after becoming a Saint, he had absorbed Regulations. It was as if the entire universe had become one with him. No matter how far away it was, he would be able to sense it very quickly.
It was as if there were multiple veins growing in the universe.
Of course, it would not be possible for him to go any further. This could only be limited to areas where there were planets.
Ling Han quickly located the location of Four Origin Planet. He then started to hurry, and in just half a day, he came out of the Void and landed on the Four Origin Planet.
There was a hint of a smile at the corners of his lips. He had finally returned as a Saint.
"Ling Han!"
When he appeared, the empress, Hu Niu, and the others all rushed over.
Although he hadn’t left for long this time, he had snuck into the Buddhist Land this time. How dangerous was it?
This naturally caused everyone to worry.
Now that Ling Han had returned safely, everyone was naturally relieved and extremely happy.
Very soon, everyone asked about Ling Han’s experiences, whether he had become a Saint and other questions.
After a while, they burst into laughter.
Ling Han had become a Saint.
"Little Han, have you finally become a Saint?" the large black dog called out.
Ling Han nodded, "Finally!"
For this day, he had really, really waited too long.
Right now, the large black dog, Brother Monkey, and the others had all become Two-Star Saints. Meanwhile, Ling Han had finally become a Saint after much anticipation and waiting.
It should be known that it would take tens of millions of years for a Saint to advance to the next level.
But now, all the waiting was worth it. The Saint that Ling Han had become was really, really too strong.
"Little Han, how powerful is a Saint like you?" the little azure dragon asked curiously. He had always had a wish to defeat Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Come, give it a try!"
He stepped into space, waiting for the little azure dragon to come up for a battle.
The little azure dragon naturally wouldn’t cower. It immediately charged into space and launched an attack at Ling Han.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

Ling Han casually parried. The little azure dragon was indeed extraordinary, but compared with Ling Han, it was still far inferior. So what if it was a Two Star Saint? The gap between them was extraordinarily large.
After blocking over a hundred moves, Ling Han finally moved. He shot out a punch, and peng, the little azure dragon was instantly sent flying.
The battle had ended.
The little azure dragon bared its teeth as it ran back, and asked, "Little Han, how much battle prowess did you use in this attack?"
Ling Han pondered for a moment before replying, "30%, maybe."
In reality, he hadn’t even unleashed 1% of his full strength. However, in order to prevent the little azure dragon from being hit too hard, he told a white lie.
"Alright, I’ll definitely defeat you!" The little azure dragon’s fighting spirit was ignited.
Meanwhile, the large black dog glanced at him sympathetically. With his understanding of Ling Han, he naturally knew that Ling Han was comforting the little azure dragon.
Just wait to be defeated with every challenge you issue.
