chapters.title: Chapter 4693: Great trend
paragraphs: Ling Han had returned, and he had also become a Saint. Four Origin Planet instantly had a stabilizing force.

However, even though he had been away for a long time, Ling Han still had no way to find out what was going on in the universe at this moment. He had no idea how far the invasion of the Netherworld had progressed, and he had no idea how great the losses of the Living Realm were.

If he wanted to obtain any information now, the Saint could only personally investigate himself. Firstly, it would be faster, and secondly, it would also be safe if he was strong enough. He could leave as he liked.
However, the Saint’s speed could only be limited to between two points. With how wide the universe was, it would be difficult for Saints to set foot on every point.
Hence, everyone’s news was very limited at present.
From this aspect, the existence of the Chang Clan was really too important. The moment they rebelled, it was equivalent to turning everyone blind and deaf.
After Ling Han became a Saint, he became incredibly sensitive to changes in heaven and earth.
Taking in Regulations was actually, from a certain aspect, annihilating oneself, and assimilating with the heaven and earth.
Thus, when heaven and earth changed, he would naturally become very sensitive to it.
Ling Han discovered that the foundation stone of Regulations was on the verge of collapse.
This was extremely terrifying. If the Regulations collapsed, would the entire universe suddenly explode? Or would some super energy storm happen, engulfing everything and destroying everything?
Why was it like this?
Of course, it was because of the invasion of the Yin souls, causing the two Realms to forcibly merge.

These two Realms were originally on opposing sides, and were incompatible with each other, yet now that they had been forcefully fused, it was natural that they would clash strongly with the Regulations of the present.
Though the Regulations were strong, they had been born from the power of heaven and earth. Now, even the power of heaven and earth was about to be destroyed, so what was left of the Regulations?
Ling Han frowned at this. Who would benefit from this?
Could it be that those ancient Great Emperors wanted to destroy the universe?
Weren’t they demanding immortality? What benefits would destroying the universe bring them?

This was something that he could not understand at all. Furthermore, those Imperial Sons would definitely know about this kind of change, and even Saints could sense it, so why would they still be willing to do it?
Without the skin, where would the fur <anno data-annotation-id="b3d82490-23fb-478d-8282-f48d42b63a41" data-title="go">go1</anno>?
Ling Han shook his head. This should be the greatest secret of the ancient Great Emperors, right?
Improve his strength!
Only if one had enough abilities, would they be able to participate in this battle of the great era. Otherwise, they would only be cannon fodder, dying in the storm of destruction.
After advancing into Saint Tier, Ling Han’s rate of improvement became even faster.

When he was at the Fourth Extreme, even if Ling Han had all kinds of Regulations and comprehension ability, he was limited by Celestial Qi, so he could only advance bit by bit. However, after entering into Saint Tier, the only thing that was important was comprehension of cultivation level.
Silent Destruction Tier was to allow one’s body to die, and be assimilated with the heaven and earth.

Ling Han soon pushed his body to its limits, accommodating a total of 25 eight-star Regulations. If he wanted to accommodate even more Regulations, there was only one way, and that was to break through his limits.
In other words, he was already at the peak stage of One Star Saint.
It couldn’t be helped. He had accumulated too much power, and that was why he burst it out in a single stroke. He had just broken through, and had already leaped to the peak stage.
The nine levels of Saint Tier was the process of breaking through one’s limits, step by step.
Realization dawned on Ling Han. No wonder there were so few high-level Saints.
In truth, Saints could completely disregard their own cultivation level, because every step they took was breaking through their limits.
Ling Han frowned. Step by step, Silent Destruction Tier cultivators were being assimilated with heaven and earth, so how could they become Emperor?
As a Great Emperor, he was superior to the Regulations, but assimilating with the heaven and earth, and absorbing the Regulations in his body, how could he achieve this step?
For others, becoming a Saint was their ultimate goal. However, Ling Han’s ambition was to become a Great Emperor, so he had to prepare for the worst.
"The so-called rebuilding after destruction?"

Ling Han murmured to himself. Every step of Silent Destruction Tier was equivalent to losing oneself. It was clear that his abilities had improved, but in essence, he was actually falling, becoming a slave of heaven and earth.
Thus, after reaching the pinnacle level, he would break through the shackles and rise from the dead?
Ling Han was still far from reaching the level of a nine-star Saint, so he could only guess at this moment.

"However, it has always been the case that the Great Emperor would advance from One Star Saint to Nine Star Saint, then become Pseudo-Emperor, and finally complete that leap, becoming the strongest of an era."
"Thus, Saint Tier is a path that one has to pass through."
"Then I can only take it one step at a time and wait and see."

Ling Han tossed all his doubts aside. He first calmed himself down, and adjusted his condition. Next, he would have to break through his limits, and become a Two Star Saint. This would need a considerable amount of time to stabilize his cultivation.
In Silent Destruction Tier, it was no big deal to spend tens of thousands of years to advance one minor level.
In truth, the majority of Saints had only been stuck for so long because they wanted to break through their limits.
No one could help him with this step, not even a Great Emperor.
He could only depend on himself.

True, now that they had reached this step, they had absorbed Regulations, and assimilated with the heaven and earth. If others interfered, it would be equivalent to making an enemy of the heaven and earth.
Of course, even the Great Emperor couldn’t do it. Otherwise, how could the Great Emperor die?
Even for those like the Lords of Death, didn’t they all hide themselves? They must have been limited by heaven and earth, or they would have long since come out and barged around.
Was a Great Emperor not awesome enough?
Faced with this kind of barrier, Ling Han was also trapped. It was impossible for him to break through in the short term.
There was no rush. Ling Han could only slowly accumulate power, and when he reached a limit, he would charge forwards.
This was the only way.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖

He did not stay idle either, and travelled all over the universe. Firstly, he wanted to see how Ding Shu and the others were doing, and secondly, he also wanted to get to know the great trends of the world.

Ding Shu and the other Genesis World Rulers were all fine, and they had all reached the level of three or four stars. Even though the distance between them was not very wide, if Ling Han wanted to catch up to them, it was very likely that he would need hundreds of years.

After all, he had spent too much time breaking through his limits when he had been at the level of Sect Master and Venerate Tier. Furthermore, he had also spent a lot of additional time to light up the holy flame.
In terms of comprehension ability, the Genesis World’s rulers were all heaven-defying freaks.

Thus, if Ling Han wanted to catch up to them, he would probably have to wait until he reached the level of Pseudo-Emperor, or when he obtained some supremely precious herb that could accelerate his speed to break through the limits of his body.
There were Great Herbs like this, but there were pitifully few of them. They would be fought over madly by Saints.

The ancient Imperial Sons also improved rapidly. When they were sealed, they were already Saints, and when they were sealed, their divine sense could also channel to a limited extent, which was equivalent to constantly appreciating heaven and earth.
Thus, after they were unsealed, their rate of advancement was frighteningly fast.

The strongest ancient Imperial Son was already a six-star Saint. In comparison, the Golden Generation Imperial Sons were far inferior. By now, no one spoke of them, and their brilliance had long since been concealed.
Now, it was publicly acknowledged that the candidates that could possibly become Emperor were the ancient Imperial Sons, as well as Ling Han, Ding Shu and the other Genesis World Rulers.

Some people were very optimistic about Ling Han, and bestowed him the title of savior. After all, he was publicly acknowledged as the strongest king tier of all eternity. However, there were also some people that thought that his cultivation level had improved too slowly, and had already been left far behind in terms of cultivation level. Clearly, heaven and earth were not optimistic about him.
—To become Emperor, he definitely had to obtain the blessing of heaven and earth.

Thus, the ancient Imperial Sons were the most favored candidates. After all, the ancient Imperial Sons all had the bloodline of a Great Emperor. Furthermore, this era was too different, and it was very likely that the curse of the Imperial Clan being unable to produce a second Great Emperor would be broken.

chapters.title: Chapter 4694: Attack of the Skeleton Saint Tool
paragraphs: Ling Han didn’t care what others said.
He charged into the Yin soul army, and began a massacre.
At present, what did he have to fear?
Boom!
He barged around, completely outmatched.

Previously, when he had still been a Venerate Tier, he had practically been able to sweep aside Yin souls. He had only been afraid of the Skeleton Saint Tool. Now that he had become a Saint, his fighting spirit was naturally blazing, and he wanted to battle the Skeleton Saint Tool.
The others were all mediocre, and did not garner his interest to battle at all.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

He was extremely casual. Sometimes he would throw punches, sometimes he would kick, and sometimes he would use the murderous aura to attack, but no matter what, with a single strike, thousands of Yin souls would be killed by him.
This was a completely one-sided battle. In fact, even the Yin Saint didn’t dare to step forward.
Even without using Destructive Energy, killing the Yin Saint would be child’s play for Ling Han now.

In the past, he would change locations with every strike, fearing that he would be targeted by the Netherworld, who would lay out an inescapable net to besiege and kill him. Now, he was completely unafraid.
Who cares who comes? Worse come to worst, I’ll use the Imperial Weapon to tear a hole, and completely leave calmly.

He killed for seven consecutive days, killing all the enemies in the surrounding dozen over galaxies. There was not a single Yin soul left, and further away, the dozen over Yin Saints were all looking at him coldly, shock visible in their empty eyes.
They had never seen such battle prowess before.
Ling Han looked at these Yin Saints, and said calmly, "Why did you guys invade the Living Realm? If anyone can tell me the reason, I can spare his life!"
Though there were more than a dozen galaxies separating them, his divine sense was too strong, and easily transmitted this message to every Yin Saint.
Yin souls didn’t have a physical body; it was just a soul.
These Yin Saints were all cold, completely unmoved.

"Since that is the case, then you all shall surrender your lives!" Ling Han took a step forwards, and Phoenix Wings Divine Flight spread out. A pair of flaming wings blotted out the skies and covered the earth. They were actually even larger than a galaxy. With a light flap, he had already appeared in front of the Yin Saints.
’Holy f*ck! How is he so quick?!’
These Yin Saints were all shocked. Previously, Ling Han had swept through the desolate lands, but he had never used this kind of extreme speed, causing them to be extremely passive.
Peng!

Ling Han shot out a punch, and the power of his fist turned into a streak of light that blasted towards a Yin Saint. As high as 25 flashes of eight-star Regulations were fused within, and this was without using the power of belief. Otherwise, Ling Han’s current limit was 30 flashes of eight-star Regulations.
It could be said that even if the ancient Imperial Sons had reached the level of nine-star Saint, then if they used the power of belief, the number of Regulations would only be equal to Ling Han’s.
In a situation when their cultivation levels were equal, who wouldn’t be trampled under Ling Han’s feet?

Unless it was Ding Shu and the other Genesis World Rulers, they were definitely more freakish than the ancient Imperial Sons. However, they were only two or three minor levels above Ling Han, and without an absolute lead, they were still no match for Ling Han.
It could be said that Ling Han was indeed the strongest Saint in the world. This was not an exaggeration in the slightest.
The fist of light struck, its speed indescribably fast. That Yin Saint didn’t even have the time to dodge, and could only be forced to parry.
However, his resistance was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot, completely meaningless.
A brilliant light burst forth, and the fist of light crushed down. That Yin Saint was instantly turned into ash.
Ling Han could feel that the heaven and earth had rewarded him, slightly improving his life force.
—Now, even the reward for killing the Yin Saint was so measly?
Ling Han shook his head, but even so, it did not affect his determination to kill Yin souls.
Since he had already become a Saint, he would kill Yin souls until they trembled in fear — if they still had the courage and heart.
Peng! Peng! Peng!

He threw a casual punch, but the fist light was like a shooting star, indescribably fast, forcing the Yin Saint to have no choice but to take it head-on, and the result of taking it head-on would be having both his form and spirit destroyed.
This was the might of the strongest Saint.
The Yin Saints were all terrified. They hurriedly turned around and fled.
It was difficult to kill Saints, because they could still flee if they were no match. This was also applicable to Yin Saints.
However, don’t forget that Ling Han had grasped the fastest movement technique in the world.
With a flap of his fiery wings, he had already caught up to a Yin Saint. With a punch, peng, this Yin Saint was instantly blown up.
What Saint? In front of him, they were practically trash.
If there was still Galaxy Network at this time, and someone was broadcasting live, then the whole universe would be in an uproar.
This was far too powerful! Was this really a Saint?
To definitely be capable of killing a Saint if he wanted to, this was practically a Pseudo-Emperor.

However, the Saints were indeed very fast. Even if they were all inferior to Ling Han, with this delay, the other Yin Saints had long since fled without a trace. Even if he wanted to give chase, he did not know where to start.
It didn’t matter.
Ling Han continued to advance, and continued to sweep through the enemy ranks.
After conquering over a hundred galaxies, he arrived in front of an extinguished sun.
The first step to transform the Living Realm into the Netherworld was to extinguish the sun, and if Ling Han wanted to revive the Living Realm, the first step would also be to reignite the sun.
This was the flame of life.
"Burn." Ling Han injected power into the sun, but this sun was lifeless, and showed no signs of burning again.
’Hmm?’
Ling Han humphed, and channelled the Heavenly Dao Flames again. This time, it was different. There were veined patterns glowing on the surface of the sun, as if lava was surging underneath.
Boom, the whole sun suddenly began to burn fiercely, exuding endless brilliance in the dark universe.
Ling Han smiled. Though this was like a solitary light in the boundless darkness, it was a light filled with hope, like a totem.
This marked the first step for him to recover the lost territory of the Living Realm.
"Once I leave, the Netherworld will definitely make a comeback and destroy the sun again."
"Thus!"
Ling Han smiled, and walked into the sun.
If the sun exploded, then even Saints would have to retreat. If they were directly hit, even if they did not die, they would be crippled.
However, it was not a big deal to just walk into the sun.
He made arrangements, then walked out, and continued to reignite the other suns.
As long as the sun burned brightly, every galaxy would slowly recover its vitality, and the darkness... would eventually recede.
One, two, three, more and more suns lit up, causing this galaxy to no longer be dark.
All of a sudden, Ling Han felt a terrifying aura approaching.
He stopped, and looked towards the dark space.

A colossal creature was approaching at an incredibly fast speed. In only an instant, "he" had already stopped thirty thousand meters in front of Ling Han. His body was completely made up of white bone, exuding a terrifying aura.
The Skeleton Saint Tool!
Finally, the Netherworld unleashed their most powerful attacks.
Ling Han smiled faintly. Very good, the Skeleton Saint Tool had finally arrived.
Boom!
The Skeleton Saint Tool didn’t have any emotions, and it wouldn’t speak any words of coercion. It immediately lashed out, unleashing a palm strike that unleashed a devastating aura toward Ling Han.
This was practically a Saint Tool, and it was not just one Saint Tool at that. Instead, it was the combination of over a hundred Saint Tools. Just how terrifying was that?

chapters.title: Chapter 4695: Resistance
paragraphs: In the past, Ling Han would have immediately fled upon seeing the Skeleton Saint Tool.
To say nothing of him, even the Nine-Star Saint was no exception to this rule. Fighting head-on against such an existence would be seeking death.
With over a hundred Saint Tools attacking him at the same time, who in the world would be able to stop them?
No matter what, it had to be a Pseudo-Emperor.
But now, Ling Han was itching to give it a try.
Would he... be able to match this?
With a soft exclamation, he went all out, extracting the power of belief and turning it into his strongest punch.
Boom!
He threw a punch, which clashed with the Skeleton Saint Tool.

The moment they came into contact, Ling Han felt a terrifying power surge over, and he was directly sent flying. Meanwhile, countless blades of Regulations slashed over, wanting to blast him into smithereens.

In the past, it wasn’t that he hadn’t parried a move before, but he had only parried it from afar. There was also the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to reduce its destructive power, but now, he was completely on his own.
He retreated explosively for more than 5,000 km, and the might of this blow finally surged past him.
Ling Han bared his teeth. A great many bloody marks had been left on his body, but thankfully, he had not sustained any serious injuries. It did not affect his battle prowess at all.
On the other hand, the Skeleton Saint Tool was completely unscathed.
This was truly terrifying. Not only was his battle prowess boundlessly strong, but his defenses were also so freakish.
It should be known that Ling Han had shot out 30 eight-star Regulations, and they actually did not hurt the Skeleton Saint Tool in the slightest.
As expected of a war machine made up of Saint Tools.

With a sweep of his divine sense, he discovered that a great many Yin Saints had already made a comeback, and were presently pouncing towards the multiple suns. Clearly, they wanted to destroy the suns again, so that the universe that had just been revitalized a little would once again be transformed into Netherworld.
Ling Han didn’t try to stop them. He was being targeted by a Skeleton Saint Tool, so how could he find the time?
It was also because of this that those Yin Saints were bold enough to extinguish the suns without worry.
Boom!

The Skeleton Saint Tool took a step forwards, and its speed was frighteningly fast, far surpassing any ordinary Saint Tool. No wonder it could make all the Saints tremble in fear upon hearing its name. It was really only slightly inferior to a Pseudo-Emperor.
It moved again, delivering a palm strike at Ling Han.
The attacks were extremely simple, without any fancy moves, but they were also extremely practical, without the slightest bit of power wasted.
The large hand struck out, like the palm of an apocalyptic demon.
Ling Han shouted loudly, unafraid of facing it head-on, and this time, he used Destructive Energy.
Peng!
With this strike, Ling Han was once again sent flying. However, the Skeleton Saint Tool’s body also flashed wildly with brilliance, which then dimmed slightly.

Destructive Energy was still very effective, and caused a certain amount of damage. However, the Skeleton Saint Tool was made up of over a hundred Saint Tools, and they divided the destructive power of Destructive Energy among themselves, so it was difficult to cause any destructive damage.
In this exchange, it could be considered a tie. Ling Han was sent flying, and there were many light injuries all over his body. The Skeleton Saint Tool had also suffered a slight loss.
If other Saints were present, they would definitely grab their heads and exclaim in shock.
Finally, someone managed to withstand the head-on attack of the Skeleton Saint Tool. Furthermore, this was based on the premise that they would not use the Imperial Weapon at all.
"Ah!"
"Ah!"
Right at this moment, a powerful shockwave traveled over. That was a tragic scream on the level of divine sense.
It could be seen that in the distance, multiple suns were spitting out Destructive Energy, burning the Yin Saints that had made a move into nothing.

Ling Han smiled faintly. Previously, he had made arrangements, and left the Destructive Energy in every sun. Now that these Yin Saints had gone to extinguish the sun, it naturally triggered the Destructive Energy.
This Destructive Energy, boosted by the power of the sun, suddenly exploded, and even the Yin Saints were directly killed.
Boom! However, the Skeleton Saint Tool remained unfazed. With a wave of its hand, it launched another attack.
Ling Han raised his fist to parry each blow head-on, unafraid.
Hong! Hong! Hong!
They battled fiercely, neither gaining the upper hand, resulting in a stalemate.
In the distance, the Yin Saints did not dare to make another move, fearing that they too would be destroyed in form and spirit.
As they watched the intense battle between Ling Han and the Skeleton Saint Tool, they all looked stunned.
Too strong!
How could there be such a powerful Saint?
Moreover, Ling Han was only a One-Star Saint.
If this guy advanced into Two Stars, then his abilities would definitely soar to a new level.
Then what about three stars, or four stars?
With his freakish talent, he could easily reach five stars. At that time, would the Skeleton Saint Tool be able to stop him?
Hiss, he was holding back the waves with his own power. This was the bearing of a Great Emperor.
However, the Yin Saints immediately calmed down, because when it came to Great Emperors, they had a total of 12 on their side.
Even if Ling Han had become Emperor, how could he have any chance of winning in a battle of one against twelve?
At that time, Xuan Taiyu was strong enough, wasn’t he? Yet, he was still heavily injured, and soon died.
Ling Han also frowned.
Though he could now hold up to the Skeleton Saint Tool, this was only one.
How many Skeleton Saint Tools did the Netherworld possess?
There were at least close to a hundred of them.
What if two of them joined forces?
This was enough to make him suffer, and if there were three or four of them, then even he would have to flee upon hearing the news.
Strength, strength was still not enough.
Ling Han gritted his teeth. He definitely had to break through to Two Stars as soon as possible, and accommodate more Regulations. Only then would he be able to fight against two, three or four.
The Skeleton Saint Tool moved as quick as lightning. It was born for battle.
Ling Han humphed, and summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

Though he had the Imperial Weapon, this was ultimately not something that he had personally refined, and there was a barrier between them. Secondly, reviving the Imperial Weapon was too exhausting, and even he could not bear it.
Thus, it was naturally best to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
As his cultivation level increased, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also became a Saint Tool.
Just how terrifying was a Saint Tool forged from Origin Gold?
Boom, lightning channelled, striking out at the Skeleton Saint Tool.
It was only a single strike, and the Skeleton Saint Tool was forced back. It was actually even more powerful than Ling Han’s own attack.

It couldn’t be helped. Th Origin Gold already possessed the potential to become the strongest in the world, and it was only limited by Ling Han’s cultivation level that it couldn’t unleash its full potential.

But now, Ling Han had already become a Saint, and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had also become a Saint Tool. It was just a little bit away from becoming an Imperial Weapon, so how could its might not be strong?

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower hovered above Ling Han’s head. The aura of Primal Chaos descended, forming an incredibly powerful defense. Ling Han himself shot out a punch, blasting the Skeleton Saint Tool madly.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
Under his powerful attacks, the Skeleton Saint Tool retreated continuously. It was actually completely outmatched.

However, the defenses of the Skeleton Saint Tool were far too terrifying, and it wasn’t damaged even after being attacked for so long. More than 100 Saint Tools divided the damage equally among themselves, so it would be extremely difficult to kill it.
Of course, this was unless Ling Han was powerful enough to obliterate over a hundred Saint Tools with a single strike. Only then would he be able to succeed.
To say nothing of him, perhaps even a Pseudo-Emperor was not that awesome, right?
The Yin Saint s were all trembling. Just looking at this kind of Saint was enough to make them shiver.
Weng, right at this moment, another frightening aura assaulted, and a massive figure appeared in the distant space.
This was the second Skeleton Saint Tool!
Boom! This Skeleton Saint Tool didn’t speak any nonsense at all—perhaps it couldn’t speak at all. Why would this war machine have the ability to speak?
It directly charged over, and delivered a palm strike. Saintly might diffused through the air.
Peng!
The two Skeleton Saint Tools joined forces, and their battle prowess naturally soared.
With the help of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, Ling Han could fight to a tie. However, this was also his limit.

chapters.title: Chapter 4696: An army bearing down on the border
paragraphs: The two Skeleton Saint Tools surrounded Ling Han.

If word of this battle could spread throughout the universe, Ling Han’s name would definitely spread throughout the universe, and he would instantly become publicly acknowledged as the greatest Saint in the universe.
This was the Skeleton Saint Tool! Just how powerful was it? It was so powerful that any Saint would have no option but to flee upon seeing it.
However, Ling Han was actually capable of not falling into a disadvantage in a battle of two against one.
This!
Wasn’t he the greatest Saint in the world?
Aside from Pseudo-Emperor, who else could compare?
However, after only a short while, a third Skeleton Saint Tool arrived.

Ling Han was not the slightest bit surprised that the Netherworld would react so quickly, because the Chang Clan was standing on the side of the Netherworld, and had grasped the Galaxy Network, so the news was naturally transmitted in real time.
These were three Skeleton Saint Tools!
Even with Ling Han’s freakish talent, he still had no option but to fall into a disadvantage.
However, he held on stubbornly. Though he was at a disadvantage, he was still undefeated.
However, were there only three Skeleton Saint Tools?
Of course not.
Only a while later, the fourth Skeleton Saint Tool appeared.
This time, even Ling Han couldn’t hold on any longer.
The limit of what he could resist was three Skeleton Saint Tools. If there were four of them, he would not be able to match them.
Retreat!
He did not choose to confront them head-on, and chose to retreat.
"You want to flee?" Di Wuji appeared. He summoned the Imperial Weapon, which he shot towards Ling Han.
Not only him, but Tong Ming also unleashed his Imperial Weapon.
Ling Han no longer hesitated. The Clear Bamboo Sword awakened, and Imperial Might spread out, forcibly carving out a path.
Then, he used the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, instantly fleeing millions and millions of km away.
With his extreme speed, if a Pseudo-Emperor didn’t appear, who could compete with him?
After throwing off his pursuers, he tore a rip into space and returned to the Four Origin Planet.
"I can only match three Skeleton Saint Tools?" Ling Han frowned. His abilities were far from enough.
The number of Netherworld’s Skeleton Saint Tools was in the hundreds. If they attacked together, even a Pseudo-Emperor would have to give them a wide berth.
"I need to break through!"
But when one had reached Saint Tier, how could breaking through be done just by thinking about it?
Ling Han switched directions, and again caused a heavy blow to the Netherworld. Only when the Skeleton Saint Tools joined forces against him did he retreat.
After several times, the invasion of the Netherworld had no choice but to stop.
It had to be admitted that Ling Han was too strong. He practically dominated the battle situation single-handedly.
However, the Netherworld weren’t idiots.
On this day, Ling Han was resting at Four Origin Planet when he suddenly sensed a powerful aura assaulting.
He immediately leaped into space, and shockingly discovered that twelve Skeleton Saint Tools had arrived together.
This!

This was enough to drive one to despair. Even though Ling Han was incredibly powerful, fighting against three of them alone was already his limit. However, there were 12 Skeleton Saint Tools, so how could he block them?
It was unknown who was the Netherworld’s strategist, to have directly struck at Ling Han’s weakness.
Shi Gang appeared before Ling Han. He wore a cold expression as he glared at Ling Han. There was a powerful hatred in his eyes.
"Ling Han, you wouldn’t have thought that you would have such a day, right?!"
By Ling Han’s side, Brother Monkey, the large black dog, the empress, and the other Saints all appeared, frowning deeply.
With so many Skeleton Saint Tools, how were they supposed to block them?
Imperial Weapon?
Ling Han had it, but so did the other side. They cancelled each other out, and the Skeleton Saint Tools could not be blocked either.
"You are nothing but a vile character who is momentarily conceited," Ling Han said with a shake of his head. "What right does a defeated opponent have to speak so boldly?"
Shi Gang’s expression changed drastically. This person was the most narrow-minded, and Ling Han had struck a sore spot, causing him to feel extremely terrible.

"Humph, you’ve become a trapped beast today. Let’s see how you can still be arrogant!" He humphed, and with a wave of his hand, the Skeleton Saint Tools immediately moved at the same time, charging towards Four Origin Planet.
What could they do?
Ling Han handed the Clear Bamboo Sword over to Brother Monkey, while the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower hovered above his head, heading towards the Skeleton Saint Tools.
Brother Monkey resuscitated the Imperial Weapon and raised a barrier for the Four Origin Planet. This blocked the Skeleton Saint Tools, but how long it could last was an extremely serious problem.
Of course, the large black dog, the little azure dragon, the empress and the others could also fight. However, there were only so many Saints, and their numbers could be counted.
"Father, let us help you!"
The seven Calabash Brothers rushed over, and as Ling Han advanced into Saint Tier, their strength also rose accordingly, advancing into Saint Tier.
However, they had their own limitations. They were unable to revive a Saint Tool.
According to Brother Monkey, they were actually the manifestations of a Saint Tool. Since that was the case, it was naturally impossible for them to activate the Imperial Weapon.
However, what use was a Saint Tool against a Skeleton Saint Tool?
Only the Imperial Weapon could suppress everything.

There was not the slightest change in the bodies of the seven Calabash Brothers. They still looked like the babies they had been several hundred years ago. They gave a soft exclamation in their childish voices, and the seven children instantly crashed into each other.
Then, with a flash of brilliance, they actually fused together, turning into... a large seven-coloured gourd.
This!
Ling Han felt powerless to complain. Why was it still a gourd?
However, he discovered that the aura exuding from this seven-coloured gourd was actually incredibly shocking. Though it was still Saint Tier, it was superior to any ordinary Saint Tool.
Yi, was this also a combination Saint Tool?
Furthermore, this could be split into seven babies, and all of them had intelligence, no different from a real person.
This caused Ling Han to become suspicious. Could a Saint forge such a Spirit Tool?
Impossible!
Absolutely impossible!

Hence, this was definitely not forged by the Ancient Sun Saint. It was not that Ling Han looked down on this Saint, but rather that Saints really could not do so. In fact, even the Great Emperor could not.
Just look at the Skeleton Saint Tool. It was indeed powerful, but did it have any intelligence?
A thought suddenly flashed through his mind.
The great fissure at the edge of the universe.
Could it be that this was where the seed of the gourd had come from?
Otherwise, how could there be such an amazing Saint Tool?
Who cares!

Ling Han discovered that his divine sense was connected to the seven-colored gourd. With a single thought, he could control this Saint Tool. Furthermore, there was no need for him to expend any energy at all, because this was actually being controlled by seven babies. He was only playing the role of commander.
Boom! A streak of light shot out from the seven-colored gourd and struck at a Skeleton Saint Tool.
The Skeleton Saint Tool was actually sent flying by this strike.
What powerful attack power!

Ling Han nodded internally. It could be imagined that the Ancient Sun Saint definitely hadn’t been able to unleash the true power of the infants. Otherwise, even if several hundred Yin Saints had come, they would definitely have been defeated by the combined forces of the infants.
M-hm, perhaps those babies had only been a seed at that time, and had been accidentally obtained by the Ancient Sun Saint.
No matter what, it was fine as long as they were strong enough.
Ling Han also launched an attack himself, blocking the attacks of three Skeleton Saint Tools.
Now, he had blocked three of them, while the babies had blocked one. There were still eight remaining, and they were all blocked by the Imperial Weapon.

From the looks of things now, the Four Origin Planet could still hold on. However, Shi Gang definitely also had an Imperial Weapon, which he hadn’t unleashed yet. Moreover, on the side of the Four Origin Planet, how long could the Clear Bamboo Sword be maintained in a state of recovery?
Ling Han was filled with anxiety. Could it be that he would have to watch helplessly as Four Origin Planet was destroyed?
He became ruthless, a cold light flickering in his eyes.
He was going to give it his all!
He shook his fist, and not only was the Destructive Energy entwined around him, he even used the holy flame.

He was going all out. The holy flame was the foundation of Saints. Once it was completely burnt, one would fall out of Saint Tier, and Ling Han was only a One Star Saint. The holy flame was only the size of a human head. Though it was much larger than the holy flame of an ordinary One Star Saint, how long could it last?
"Charge!" Ling Han charged out resolutely.

They were unable to revive a Saint Tool.
According to Brother Monkey, they were actually the manifestations of a Saint Tool.
Since that was the case, it was naturally impossible for them to activate the Imperial Weapon.
However, what use was a Saint Tool against a Skeleton Saint Tool?
Only the Imperial Weapon could suppress everything.
There was not the slightest change in the bodies of the seven Calabash Brothers.
They still looked like the babies they had been several hundred years ago.
They gave a soft exclamation in their childish voices, and the seven children instantly crashed into each other.
Then, with a flash of brilliance, they actually fused together, turning into... a large seven-coloured gourd.
This!
Ling Han felt powerless to complain.
Why was it still a gourd?
However, he discovered that the aura exuding from this seven-coloured gourd was actually incredibly shocking.
Though it was still Saint Tier, it was superior to any ordinary Saint Tool.
Yi, was this also a combination Saint Tool?
Furthermore, this could be split into seven babies, and all of them had intelligence, no different from a real person.
This caused Ling Han to become suspicious.
Could a Saint forge such a Spirit Tool?
Impossible!
Absolutely impossible!
Hence, this was definitely not forged by the Ancient Sun Saint.
It was not that Ling Han looked down on this Saint, but rather that Saints really could not do so.
In fact, even the Great Emperor could not.
Just look at the Skeleton Saint Tool.
It was indeed powerful, but did it have any intelligence?
A thought suddenly flashed through his mind.
The great fissure at the edge of the universe.
Could it be that this was where the seed of the gourd had come from?
Otherwise, how could there be such an amazing Saint Tool?
Who cares!
Ling Han discovered that his divine sense was connected to the seven-colored gourd.
With a single thought, he could control this Saint Tool.
Furthermore, there was no need for him to expend any energy at all, because this was actually being controlled by seven babies.
He was only playing the role of commander.
Boom!
A streak of light shot out from the seven-colored gourd and struck at a Skeleton Saint Tool.
The Skeleton Saint Tool was actually sent flying by this strike.
What powerful attack power!
Ling Han nodded internally.
It could be imagined that the Ancient Sun Saint definitely hadn’t been able to unleash the true power of the infants.
Otherwise, even if several hundred Yin Saints had come, they would definitely have been defeated by the combined forces of the infants.
M-hm, perhaps those babies had only been a seed at that time, and had been accidentally obtained by the Ancient Sun Saint.
No matter what, it was fine as long as they were strong enough.
Ling Han also launched an attack himself, blocking the attacks of three Skeleton Saint Tools.
Now, he had blocked three of them, while the babies had blocked one.
There were still eight remaining, and they were all blocked by the Imperial Weapon.
From the looks of things now, the Four Origin Planet could still hold on.
However, Shi Gang definitely also had an Imperial Weapon, which he hadn’t unleashed yet.
Moreover, on the side of the Four Origin Planet, how long could the Clear Bamboo Sword be maintained in a state of recovery?
Ling Han was filled with anxiety.
Could it be that he would have to watch helplessly as Four Origin Planet was destroyed?
He became ruthless, a cold light flickering in his eyes.
He was going to give it his all!
He shook his fist, and not only was the Destructive Energy entwined around him, he even used the holy flame.
He was going all out.
The holy flame was the foundation of Saints.
Once it was completely burnt, one would fall out of Saint Tier, and Ling Han was only a One Star Saint.
The holy flame was only the size of a human head.
Though it was much larger than the holy flame of an ordinary One Star Saint, how long could it last?
"Charge!" Ling Han charged out resolutely.

chapters.title: Chapter 4697: Going all out
paragraphs: Ling Han rushed in front of a Skeleton Saint Tool, and shot out a punch.
This time, he was really going all out. He had even used the holy flame.
Boom! The punch arrived, yet the Skeleton Saint Tool wasn’t stupid either. It immediately raised its fist to block the attack.
The two fists that were extremely different in size crashed into each other, immediately releasing a blinding light. The Regulations exploded, forming a powerful shockwave.
Peng! Ling Han was instantly sent flying. In terms of power, he was still inferior to the Skeleton Saint Tool.
5,000 kilometers away, Ling Han stopped, and when the light completely dissipated, the entire right hand of the Skeleton Saint Tool had dimmed, and there was no longer any sign of saintly might.
This!
The right hand of the Skeleton Saint Tool had actually been forcefully destroyed.

It should be known that the Skeleton Saint Tool was equivalent to a combination of over a hundred Saint Tools. Now, its right hand had dimmed, which was equivalent to several Saint Tools having been destroyed, and could no longer show their might.
The might of Ling Han’s punch was actually so terrifying!

This was something that even Ling Han hadn’t expected. He raised his fist to take a look. The combination of the Destructive Energy and the holy flame had actually exploded with such astonishing destructive power?

He had once guessed that the Destructive Energy had originated from the abyss at the edge of the universe, and there was no need to mention the Seed of the Holy Flame. It must have come from there, or it was even highly possible that Genesis World rulers such as himself and Ding Shu, and the others had also come from the abyss of the universe, and that was why they were so freakish.

Then, it could be imagined that when the beings at the three great abysses at the edge of the universe joined forces, they would resonate, and explode with destructive power that surpassed their cultivation level.
Ling Han couldn’t imagine this scene, and those people from the Netherworld couldn’t imagine it even more.

One after another, the Yin Saints were all dumbfounded, completely unable to believe what they had seen. Meanwhile, Shi Gang was also surprised. He still had the Imperial Weapon in his hand, which he had not shot out yet. This was meant to deliver a fatal blow to Ling Han.
How was this possible?

The Skeleton Saint Tool had been created by the Great Emperors after they had entered into the abyss of the universe. It possessed battle prowess that could crush all Saints. In fact, even against a Pseudo-Emperor, it was unafraid. With over a hundred Saint Tools dividing the destructive power among themselves, it was completely indestructible.
However, a punch from Ling Han actually damaged a few Saint Tools.
Though this did not have much effect on the Skeleton Saint Tool, if he threw a few more punches, even something as strong as the Skeleton Saint Tool could possibly be shattered.
Ling Han laughed loudly. This was a new discovery.
He used Phoenix Wings Divine Flight, and charged towards that Skeleton Saint Tool from before.
Injuring all of a man’s fingers is not as effective as chopping off one!
However, the other two Skeleton Saint Tools immediately came over to block him, exerting pressure on Ling Han and preventing him from succeeding.

Ling Han was already fighting with his life on the line. With a battle cry, he charged forwards to meet the attack. The holy flame and Destructive Energy fused together, turning into a terrifying destructive power. So what if it was the Skeleton Saint Tool? As long as it was hit, it would definitely be damaged.
Even though the attacks of the Skeleton Saint Tool were powerful, it wasn’t intelligent like the babies. It would only battle to the death against its opponents.
Under normal circumstances, with their powerful battle prowess, they would naturally be invincible. This was an advantage.

However, things were different now. Ling Han’s destructive ability was far too terrifying. Moreover, these Skeleton Saint Tools were fighting to the death and refusing to retreat. They would face Ling Han’s attacks head-on, and the damage they suffered was also incredibly terrifying.
Shi Gang hurriedly issued an order for the three Skeleton Saint Tools to retreat. Otherwise, it was really possible that they would die here.
It should be known that the Skeleton Saint Tool was a weapon that they had used to sweep aside all opposition in this world. Otherwise, could they rely on the Yin Saints alone?
What a joke. Though there were many Yin Saints, their battle prowess was far from being comparable to a true Saint.

He looked at Ling Han with jealousy. When he thought about how Ling Han had entered into the Sacred Land and become a Saint after obtaining the great fortune in the Pool of Life, he was filled with anger.
You have benefited from the glory of the Buddhist Race, and that is why you have the glory that you have now!
And this should have been his.
The first generation Buddha Son!

Ling Han also stopped his attacks. The more the holy flame was used up, the less there would be left. He didn’t want to waste it, and as long as he advanced into Two Stars, his battle prowess would naturally be greatly improved, and he wouldn’t be forced into such a miserable state.
Shi Gang activated the Imperial Weapon and charged at Ling Han. However, Brother Monkey also charged over with the Clear Bamboo Sword in hand.
Boom!
In a clash of Imperial Weapons, who would be weaker than the other?

Meanwhile, Ling Han charged toward the remaining eight Skeleton Saint Tools. Although he was definitely no match for eight Skeleton Saint Tools at once, he had also caused great damage to these Skeleton Saint Tools.
After battling for half a day, Shi Gang had no choice but to call a ceasefire.
If it was just an Imperial Weapon, it would not be enough to destroy Four Origin Planet.
"Ling Han, when I make a comeback, the Nine Suns Holy Land will be destroyed," he said balefully.

He had initially thought that this assault would be an absolutely one-sided suppression, yet he had no choice but to return in defeat, causing him to lose all face. Thus, he definitely had to say these words.
Ling Han said coldly, "Bring it on, and see how I chop off your dog’s head."
"Woof!" the large black dog shouted in displeasure. You can’t insult me as well like this, all right?
"Fine, I’ll chop off your pig head." Ling Han changed his words.
"Gu, gu, gu!" This time, the pervert pig was displeased. Did Uncle Pig trifle with you?
Ling Han hadn’t even opened his mouth, when he saw the little azure dragon glaring at him.
Er... you already know to snatch my lines first.
Shi Gang was almost angered to death. None of these people took him seriously.
He humphed, and with a wave of his hand, retreated with his troops.
He swore that the next time he came, he would definitely destroy Four Origin Planet.
Ling Han’s revenge?
Hehe, what need was there for him to be concerned? Even if he did not destroy Four Origin Planet, Ling Han was still sniping the Netherworld everywhere.
So, this was their revenge, all right?
After Shi Gang and the others left, Ling Han didn’t give chase.
The other side had the Imperial Weapon, as well as twelve Skeleton Saint Tools. This kind of power was too powerful, and there was absolutely no way to destroy them.
Most importantly, Ling Han’s holy flame was limited, and couldn’t withstand this kind of exhaustion.
"Next time, what if they come with two Imperial Weapons, and send out twenty or thirty Skeleton Saint Tools?" Ling Han frowned.
He could cause damage to the Skeleton Saint Tool, but that did not mean that he was invincible.
On the other hand, if a dozen or so Skeleton Saint Tools attacked him at the same time, even if one or two of them would be destroyed, it would still be enough to blast him into smithereens.
Moreover, two Imperial Weapons were enough to suppress the Clear Bamboo Sword.
If Ling Han was all alone, then there was absolutely no need for him to be afraid. If he couldn’t win, he could just run.
But now, he could run, but what about the Four Origin Planet?
"I have to think of some way to unite the Imperial Clans."
"There are at least a few dozen Imperial Clans in the world, and if these powers are pulled together, they would be completely capable of fighting against the Skeleton Saint Tools."
"Alright, I’ll go and ’convince’ them to join."
This time, he planned to use both force and persuasion. It was best if you agreed, but even if you didn’t, you would have no choice.
He brought the Imperial Weapon and began to move.
Time was limited, and he had to make the most of it.
The first stop was naturally Donglin Imperial Clan.
After hearing his reason for coming, the Chi Clan immediately decided to join the alliance that Ling Han had advocated.
—Firstly, Ling Han was the son-in-law of the Chi Clan, so no matter what, he was one of their own. Secondly, Ling Han had already become a Saint, and had grown to become a powerful backer.
Ling Han didn’t stop, and for the second stop, he chose Ziwei Imperial Clan.

chapters.title: Chapter 4698: Zhen Baili
paragraphs: Ling Han chose Ziwei Imperial Clan for his second stop.
He had a grudge with a great many Imperial Clans, and the one he had the greatest grudge with was definitely the Baili Clan.
Since he had already become a Saint, he naturally had to keep his promise.
Ling Han released his divine sense and searched for the planet where the Ziwei Clan was located. After a short while, a smile appeared at the corners of his lips.
Found it.

Saints were awesome indeed. They could absorb Regulations, and assimilate with the heaven and earth. It was as if the heaven and earth had become a part of their bodies, and it would be too easy to find a planet.
Of course, this was only limited to searching for planets. He couldn’t use this to locate a person.

Ling Han tore open the Void and rushed over with Phoenix Wings Divine Flight. After only two days, he reappeared from the Void, only to see that there were shockingly 27 planets floating in front of him.
It was as if these planets were fitted with some kind of propulsion device. They were not orbiting around a certain sun at all, but were rather heading straight ahead.
This wasn’t strange.
Saint-level formations were definitely laid out on every planet, forming a continuous propulsive force that headed towards the edge of the universe.
Tsk, the Ziwei Imperial Clan was truly rich and imposing, being able to set up 27 Saint-level formations in one go.

It should be known that formations needed formation foundations to set up, and the higher the level of the formation, the rarer and more precious the formation foundations needed. That was even more so the case for Saint-level formations.
After being robbed by Ling Han and Brother Monkey, the Ziwei Imperial Clan could actually set up 27 Saint-level formations?
Thus, a cunning rabbit has three burrows. Looks like what Brother Monkey had emptied out previously was only one of the treasure chambers of the Baili Clan.
Among these 27 planets, one was obviously larger, and the other 26 planets added together might only be this big.
This was the Ziwei Planet.
Ling Han had already been here once, so he was naturally familiar with this place. With a single step, he had already landed on the Ziwei Planet.
This wasn’t the core area of the Ziwei Imperial Clan, so it wasn’t very heavily guarded. Ling Han walked around casually, and no one came to ask for his identity.
However, this place was bustling with noise and excitement, as if it was completely unaffected by the invasion of the Yin souls.
Ling Han made some queries, and couldn’t help but reveal a strange expression.
Because today was Baili Tian’s wedding day.
This guy was getting married again?

Previously, he had wanted to marry Chi Menghan, but in the end, Ling Han barged into the wedding venue, defeated the groom, and snatched the bride from him. This caused Baili Tian to be utterly humiliated.
And now, this guy actually dispelled his psychological trauma, and was getting married again?
En.
Ling Han rested his chin on his hand. He had actually come here at such a coincidental time. It must be heaven’s will.
Alright, the will of the heavens told him to cause trouble again, so how could he act in defiance of the will of heaven?
—If the large black dog knew about this, his expression would definitely be filled with disdain. Since when did you not act in a heaven-defying manner?
However, Ling Han was very excited about ruining Baili Tian’s wedding.
Moreover, he couldn’t just stand by and watch as some girl fell into a tiger’s den.
This was called saving a life, which would garner more blessing than building a seven-storey pagoda.
This was what the Ancestral Buddha had said.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
Thus, Ling Han walked slowly and leisurely towards the main venue of the wedding.

Ever since the incident of Ling Han and Brother Monkey sneaking in, all banquets that involved inviting outsiders, such as the 100,000-year-old birthday of an elder, the 500,000-year-old birthday celebration, or the wedding of some prodigy, were not held in the ancestral grounds..
They were all outside the Great Emperor Formation. The ancestral grounds were heavily guarded, and not even a fly could fly in.

Thus, the main venue for Baili Tian’s wedding was also arranged to be held at Xuanyun City. This was the largest city outside of the ancestral grounds. There were many guests here, and all of them were smiling. They did not look like refugees at all.
True, with the collective relocation of 27 planets, they could completely form their own society. Even if the galaxy fell, they would still be able to live well.
Thus, some people were short-sighted, only looking at the present, and getting by.

Ling Han made some queries about the bride, and shockingly discovered that Baili Tian was actually very popular. His bride was shockingly another noble daughter of an Imperial Clan, but not the Imperial Daughter.
After all, in the cultivation world, there were more men than women. Among the top-notch elites, the number of women was relatively small.
Of course, there had also been existences like Empress Qingzhu, who had reigned supreme over an era, suppressing all the men in the world to the point that they had to bow their heads.

The partner that Baili Tian was marrying for a matrimonial alliance was a daughter of the Peacock Imperial Clan, and the bride was called Kong Ling’er. It was said that she was extremely beautiful. However, in this kind of matrimonial alliance, whether she was beautiful or not was not important. What was important was the significance that she represented.

It was very lively today, and there were as many guests as clouds. However, those that could come to Xuanyun City were all mighty figures, and as for the two Imperial Clans, to say nothing of Saints, there were tens of thousands of elites above Spirit Transformation Tier.
And this was still because it was currently a time of crisis. Otherwise, which sect wouldn’t give the Golden Generation some face during their wedding?
As for now? The majority of forces had already fallen, and those that had not died were still fleeing, so how could they have the time to attend some wedding?
Ling Han smiled. Since there were two Imperial Clans, this was just right, saving him the trouble of making another trip.
He sat at the side and began eating. No one cared if he was qualified to sit here or not.

In truth, there were too many elites. Though every single one of them had restrained their aura, added together, they still formed a powerful oppressive force. Without a high enough cultivation level, coming here would only be seeking their own humiliation.
Ling Han waited quietly. He was not in a rush to reveal his identity yet.
At noon, the banquet began, and dishes were served. However, there was still no sign of the bride and groom. They would definitely only come out during the evening banquet.

The Ziwei Imperial Clan didn’t move the sun along with them. This was relatively difficult. After all, the sun was a giant fireball, and it was difficult to set up formations. It wasn’t that it couldn’t be done, but the price was too high.
However, the Saint of the Ziwei Imperial Clan had still used his great power to create a sun. If it was only used to illuminate the Ziwei Imperial Clan, it was naturally more than enough.
Very quickly, the light dimmed, and the bright moon rose — this was also the handiwork of a Saint.
There were even more guests at night, and this was the real banquet.
A group of people were walking around, and this was a good opportunity for them to get to know people and expand their networks.

"This brother looks unfamiliar. How should I address you?" Just as Ling Han was eating and drinking with his head lowered, he saw someone approach with a wine cup in hand, taking the initiative to strike up a conversation.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "Gao Bupan?"
What kind of name was that?
That person thought for a moment, and immediately understood. This was <anno data-annotation-id="ceecde30-a5d6-4a09-a703-9f2e2c71e1d7" data-title="unattainable">unattainable1</anno>.
Hiss, was there anyone as shameless as you?
"Humph!" That person instantly flicked his sleeves and left.
Ling Han smiled, and continued to eat and drink. Later, he was going to cause a great commotion at the wedding, and he was not here to make friends.
After a while, he shockingly discovered that the person from before had actually come again. Furthermore, there was another person beside him, dressed in a tight-fitting green suit.
"I heard that you’re very proud!" the man in green said coldly.
Ling Han was surprised, "What does my pride have to do with you?"
"My name is Baili Bahuang!" the man in green said proudly.
Oh, so he was a member of the Baili Clan.
Ling Han glanced at him. This person was at the level of Sect Master. He was about a thousand years old, and it could be said that his natural talent was astonishing.
He smiled, "I also have another nickname, and that is Zhen <anno data-annotation-id="b9aeb799-b085-4445-b8c9-b894c82df5c6" data-title="Baili.">Baili.1</anno>"
<annotations style="display: none;">MC’s alias literally means that he was ’unattainable’.Literally translates to suppressing Baili Clan.</annotations>

Saint-level formations were definitely laid out on every planet, forming a continuous propulsive force that headed towards the edge of the universe.
Tsk, the Ziwei Imperial Clan was truly rich and imposing, being able to set up 27 Saint-level formations in one go.
It should be known that formations needed formation foundations to set up, and the higher the level of the formation, the rarer and more precious the formation foundations needed.
That was even more so the case for Saint-level formations.
After being robbed by Ling Han and Brother Monkey, the Ziwei Imperial Clan could actually set up 27 Saint-level formations?
Thus, a cunning rabbit has three burrows.
Looks like what Brother Monkey had emptied out previously was only one of the treasure chambers of the Baili Clan.
Among these 27 planets, one was obviously larger, and the other 26 planets added together might only be this big.
This was the Ziwei Planet.
Ling Han had already been here once, so he was naturally familiar with this place.
With a single step, he had already landed on the Ziwei Planet.
This wasn’t the core area of the Ziwei Imperial Clan, so it wasn’t very heavily guarded.
Ling Han walked around casually, and no one came to ask for his identity.
However, this place was bustling with noise and excitement, as if it was completely unaffected by the invasion of the Yin souls.
Ling Han made some queries, and couldn’t help but reveal a strange expression.
Because today was Baili Tian’s wedding day.
This guy was getting married again?
Previously, he had wanted to marry Chi Menghan, but in the end, Ling Han barged into the wedding venue, defeated the groom, and snatched the bride from him.
This caused Baili Tian to be utterly humiliated.
And now, this guy actually dispelled his psychological trauma, and was getting married again?
En.
Ling Han rested his chin on his hand.
He had actually come here at such a coincidental time.
It must be heaven’s will.
Alright, the will of the heavens told him to cause trouble again, so how could he act in defiance of the will of heaven?
—If the large black dog knew about this, his expression would definitely be filled with disdain.
Since when did you not act in a heaven-defying manner?
However, Ling Han was very excited about ruining Baili Tian’s wedding.
Moreover, he couldn’t just stand by and watch as some girl fell into a tiger’s den.
This was called saving a life, which would garner more blessing than building a seven-storey pagoda.
This was what the Ancestral Buddha had said.𝗳𝐫𝚎𝗲𝚠𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝘃𝚎𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺
Thus, Ling Han walked slowly and leisurely towards the main venue of the wedding.

Ever since the incident of Ling Han and Brother Monkey sneaking in, all banquets that involved inviting outsiders, such as the 100,000-year-old birthday of an elder, the 500,000-year-old birthday celebration, or the wedding of some prodigy, were not held in the ancestral grounds..
They were all outside the Great Emperor Formation.
The ancestral grounds were heavily guarded, and not even a fly could fly in.
Thus, the main venue for Baili Tian’s wedding was also arranged to be held at Xuanyun City.
This was the largest city outside of the ancestral grounds.
There were many guests here, and all of them were smiling.
They did not look like refugees at all.
True, with the collective relocation of 27 planets, they could completely form their own society.
Even if the galaxy fell, they would still be able to live well.
Thus, some people were short-sighted, only looking at the present, and getting by.
Ling Han made some queries about the bride, and shockingly discovered that Baili Tian was actually very popular.
His bride was shockingly another noble daughter of an Imperial Clan, but not the Imperial Daughter.
After all, in the cultivation world, there were more men than women.
Among the top-notch elites, the number of women was relatively small.
Of course, there had also been existences like Empress Qingzhu, who had reigned supreme over an era, suppressing all the men in the world to the point that they had to bow their heads.
The partner that Baili Tian was marrying for a matrimonial alliance was a daughter of the Peacock Imperial Clan, and the bride was called Kong Ling’er.
It was said that she was extremely beautiful.
However, in this kind of matrimonial alliance, whether she was beautiful or not was not important.
What was important was the significance that she represented.
It was very lively today, and there were as many guests as clouds.

However, those that could come to Xuanyun City were all mighty figures, and as for the two Imperial Clans, to say nothing of Saints, there were tens of thousands of elites above Spirit Transformation Tier.
And this was still because it was currently a time of crisis.
Otherwise, which sect wouldn’t give the Golden Generation some face during their wedding?
As for now?
The majority of forces had already fallen, and those that had not died were still fleeing, so how could they have the time to attend some wedding?
Ling Han smiled.
Since there were two Imperial Clans, this was just right, saving him the trouble of making another trip.
He sat at the side and began eating.
No one cared if he was qualified to sit here or not.
In truth, there were too many elites.
Though every single one of them had restrained their aura, added together, they still formed a powerful oppressive force.
Without a high enough cultivation level, coming here would only be seeking their own humiliation.
Ling Han waited quietly.
He was not in a rush to reveal his identity yet.
At noon, the banquet began, and dishes were served.
However, there was still no sign of the bride and groom.
They would definitely only come out during the evening banquet.
The Ziwei Imperial Clan didn’t move the sun along with them.
This was relatively difficult.
After all, the sun was a giant fireball, and it was difficult to set up formations.
It wasn’t that it couldn’t be done, but the price was too high.
However, the Saint of the Ziwei Imperial Clan had still used his great power to create a sun.
If it was only used to illuminate the Ziwei Imperial Clan, it was naturally more than enough.
Very quickly, the light dimmed, and the bright moon rose — this was also the handiwork of a Saint.
There were even more guests at night, and this was the real banquet.
A group of people were walking around, and this was a good opportunity for them to get to know people and expand their networks.
"This brother looks unfamiliar.
How should I address you?" Just as Ling Han was eating and drinking with his head lowered, he saw someone approach with a wine cup in hand, taking the initiative to strike up a conversation.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before saying, "Gao Bupan?"
What kind of name was that?
That person thought for a moment, and immediately understood.
This was <anno data-annotation-id="ceecde30-a5d6-4a09-a703-9f2e2c71e1d7" data-title="unattainable">unattainable1</anno>.
Hiss, was there anyone as shameless as you?
"Humph!" That person instantly flicked his sleeves and left.
Ling Han smiled, and continued to eat and drink.
Later, he was going to cause a great commotion at the wedding, and he was not here to make friends.
After a while, he shockingly discovered that the person from before had actually come again.
Furthermore, there was another person beside him, dressed in a tight-fitting green suit.
"I heard that you’re very proud!" the man in green said coldly.
Ling Han was surprised, "What does my pride have to do with you?"
"My name is Baili Bahuang!" the man in green said proudly.
Oh, so he was a member of the Baili Clan.
Ling Han glanced at him.
This person was at the level of Sect Master.
He was about a thousand years old, and it could be said that his natural talent was astonishing.
He smiled, "I also have another nickname, and that is Zhen <anno data-annotation-id="b9aeb799-b085-4445-b8c9-b894c82df5c6" data-title="Baili.">Baili.1</anno>"
<annotations style="display: none;">MC’s alias literally means that he was ’unattainable’.Literally translates to suppressing Baili Clan.</annotations>

chapters.title: Chapter 4699: Again
paragraphs: Hiss!
The person who had spoken up earlier couldn’t help but inhale sharply. This was too arrogant, wasn’t it?
On the Ziwei Planet, you actually dare call yourself Zhen Baili, aren’t you afraid of being blasted into dust?
"How dare you!" Baili Bahuang flew into a thunderous rage. He did not believe that Ling Han really had the nickname of "Zhen Baili", but was something that the latter had come up with.
His expression turned cold, and he was just about to make a move.
Ling Han waved his hand, and said, "Think about it. Today is Baili Tian’s wedding day. Aren’t you afraid of making that Imperial Son unhappy, and he would use you as a sacrifice?"
When these words fell, Baili Bahuang’s aura immediately weakened.
If a fight broke out at the wedding venue, it was naturally not auspicious, what more when it involved murder and bloodshed.
Moreover, Baili Tian had already experienced a failed wedding once, so he was especially sensitive about this. If he caused any commotion, this person would probably go crazy.

Although the person with the greatest hopes of becoming Emperor in the Baili Clan now was Baili Haojie, Baili Tian was still a Golden Generation after all. Even if he couldn’t become Emperor, he still had a high chance of becoming a nine-star Saint. He was still very impressive.
Thus, Baili Bahuang had to consider carefully.
"You are indeed very arrogant," Baili Bahuang said in a baleful voice. He had already suppressed his urge, but he would definitely not give up just like that.
When the wedding ended, this guy would know the consequences of being insolent in the Baili Clan.
Humph, how ignorant and fearless.
He didn’t leave, and he simply sat down at this table. He definitely wouldn’t give Ling Han the chance to sneak away.
Ling Han didn’t mind, and continued to eat and drink.
Time slowly passed, and finally, the bride and groom came out, preparing to pay their respects and complete the ceremony.𝑓𝑟𝑒𝘦𝓌𝑒𝑏𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝘭.𝒸𝘰𝑚
When this couple was about to bow to the heaven and earth, Ling Han suddenly stood up.
Sigh, without the cooperation of the large black dog, he could only do things himself.
Hiss, what do you want to do?
Baili Bahuang couldn’t help but feel shocked. If Ling Han dared to ruin the wedding in front of him, then he would definitely be reprimanded by Baili Tian afterwards.
"Sit down quickly!" he hurriedly shouted.
How could Ling Han possibly pay any heed to him? He said calmly, "I object!"
’I! Object!’
Though these three words were melodious, they were like a resounding bell, deafening.
Yi?
Who was being insolent?
No one asked if anyone objected, so why did you suddenly jump out to join in on the excitement?
Was he seeking death?
Meanwhile, Baili Tian’s expression darkened, and a strong sense of familiarity rose up in him.
’F*ck! This scene is so familiar!’
"How dare you!" Baili Bahuang could no longer bear it, and immediately moved to attack Ling Han.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "Sit down, and watch the show obediently."
Pa, Baili Bahuang immediately flopped onto the ground, feeling his mind go blank. Then, a layer of cold sweat broke out on his back, and his hands and feet were completely cold.
This was far too terrifying. It was as if he were facing a Great Emperor.
"Impudence!" One of the elites from the Peacock Imperial Clan shouted immediately, "Which arrogant brat dares to be impudent in this place!"
This was not only the Baili Clan’s wedding, but also the Kong Clan’s.
However, someone from the Baili Clan immediately spoke up, and said balefully, "Ling Han, how dare you come here!"
What, Ling Han?
The elite from the Peacock Clan immediately shut his mouth, not daring to make another sound.
Though he was also a Venerate Tier, could he compare to Ling Han?
Who didn’t know that Ling Han was capable of matching Saints? In fact, he was actually capable of sweeping aside all opposition below five stars of Saint-level.
In front of Ling Han, who was he?
Ling Han chuckled, and mumbled, "You speak as if I’ve never been here before."
Though this was a murmur, quite a number of people had heard it, which immediately made the members of the Baili Clan feel stifled.

Indeed, Ling Han had already come once, and he had even ransacked the ancestral grounds. Even now, this was still a great humiliation to the Baili Clan. This was something that had never happened before in hundreds of millions of years.
What could the Baili Clan do?
Ling Han was still alive and well.
And now, he had come again!
"Ling Han, you are really courting death!" A Saint from the Baili Clan stepped out. He was a six-star Saint. Otherwise, he would not have dared to step out.
Who didn’t know that Ling Han was capable of matching a Five Star Saint?
However, the Galaxy Network was already cut off, and there was no news. The Baili Clan definitely couldn’t anticipate that Ling Han had already become a Saint.
—If he had known, he probably would not have jumped out now.
Ling Han had become a Saint, and he had absorbed Regulations, assimilating with heaven and earth. If he didn’t reveal his aura, no one would be able to see through him.
He smiled slightly, "Don’t you guys think that this wedding is too monotonous?"
’F*ck! Are you trying to add to the excitement of the wedding?’
This was practically causing trouble, all right!
"You’ve gone too far!" The six-star Saint stretched out a finger, and pressed it down on Ling Han.
This was the Ziwei Planet. In the past, it had been reinforced by the Great Emperor. Otherwise, he would definitely not dare make a move on his home planet.

Ling Han also pointed a finger at the six-star Saint. He then turned to the bride who was wearing a red veil, and said, "I say, young lady, have you considered carefully? Do you really want to marry that guy?"
Peng!
The two attacks collided, instantly setting off a terrifying storm of energy. Instantly, figures flew, and the ground trembled. The entire city was on the verge of collapse.
The Ziwei Planet had been strengthened by the Great Emperor, so there was no fear of it being destroyed by Saints. However, this didn’t mean that the structures on it were the same.
In short, in this short while, the wedding venue was already in a complete mess.

Baili Tian was in a towering rage. He very much wanted to make a move himself, but firstly, he was the groom, so it was not appropriate. Secondly, in the grounds of the Chi Clan, he had already made a move once. Though he had been a Half-Saint then, he had still been beaten up by Ling Han.
Under the strong psychological trauma, he unconsciously cowered in front of Ling Han.
"As expected of the greatest prodigy of all eternity!" Baili Haojie appeared, looking down on Ling Han with disdain and condescension.
He was the son of a Great Emperor, and now, he was a six-star Saint!
They were both six-star Saints, so how could his battle prowess compare to that Saint from before?
His battle prowess... was as high as eighteen stars, and this was without taking into account the blessing of the power of belief.
"However, what kind of place do you think this is?" he asked balefully, his killing intent soaring.

"Cough!" Ling Han waved his hand, indicating for Baili Haojie to calm down. "The reason why I have come here today is mainly to deliver a notice, inviting your Baili Clan to join my alliance and join forces to resist the invasion of the Netherworld."
"As for the matter of the wedding, hehe, it can’t be helped. I’m a straightforward person, and I can’t bear to see anyone fall into a fire pit, so I stepped out to speak up for justice."
’Holy f*ck! Is this the attitude of an invitation?’
He had already ruined their wedding, so who would want to form an alliance with him?
"Oh, that’s right. Since the Kong Clan is also here, I’ll inform them as well. Come, join my alliance," Ling Han added.
"Ling Han, are you daydreaming?" Baili Haojie said coldly. He had already lost his patience.
Are you toying with the Baili Clan like we are monkeys?
Ling Han sighed, "You see, I am very seriously and sincerely negotiating with you."
"Die!" Baili Haojie couldn’t endure it any longer, and he launched an attack at Ling Han.
