chapters.title: Chapter 4700: Threat
paragraphs: Ling Han activated the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and suddenly moved at an indescribably fast speed.
’What?’
Baili Haojie paled in shock. How had Ling Han suddenly arrived in front of him?

However, after a moment of shock, he calmed down. The other had grasped the True Phoenix’s movement technique, and his speed was indeed fast. However, he was a six-star Saint, and was also the son of a Great Emperor. Just how powerful was his battle prowess?
Aren’t you just walking right into a trap?
"If you want to die, I’ll oblige you!" He sent out a palm strike towards Ling Han.

If they distanced themselves from each other and exchanged blows, then even if one was outmatched, he would still have a chance to escape. However, if they were to exchange blows at close quarters, it was possible that the outcome of the battle would be revealed in just a few moves.
Saints were hard to kill, but he could not help it that Ling Han was seeking death.
Boom, he sent out a palm strike, eighteen streaks of eight-star Regulations entwined around it, indescribably mighty.
Baili Haojie couldn’t be bothered to use the power of belief at all. With his battle prowess of eighteen stars, how could it be that he couldn’t suppress a puny Fourth Extreme?
Ling Han smiled, and waved out a palm.
Peng!
Without a doubt, Baili Haojie flew out and instantly became a small black dot in the horizon, disappearing into space.
This!
In an instant, everyone was dumbfounded, their minds completely blank.
F***, was there something wrong with their eyes?
Baili Haojie was a six-star Saint!
He was actually sent flying with a single palm strike?
You’ve got to be joking, right? It must be fake, right?
However, they only saw Ling Han standing proudly where he was. As for Baili Haojie, well, there was no sign of him at all.
How was this possible!
Everyone was numb with shock. This was too terrifying, wasn’t it? Just how powerful was Ling Han?
"You’ve become a Saint!" Baili Tian said in a trembling voice.
Right now, most of the young king tiers had already become Saints. Only Ling Han was an exception.
But it was this one exception that was the strongest prodigy in history.
And now, this guy had become a Saint.
This was too terrifying. Baili Haojie, a six-star Saint, was actually sent flying with a single palm strike. That was the battle prowess of an eighteen-star Saint.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "That um, you guys haven’t answered my suggestion yet?"

"You’ve gone too far!" The nine-star Saint from the Baili Clan stepped forward. His name was Baili Chao, and he had already lived for over 900,000 years. His entire body was exuding an aura of decay, and the flame of life was on the verge of extinguishing.
However, once this kind of old Saint unleashed his might, he would still possess a terrifying battle prowess that would cause heaven and earth to pale in colour.
He directly drew the Imperial Weapon. The Purple Star Sword floated above his head. It had already awakened, and was emitting Imperial Might.
Ling Han chuckled, and similarly drew the Clear Bamboo Sword..
The Imperial Weapons cancelled each other out, and he was still invincible.
This!
The members of the Baili Clan were all sullen. Could it be that they would have retreat to their ancestral grounds, and depend on the Great Emperor formation for protection?

After entering the Imperial Formation, so what if Ling Han possessed the Imperial Weapon? There was a time limit to the might of the Imperial Weapon, but the power of the Great Emperor Formation originated from the compressed stars, which were endless.
Thus, it was because of this that the Imperial Clans had such powerful confidence. Even if they were trapped, they would at least be able to ensure their safety.
But the problem was, being forced by a Saint to the point that they could only struggle at death’s door in the ancestral grounds, how could they bear with that?

"Ling Han, what exactly do you want to do?" Baili Chao was afraid now. The situation was far too dire right now, so Ling Han’s battle prowess was already extremely terrifying. Moreover, he also possessed the Imperial Weapon, so who in the world could stop him?
Probably only Pseudo-Emperors, right?
Unfortunately, the Baili Clan did not have any Pseudo-Emperor.
"Huh? Didn’t I say? Join my alliance," Ling Han said with a smile. "When Yin souls invade, no one can stay out of it."
"What if we refuse?" Baili Chao asked. If they were really forced to agree by Ling Han like this, that would really be too vexing.
Ling Han hadn’t even finished speaking when he saw a figure descend from the sky. It was Baili Haojie.
His expression was livid, his fury blazing.
He was the son of a Great Emperor, and he had actually been sent flying with a single palm strike. How could he accept this?
"Ling Han!" he said through gritted teeth.
"Yo, you’re back so soon," Ling Han greeted.
"Damn guy!" Baili Haojie snatched the Ziwei Sword=, and said, "Let’s battle again!"
"Come on," Ling Han said with a hook of his finger. If he wanted the Ziwei Imperial Clan to join his alliance, he obviously couldn’t rely on words alone. He had to force them into submission.
Baili Haojie charged over, while Ling Han unleashed his Imperial Weapon to oppose the Ziwei Sword.
Boom!
Imperial Weapon against Imperial Weapon, Saint against Saint.
It was impossible that anyone who could become a Great Emperor would be weaker than the other. However, it was a different story for Saints.
Pa, Ling Han sent out a palm strike, and Baili Haojie turned into a black dot again, disappearing into the horizon.
This...

Everyone was speechless. This time, Baili Haojie had obviously used the power of belief. It could be said that aside from the holy flame, he had already gone all out, but was still no match for Ling Han, which showed how great the gap between the two of them was.
The greatest prodigy of all eternity. Once he became a Saint, he would have the strength to sweep aside all opposition in Silent Destruction Tier.
Who could not submit?

Ling Han withdrew his palm as if nothing had happened, and said to Baili Chao, "If you guys refuse, then I can only go on a killing spree! In front of a great enemy, you guys are still so selfish. You only worry about yourselves, so what is the point of leaving you alive?"

These words caused the expressions of all the members of the Baili Clan to change drastically. Ling Han was too strong. If they were really targeted by him, they could only duck into the Great Emperor formation.
However, with how domineering this guy was, if he attacked madly with the Imperial Weapon, would the Great Emperor Formation collapse?
Though the advantage of the Great Emperor Formation was that it could be channeled continuously, in terms of power alone, it was inferior to the Imperial Weapon.

After all, after the awakening of the Imperial Weapon, it was equivalent to the arrival of the Great Emperor himself. However, the Imperial Weapon was only one of the arrangements that the Great Emperor had set up.
Baili Chao gritted his teeth, and said, "All right, let’s form an alliance!"
Ling Han smiled and said, "That’s more like it. Come, let’s discuss the details."
Not only were there members of the Baili Clan, but even the Saints of the Peacock Clan also sat down to discuss the matter of the alliance.

In addition to some ordinary offensive and defensive assistance, Ling Han also took advantage of the opening to make an exorbitant demand, demanding a large amount of cultivation resources from the two great Imperial Clans.
He had already become a Saint, so there were really too few Great Herbs that could help him improve. Even the two great Imperial Clans could not produce them.
However, he still had a great many friends and family by his side, such as Lin Luo, Zhou Heng, Karmic Life Heavenly Venerable and so on. None of them had become a Saint.

Being able to cultivate to Heavenly Venerable Tier in Genesis World, even if they were inferior to rulers of the Genesis World, they still possessed astonishing natural talent in cultivation. Once they became Saints, their battle prowess would definitely be extraordinary, and it was precisely battle prowess that he needed the most at present.
"You’ve gone too far!" the two Imperial Clans objected. This was an attempt to rob them clean.

Ling Han did not speak either. He stretched out his hand, and 30 eight-star Regulations surged out. Furthermore, he had also released his own holy flame. It was white, and clearly showed that he presently was still only a One Star Saint.
’Holy f*ck!’
The Saints from the two Imperial Clans were all so shocked that the corners of their mouths twitched. A One Star Saint was capable of using 30 Eight Star Regulations; what kind of concept was that?

Even if Baili Haojie was the son of a Great Emperor, and had excellent natural talent, when he had reached the level of Nine Star Saint, he would only be able to use 30 flashes of Eight Star Regulations, which was his maximum.
But what about Ling Han?
This was a One Star Saint!
They were all thinking that if Ling Han had reached the level of Nine Star Saint, would he be able to match a Pseudo-Emperor, or even... defeat a Pseudo-Emperor?
And if this guy had reached Pseudo-Emperor-level?
They didn’t dare to think about it anymore. That would be too terrifying.

sentences.text: Ling Han activated the Phoenix Wings Divine Flight and suddenly moved at an indescribably fast speed.
’What?’
Baili Haojie paled in shock.
How had Ling Han suddenly arrived in front of him?
However, after a moment of shock, he calmed down.
The other had grasped the True Phoenix’s movement technique, and his speed was indeed fast.
However, he was a six-star Saint, and was also the son of a Great Emperor.
Just how powerful was his battle prowess?
Aren’t you just walking right into a trap?
"If you want to die, I’ll oblige you!" He sent out a palm strike towards Ling Han.
If they distanced themselves from each other and exchanged blows, then even if one was outmatched, he would still have a chance to escape.
However, if they were to exchange blows at close quarters, it was possible that the outcome of the battle would be revealed in just a few moves.
Saints were hard to kill, but he could not help it that Ling Han was seeking death.
Boom, he sent out a palm strike, eighteen streaks of eight-star Regulations entwined around it, indescribably mighty.
Baili Haojie couldn’t be bothered to use the power of belief at all.
With his battle prowess of eighteen stars, how could it be that he couldn’t suppress a puny Fourth Extreme?
Ling Han smiled, and waved out a palm.
Peng!
Without a doubt, Baili Haojie flew out and instantly became a small black dot in the horizon, disappearing into space.
This!
In an instant, everyone was dumbfounded, their minds completely blank.
F***, was there something wrong with their eyes?
Baili Haojie was a six-star Saint!
He was actually sent flying with a single palm strike?
You’ve got to be joking, right?
It must be fake, right?
However, they only saw Ling Han standing proudly where he was.
As for Baili Haojie, well, there was no sign of him at all.
How was this possible!
Everyone was numb with shock.
This was too terrifying, wasn’t it?
Just how powerful was Ling Han?
"You’ve become a Saint!" Baili Tian said in a trembling voice.
Right now, most of the young king tiers had already become Saints.
Only Ling Han was an exception.
But it was this one exception that was the strongest prodigy in history.
And now, this guy had become a Saint.
This was too terrifying.
Baili Haojie, a six-star Saint, was actually sent flying with a single palm strike.
That was the battle prowess of an eighteen-star Saint.
Ling Han smiled faintly, "That um, you guys haven’t answered my suggestion yet?"
"You’ve gone too far!" The nine-star Saint from the Baili Clan stepped forward.
His name was Baili Chao, and he had already lived for over 900,000 years.
His entire body was exuding an aura of decay, and the flame of life was on the verge of extinguishing.
However, once this kind of old Saint unleashed his might, he would still possess a terrifying battle prowess that would cause heaven and earth to pale in colour.
He directly drew the Imperial Weapon.
The Purple Star Sword floated above his head.
It had already awakened, and was emitting Imperial Might.
Ling Han chuckled, and similarly drew the Clear Bamboo Sword..
The Imperial Weapons cancelled each other out, and he was still invincible.
This!
The members of the Baili Clan were all sullen.
Could it be that they would have retreat to their ancestral grounds, and depend on the Great Emperor formation for protection?
After entering the Imperial Formation, so what if Ling Han possessed the Imperial Weapon?
There was a time limit to the might of the Imperial Weapon, but the power of the Great Emperor Formation originated from the compressed stars, which were endless.
Thus, it was because of this that the Imperial Clans had such powerful confidence.
Even if they were trapped, they would at least be able to ensure their safety.
But the problem was, being forced by a Saint to the point that they could only struggle at death’s door in the ancestral grounds, how could they bear with that?
"Ling Han, what exactly do you want to do?" Baili Chao was afraid now.
The situation was far too dire right now, so Ling Han’s battle prowess was already extremely terrifying.
Moreover, he also possessed the Imperial Weapon, so who in the world could stop him?
Probably only Pseudo-Emperors, right?
Unfortunately, the Baili Clan did not have any Pseudo-Emperor.
"Huh?
Didn’t I say?
Join my alliance," Ling Han said with a smile.
"When Yin souls invade, no one can stay out of it."
"What if we refuse?" Baili Chao asked.
If they were really forced to agree by Ling Han like this, that would really be too vexing.
Ling Han hadn’t even finished speaking when he saw a figure descend from the sky.
It was Baili Haojie.
His expression was livid, his fury blazing.
He was the son of a Great Emperor, and he had actually been sent flying with a single palm strike.
How could he accept this?
"Ling Han!" he said through gritted teeth.
"Yo, you’re back so soon," Ling Han greeted.
"Damn guy!" Baili Haojie snatched the Ziwei Sword=, and said, "Let’s battle again!"
"Come on," Ling Han said with a hook of his finger.
If he wanted the Ziwei Imperial Clan to join his alliance, he obviously couldn’t rely on words alone.
He had to force them into submission.
Baili Haojie charged over, while Ling Han unleashed his Imperial Weapon to oppose the Ziwei Sword.
Boom!
Imperial Weapon against Imperial Weapon, Saint against Saint.
It was impossible that anyone who could become a Great Emperor would be weaker than the other.
However, it was a different story for Saints.
